job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get To Know Our Team:

The People Team is a purveyor of opportunity, searching the globe for the most talented individuals and offering them an open, collaborative workplace. By prioritizing skill and potential, we have cultivated a powerful assembly of professionals through our drive for equal opportunity and diversity. We make the move to Agoda a breeze with assisted onboarding programs, and we continue to support and enrich our thousands of Agoda employees through individual growth with outstanding learning programs and various means of assistance. Our development of incredible benefits has ensured everyone can stay strong, healthy, and happy during their time at Agoda. Leading ambitious changes and making a positive impact in the lives of our employees, the People Team is a crucial and rewarding part of the Agoda family.

The Opportunity:

We are looking for someone to be part of our Global Employee Relations Team (based in either in Kuala Lumpur (Bangkok may also be offered) as a Consultant, Employee Relations. Our Employee Relations team works closely with key stakeholders including our Legal/Compliance team, Talent Business Partner, HR Business Partners and the Senior Management Team to support employees in challenging circumstances, and we seek to identify trends and share insights to adjust our people management practices to get the best talent outcomes. We advise and enable managers to make the best possible decisions, challenging practices that go beyond legal obligation to protect our unique culture at Agoda.

We are looking for someone who combines great execution, can effectively handle multiple competing priorities, with the intellectual disposition to challenge current practices.

In this Role, you’ll get to:

  • Act as the subject matter expert on compliance and company policies and procedures, providing advice to managers and employees.
  • Coach, counsel, and guide managers in managing employees with poor performance and handling misconduct cases.
  • Support managers in the execution and tracking of disciplinary actions according to the local laws and regulations.
  • Handle terminations, ensuring the right steps are taken and the right documentation is used so that the risk of labor claims is minimized.
  • Conduct impartial investigations into grievances and serve as a dedicated Employee Relations partner, identifying trends and insights to inform procedural improvements.
  • Manage employee relations case timelines and deliverables, ensuring timely stakeholder updates and high‑quality documentation
  • Analyze performance management data and past misconduct cases to develop recommendations for capability building, policy revisions, training enhancements, and more effective management practices.
  • Act as an HR Business Partner to a dedicated Department to share actionable insights and trends.
  • Spearhead automation and improvements towards internal process such as (but not limited to) performance management, offboarding, etc.

To be successful in this position, it will help you to have:

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Law, or related field.
  • Minimum 8-10 years’ experience in Employee Relations or HR Business Partnering/Generalist roles, with deep expertise in employment law, complex investigations, disciplinary processes, terminations, workforce reduction projects, and high-risk employee relations matters across multiple jurisdictions or business units.
  • Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders on sensitive and business-critical people issues, while balancing legal risk, employee experience, and organizational culture.

Skills & Attributes

  • Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, and sound judgment in navigating complex, high-impact, and highly sensitive employee relations matters.
  • Ability to operate with a high degree of independence and provide strategic recommendations on employee relations risks, case management, and people practices.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with confidence and credibility to influence senior leaders and challenge perspectives constructively.
  • High attention to detail, ownership, reliability, and ethical standards, including discretion and confidentiality.
  • Ability to cope well with ambiguity, manage change effectively, and lead through competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven ability to identify trends, generate insights from ER data, and drive improvements in policies, processes, training, and manager capability.

Communication

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate risks, recommendations, and case strategies to senior stakeholders across functions and geographies.

It’s Great if you Have:

  • Curiosity and readiness to challenge current practices and perspectives.
  • Great attention to detail.
  • Great sense of ownership, reliability, and accountability.
  • Multicultural or international experience.
  • Humility, flexibility, and strong interpersonal skills.
  • Experience leading regional or enterprise-wide employee relations projects, policy enhancements, or process transformation initiatives.

The Tax (Senior) Manager for VAT and Indirect Taxes will lead all aspects of indirect tax compliance and advisory for UK and Ireland. This role ensures accurate reporting, risk management, and strategic tax planning while supporting business growth and transformation initiatives. This is a great opportunity to join us on an initial 12-month contract on a full-time basis (part time also an option) as we evolve our approach to VAT with exposure to a variety of interesting and challenging topics.

The role will be published until 9 August 2026.

 

About Our Offer  

  • Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.
  • Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.
  • A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.
  • Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams
  • Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.

 

  

About The Job 

  • Compliance & Reporting – Support the review of UK and Irish VAT returns, Intrastat, RCT, and other indirect tax filings.
  • Maintain robust internal controls and processes for indirect tax compliance.
  • Advisory & Risk Management
  • Provide practical, commercially focused VAT advice on complex transactions, cross-border trade, and business projects.
  • Monitor legislative changes and assess impact on the business.
  • Drive improvements in VAT reporting systems and data management.
  • Implement tax technology solutions to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
  • Partner with finance, legal, treasury, and operational teams to ensure consistent tax practices.
  • Mentor and develop junior tax team members.
  • Contribute to wider tax strategy and transformation projects

About You  

  • Professional qualification (CTA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent).
  • Extensive experience in UK and Irish VAT and indirect taxes, ideally within a multinational or Big 4 environment.
  • Strong technical knowledge of VAT legislation and compliance requirements.
  • Proven ability to manage complex projects and communicate technical concepts clearly.
  • Experience with tax technology and ERP systems (e.g., SAP) is desirable.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Commercial mindset with ability to balance compliance and business objectives.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work under pressure.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please do let us know.

Job Description

Conrad Indianapolis is looking for a Human Resources Generalist to join the Team! This is an amazing opportunity to grow your career in a Fortune 500 company within a sophisticated luxury brand.

At Marriott International, you have the opportunity to grow in your career, work with teammates that feel like family, and help make our world a better place. As the #1 leader in hospitality worldwide, a career with Marriott provides an open road to opportunity and growth.

The Voyage Global Leadership Development Program

Voyage: Training tomorrow’s leaders today

Marriott International welcomes recent university graduates to experience the career development adventure of a lifetime and a world of leadership opportunities. Our global leadership development program, Voyage, propels participants on a mentored, learning-inspired journey to prepare you for a successful career. Voyage is a full-time, paid development program. As an associate and trainee, you’ll build upon the skills you developed in school by participating in real world assignments.

About The Journey

Voyage is an elite, award-winning program that provides a combination of hands-on, discipline-specific training and a leadership-focused curriculum. The program takes place at a Marriott International managed hotel, not a classroom, and is offered in 50+ countries. Voyage is available in the following disciplines:

  • Accounting & Finance
  • Culinary
  • Engineering
  • Event Operations
  • Event Planning
  • Food & Beverage Operations
  • Human Resources
  • Revenue Management
  • Rooms Operations
  • Sales & Marketing
  • Information Technology
  • Residences

When you join Voyage, you gain access to Marriott’s senior leaders and coaches and have many opportunities to stand out. You’ll participate in mini-rotations across the disciplines to learn firsthand how to manage various hotel functions and to connect with current and former Voyage participants through our social collaboration tools. Voyage is a 18 months full-time program. You’ll immediately be immersed in our rich culture and portfolio of global brands to learn how Marriott sets the standard of industry excellence.

The Experience You’ll Gain

Voyage participants learn by doing! You’ll be fully immersed in the day-to-day operations of a hotel. If accepted into this elite program, you will:

  • Cultivate customer relationships
  • Be a champion for innovation within the organization
  • Get exposure to managing projects & people
  • Improve processes & pitch new initiatives through your Voyage project
  • Take on special projects that will draw upon all your training

Destination: Marriott leadership

You’ll participate in management meetings and collaborate with Voyage participants worldwide. You’ll be expected to solve challenges, as well as offer ideas and innovative solutions. You will also have an opportunity to provide feedback on your curriculum and have an impact on future Voyage hires’ experiences. After graduation, you’ll be well-prepared to pursue your passion and take on new challenges. Many program graduates are ready to step into a Marriott supervisory or entry-level management role right away, because the program has provided a foundation for future leadership.

Ready to embark?

To become a Voyage participant, you must have graduated from a university or hotel school within the past year. Other qualifications include:

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent higher level education required (Associates degree acceptable for Culinary)
  • Superior critical thinking & interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to foster relationships & work collaboratively
  • Self-manage & be a self-starter
  • Real desire for personal & professional growth
  • Work authorization in the country you apply (local citizen or permanent resident)
  • Those currently enrolled in a college/university with an expected graduation date within 12 months of the date of application may also be considered.
  • Please note that the onboarding period may vary based on available positions. This application is for the 2026 Voyage Program intake. Kindly complete the video interview upon successful submission of your application online, and the hiring team will contact you if shortlisted.

To stay connected and receive updates on future opportunities, company news, and career tips, we invite you to join our Talent Community (careers.marriott.com/talent-community).

Want to learn more?

Visit Marriott.com/EarlyCareers

The Tax (Senior) Manager for VAT and Indirect Taxes will lead all aspects of indirect tax compliance and advisory for UK and Ireland. This role ensures accurate reporting, risk management, and strategic tax planning while supporting business growth and transformation initiatives. This is a great opportunity to join us on an initial 12-month contract on a full-time basis (part time also an option) as we evolve our approach to VAT with exposure to a variety of interesting and challenging topics.

The role will be published until 9 August 2026.

 

About Our Offer  

  • Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.
  • Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment.
  • A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.
  • Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams
  • Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.

 

  

About The Job 

  • Compliance & Reporting – Support the review of UK and Irish VAT returns, Intrastat, RCT, and other indirect tax filings.
  • Maintain robust internal controls and processes for indirect tax compliance.
  • Advisory & Risk Management
  • Provide practical, commercially focused VAT advice on complex transactions, cross-border trade, and business projects.
  • Monitor legislative changes and assess impact on the business.
  • Drive improvements in VAT reporting systems and data management.
  • Implement tax technology solutions to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
  • Partner with finance, legal, treasury, and operational teams to ensure consistent tax practices.
  • Mentor and develop junior tax team members.
  • Contribute to wider tax strategy and transformation projects

About You  

  • Professional qualification (CTA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent).
  • Extensive experience in UK and Irish VAT and indirect taxes, ideally within a multinational or Big 4 environment.
  • Strong technical knowledge of VAT legislation and compliance requirements.
  • Proven ability to manage complex projects and communicate technical concepts clearly.
  • Experience with tax technology and ERP systems (e.g., SAP) is desirable.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Commercial mindset with ability to balance compliance and business objectives.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work under pressure.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please do let us know.

Company Description

Accor is a world leader in the hotel industry, present in 110 countries, with more than 5,500 hotels and 10,000 restaurants and bars. The group deploys an integrated hotel ecosystem that is among the most diversified in the sector, notably associating luxury and high-end brands, mid-range and economic offers, exclusive lifestyle concepts, venues for shows and entertainment, clubs, restaurants and bars, private residences, shared accommodation, Qantas Lounges, concierge services and co-working spaces. Accor has a portfolio of incomparable brands, led by more than 300,000 employees around the world.

Job Description

As a Franchise Operations Executive at Accor, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that our franchisee-operated hotels across the Pacific region uphold the highest standards of compliance and operational excellence.

This dynamic, high-impact position offers you the unique opportunity to influence and guide General Managers and Franchisees as well as their hotel leadership teams, masterfully balancing Accor corporate objectives with individual hotel goals – you will be responsible for enabling the franchisee performance with Accor and delivering Accor deliverables in their hotels.

In this role, you will drive regional success by seamlessly integrating new partners, training teams to optimise Accor systems and ensuring total compliance across brand standards, safety, ESG, and global commercial systems and platforms.

If you are a relationship-driven hospitality professional looking to make a significant, visible impact in a fast-paced and evolving environment, this is your next career step.

This is a 6-month fixed-term contract opportunity.

Getting To Know The Role And Your Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic support and training for hotels on Accor systems (e.g., Anais and TARS) during the integration process and on going support.
  • Act as the primary liaison for franchise hotels, resolving daily inquiries and administrative issues promptly.
  • Assist in onboarding new staff, fostering open communication, and supporting the rollout of Heartist culture initiatives in hotels.
  • Manage information flow between hotels and the Accor network.
  • Monitor hotel compliance with contractual obligations and Accor agreements.
  • Oversee regional performance against Loyalty, NPS, RPS and distribution targets.
  • Work closely with the VP of Franchise to support franchise network growth and integration of new hotels.
  • Evaluate the financial impact of activities, implementing measures to enhance Accor's web direct performance across franchise hotels.

Qualifications

What we need from you

  • Minimum of 5 years' experience in hotel operations, distribution, sales, or marketing, with a focus on commercial distribution and operations.
  • Proven track record in managing and influencing teams, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture.
  • Ability to understand and navigate complex stakeholder environments, building strong relationships across various levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to guide, train, and influence teams towards achieving organisational goals.
  • Confident and articulate in communication, with strong relationship-building and networking abilities.
  • Strong personal integrity with an entrepreneurial spirit, drive, ambition, and a high level of energy.
  • Ability to engage effectively with individuals at all organisational levels.
  • Demonstrated flexibility and responsiveness to change in dynamic environments.

Additional Information

Benefits

  • Enjoy discounted Heartist® rates across our global network of 5,600 properties, 10,000 food and beverage venues, and wellness centers.
  • Grow and travel with your career globally across more than 110 countries, 45 hotel brands from luxury and lifestyle to premium and economy.

We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

This role is based in Sydney, Australia. Only applicants who currently hold full working rights in Australia will be considered.

Candidate screening and interviews may be conducted prior to the closing date of the advertisement. Accor reserves the right to close applications for the position prior to the advertised date. We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

job.job_description:
Join Marella Cruises and help us become the UK's most loved cruise line by leading hotel refurbishment projects across our fleet. You'll drive innovative solutions and own the complete delivery of unique refurbishment works that directly enhance our guests' experiences.

The role will be published until 9th August 2026.

About Our Offer

  • Personal benefits: Attractive remuneration, discretionary bonus schemes, generous travel benefits, extensive health & well-being support, and more.
  • Flexible working: Work is something you do, not somewhere you go. We encourage a healthy work-life balance with a dynamic working environment, including hybrid working from our Southampton office with a minimum of one day per week in the office.
  • A career to shape: Access the TUI Learning Hub to level-up and reach your ambitions.
  • Broaden your network: We champion intercultural collaboration and provide opportunities to work on global projects and teams.
  • Community: Get involved with incredible local charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation.

About The Job

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of hotel refurbishment projects across the Marella Cruises fleet, from initial scoping through to final handover, ensuring we meet quality, timescale and budget parameters.
  • Coordinate specialist resources and riding crews to ensure the right capability and readiness are in place to deliver approved refurbishment and maintenance works safely and effectively.
  • Define and manage work scopes for riding team activity, ensuring labour, tools, materials and access arrangements support safe, efficient and right-first-time delivery.
  • We'll trust you to manage the delivery of fleet signage works, coordinating with Product, Brand and operational teams to implement approved requirements to agreed standards.
  • Deliver standardised hotel refurbishment materials, specifications and equipment across projects, ensuring the correct products are selected and applied consistently across the fleet.
  • Maintain our approved materials and equipment library, keeping specifications current and ensuring vessel ordering remains aligned to approved requirements.

About You

  • Maritime experience is essential - you'll have proven experience in marine design, hotel refurbishment or related trades within the maritime industry, with a solid understanding of the constraints and legislation involved in marine projects.
  • Proven experience in planning and logistical support when managing contractor trades, with the ability to coordinate multiple moving parts effectively.
  • You'll bring broad working knowledge of equipment and materials manufacturers and suppliers supporting the marine hotel refurbishment industry.
  • We're looking for someone with a genuine interest in developing their expertise and applying it to enhance the customer product offering on Marella Cruises ships.
  • Strong decision-making abilities and comfort with complete end-to-end ownership in a small, agile team environment where you can drive a new way of working.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please do let us know.

Accor est un leader mondial de l’hospitalité, offrant des expériences dans plus de 110 pays avec 5 700 hôtels, 10 000 restaurants et bars, ainsi que des espaces de bien‑être et de coworking. Le Groupe opère l’un des écosystèmes les plus diversifiés du secteur, grâce à plus de 45 marques hôtelières allant du luxe à l’économie, incluant des marques lifestyle via Ennismore. Accor s’engage à mener des actions concrètes en matière d’éthique des affaires, de tourisme responsable, de développement durable, d’engagement communautaire et de diversité & inclusion.

Avec son vaste portefeuille de 15 marques distinctives et puissantes couvrant les segments Premium, Midscale et Économique dans 48 pays, la région Europe & Afrique du Nord offre aux clients une large gamme d’expériences uniques.

Job Description

Maximize topline performance across franchise hotels by providing expert revenue guidance, proactively identifies performance gaps, and influences franchisees to adopt the right levers and actions. The role ensures strong proximity with hotels, drives improvements in RevPAR, Net RevPAR, and RGI through persuasive support rather than direct control. The role ensures consistent delivery of recommended commercial initiatives within the franchised hotels, strengthens hotels and operations engagement, and focusing on RevPAR, Net RevPAR, and RGI deviations through proximity, rapid issue resolution, and consistent performance follow‑up.

  • Drive RevPAR, Net RevPAR, and RGI improvement across franchised hotels through expert commercial guidance.
  • Proactively identify performance gaps and ensure hotels receive clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Influence franchisees to adopt the right revenue levers through strong proximity, persuasion, and data‑driven insights.
  • Build trusted relationships with franchise owners to secure alignment on commercial priorities and performance expectations.
  • Proactively identify performance gaps and ensure hotels receive clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Coordinate with RMod (when relevant) or RM Services &Product dept as well as Operations to ensure consistent topline strategies across franchised hotels
  • Monitor performance rigorously through structured routines and KPI governance, ensuring follow‑through and measurable impact
  • Ensuring all performance levers are available and measured,building the capabilities needed to accelerate business growth and securing expected results for openings and ramp‑ups.

Mission Principale : Maximiser la performance du chiffre d'affaires (topline) des hôtels franchisés en fournissant des conseils experts en matière de revenus, en identifiant proactivement les écarts de performance et en travaillant avec les franchisés pour adopter les leviers et les actions appropriés. Ce rôle assure une forte proximité avec les hôtels, stimule l'amélioration du RevPAR, du Net RevPAR et du RGI grâce à un soutien persuasif plutôt qu'un contrôle direct. Le/la titulaire du poste garantit la mise en œuvre cohérente des initiatives commerciales recommandées au sein des hôtels franchisés, renforce l'engagement des hôtels et des opérations, et se concentre sur les écarts de RevPAR, Net RevPAR et RGI grâce à la proximité, une résolution rapide des problèmes et un suivi constant de la performance.

Responsabilités Clés

  • Favoriser l'amélioration du RevPAR, du Net RevPAR et du RGI au sein des hôtels franchisés grâce à des conseils commerciaux experts.
  • Identifier proactivement les écarts de performance et s'assurer que les hôtels reçoivent des recommandations claires et actionnables.
  • Influencer les franchisés à adopter les leviers de revenus adéquats grâce à une forte proximité, une persuasion efficace et des informations basées sur les données.
  • Établir des relations de confiance avec les propriétaires franchisés pour assurer l'alignement sur les priorités commerciales et les attentes en matière de performance.
  • Coordonner avec le service RM (Revenue Management) approprié (lorsque pertinent) ou le département RM Services & Produit, ainsi qu'avec les Opérations, pour assurer des stratégies cohérentes à travers les hôtels franchisés.
  • Surveiller rigoureusement la performance via des routines structurées et une gouvernance des KPI, assurant le suivi et un impact mesurable.

Job Description

Group Procurement Organization – Indirect Procurement department

The Indirect Procurement department of the Accor Group is a fundamental pillar of the organization, playing a central role in our cost management strategy. With annual expenditures of approximately €800 million, we oversee a diverse range of spending, particularly in the areas of information technology and digital, marketing and communications, as well as intellectual services.

We are responsible for the entire process, from Source to Contract to Procure to Pay, which allows us to ensure efficient and optimized purchasing management, aligned with the strategic objectives of the company. As strategic business partners for all departments within the Accor Group, we play a vital role in achieving over 10% annual savings, thereby contributing to the financial strength and sustainability of the company. Our team excels through close collaboration with the Finance department.

Incorporated within the Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) that manages both Direct and Indirect procurement for the group, our Indirect Purchasing team consists of 12 specialized category managers, divided between IT and non-IT procurement divisions.

Job Description

As a Category Manager – IT Time & Material Professional Services, fully integrated into the Global Category Management Teams, your responsibilities are:

Category Expertise:

  • Own & propose category strategy for IT T&M Professional services
  • Ease, formulate and deliver the category strategy, the understanding of drivers, market forces, SWOT
  • Support category knowledge to grow procurement offers and drive category expertise

Supplier Management & Procurement Process:

  • Manage T&M and fixed-price Professional Services contracts
  • Secure supplier selection processes through RFI/RFQ procedures
  • Lead negotiation campaigns for daily labor rates
  • Define supplier categorization based on internal stakeholders’ needs in vendor’s management system (SmartConsult).
  • Oversee category supplier management, including governance and business reviews
  • Review & approve purchase orders through Coupa

Spend & Budget

  • Control spend of T&M Professional Services category
  • Responsible for the budget achievement and for cost optimization (cost out & savings)
  • Manage remuneration processes (declaration, budget, forecasts, payments, etc.)
  • Crunch data

Support Category Visibility

  • Support and actively promote the Group procurement functions for indirect procurement
  • Communicate, co-operate and involve relevant stakeholders to drive the overall strategy
  • Engage and secure an open and direct dialogue with stakeholders
  • Able to sell solutions internally

Coordination of transversal projects

  • Participation in sustainability initiatives to support the group sustainable targets
  • Support marketing initiatives to accelerate communication strategy of the corporate procurement department such as internal newsletter, webinars, etc…
  • Track KPIs implementation to monitor category performance & adoption
  • Report & follow remuneration processes
  • Initiative actions to reinforce category expertise

Qualifications

As Category Manager you should :

  • Demonstrate agility & resilience to changes
  • Maintain and improve global performance (Contract, data, savings)
  • Be able to develop the relationship will all brands and customers to increase compliance
  • Develop leadership with internal/external customers to satisfy their expectations by increasing business opportunities worldwide
  • Position is international, and requires to deal with many international stakeholders
  • Manage market uncertainty

In addition, as the right candidate, you should have the below requested formation & experience :

  • At least 3 years’ experience indirect procurement with an international background
  • Relevant work experience in negotiation
  • Proven track record as a category manager
  • Awareness in distribution, BtB, or BtC, E-commerce
  • Contract management
  • Experience in required Professional Services
  • Hospitality experience is a plus

Last but not the least, the candidate should have :

  • Ability to listen & understand to customer’s needs (stakeholders & hotels)
  • Able to work in international environment
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • Influencing skills & ease flexibility in approach between different stakeholders
  • Personal integrity and strong work ethics
  • Required language skills: Fluent English (Daily working language), French will be a plus and any others

Company Description

At Accor, we believe in creating meaningful experiences and vibrant workplaces where people feel welcome and valued. As one of the world’s leading hospitality groups, Accor is home to over 5,000 properties across 110 countries, united by a shared commitment to excellence, innovation, and our signature Heartist culture.

At Sydney Olympic Park, our precinct brings together three iconic brands, Pullman, Novotel, and Ibis. Each offering a distinct guest experience while sharing a unified team spirit. Whether it’s the upscale sophistication of Pullman, the modern comfort of Novotel, or the smart simplicity of Ibis, our hotels work together to deliver exceptional service in one of Sydney’s most dynamic and event-rich locations.

As part of this precinct, you’ll be joining a collaborative, high-energy that thrives on diversity, creativity, and genuine connection. We’re proud to be part of a global network while maintaining a strong local identity, where every team member is empowered to grow, contribute, and make a difference.

Job Description

Join us on a 12 month fixed-term contract as you support the team during a period of parental leave coverage.

Reporting to the reservations manager, as a Reservations Sales Agent, you’ll be the first point of contact for guests, handling all reservation inquiries promptly and professionally while maximising revenue through effective upselling. You’ll deliver passionate and knowledgeable service, ensuring every interaction is friendly and personalised. You’ll manage guest details in the PMS system, confirm bookings, and maintain clear communication across departments to fulfill special requests. Familiarity with our reservations system, rate structures, and property features will help you optimise occupancy and meet targets. You’ll also stay informed on promotions, maintain strong product knowledge, and actively promote the Accor Loyalty Program. In this role, you’ll represent our brand standards by answering calls efficiently, sharing sales leads, and creating seamless experiences for both internal and external guests.

Qualifications

  • Experience in Reservations or Front Office, preferably in a Hotel environment or similar.
  • Strong knowledge of hotel systems such as OPERA cloud and RESAweb or similar.
  • Knowledge of Hotel loyalty programs is advantageous.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to deliver exceptional service and build rapport with guests over the phone.
  • Experience providing prompt and efficient service including upselling.
  • Flexible working a variety of shifts including some weekends and public holidays.
  • Have full working rights in Australia.

Additional Information

Why work for Accor?

We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities. With 5400+ Hotels across 110+ countries, the opportunities to grow your career are endless!

  • Build Your Network - With more than 300,000 Accor professionals globally sharing the same guest passion, you have the ability to grow your hospitality network worldwide

Why Join the Sydney Olympic Park Precinct?

  • Be part of a collaborative, multi-brand precinct team in a dynamic location.
  • Enjoy exclusive staff benefits such as $5 duty meals, complimentary coffee and free parking on non major event days.
  • Be part of a vibrant, high energy precinct with Sydney's biggest events right on your doorstep.

This role is based at our corporate office in Mexico City, MX

This is your chance to be part of a Finance Team that is a critical partner that manages all global activities related to financial performance, accounting, tax, forecasting, risk management, and asset management. As a tax analyst on the Finance Tax team reporting to the Tax Leader, you will focus on this role. You will manage the calculation, filing, and reconciliation of federal, state, local, and foreign taxes, including Mexican tax requirements. It also ensures accurate tax recording, revenue and tax account reconciliations, and compliance with withholding and electronic invoicing controls.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

As Tax Analyst you would be manage all operational tax duties of our Mexico and Caribbean Managed hotels in the continuing effort to deliver outstanding guest service and maintaining accurate control environments. Specifically, you would perform the following duties:

  • Mexican tax filing
  • Ensure that accounting records record tax transactions in their financial systems
  • Ensure revenue reconciliations are accurate
  • Calculate local and foreign tax withholdings
  • Electronic invoicing controls
  • Tax accounts reconciliations

How You'll Collaborate With Others

  • Sense of organization and planning
  • Teamwork
  • Good interpersonal relationship
  • Good knowledge in computer science, including Excel

You'll Take Ownership Of

  • Calculate monthly Federal operational taxes
  • Calculate monthly State operational taxes

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Six (6) months of experience in an internship or professional position, with Accounting or Bookkeeping or Tax
  • Work a hybrid office schedule based in our office in Mexico City 3 days per week
  • Experience using Excel to maintain spreadsheets

Job Description

Role based at Novotel Wolverhampton or Novotel Coventry

  • With some travel in between

About Us

Fairview Hotels owns and operates a portfolio of branded hotels across the UK. As we continue to grow and develop throughout 2026, our people remain at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to investing in our teams and creating opportunities for career progression within our business.

Our West Midlands Cluster comprises Novotel Coventry and Novotel Wolverhampton, both offering extensive meeting and event facilities for corporate and social occasions. We are looking for an enthusiastic and organised Cluster Meetings & Events Sales Coordinator to join our growing team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone currently working within a busy Meetings & Events Sales Office who is ready to take the next step in their career and gain valuable experience towards a proactive sales role.

The successful candidate will be highly organised, customer-focused and passionate about delivering exceptional service while maximising sales opportunities. As this is a dual-site position, your time will be split between both hotels, so flexibility and the ability to travel between the two locations are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage meetings and events enquiries from all sales channels, taking each enquiry from initial contact through to confirmation.
  • Prepare accurate quotations and follow up to maximise conversion opportunities.
  • Arrange and conduct hotel show rounds, ensuring all client requirements are understood and presented effectively.
  • Ensure all confirmed bookings are issued with contracts, pro-forma invoices and that payments are secured in line with company procedures.
  • Prepare detailed function sheets and present event information during hotel function sheet meetings.
  • Maintain and update hotel sales profiles, ensuring familiarity with Novotel brand standards and Meeting Planner, our meetings loyalty programme.
  • Use the C&E booking system to manage enquiries and bookings (full training will be provided).
  • Produce professional documents using Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Work collaboratively across both hotels to ensure a seamless customer experience.
  • Travel between both properties as required.
  • Demonstrate flexibility in working hours to meet the needs of the business.

About You

You'll ideally have:

  • Previous experience within a hotel Meetings & Events Sales Office.
  • Excellent organisational and administrative skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Outstanding communication and customer service skills.
  • A proactive approach with a passion for sales and delivering memorable events.
  • Confidence using Microsoft Office applications.
  • The ability to prioritise a varied workload in a fast-paced environment.
  • A full UK driving licence and access to transport would be advantageous due to travel between properties.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary
  • Access to worldwide Accor accommodation discounts for you, your friends and family.
  • NEST Pension Scheme.
  • Complimentary eye tests.
  • Two complimentary hotel stays per year (subject to availability).
  • Meals provided whilst on duty.
  • Uniform provided.
  • 28 days annual leave, including bank holidays.
  • Ongoing training and development opportunities.
  • Free on-site parking.
  • Employee discount scheme.
  • Company pension.
  • Referral programme.

Job Details

Job Type: Full-time

Working Pattern: Monday to Friday (Occasional Weekends Required)

If you're looking to build your career within hotel sales and events and want to be part of a supportive, growing team, we'd love to hear from you.

Description de l'entreprise

L’hôtel Novotel Paris Vaugirard Montparnasse est en quête d’un(e) Assistant(e) Maître d'hôtel !

(CDD/mission pour un remplacement de congé maternité à compter de fin septembre)

Notre hôtel flagship de 198 chambres dont 4 suites avec vue sur la Tour Eiffel a fait peau neuve en 2021. Cette transformation spectaculaire confiée au Studio Jean-Philippe Nuel, signature internationale de l’architecture d’intérieure, nous permet aujourd’hui de proposer à nos clients et nos talents une expérience parisienne unique.

PRÊT.E POUR LE GRAND VOYAGE ?

Le Novotel Paris Vaugirard Montparnasse est plus qu’un hôtel : c'est une destination à part entière.

  • le Quindici Trattoria propose une expérience gustative simple, authentique et généreuse.
  • le Quindici Caffè, temple de l'Art Coffee méditerranéen, prépare des encas et latte aussi beaux que délicieux.
  • enfin, notre rooftop ILVOLO Paris transporte vos papilles à travers des cocktails hors du commun avec une vue sur la Tour Eiffel à couper le souffle.

Nos 11 salles de séminaires - dont un centre de convention de 350 m2 modulable en 3 salles de 100 à 135 m2 - ont été rénovées et dotées de matériel dernier cri afin de ravir notre clientèle business.

Notre établissement poursuit sa transition digitale au travers de différents projets Accor & ESSENDI qui le placent, toujours plus chaque jour, comme véritable moteur et précurseur dans ce domaine.

Forte d'une vingtaine de collaborateurs aussi talentueux qu'engagés, notre équipe cuisine s’affaire à personnaliser quotidiennement l'expérience culinaire de nos clients.

Quelques Liens à Parcourir

  • https://instagram.com/novotelparisvaugirard/
  • https://instagram.com/ilvolo_paris/
  • https://www.instagram.com/quindici_trattoria/
  • https://www.instagram.com/quindicicaffe/

Description du poste

L’Assistant(e) Maître d’Hôtel assure le bon déroulement des services petit déjeuner, restaurant du midi et du soir, des banquets et séminaires, en respectant les procédures, dans un souci de satisfaction optimale et en accord avec les standards de l’hôtel. Avec le Maître d’hôtel, il est le leader polyvalent de l’équipe restauration, planifie le travail, encadre et forme l’équipe. Il travaille en collaboration avec le maître d’Hôtel et rapporte au Responsable de salle ou restauration.

Missions

L’Assistant(e) maître d'hôtel polyvalent H/F seconde le chef de la salle qui orchestre minutieusement le travail des commis, et des chefs de rang afin de garantir le bon déroulement et l'excellence des services.

Il/elle connaît parfaitement le mécanisme du service en salle, banquets et séminaires, il/elle sait détecter immédiatement le détail à corriger.

Il assiste le Maître d’hôtel dans ses taches quotidiennes opérationnelles et administratives

Il/elle est acteur/rice permanent dans le déroulement du service.

Il/elle est garant de la qualité des prestations et veille au bon déroulement du service dans un souci permanent du détail, de la qualité, de l’excellence et de la satisfaction de notre clientèle.

Il/elle participe à l’ensemble des opérations de l’accueil client, à l’encaissement et développe en permanence une attitude commerciale et de conseil.

Il/elle fédère l’équipe et coordonne le travail dans un souci permanent de qualité et de fluidité du service.

Il/elle accueille et forme les nouveaux collaborateurs selon nos standards.

Qualifications

Fournir en permanence un service attentionné, vigilant et sincère envers le client

Respecter les procédures et les techniques d'un service

Faire preuve de prise d’initiative et de polyvalence

Etre force de proposition

Etre loyal et impliqué

Etre Attentif et bienveillant

Informations supplémentaires

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Un poste à responsabilités dans un hôtel dynamique au sein d’un groupe reconnu.
  • Un environnement stimulant mêlant restauration à la carte et activité événementielle.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Get to know our team:

Since inception of Flights in late 2019, momentum has surged, particularly in response to the transformative impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. Today, we are a fast-growing group of passionate individuals that thrive in a bustling, dynamic environment. Our sole objective is to propel the Flights vertical forward, in a competitive landscape. Operating with the agility of a startup within the broader Agoda ecosystem, we're driven by innovation and the relentless determination to scale and shape the future of flight bookings.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Strategic Project Manager to join our Flights Supply team. In this key role, you will manage and support a variety of strategic projects within the flights supply team, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive business growth and expansion.

You will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving the execution of key initiatives across departments such as product, supply, marketing, finance, and customer service. This includes setting clear project objectives, managing timelines, mitigating risks, and ensuring deliverables are met on time and within scope. By translating business data and insights into actionable strategies, you will ensure alignment and progress toward organizational goals.

This role is vital to the growth of Agoda Flights, contributing to its transformation from a new vertical into a core component of Agoda's operations. You will play an integral role in driving effective project execution and ensuring alignment with Agoda's broader business objectives.

In this role, you will get to:

Project Management and Execution:

  • Manage and oversee strategic projects for flights supply, ensuring initiatives move the dial, are executed on time and exceed expectations.
  • Develop and maintain project roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables, coordinating across multiple team in various departments to ensure successful implementation.
  • Monitor project progress and proactively address risks and challenges to maintain alignment with business objectives.
  • Support the development and deployment of tools and processes to improve team efficiency and productivity.

Stakeholder Management and Collaboration:

  • Act as a central point of contact between supply, operations, analytics, product, and finance teams at Agoda and other brands of Booking Holdings.
  • Work closely with Country Directors to understand their market needs and ensure alignment with broader organizational goals.
  • Facilitate communication and alignment across teams, ensuring all stakeholders are informed and engaged throughout project lifecycles.

Strategy, Performance Steering and Reporting:

  • Assist in defining OKRs and KPIs for the flights supply team, ensuring they align with overall company goals.
  • Track, analyze and guide team performance against key metrics, providing regular updates and actionable insights to collaborators and leadership alike.
  • Compile reports and updates for senior leadership to showcase progress, challenges, and outcomes of key initiatives.

Operational Support:

  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency across the flights supply team.
  • Support the creation of scalable workflows and best practices for cross-departmental collaboration.

What you will need to succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 4-5 years of relevant experience in a strategy consulting firm or in a tech company (project / program manager role)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly and concisely.
  • Proven track record of successful cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate strategic initiatives and drive business growth.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders
  • Ability to learn fast and understand new business dynamics.
  • Excitement to join a dynamic and innovative team within Agoda, with excellent growth prospects.

It’s great if you have:

  • Knowledge of SQL or willingness to invest time to learn.

  • Proactively bring new ideas and competitor insights to drive campaign success
  • Work in close cooperation with the Air Supply Teams, Media Service and other functions to accomplish the annual marketing revenue budget
  • Relationship Building: Create and maintain close relations with Marketing Executives and decision makers from assigned airline accounts
  • Participate in Frequent face to face and/or remote airline meetings to review performance, agree and implement promotional measures and actions

What do you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

What's in it for you?

job.job_description:
Job Summary

Choice Hotels International is seeking a Director, Paid Media – Media Planning & Activation to lead full‑funnel paid media strategy and execution across the enterprise and segment portfolios. This role is responsible for driving performance excellence across TV/OLV/CTV, Paid Search, Metasearch/Hotel Ads, Paid Social, Programmatic Display & Video, and Affiliate Marketing. As a people leader, this role owns how paid media is planned, activated, optimized, and measured—ensuring Choice’s owned digital channels deliver incremental, measurable business growth for franchisees. The Director partners closely with Brand Marketing, Analytics, Finance, Revenue Management, Technology, and agency partners to improve media efficiency, scale performance marketing capabilities, and advance modern measurement approaches. The ideal candidate is a strategic, data‑driven media leader with strong judgment, a clear point of view, and a relentless focus on performance outcomes in a fast‑paced, matrixed environment.

Key Responsibilities

Full‑Funnel Paid Media Leadership & Strategy

  • Lead full‑funnel paid media strategy and activation across Paid Search, Metasearch/Hotel Ads, Paid Social, Programmatic Display & Video, CTV/OLV, and Affiliate Marketing, with a strong emphasis on performance and incrementality.
  • Translate business and marketing objectives into integrated channel strategies, audience approaches, investment recommendations, and measurable performance expectations.
  • Establish and evolve paid media standards, best practices, and guardrails that guide planning and activation across internal teams, agencies, and partners.

Media Planning & Activation Team Leadership

  • Lead the Media Planning & Activation team, setting clear priorities, operating rhythms, and quality standards for planning, activation, optimization, and reporting.
  • Own quarterly and annual media and financial planning processes; align priorities and tradeoffs with Brand Marketing, Analytics, and Finance.
  • Coach and develop managers and individual contributors, building bench strength, planning rigor, and strong performance accountability.

Performance Management & Measurement

  • Lead performance management forums including pacing, optimization reviews, and QBRs; ensure insights are actionable and followed through.
  • Ensure reporting clearly connects paid media performance to business outcomes, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Advance measurement frameworks including incrementality testing, attribution, and media effectiveness analysis to improve decision‑making.

Cross‑Functional & Enterprise Impact

  • Partner closely with Brand Marketing, Analytics, Revenue Management, Finance, and Technology to enable integrated execution and decision‑making across the funnel.
  • Serve as a senior subject matter expert, providing POVs, tradeoffs, and recommendations to leadership on media investment, channel mix, audience strategy, and performance drivers.

Agency & Partner Leadership

  • Act as senior client lead for paid media agencies, setting expectations, operating principles, and performance standards.
  • Orchestrate and prioritize agency partnerships across segments and channels; drive accountability for high‑quality outputs and measurable impact.

Innovation & Capability Evolution

  • Lead test‑and‑learn initiatives and adoption of new platforms, media capabilities, and AdTech to improve full‑funnel effectiveness and scalability.
  • Stay current on industry, platform, and regulatory changes; evolve strategy, measurement, and operating standards accordingly.

Qualifications

Employment Experience

  • 10+ years of experience managing enterprise‑level, full‑funnel paid media programs, with deep focus on Paid Search, Programmatic Display & Video, Paid Social, and Affiliate Marketing.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience managing teams, agency partners, and large‑scale budgets ($50M+ annual media spend preferred).

Technical & Functional Expertise

  • Expert‑level knowledge of Paid Search (Google, Bing), Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit), Programmatic Display (DV360, The Trade Desk), and CTV/OLV.
  • Proficiency with ad tech and analytics platforms such as Google Marketing Platform, Adobe Analytics, and Flashtalking.
  • Strong understanding of first‑party data activation, identity resolution, and audience segmentation.
  • Experience with incrementality testing, attribution models, and measurement frameworks (MMM, RBA, MTA, DDA).
  • Deep understanding of bidding strategies, automation, machine learning, and AI‑driven optimizations.
  • Proven ability to scale paid media programs, improve CAC efficiency, and drive incremental revenue growth.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations.

Leadership & Business Competencies

  • Proven ability to lead cross‑functional initiatives with enterprise‑wide impact.
  • Strong judgment and problem‑solving skills in ambiguous, fast‑moving environments.
  • Executive‑ready communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders in a matrixed organization.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience; advanced degree preferred.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $163,287 to $192,456 annually. In addition to the annual salary, this role is eligible for an annual bonus based on the terms of Choice's Management Incentive Plan (MIP)

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

Our corporate office locations:

North Bethesda, MD — Located at Pike & Rose, our worldwide headquarters is less than 15 miles from Washington, D.C., one block away from the North Bethesda Metro station, with easy access to I-495, complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Scottsdale, AZ — Located at the northwest corner of Loop 101, the Scottsdale office is home to our technology, eCommerce and customer service organizations, with easy access to complimentary parking, electronic charging stations, restaurants and retail.

Minneapolis, MN — Select roles are based in our Minneapolis office on Highway 394, near the intersection with Highway 100, only five minutes from downtown.

Field/Remote — Select roles designated as field/remote will require associates to work from a home office, connecting virtually with Choice team members and leadership on Zoom, with possible required travel depending on the role.

Choice’s Cultural Values

Welcome and Respect Everyone | Be Bold | Be Quick | Listen | Be Curious | Show Integrity

Choice’s Leadership Principles

Act with Intention | Lead with Authenticity | Grow & Deliver

job.job_description:
¿Quiénes somos?

Despegar es la plataforma de viajes líder en América Latina — y parte de un ecosistema aún más grande: Prosus, el grupo tecnológico global que también opera iFood, la app de delivery dominante en Brasil. Juntos, estamos construyendo la primera súper app latinoamericana que conecta consumo cotidiano con experiencias de alto impacto, como los viajes.


En México, nuestro equipo opera con una lógica clara: alta autonomía, alto alineamiento. No micromanageamos. Definimos hacia dónde vamos, y cada persona decide el cómo. Buscamos gente que piense como dueña de su proceso — que proponga, que cuestione, que mejore.


Si buscas un lugar donde el "siempre se hizo así" no existe, esta posición es para ti. ✈️


 


Por qué este rol importa ahora

La nómina en México no es solo un proceso de compliance: es un sistema vivo con margen real de optimización. Hoy, esa oportunidad está sin aprovechar. Buscamos a alguien que llegue con mirada de ingeniería de procesos — que no se conforme con ejecutar, sino que identifique dónde automatizar, dónde eliminar fricción y dónde construir algo más sólido y escalable.


Con autonomía real, colaborando de cerca con HR, Finanzas y Contabilidad.


 


 


 



Tu impacto — Lo que vas a hacer

Lo que más nos importa:




  • Automatizar y optimizar. Identificar ineficiencias en los procesos de nómina y liderar su mejora concreta — ya sea con RPA, IA aplicada, herramientas de análisis de datos o automatización dentro de los sistemas existentes. No describir el problema: resolverlo.




  • Ser dueño del proceso de principio a fin. Calcular, preparar y procesar la nómina quincenal con exactitud: salarios, bonos, deducciones, impuestos. Gestionar incidencias (ausentismos, vacaciones, incapacidades, horas extras, movimientos de personal).




  • Garantizar el cumplimiento normativo. Timbrado CFDI 4.0, dispersión en tiempo y forma, obligaciones ante IMSS, INFONAVIT, SAR e ISR. Manejo fluido de plataformas gubernamentales (SUA, IDSE, Buzón IMSS, REPSE, SAT).




  • Procesar finiquitos, liquidaciones e indemnizaciones con exactitud y criterio, conforme a la Ley Federal del Trabajo.




  • Construir inteligencia de datos. Generar reportes contables, financieros e indicadores de nómina para análisis y toma de decisiones. Conciliaciones bancarias y contables pre y post-dispersión.




  • Colaborar de forma real con el equipo. HR, Finanzas y Contabilidad son tus contrapartes naturales. El modelo es ONE HR: sin silos, sin territorios. Participar en auditorías internas y externas con criterio.




  • Mantenerse actualizado. Reformas laborales, fiscales y de seguridad social evolucionan. Alguien que entiende esto no espera que le avisen — lo monitorea.






Lo que buscamos
Must-haves

  • Mínimo 4 años de experiencia en administración integral de nómina — de principio a fin, no solo una parte del proceso

  • Mentalidad de optimización real. Experiencia concreta con herramientas de automatización, RPA o IA aplicadas a nómina o procesos similares. No alcanza con "estoy interesada/o en aprender" — buscamos alguien que ya lo haya hecho o que tenga el mindset y las bases técnicas para hacerlo desde el día uno

  • Excel avanzado: tablas dinámicas, macros, fórmulas complejas, análisis de datos

  • Dominio de al menos un software de nómina (Aspel NOI, Contpaq iNominas, SAP, ADP Global View, Workday, Tress, UKG WFM o similar)

  • Background en tecnología, e-commerce 

  • Presencia en CDMX. La posición es  hibrida — requiere estar en la ciudad y disponibilidad para asistir a eventos del equipo

  • Alta autonomía y autoconfianza. En este equipo no habrá alguien mirando por encima de tu hombro. Necesitamos a alguien que gestione, decida y escale cuando corresponde



Nice-to-haves (suman, no bloquean)

  • Conocimiento de LFT, ISR, IMSS, INFONAVIT, ISN, CFDI 4.0 y legislación laboral mexicana. Lo valoramos — y si no lo tenés completo, se puede adquirir. Lo que no se enseña fácil es la capacidad de optimizar procesos

  • Manejo de Power BI, SQL u otras herramientas de análisis de datos

  • Experiencia en implementación o migración de sistemas de nómina

  • Experiencia en nóminas de alto volumen (100+ empleados)

  • Auditorías de nómina y controles SOX

  • Certificaciones en materia fiscal, laboral o de nómina

  • People Analytics o indicadores de RRHH

  • Experiencia en Big Four o consultoras especializadas




Por qué Despegar 🌎

No somos una empresa que pega la cultura en la pared. Acá los Core Drivers se usan de verdad:



  • Mars-shot Thinking: No perseguimos mejoras incrementales. Pensamos en 10x — y eso aplica también a cómo se hace la nómina

  • Alta Autonomía + Alto Alineamiento: Sabés hacia dónde va el equipo y decidís cómo llegar. Sin micromanagement

  • Fail Fast, Learn & Scale: Si probás algo nuevo y no funciona, lo documentamos, aprendemos y escalamos lo que sí funciona

  • Radical Candor: Feedback directo con empatía. Duro con los problemas, nunca con las personas

  • Outcome Focus: Lo que medimos es impacto, no esfuerzo

  • Ambidiestría: Seguimos operando con excelencia mientras exploramos formas mejores de hacer las cosas



El equipo de México es de alto impacto. Cada persona tiene visibilidad real, voz en las decisiones del proceso y acceso directo al liderazgo regional. Y como parte del ecosistema Prosus, conectás con una red tech global que incluye iFood, OLX, Swiggy y más.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.   • Responsible for the direction and management of CASA UK and Ireland, managing the flow of customer feedback and complaints from all channels (direct, NEBs, consumer protection agencies, legal firms, media etc.), from investigation to conclusion, conforming to our company quality, time and cost standards.
  • Plan and implement effective strategies and tactics in the management of UK and Ireland Customer Affairs unit, ensuring customer complaints are responded to in a substantive, timely and cost effective manner and in line with CASA Global and Company objectives. Ensure that customer confidence, loyalty and goodwill is restored to retain customers, minimise revenue loss and to protect future revenue.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

AI adoption at GetYourGuide is growing fast, and the decisions made now — about what we build, what we allow, and how we govern it — will shape the company for years. This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of AI strategy, security, legal, and product.

You’ll work directly with the AI Council, IT, Security, and Legal, and partner with AI-focused teams across the business. The role reports into SaaS Operations and operates with company-wide scope: you will build and operate the technical foundations for AI adoption, execute against the governance framework and strategic direction set by IT leadership, and be the go-to technical owner for putting AI governance into practice day to day..

Your mission

Bring GetYourGuide's internal AI governance framework to life, from policy into practice. This means:

  • Build and operate the technical foundations that put the AI governance framework into practice: implement the standards, guardrails, and tooling that determine how AI tools are evaluated, adopted, and used across the company.
  • Execute against the AI enablement roadmap, balancing innovation velocity with security, compliance, and operational integrity.
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact internally, the go-to advisor for teams navigating tooling choices and shadow AI risks, escalating governance calls to IT leadership when needed.
  • Support cross-functional alignment between AI, Security, Legal, and business stakeholders, translating technical trade-offs into clear recommendations for decision makers.
  • Drive the reduction of shadow AI and fragmentation across the organization through governance structures that are practical enough to actually get adopted.
  • Evaluate AI platforms and tools and recommend selections based on security posture, compliance requirements, and long-term operational fit, not just near-term capability.

Your toolkit

AI Enablement and Delivery

  • A track record of implementing AI governance frameworks, tooling, or enablement programs at scale.
  • Strong technical judgment on where to move fast and where to slow down when rolling out AI capabilities.

Cross-functional Influence

  • Experience operating at the intersection of technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to challenge assumptions, surface the real problem behind a request, and guide decisions under ambiguity without waiting for permission.

Technical Breadth

  • Solid generalist background across platform, SaaS, or systems environments — enough to evaluate AI tooling credibly and ask the right hard questions.
  • Fluency in security, compliance, and data governance considerations specific to AI: model risk, data residency, access controls, auditability.

Execution at Scope

  • Comfortable owning initiatives from 0 to 1 — problem definition through implementation and iteration.
  • Can operate in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment and make high-quality decisions without perfect information.

Extras that give you an edge

  • You've built and scaled an AI enablement or platform function from the ground up.
  • Background in cybersecurity, privacy, or legal/compliance adjacent roles.
  • Experience in a high-growth tech company navigating rapid AI adoption.
  • Sysadmin or platform engineering background that gives you technical credibility with engineering teams.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

job.job_description:
Director / Principal of Product Design – Search


Location: New York, Los Angeles, San Jose, San Francisco, Seattle, Austin, Chicago, London, Montreal, with other EG Locations up for discussion.


At Expedia Group, our mission is to power global travel for everyone, everywhere. Within Expedia Group, the Experience Design (XD) organization brings together product design, content design, and research to shape experiences that help travelers confidently discover and explore the world.


We’re seeking a Director/Principal of Product Design – Search to own and advance the design direction for Expedia Group’s search experiences. This role is calibrated as a senior individual‑contributor leadership position, with scope expected to evolve as the Search domain and organization continue to mature.


In this role, you’ll operate as a design and creative authority who leads through vision, judgment, and hands‑on craft—taking on the most complex experience challenges while setting standards others follow. You’ll lead the design of intelligent search as the foundation for travel discovery, planning, and shopping—using high‑fidelity design, systems thinking, and advanced prototyping at a global scale.


Introduction to the team:

We’re a multidisciplinary design team shaping the future of travel through human-centered, AI-powered experiences. Our mission is to help travelers imagine, plan, book, and manage every part of their journey across Expedia Group’s family of brands and platforms — with clarity, delight, and confidence.


In this position, you’ll lead and inspire a team designing Expedia Group’s search experience end to end, set a bold design vision, establish systems that raise the bar for quality, and partner closely with product, engineering, and data science to deliver intelligent, intuitive experiences at global scale—helping define what AI-driven travel design looks like for the entire industry.


In this role, you will:

  • Own and lead the design direction for Expedia Group’s AI‑powered Search experiences, driving outcomes from concept through execution while orchestrating the work across interconnected search initiatives.
  • Define how travelers express intent, explore options, and understand results—bringing clarity, transparency, and trust to complex search interactions.
  • Work hands‑on with high‑fidelity design, prototyping, and systems thinking, while helping shape how search work is sequenced, scoped, and delivered to tackle the most complex discovery challenges.
  • Partner closely with senior leaders in Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science to coordinate priorities, align roadmaps, and ensure design effort is focused where it matters most.
  • Translate advanced AI and machine‑learning capabilities into intuitive, human‑centered experiences used by millions of travelers worldwide.
  • Establish and scale experience patterns, interaction models, and quality standards across brands and platforms, providing structure and cohesion across parallel search workstreams.
  • Influence and elevate design quality through critique, mentorship, and shared standards—leading by example and helping others deliver at a higher bar.
  • Collaborate across Expedia Group to align Search experiences with the company’s broader AI strategy, shared capabilities, and platform investments.
  • Represent the traveler in senior‑level and cross‑functional forums, influencing decisions that shape the future of travel discovery and intelligent search.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of experience in product design with, at least, 4 years leading design teams at scale.
  • Expertise in search, discovery, or recommendation systems, with a deep understanding of how AI and ML shape relevance, ranking, and explainability.
  • A proven track record of designing experiences that simplify complex information and build trust with users.
  • Skilled in translating ambiguous technical opportunities into clear, inspiring product experiences.
  • Adept at building, scaling, and coaching design teams that deliver at both craft and strategic levels.
  • An exceptional communicator who can bring stakeholders along through strong storytelling and influence.
  • Energized by the challenge of creating travel experiences that feel intelligent, human, and memorable.
  • Deep understanding of AI and conversational design tools and methods, including prototyping with LLMs, prompt engineering, data-informed interaction design, and expert knowledge of modern design and prototyping platforms including but not limited to Figma, Cursor, etc.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep knowledge of semantic and natural language search, conversational interfaces, and AI explainability principles.
  • Experience working with data scientists and ML engineers to translate advanced models into user-facing experiences at scale.
  • Demonstrated strength in connecting design quality to measurable product outcomes through experimentation and data-driven metrics.
  • Track record of driving design excellence across multiple brands, platforms, and domains in a fast-moving, results-oriented environment.
  • Demonstrated experience taking products from concept to scaled adoption.


Expedia Group is proud to offer a wide range of benefits to support employees and their families, including medical/dental/vision, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program. To fuel each employee’s passion for travel, we offer a wellness & travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and an International Airlines Travel Agent (IATAN) membership. View our full list of benefits.
