job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get To Know Our Team:

The Supply department is the B2B division within Agoda that connects with our external partners to ensure the supply of accommodations, flights, and activities. Within Supply, the Central Management Office team has been established to strengthen the backbone of the Supply team in various aspects, including project management for both internal Supply and Supply-led cross-department projects.

The Opportunity:

This is a high-impact PMO role sitting at the heart of the Supply Central Management Office, working directly with senior leadership to drive coordination, structure, and execution across complex cross-functional initiatives. The role offers unique exposure to C-level stakeholders and the opportunity to build processes from the ground up in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own end-to-end coordination of risk-related and high-stakes cross-functional workstreams, identifying issues, escalating where needed, driving resolution to closure, and ensuring full visibility across all stakeholders.
  • Monitor and consolidate inputs from internal teams, external partners, regulatory sources, and market signals to ensure early detection of country-level risks and operational exposures.
  • Prepare concise, well-structured risk reports and briefings for C-level executives and senior leadership, translating complex situations into clear recommendations.
  • Design and own detailed SOPs (standard operating procedures) for risk monitoring, incident response, and other cross-Supply processes: drafting them end-to-end, securing senior signoff, rolling them out across teams, and refining them based on feedback and lessons learned.
  • Build and maintain alignment with senior stakeholders (Director level and above) across Supply and partner functions: surfacing trade-offs, framing options clearly, and driving decisions to closure with clear ownership and timing.
  • Run end-to-end project management on cross-functional Supply initiatives, from planning and stakeholder alignment to execution, reporting, and post-mortem.
  • Prepare and run cross-functional working sessions, steering committees, and Supply leadership cadences (e.g. QBRs, leadership summits): drafting agendas, quality-checking inputs, capturing decisions, and tracking follow-ups. Take on additional Supply-led projects as required.
  • Build and maintain trackers, dashboards, and summary reports that give senior and C-level stakeholders a clear, current view of progress, blockers, and decisions needed.
  • Maintain a single source of truth for processes, decisions, action items, and artefacts so the work is auditable, repeatable, and aligned with company policies.
  • Continuously improve monitoring, reporting, escalation, and team operations by building templates, automations, and AI-assisted tools that increase the team's leverage.

Required Qualifications:

  • 4 to 5 years of experience in project management, preferably in a multinational or cross-functional environment, C-level office, strategy, or general management consulting.
  • A bachelor's or master's degree, ideally in business, operations, or project management.
  • Experience in risk management, PMO, compliance, or a related function, preferably in a multinational, cross-functional, or high-growth environment.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to build lightweight automations, dashboards, or workflow tools that improved how a team plans, tracks, or reports work.
  • Highly structured thinker, organized, and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment under time pressure. In this role, missing something can have significant market-level consequences.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and roll out SOPs or governance frameworks from scratch, and to drive cross-functional decisions with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience reporting to senior leadership.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to report project updates clearly and succinctly to different levels of management.
  • Self-starter mentality, able to operate in ambiguous environments, define your own structure, and move quickly without waiting to be told what to do.
  • High proficiency with the MS Office Suite, particularly PowerPoint for executive-grade reporting and Excel for tracking and data consolidation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with risk frameworks, incident management processes, or governance structures.
  • Analytical and quantitative skills that allow you to generate hypotheses and insights based on the analyses of large datasets using our various databases and BI tools.
  • Experience with project management tools (such as MS Project, Jira, Asana, or similar).
  • Experience in the hotel or OTA industry.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

About The Role

Strategic Partnerships is running a multi-vertical, multi-region portfolio with real scale ambitions. The channels are defined. The teams are in place. What's missing is the machine that makes it all repeatable, and the person obsessed with building it.

This is a role for someone who chooses hard problems over safe ones, who sees an under-built operating system and can't help but fix it, and who measures success by whether the org around them got faster, sharper, and more capable. You sit at the center of how Partnerships executes: owning the planning cadences, performance frameworks, cross-functional machinery, and analytical infrastructure that lets a lean team manage a complex portfolio without losing speed or discipline.

You'll work directly with the Head of Strategic Partnerships and lead the Operations team, translating direction into action and making sure nothing important falls between the cracks. The right person for this role gets energy from closing things - you don't hand off recommendations, you stay in the room until things are done.

Your mission

  • Own the operating system. Design, build, and maintain the frameworks, playbooks, and cadences that let channel teams execute at scale: partner tiering logic, corridor launch checklists, activation tracking, readiness gates, WIN vs. PLAY operating guidelines. The goal is a system where teams spend less time figuring out what to do and more time doing it. You build it, you keep it current, and you hold the org accountable to using it. You're not inheriting something polished — you're building it.
  • Run the planning cycle end-to-end. Own the annual and quarterly planning process for Strategic Partnerships — translating channel strategy into OKRs, KPI frameworks, financial frames, and execution roadmaps. Run the QBR process: structure the reviews, build the narrative, surface the decisions, and follow through on actions. This is not a facilitation role — you own the output and are accountable for whether the org is working on the right things in the right order.
  • Lead and develop the Operations team. Manage and develop the Operations team, setting clear direction and holding a high bar for output. Your team should be growing — developing commercial instincts, improving their judgment, getting better at making calls. You're not just approving their work; you're raising their ceiling and creating an environment where ambition is contagious.
  • Drive strategic projects. Own the execution of complex, cross-functional strategic projects — from problem framing and stakeholder alignment through to delivery. When a project is ambiguous, you create the structure. When it stalls, you unblock it. You don't escalate dependency problems — you resolve them. And when it's done, you move on to the next one.
  • Own performance tracking and the channel P&L view. Maintain the GMV forecast, track actuals against plan, and build the dashboards that give leadership clear visibility into what's working, what's at risk, and what needs intervention. Translate data into decisions — partner health, ROAS trends, pipeline conversion, incrementality signals. You're not reporting numbers; you're surfacing the story behind them and making sure the right calls get made.
  • Drive cross-functional execution. When a partner launch is blocked by a tracking gap, an unresolved payment rail, or a product dependency that hasn't been prioritized, you own the resolution. You don't build empires — you build bridges. You know what every function needs from every other function, and you align them without waiting to be asked.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years combining strategy and operations, ideally starting in top-tier consulting and moving into an in-house role at a marketplace, platform, or high-growth tech company. The consulting foundation matters; the operational scar tissue matters more.
  • A builder, not an advisor. You've owned initiatives end-to-end — problem framing, cross-functional alignment, execution, post-mortem. You can point to things that exist because you built them. You're energized by a blank page, not intimidated by it.
  • Growth-obsessed. You set ambitious targets, push yourself and the people around you further than feels comfortable, and treat every constraint as a problem to be solved rather than a ceiling to accept. You choose hard over easy every time.
  • Bias to action. You create clarity rather than waiting for it. You figure out what needs to happen and go do it. People around you move faster because you're there.
  • People leadership experience. You've managed a team and made it better — not just coordinated across one. You hold a high bar, develop judgment in others, and don't mistake activity for output.
  • Strong analytical foundation. You can build a channel P&L, model GMV scenarios, and structure a business case from scratch. Excel fluency is a must; comfort with ambiguous data is essential.
  • Strategic planning and OKR experience. You've owned planning cycles and OKR frameworks, not just participated in them. You know the difference between a good OKR and a vanity metric.
  • Exceptional communication. You write and present clearly at every level — weekly ops update to exec narrative. You simplify complexity without losing accuracy, and you know when to lead with the insight rather than the evidence.

Why this role

Strategic Partnerships is at an inflection point — converting a strong pipeline into launched, scaled distribution while building the org infrastructure to sustain it. The ambition is set. The channel teams are in place. This role is for someone who sees that and wants to be the one who builds the system that makes it repeatable — then keeps raising the bar on what repeatable looks like.

If you thrive when the problem isn't fully defined, the data is imperfect, and the timeline is short, this is your kind of role.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

job.job_description:
Director / Principal of Product Design – Search


Location: New York, Los Angeles, San Jose, San Francisco, Seattle, Austin, Chicago, London, Montreal, with other EG Locations up for discussion.


At Expedia Group, our mission is to power global travel for everyone, everywhere. Within Expedia Group, the Experience Design (XD) organization brings together product design, content design, and research to shape experiences that help travelers confidently discover and explore the world.


We’re seeking a Director/Principal of Product Design – Search to own and advance the design direction for Expedia Group’s search experiences. This role is calibrated as a senior individual‑contributor leadership position, with scope expected to evolve as the Search domain and organization continue to mature.


In this role, you’ll operate as a design and creative authority who leads through vision, judgment, and hands‑on craft—taking on the most complex experience challenges while setting standards others follow. You’ll lead the design of intelligent search as the foundation for travel discovery, planning, and shopping—using high‑fidelity design, systems thinking, and advanced prototyping at a global scale.


Introduction to the team:

We’re a multidisciplinary design team shaping the future of travel through human-centered, AI-powered experiences. Our mission is to help travelers imagine, plan, book, and manage every part of their journey across Expedia Group’s family of brands and platforms — with clarity, delight, and confidence.


In this position, you’ll lead and inspire a team designing Expedia Group’s search experience end to end, set a bold design vision, establish systems that raise the bar for quality, and partner closely with product, engineering, and data science to deliver intelligent, intuitive experiences at global scale—helping define what AI-driven travel design looks like for the entire industry.


In this role, you will:

  • Own and lead the design direction for Expedia Group’s AI‑powered Search experiences, driving outcomes from concept through execution while orchestrating the work across interconnected search initiatives.
  • Define how travelers express intent, explore options, and understand results—bringing clarity, transparency, and trust to complex search interactions.
  • Work hands‑on with high‑fidelity design, prototyping, and systems thinking, while helping shape how search work is sequenced, scoped, and delivered to tackle the most complex discovery challenges.
  • Partner closely with senior leaders in Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science to coordinate priorities, align roadmaps, and ensure design effort is focused where it matters most.
  • Translate advanced AI and machine‑learning capabilities into intuitive, human‑centered experiences used by millions of travelers worldwide.
  • Establish and scale experience patterns, interaction models, and quality standards across brands and platforms, providing structure and cohesion across parallel search workstreams.
  • Influence and elevate design quality through critique, mentorship, and shared standards—leading by example and helping others deliver at a higher bar.
  • Collaborate across Expedia Group to align Search experiences with the company’s broader AI strategy, shared capabilities, and platform investments.
  • Represent the traveler in senior‑level and cross‑functional forums, influencing decisions that shape the future of travel discovery and intelligent search.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of experience in product design with, at least, 4 years leading design teams at scale.
  • Expertise in search, discovery, or recommendation systems, with a deep understanding of how AI and ML shape relevance, ranking, and explainability.
  • A proven track record of designing experiences that simplify complex information and build trust with users.
  • Skilled in translating ambiguous technical opportunities into clear, inspiring product experiences.
  • Adept at building, scaling, and coaching design teams that deliver at both craft and strategic levels.
  • An exceptional communicator who can bring stakeholders along through strong storytelling and influence.
  • Energized by the challenge of creating travel experiences that feel intelligent, human, and memorable.
  • Deep understanding of AI and conversational design tools and methods, including prototyping with LLMs, prompt engineering, data-informed interaction design, and expert knowledge of modern design and prototyping platforms including but not limited to Figma, Cursor, etc.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Deep knowledge of semantic and natural language search, conversational interfaces, and AI explainability principles.
  • Experience working with data scientists and ML engineers to translate advanced models into user-facing experiences at scale.
  • Demonstrated strength in connecting design quality to measurable product outcomes through experimentation and data-driven metrics.
  • Track record of driving design excellence across multiple brands, platforms, and domains in a fast-moving, results-oriented environment.
  • Demonstrated experience taking products from concept to scaled adoption.

job.job_description:
Employment Type: Permanent

Contract Duration

 Why you will love working here

At IATA, we represent over 350 airlines worldwide, striving to make aviation safer, smarter, more sustainable, and inclusive.

  • Our Values are not just words on a page - they are the energy behind everything we do: ONE IATA - We collaborate across teams, TRUSTED - We do the right thing, INNOVATIVE - We make tomorrow better, INCLUSIVE - We embrace diverse perspectives.
  • With over 30,000 courses available, we believe in continuous learning and support your growth in an ever-changing industry.
  • Diversity, equity, and inclusion are our priorities. We are certified by the Equal Salary Foundation, offering equal pay and family-friendly policies.
  • We encourage community involvement through volunteering and strive to make tomorrow better for aviation and our communities. We offer time off so you can support causes important to you.
  • We promote work-life balance with flexible work options, including remote and hybrid work, a generous 'work from abroad' policy, and you get your birthday off!

About The Team You Are Joining

Airlines worldwide are increasingly recognizing sustainability as a critical factor for their “license to operate.” At the same time, high fuel costs necessitate efficient fuel management strategies. Most airlines need support to improve their fuel efficiency management.

IATA aims to be a center of expertise in fuel efficiency, supporting airlines and the industry in adopting best practices for fuel efficiency to optimize fuel consumption and achieve savings. IATA’s initiatives related to fuel efficiency are grouped under the IATA Fuel Efficiency Program.

We are seeking an experienced commercial lead to drive all commercial aspects of the Fuel Efficiency Program. Reporting to the Principal of Safety and Operational Analytics, the Senior Manager of Fuel Efficiency Solutions will focus on executing the go‑to‑market strategy and accelerating business development. The role will also oversee the delivery of fuel‑efficiency consulting engagements end‑to‑end to grow the Program’s commercial reach.

What Your Day Would Be Like

The Senior Manager is expected to:

  • Participate in the update of the IATA commercial strategy for the Center of Excellence on Fuel Efficiency, including its related go‑to‑market strategy, by driving the development, commercialization, and execution of its products and services—consulting, BI solutions, training, and publications—in close collaboration with all relevant IATA stakeholders.
  • Identify commercial opportunities related to fuel efficiency within the consulting segment, develop responses to expressions of interest and contract proposals, and negotiate projects until contract closure, ensuring alignment with budgetary targets.
  • Manage the execution and/or delivery of consulting projects, including but not limited to fuel efficiency (such as FEGA – Fuel Efficiency Gap Analysis), in close collaboration with IATA data analysts, flight operations experts, sustainability experts, including sourcing and managing external subject matter experts as required.
  • Prepare annual budgets and monthly financial projections; submit reports and regular updates on progress, accomplishments, financial status and plans as requested.
  • In close coordination with the IATA-core team, participate in research and development activities related to fuel efficiency to benefit airlines and the industry.

消費者のインサイト、競合分析、およびシステムの適応性を活用して意思決定を行い、ゲスト体験の競争力、一貫性、品質を確保するための継続的改善システムを設計・実施します。

日々の業務

グローバルフレームワークに基づき、担当地域に合わせて適宜調整したブランド戦略およびブランド計画のローカライズと実施を管理します。

各ブランドの製品・サービスイノベーションの開発、パイロット実施、およびホテルへの導入を支援し、ブランドの健全性／属性に対する認識を強化するとともに、地域内でのブランド認知度とブランドエクイティを高めます。必要に応じて、グローバルプロジェクトグループと連携して展開を行います。「ホテルレディ」プロセスの採用を確実にします。

コーポレートオフィスおよびホテル従業員向けのブランド導入プログラムの展開を管理する。

New Hotel Opening（新規開業ホテル）のエンドツーエンドでの提供を確実にするため、ホテルブランドの開業前プロセスを遂行する。

ホテルの品質管理チームのメンバーと連携し、ブランド基準およびゲスト体験基準の策定・実施・評価を管理・実行する。これにより、関連するすべての製品・サービスの改善がブランド基準に反映されるよう確保するとともに、ブランド基準が常に最新かつ正確な状態を維持されるようにする。

高品質かつ一貫性のあるホテルブランドマーケティングを支援するための地域向けツールキットおよびリソースの開発を主導し、効果的な導入を確実にする。また、その他のステークホルダーチーム（開発部門、D&Eなど）向けのブランドツールについても同様の支援を行う。

プロジェクト予算、コスト見積もり、請求書を監視・追跡し、地域内で制作されたすべてのブランド資料のファイリングシステムを整備する。

ホテル運営チームおよび地域マーケティングチームが、ホテルにおけるブランドマーケティングのコンプライアンスを達成できるよう支援する。

すべてのブランドにおいて一貫したグローバルブランドコミュニケーションガイドラインを維持するため、サブリージョンのコーポレートオフィスに対するブランドガーディアンおよび窓口としての役割を果たす。

すべてのブランド投資の成果を定量化するための適切な追跡・測定システムが整備されていることを確認し、事業上の優先事項に対して投下資金から最大の成果が得られるよう責任を負う。

ブランド／カテゴリーディレクターと連携し、マーケティング・シェアード・サービス・チームに対してブランドコミュニケーションのニーズや目標を説明し、同チームが関連する地域ブランドキャンペーンを策定・実行できるようにする。

カテゴリー、ブランド、および消費者インサイトチームと連携し、市場、ブランド、およびビジネスチャンスを徹底的に理解するための調査要件を特定・策定する。

担当地域のブランドを強化するため、既存データを分析し、必要に応じて追加調査を実施し、現在および将来の消費者ニーズ、製品・ブランド認知度、価格・価値に対する認識、ならびに消費者および仲介業者の動向に関する知見を最大限に深める。

地域ステークホルダー向けコミュニケーションプログラムの策定および実施を支援する。

応募要項

マーケティング、コミュニケーション、またはビジネス関連の学位を有することが望ましい

ラグジュアリー・ホスピタリティ業界、またはその他の消費者向けラグジュアリー分野において、5年以上の実務経験（特に大手多国籍企業での経験が望ましい）。マーケティングおよび／またはブランドマネジメントに重点を置いた職務経験があること

アジア地域における多国籍企業での実務経験

責任感を持ち、厳しい納期に対応し、マルチタスクをこなせること

社内のステークホルダーに影響を与え、確かな成果を生み出す強固な協力関係を効果的に構築できる能力

代理店との関係を自発的に行動し、自主的に業務を遂行し、効果的な提案と実行ができること

Job Description

The successful candidate will be part of Finance Division, Financial Planning & Control Department. He/She will be responsible for ensuring proper budgeting, correct accounting, timely processing, analysis and reporting of expenses/recoveries, as well as budgeting, forecasts and cost savings initiatives for Head Office Divisions (Fixed Cost) and Variable cost items under his/her responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

Operating expenditure accounting for Divisions under his/her charge:

  • Review and ensure that accruals/J ournal Vouchers (JVs) put through for accuracy and completeness. Check for omissions/errors in invoices raised/JVs put through.
  • Accounts Receivable and Account Payable invoice approvals. Review and ensure correct accounting allocation by Divisions.
  • Monitor and review monthly accounts variance analysis. Review and monitor Divisions’ expenditure against budget and forecast. Work with users on explanations for budget overruns and supplementary budgets. Ensure that users comply with Finance Manual procedures on budgetary control.
  • Discuss and liaise with Divisions on accounting treatment for their business process/initiatives.
  • Compile and analyse material monthly expense variances. Submission of monthly, quarterly and yearly reports to Corporate Accounts & Projects department as per reporting timelines.
  • Monitor and clear suspense accounts to ensure that balances are within timelines set. Work with users on explanations for balances exceeding stipulated timelines.

Annual operating budget/Long term projection exercise

  • Assist with preparation work for roll out of budget/long term projection exercise.
  • Assist/Support Divisions on queries regarding budget/projection. Work with Divisions to identify and achieve cost savings/efficiencies.
  • Assist with preparation of budget paper as per timeline.

Monthly rolling forecast exercises

  • Assist with user queries and carrying out of preparation work for roll out of forecast exercises.
  • Analysis of significant variances for forecast figures for preparation of forecast materials.

Understand the business processes of the different divisions and how it relates to the accounting treatment of their expenses. Work closely with the various divisions to have a better understanding of their operations and be able to provide value-added advice whenever necessary.

Work with internal and external auditors during their audits of the section’s processes and controls. Follow up on recommendations given.

Handle ad-hoc projects, such as implementation or enhancements of IT systems, to improve processes. Department’s representative for ad-hoc projects/exercises or administrative matters.

Provide guidance to staff on work procedures relating to the use of systems and resolution of work-related problems. Monitor and assess staff performance.

Requirements

  • University Bachelor's Degree in Accountancy or an equivalent professional qualification recognised by ACCA.
  • Good attention to details.
  • Good numerical and analytical skills.
  • Effective time management skills.
  • Effective communications skills.

job.job_description:
Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Partner directly with Executive Managers and senior leaders to shape business strategy, influence critical people decisions and drive organisational performance across one of Australia's most dynamic customer businesses
  • Join a highly regarded People Group where you'll leverage specialist expertise across Talent, Learning, Reward and Analytics while remaining focused on strategic business partnering and solving complex commercial challenges
  • 24 month fixed term role based at our Mascot Head Office

At Qantas, we're constantly evolving to meet the needs of our customers, our people and our business. As a Senior People Manager supporting Qantas Loyalty & Customer, you'll be a trusted strategic advisor to senior leaders, helping to shape workforce strategy, organisational capability and culture across a dynamic and commercially focused portfolio.

This is a genuine strategic HR Business Partner opportunity where you'll work closely with Executive Managers and senior leaders to solve complex business challenges, influence decision making and translate business priorities into impactful people outcomes.

What You'll Be Doing

As a trusted strategic partner, you will:

  • Develop and execute people strategies and workforce plans aligned to business objectives.
  • Partner with senior leaders to build organisational capability and drive business performance.
  • Lead organisational design, transformation and change initiatives.
  • Influence executive stakeholders on talent, succession planning and leadership capability.
  • Use insights, data and analytics to identify opportunities and develop practical solutions to people challenges.
  • Drive high-performance culture, employee engagement and inclusion outcomes.
  • Partner across the wider People Group to deliver scalable and commercially focused people solutions.

You’ll have

  • Significant experience in people partnering with senior leadership teams within a large, complex organisation.
  • Demonstrated success developing and implementing strategic people plans.
  • Strong organisational design, workforce planning and change leadership experience.
  • Exceptional stakeholder engagement and influencing capability.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to leverage people insights and analytics to inform decisions.
  • Experience coaching senior leaders and driving leadership effectiveness.
  • A growth mindset, curiosity and passion for modern people practices.
  • Tertiary qualifications in Human Resources, Business, Psychology or a related discipline.

Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully.

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave (plus superannuation payments on all paid and unpaid parental leave until your child turns 1) and additional purchased leave options for eligible employees.
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion. If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application.

Travelers across the globe use the Tripadvisor site and app to discover where to stay, what to do and where to eat based on guidance from those who have been there before. With more than 1 billion reviews and opinions of nearly 8 million businesses, travelers turn to Tripadvisor to find deals on accommodations, book experiences, reserve tables at delicious restaurants and discover great places nearby. As a travel guidance company available in 43 markets and 22 languages, Tripadvisor makes planning easy no matter the trip type. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), own and operate a portfolio of travel media brands and businesses, operating under various websites and apps, including the following:
www.bokun.io, www.cruisecritic.com, www.flipkey.com, www.thefork.com, www.helloreco.com, www.holidaylettings.co.uk, www.jetsetter.com, www.niumba.com, www.seatguru.com, www.singleplatform.com, www.vacationhomerentals.com, www.viator.com.

job.job_description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor is a highly respected and trusted platform in the travel industry. The Trust and Safety team at Tripadvisor is responsible for all the user-generated content that we receive from our members, which is the very core of our travel guidance offering. We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced content specialist to join our team as a Lead Content Specialist.

As a Lead Content Specialist on our Content Moderation team, you will leverage analytics to identify and moderate content to ensure compliance with guidelines and policies. In this role, you will contribute to projects that refine content moderation processes, foster continuous improvement, and ensure our moderation efforts align with broader business objectives.

Location: UK Hybrid/Remote

What You’ll Do

  • Lead moderation projects focused on enhancing the accuracy and eligibility of our published content.
  • Implement innovative moderation techniques and tools for improving the reliability of our content.
  • Identify, analyse, and moderate content to ensure compliance with guidelines and policies. implementing strategic content improvements.
  • Directly contribute to KPIs related to content moderation accuracy, response times, and user satisfaction.
  • Regularly report on individual performance metrics and contribute to team goals by identifying areas for improvement in the moderation process.
  • Participates in discussions and projects within the Trust & Safety team, focusing on direct contributions to shared objectives and learning from experienced team members.
  • Communicate moderation actions and guidelines effectively within the Trust & Safety team, contributing to internal meetings with clear and concise input on daily moderation challenges.
  • Produce detailed reports on moderation activities and outcomes.
  • Contribute to the internal documentation of moderation processes, ensuring these resources are accurate and easy to understand for team use.
  • Use database querying and data analysis skills to track and report on key metrics and analyze content trends
  • Drive execution of projects and product ideas to increase the efficiency of tools, enhance automation, and improve quality using relevant metrics
  • Identify, quantify, and articulate impact and resolutions of bugs and other improvements
  • Executes day-to-day operational content moderation tasks, including moderating user-generated content and handling escalations, applying advanced judgment to resolve complex content issues.

Skills & Experience

  • 4+ years of relevant professional experience
  • University degree or equivalent experience required
  • Advanced proficiency in user-generated content moderation.
  • Intermediate data analysis skills. Familiarity with tools for tracking and reporting on content moderation effectiveness and efficiency; SQL proficiency is a plus.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams across an organization.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and inspire others.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically and translate insights into actionable plans.
  • Passion for innovation and a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Knowledge of multiple languages a plus

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

#TRIPADVIOSOR

job.job_description:
Join our Operations & Delivery team as a Port Delivery Agent in Bangkok where you will work as a team responsible for the tour operations, ensuring a high standard and quality service to achieve the highest guest and client satisfaction.

Intercruises Shoreside & Port Services is a TUI owned specialist business providing cruise ship handling services to cruise lines in destinations throughout the world. You will be assisting cruise lines and other clients on their daily operations.

If you have got the right to work in Thailand and speak Thai and English, keep on reading!

The closing date for applications is the 31st of July 2026.

About Our Offer

  • A job at TUI offers more than your basic salary which already starts at 327,200 THB gross per year.
  • We pay you for all training days completed plus free access to our TUI Learning Hub, TUI Skills Academy & language lessons.  
  • Get involved with charity and sustainability initiatives like the TUI Care Foundation and complimentary access to our dedicated WeCare Team & 24/7 Wellbeing Hub. 
  • We offer a permanent contract, and you can level up your career with growth opportunities tailored to your unique skills and expertise.

About You

  • You have experience as tour operator, planning and organizing and understand the need to provide exceptional customer service at all times.
  • You are a confident decision maker, even when working under pressure.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written in English.
  • You have a pro-active guest service mindset with a clear focus on quality and efficiency.
  • Able to work in a flexible manner (including different work shifts) depending on cruise ship schedules will be required.
  • Willing to travel for cruise operations within the ports in Thailand and Cambodia.
  • You are open to learn, grow and drive your career while passionately delivering a great service to our guests and cruise clients.
  • You are comfortable using Microsoft Office tools, including Outlook (email), Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

About The Job

  • Pre-operational preparations - securing the suppliers, coaches, Guides etc for the tours.
  • Being physically present at the port on the days of operation to deliver excellent customer and cruise line operational service. Early starts and demands work during some weekends.
  • Liaise with ships and respective operations onboard teams to review, update and arrange all final details, according to pre-approved itineraries.
  • Invoicing and costing. Information is promptly entered into the database.
  • To respond to all inquiries in a timely manner (within 24 hours).
  • Invoicing – preparation and dissemination on a timely manner.
  • Verification of suppliers/vendors invoices, bills and payments.
  • Any other duties assigned to you from time to time either verbally or in writing by your supervisor/manager.

From a workplace to a place to belong. At TUI we embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, encouraging everyone to come as you are, because together, our potential is limitless.

We are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities and impairments so if you require any support, please do let us know.

Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

Why Inflight Services?

Our customers choose United because of our dedication to safety and passion for service. United's Inflight Services team is made up of diverse, driven individuals working together to Connect People and Unite the World. From operational leadership and crew planning to safety and service procedures, our Inflight Services team provides the innovative approaches, tools, training and guidance needed for our flight attendants to deliver the best possible customer experience, and aid in our mission to become the best airline in the history of aviation.

Job Overview And Responsibilities

The Inflight Crew Scheduling department includes Crew Schedulers and the flight attendants we operationally schedule. Providing contractual compliance and efficient procedures for Crew Scheduling.

  • Assists with coordinating the activity of Inflight crew schedulers in day(s) leading up to irregular events
  • (Weather, system outages, etc). Responsibilities include participation in scheduler team selection and role assignments, briefing the team on situation, mission, and execution, and creating reporting for the
  • IRROPs Manager to incorporate into team communications
  • Monitors key tools and metrics (Volare, uCrew, phone/chat systems) for high-risk flights and peak wait periods and redistributes staffing during irregular events and recovery period
  • Operates recovery tools (i.e. Crew Solver, etc) and makes operational recommendations
  • Facilitates internal department process improvement/intake sessions focused on IRROPs
  • Refines departmental IRROP tool parameters and trains schedulers on IRROP processes during recurrent and New Hire modules

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree or 4 years of relevant work experience
  • 1 - 2 years Scheduling Operations experience
  • 1 - 2 years operational management
  • Knowledge of FARs, crew collective bargaining agreements, policies & procedures
  • Process implementation and training for front line employees
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Adaptability to changing business environment
  • Ability to identify opportunities, motivate and drive consistency
  • Build and maintain positive relationships with front line employees and stakeholders
  • Read and write in English
  • Microsoft Office experience
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Good presentation skills
  • Ability to interact with all levels of management
  • Experience in training delivery tools
  • Experience in operational tools (i.e. Volare, uCrew, Crew Solver, etc)

This position will be open from 7/24/2026 through 8/3/2026.

The base pay range for this role is $81,795.00 to $106,602.00.

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

You may be eligible for the following competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident & disability, parental leave, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) and flight privileges.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Strategic Partnerships team is responsible for identifying, building, and scaling high-impact partnerships that expand Agoda’s reach, improve customer acquisition, and create long-term business value.

For Taiwan, Financial Institution (FI) partnerships represent a strategic growth channel. This role will focus on developing and managing relationships with banks, card issuers, digital wallets, and other financial ecosystem partners to drive customer engagement, commercial growth, and win-win partnership outcomes.

You will work cross-functionally with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and Operations to bring partnership opportunities from idea to execution and optimization.

  • This role is based in our Bangkok or Shanghai office with a hybrid setup (3 days in office per week / Relocation support will be provided).

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager/Senior Area Manager, Strategic Partnerships to lead Agoda’s Taiwan FI partnership strategy and execution.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new partnership opportunities, managing key strategic accounts, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving performance across Agoda’s financial institution partnerships in Taiwan. You will help shape Agoda’s local partnership roadmap, unlock joint business opportunities, and ensure excellent execution of campaigns and initiatives with partners.

The ideal candidate brings strong business development and partnership experience, sharp commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is highly strategic but also willing to work hands-on to deliver measurable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Partnership Strategy & Business Development

  • Define and drive Agoda’s FI partnership strategy for Taiwan, aligned with market priorities and business growth objectives
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnership opportunities with banks, credit card issuers, payment platforms, loyalty programs, and other financial ecosystem players
  • Build compelling partnership value propositions and business cases to secure internal alignment and partner buy-in
  • Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract execution with prospective and existing FI partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key FI partners in Taiwan, ensuring strong relationship management and long-term strategic alignment
  • Develop joint business plans with partners to drive customer acquisition, transaction growth, brand visibility, and partnership profitability
  • Monitor partner performance and proactively identify growth levers, optimization opportunities, and operational improvements
  • Ensure timely execution of campaigns, product integrations, and partner initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale partnership initiatives
  • Translate partner needs into clear internal requirements and drive execution across multiple teams
  • Influence decision-making through strong communication, stakeholder management, and data-backed recommendations
  • Support process improvements, reporting frameworks, and operating models to improve scalability and partner experience

Analytics & Optimization

  • Analyze partnership performance, customer behavior, campaign effectiveness, and commercial outcomes to generate actionable insights
  • Use data to identify trends, optimize investment decisions, and improve partnership ROI
  • Build business cases for new initiatives and present recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Track key success metrics and maintain clear visibility on pipeline, performance, and impact

Experience

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 7+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, consulting, or a related commercial role
  • Strong experience managing external partners and driving commercial outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
  • Experience working with or within financial institutions, payment companies, loyalty ecosystems, or digital consumer platforms is highly preferred
  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, fintech, payments, or internet platforms is a strong plus
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to structure win-win partnerships and negotiate effectively
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into clear business insights and actions
  • Strong project management capabilities with high attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience influencing senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Self-starter with a bias for action and ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment
  • Comfortable working hands-on while also thinking strategically

Technical / Functional

  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with SQL, Tableau, or data visualization tools is a plus
  • Ability to develop business cases, commercial models, and performance reporting frameworks
  • Familiarity with campaign execution, co-marketing partnerships, loyalty mechanics, or payment-related partnership models is beneficial

Language

  • Fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese is required

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at our corporate office in McLean, VA

This is your chance to be part of an award-winning in-house Communications Team! As Director, Executive Communications – Commercial, you will work in close partnership with Hilton's Commercial Services organization – comprising over 4,000 Team Members driving our sales, revenue management, call center, and analytics functions – to shape internal and external storytelling that drives growth across a global business.

You will support the Chief Commercial Officer in internal and external communications focused on Hilton's commercial performance, strategic agenda, and Team Member engagement worldwide. You will be a member of the Hilton Corporate Affairs Team, reporting to the Sr. Director of Executive Communications, and working in close partnership with the Global Commercial Leadership Team.

You will take complex and disparate information and translate it into a clear and compelling narratives, creating messaging that reflects both the strength Hilton's commercial engine and the strategic direction of our business globally. You will bring a strong global perspective, exceptional executive voice, and proven ability to develop high-impact speeches and internal and external thought leadership stages/opportunities in a complex, matrixed environment.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

  • Serve as a primary communicator for the Chief Commercial Officer, developing remarks, scripts, and narratives for internal and external engagements that are clear, authentic, and aligned to Hilton's enterprise strategy.
  • Craft impactful communications materials, including leadership updates, presentations, talking points, and executive briefings.
  • Source and synthesize information and data to develop clear, cohesive messaging, partnering across the organization to distill insights into compelling storylines that resonate globally.
  • Build and elevate an external thought leadership platform for the Chief Commercial Officer, in partnership with the broader Corporate Affairs team
  • Build an internal leadership platform that connects the Chief Commercial Officer with Team Members worldwide, in close coordination with Commercial Services Planning & Business Operations and HR.
  • Support the Chief Commercial Officer's global speaking engagements, ensuring consistency, relevance, and clarity across diverse audiences and markets.

How You'll Collaborate With Others

  • Partner across a global, matrixed organization to ensure aligned and effective communications planning and execution.
  • Be a connector across teams, bringing together inputs from multiple stakeholders to create unified, enterprise-aligned messaging.
  • Lead others formally and informally to ensure communications activities are connected and aligned across the Commercial Services organization globally.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Seven (7) years of experience in Communications, Public Relations, or a related field
  • Experience working in a global, corporate, matrixed environment
  • Experience supporting executive communications, including preparing materials for senior leaders
  • Experience developing written communications for internal and/or external audiences
  • Travel up to 30%

It Would Be Useful If You Have

  • Two (2) years of Supervisory, Project Management, and/or hospitality experience
  • Multimedia communications experience including copywriting, graphic design, MS PowerPoint presentations, and video production
  • Communications consulting/coaching experience in a communications agency or consulting environment

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we're known for doesn't end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members' wellbeing, supporting you through all of life's moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most

エクスペディアグループは、世界のあらゆる場所で、誰もが楽しめる旅行を実現しています。私たちは、旅をより思い出深いものする最先端のテクノロジーと、パートナー企業向けの画期的なサービスを展開しています。また、多様性に溢れて活気があり、居心地の良い社内のコミュニティは、私たちの成功への原動力となっています。

■当社を選ぶ理由

旅行の未来を切り開くには、まず人が第一です。私たちの理念とリーダーシップに導かれて、誰もが帰属意識を強く持ち、違いを認め合い、個人の成功が全員の勝利として扱われるオープンな社風を育んでいます。

社員が旅行に対する情熱を燃やし、やりがいのあるキャリアを歩めるよう、刺激的な旅行特典や柔軟な休暇制度、ハイブリッドなワークセットアップ（素敵なオフィスもあります）、そしてキャリア開発に関するリソースなど、充実した福利厚生をご用意しています。よりオープンな世界を目指している私たちと、ぜひ一緒にお仕事をしませんか？

■当チームについて

Travel Partnership & Mediaでは、競争性の高い商品供給、価値ある広告および旅行メディアネットワーク、アフィリエイトの提供を通じて、パートナー各社が優れた旅行体験やB2B体験を実現すると共に、エクスペディアグループプラットフォームでの成長を促進できるようサポートしています。

担当ポートフォリオにおいて、Expediaの急成長するグローバル顧客基盤に向けて、関連性が高く、魅力的で競争力のある高品質なホテル商品ポートフォリオを企画・開発・維持することが主な職務です。

その過程で、アソシエイトアカウントマネージャはホテルパートナーと継続的に連携し、Expediaマーケットプレイスへの参加を通じて生産性を最大化できるよう支援します。そのために、Expedia独自のデータインサイト、マーケティング、流通、収益管理ツールを効果的に活用します。

■主な業務内容

・提携ホテルに有益なデータ分析の情報や、ニーズに基づいた質の高いコンサルティングサービス（例：収益管理に関する助言や、当グループの市場参入における市場開拓の機会）を提供することで、力強い協力関係を築き、持続させる。

・当グループのウェブサイト上で提携ホテルの商品（コンテンツ、料金、空室状況）が確実に最適化され、サイト閲覧者の宿泊率が最大化されるよう努める。

・宿泊客のニーズを満たすため、繁忙期や満室時における追加宿泊料金や空室情報を提供する。

・各ブランドのマーチャンダイジングやマーケティング施策を強化するため、季節ごとのお得なキャンペーンやプロモーションを実施する。

・当グループのあらゆるサービスを活用し、提携ホテルからの高い関心を引き出し、促進させる： 独自の市場分析（パートナーレポート、競合データ、主要業績ドライバー）、社内収益管理ツール（Rev+）、マーケティングおよびマーチャンダイジングの可能性（動的販促、パッケージ、会員優待、モバイルオファー）、専門ブランド（メディアソリューションなど）の有望性、セルフサービスツール（エクスペディアパートナーセントラル）。

・ホテル パートナーが最高の旅行体験を提供できるよう指導、サポートする。

・KPI指標に基づき業務を効率的に遂行させ、業績目標を達成する。

・スキル向上のため、定期的に自己研鑽を行う。

・ビジネスニーズに応じて、20～30％の出張業務に対応する。

・その他付随する業務を遂行する。

■応募条件

・ネイティブまたはそれ同等の日本語

・ビジネスレベルの英語力（ビジネスの場面において読み書きができ、会話にも抵抗がない方）

About The Team You Are Joining

Reporting to the Corporate Secretary and General Counsel, the Senior Manager Legal Operations and Administration (SMLOA) is a skilled professional with knowledge, skills and experience in legal operations in in-house legal departments. The SMLOA is responsible for the efficient and effective management and operation of IATA’s legal department systems and procedures including IATA’s contract tool, legal matter management system and the oversight of administrative support to the General Counsel and the lawyers in the legal team. The SMLOA reports to the General Counsel and leads an experienced team located in Montreal and Geneva with dedicated legal operations and administrative responsibilities including the Business Operations Coordinator, Legal Administrator and Paralegal.

What Your Day Would Be Like

  • Leads the Legal Operations and Administration team within the Legal Services department to ensure performance is aligned with IATA’s strategic objectives;
  • People management for the Legal Ops and Admin team;
  • Collaborates with the Directors Legal Services and General Counsel on developing improvements, implementing change and management initiatives across the Legal Workstreams to enhance the day-to-day efficiency, consistency and effectiveness of the team;
  • Supports the design, implementation and continuous improvement of legal intake, triage and matter allocation processes, including intake requirements, matter categorisation, workflow discipline and escalation pathways; Supports the development and maintenance of consistent legal operating procedures across legal workstreams, including processes for contract review, matter management, risk assessment and approvals;
  • Supports the development and operationalization of legal playbooks, template materials and customer facing guidance;
  • Works with lawyers and business stakeholders to improve the quality, completeness and timeliness of legal requests and to support consistent use of legal processes and tools;
  • Developing strong relationships within IATA with those interacting with IATA’s legal processes, ERP, legal intake tools and contract tool;
  • Developing strong relationships with IATA’s external law firms’ legal operations team and legal vendors
  • Managing, implementing and reviewing technology including IATA’s contract tool, matter management systems and online legal research resources;
  • Leading projects to improve efficiency and consistency in the delivery of legal services;

We would love to hear from you if you have

  • Experience in project management or similar role;
  • Relevant qualifications and experience in in legal project management, legal operations, legal administration or legal technology;
  • A minimum of 7 years’ experience in legal project support, legal operations or administration in an in house legal department or equivalent in increasingly senior roles;
  • Demonstrated experience with legal matter management, contract lifecycle management, legal intake, workflow design, reporting, dashboards and legal technology implementation;
  • Experience designing, implementing or improving legal department processes, including stakeholder adoption, change management and performance reporting;
  • Sound understanding of in-house legal department operations, including contract review workflows, legal risk processes, external counsel management, document management and administrative support;
  • Commitment to personal development and developing team members;
  • Excellent command of English;
  • Superior written and oral communication skills;
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills;
  • Effective, confident communicator and a team player.

Travel Required: N

Learn more about IATA’s role in the industry, our benefits, and the team at iata/careers/ . We are looking forward to hearing from you!

job.job_description:
Role Purpose

Responsible for developing and documenting detailed business and functional requirements that support the product lifecycle for IHG’s Groups & Events and Global Sales capabilities. This role partners closely with Product Managers, Sales stakeholders, Technology, and external vendors to research current-state processes, identify gaps and pain points, and support the design and delivery of system enhancements across multiple integrated platforms.

The Business Analyst supports assigned initiatives end‑to‑end, from discovery and planning through testing and implementation, ensuring solutions align to business outcomes such as improved sales enablement, operational efficiency, and enhanced guest and planner experiences.

Key Accountabilities

  • For assigned initiatives, partner with Product, Sales, and Operations stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document detailed business and functional requirements, including scope documents, process flows, use cases, business rules, and supporting documentation (e.g., business justification and ROI inputs).
  • Conduct fact‑finding and current‑state analysis by engaging users of existing systems and processes (e.g., sales teams, hotels, planners, call centers), identifying complexities, dependencies, and pain points to ensure proposed solutions fully address business needs.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers and Technology teams to translate business needs into clear, consumable documentation for internal delivery teams and external vendors, supporting solution design and prioritization.
  • Support initiatives involving multiple integrated systems and vendors, including CRM (Salesforce), booking, inventory, reservation, and related sales and events platforms, ensuring alignment across end‑to‑end workflows.
  • For assigned projects, coordinate with stakeholders to manage requirements changes, identify preferred solutions, and support the delivery of enhancements that drive revenue, reduce operational friction, or improve customer and planner experiences.
  • Design, document, and support Business and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities, including test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and defect tracking. Communicate issues and outcomes to key stakeholders and technology teams.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for clarifying business processes, system behavior, and data interpretation between IHG, internal teams, and external vendors.

Key Skills & Experiences

Education

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Experience

  • 2–5 years of progressive experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or similar role, with a strong focus on business processes and system functionality rather than reporting or pure data analytics.
  • Experience supporting end‑to‑end product or project lifecycles, from discovery through delivery and testing.
  • Experience working in cross‑functional, matrixed environments with Product, Sales, Operations, and Technology teams.
  • Hospitality, travel, or commercial sales platform experience is preferred but not required.

Technical Skills & Knowledge

Founded in the Queensland outback in 1920, Qantas has grown to be Australia’s largest regional, domestic, and international airline. Qantas has a range of subsidiary businesses that support the overall operations of the Group. The Qantas Group’s main business is the transportation of customers and freight using two complementary airline brands — Qantas and Jetstar — operating regional, domestic, and international services.

Job Description

  • Lead efficient business support for the Australasian Sales, Distribution and Modern Retailing team, ensuring seamless day-to-day operations.
  • Provide executive and operational support by managing priorities, enabling project delivery and supporting key business initiatives.
  • Permanent position based at our Mascot Campus

Qantas is in the middle of one of the most significant transformations in its commercial history. The way we sell, distribute and retail our product is changing, and the team leading that change needs someone who can keep everything moving.

This is a pivotal support role at the centre of our Australasian Sales, Distribution and Modern Retailing function. You'll work directly with the Executive Manager and senior leadership team, helping to drive delivery across a broad portfolio that spans corporate and SME sales, NDC and modern retailing strategy, agency and OTA channels, and our Jetconnect New Zealand business.

Your days will vary. You might be coordinating a cross-regional stakeholder engagement one morning and preparing executive-level documentation the next. You'll manage complex calendars, support global distribution projects, and help ensure the team operates with the pace and precision this kind of work demands. You'll also support corporate hospitality and event engagements, monitor expenses and business processes, and help us continuously improve how we work.

To thrive here, you'll bring;

  • five or more years of experience in executive support,
  • experience in business coordination, or similar role, ideally in an aviation, travel, or commercial environment
  • you're highly organised, discreet with sensitive information,
  • confident preparing reports, presentations, and executive communications
  • having strong Microsoft Office skills is essential, and
  • experience with Salesforce and Power BI will give you a genuine head start

Why Qantas?  

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully. 

There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.  

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.  

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays. 
  • We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave (plus superannuation payments on all paid and unpaid parental leave until your child turns 1) and additional purchased leave options for eligible employees. 
  • We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment. You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships. 
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan. 

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion.  We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply.  If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application.  Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation. 

Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – get in touch today. 

Applications close: Friday 31st July 2026

Please note: applications will only be considered for candidates who have the right to work in Australia / New Zealand without restriction or sponsorship.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Strategic Partnerships team is responsible for identifying, building, and scaling high-impact partnerships that expand Agoda’s reach, improve customer acquisition, and create long-term business value.

For Taiwan, Financial Institution (FI) partnerships represent a strategic growth channel. This role will focus on developing and managing relationships with banks, card issuers, digital wallets, and other financial ecosystem partners to drive customer engagement, commercial growth, and win-win partnership outcomes.

You will work cross-functionally with teams across Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, Analytics, and Operations to bring partnership opportunities from idea to execution and optimization.

  • This role is based in our Bangkok or Shanghai office with a hybrid setup (3 days in office per week / Relocation support will be provided).

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Manager/Senior Area Manager, Strategic Partnerships to lead Agoda’s Taiwan FI partnership strategy and execution.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new partnership opportunities, managing key strategic accounts, negotiating commercial agreements, and driving performance across Agoda’s financial institution partnerships in Taiwan. You will help shape Agoda’s local partnership roadmap, unlock joint business opportunities, and ensure excellent execution of campaigns and initiatives with partners.

The ideal candidate brings strong business development and partnership experience, sharp commercial judgment, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is highly strategic but also willing to work hands-on to deliver measurable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Partnership Strategy & Business Development

  • Define and drive Agoda’s FI partnership strategy for Taiwan, aligned with market priorities and business growth objectives
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new partnership opportunities with banks, credit card issuers, payment platforms, loyalty programs, and other financial ecosystem players
  • Build compelling partnership value propositions and business cases to secure internal alignment and partner buy-in
  • Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract execution with prospective and existing FI partners

Account Management & Growth

  • Own and grow a portfolio of key FI partners in Taiwan, ensuring strong relationship management and long-term strategic alignment
  • Develop joint business plans with partners to drive customer acquisition, transaction growth, brand visibility, and partnership profitability
  • Monitor partner performance and proactively identify growth levers, optimization opportunities, and operational improvements
  • Ensure timely execution of campaigns, product integrations, and partner initiatives

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Marketing, Product, Analytics, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale partnership initiatives
  • Translate partner needs into clear internal requirements and drive execution across multiple teams
  • Influence decision-making through strong communication, stakeholder management, and data-backed recommendations
  • Support process improvements, reporting frameworks, and operating models to improve scalability and partner experience

Analytics & Optimization

  • Analyze partnership performance, customer behavior, campaign effectiveness, and commercial outcomes to generate actionable insights
  • Use data to identify trends, optimize investment decisions, and improve partnership ROI
  • Build business cases for new initiatives and present recommendations to senior stakeholders
  • Track key success metrics and maintain clear visibility on pipeline, performance, and impact

Experience

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 7+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, business development, account management, consulting, or a related commercial role
  • Strong experience managing external partners and driving commercial outcomes in a fast-paced, data-driven environment
  • Experience working with or within financial institutions, payment companies, loyalty ecosystems, or digital consumer platforms is highly preferred
  • Experience in e-commerce, travel, fintech, payments, or internet platforms is a strong plus
  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to structure win-win partnerships and negotiate effectively
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert data into clear business insights and actions
  • Strong project management capabilities with high attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience influencing senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Self-starter with a bias for action and ability to operate independently in an ambiguous environment
  • Comfortable working hands-on while also thinking strategically

Technical / Functional

  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with SQL, Tableau, or data visualization tools is a plus
  • Ability to develop business cases, commercial models, and performance reporting frameworks
  • Familiarity with campaign execution, co-marketing partnerships, loyalty mechanics, or payment-related partnership models is beneficial

Language

  • Fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese is required

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
