Market Manager, Bangkok

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services - helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their customers. From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world.

As a Market Manager within our Market Management organization, you will own a key portfolio of hotel and lodging partners in Thailand and help them win on Expedia Group’s global travel platforms.

You will use data, market insights, an understanding of the partner’s business, and trusted relationships to grow partner performance while ensuring travelers have access to attractive, competitive rates. This is a highly visible role where you shape local market strategy, influence partner success, and contribute directly to Expedia Group’s growth in the Thailand market.

In this role, you will

  • Build and grow strategic relationships with hotel and lodging partners in your territory, acting as a trusted consultant on revenue management, distribution, and marketing.
  • Optimize partner performance on Expedia Group sites by ensuring high-quality content, competitive rates, and strong availability to maximize traveler conversion.
  • Identify and secure targeted promotions, seasonal deals, and additional inventory over peak and compression periods to capture demand and support brand marketing initiatives.
  • Use data insights, partner reports, and competitive analysis to diagnose performance, recommend actions, and demonstrate the value of partnering with Expedia Group.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to execute market strategies and business initiatives, while representing Expedia Group with local tourism boards, associations, and other key influencers.
  • Travel 20–30% of the time to visit partners in market, deepen relationships, and drive results.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in account management, sales, or a closely related field.
  • Proficient in English and Thai, with the ability to clearly present ideas, influence stakeholders, and negotiate for win–win outcomes.
  • You bring a passion for travel, a data-driven mindset, and comfort working in a fast-changing, technology-led environment.
  • Proven ability to manage a portfolio, prioritize and multi-task, and consistently meet or exceed targets, goals, or strategic objectives.
  • Strong analytical skills using market trends, partner performance, and competitor data to identify opportunities and address partner needs.
  • Relationship builder with a growth mindset: you proactively seek feedback, coach others, and use Expedia Group’s tools and self-service solutions to help partners and colleagues succeed.

Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national promotions pull through. Develops and implements property–wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer profile and property associates and provides a return on investment to the owner and Marriott International.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

Required:

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR

  • 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

Preferred:

  • 4 year college degree.

Building Successful Relationships

Leadership

  • Creates effective structures, processes, jobs and performance management systems are in place.

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know Our Team

The Data department oversees all of Agoda’s data-related requirements. Our ultimate goal is to enable and increase the use of data in the company through creative approaches and the implementation of powerful resources such as operational and analytical databases, queue systems, BI tools, and data science technology. We hire the brightest minds from around the world to take on this challenge and equip them with the knowledge and tools that contribute to their personal growth and success while supporting our company’s culture of diversity and experimentation. The role the Data team plays at Agoda is critical as business users, product managers, engineers, and many others rely on us to empower their decision making. We are equally dedicated to our customers by improving their search experience with faster results and protecting them from any fraudulent activities. Data is interesting only when you have enough of it, and we have plenty. This is what drives up the challenge as part of the Data department, but also the reward.

The Opportunity

This role is a 6-month contract based in Bangkok, Thailand, and the candidate who succeeds will be assigned to the projects.

As a Business Intelligence Developer, you will have the exciting opportunity to design and develop data and BI solutions that drive Agoda’s analytics capabilities. In this role, you’ll collaborate across diverse functional teams to ensure our data and solutions truly meet business analytic needs. You’ll work closely with engineering teams responsible for Agoda’s products and applications, ensuring that all critical data is accurately tracked and logged with the highest quality standards.

This position focuses on Rocket Travel by Agoda’s data, giving you the chance to work on impactful projects and collaborate with teams from different backgrounds and expertise. You’ll enjoy a flexible working environment that empowers you to manage your own schedule and encourages innovative thinking. If you’re looking for a role where you can make a real difference, grow your skills, and work with talented colleagues in a dynamic, supportive setting, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

In This Role, You’ll Get to

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather and understand their data and reporting requirements, ensuring solutions align with business objectives.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure that all critical data from Agoda’s products and applications is accurately captured and maintained.
  • Design, develop, and enhance dashboards and reports that provide valuable insights and support data-driven decision-making across the organization.
  • Implement and uphold data quality processes to ensure information is accurate, complete, and available when needed.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of team processes, helping to streamline workflows and increase efficiency.
  • Participate in key projects, such as migrating data from legacy systems to new platforms, to support the creation of a unified and reliable data source for Agoda and Rocket Travel by Agoda.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply, preferably less than 2-year experience
  • Proficiency in basic SQL, with the ability to write queries and work with large datasets.
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English within a professional setting, facilitating smooth collaboration with colleagues from different teams and diverse backgrounds.
  • The ability to work independently as well as part of a team, demonstrating initiative and reliability.
  • Excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Willing to adjust working hours, including starting early or finishing late, to participate in meetings across different time zones sometimes.

It’s Great If You Have

  • Experience or knowledge in Business Intelligence, data warehouse concepts, or familiarity with tools such as Tableau, Metabase, SQL Server, Vertica, Hadoop, or MSDT.
  • Skills in Python programming, which can support more advanced data analysis and automation tasks.
  • Please note that this position does not offer visa or work permit sponsorship.*

Job Summary

Hilton Supply Management (HSM) is the largest global hospitality-focused supply chain organization, managing over $6 billion in spend influence across more than 2,000 suppliers worldwide. This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and high-impact team within HSM's Corporate and Technology Procurement division. In this role, you will be responsible for managing supplier data, supporting program implementation, and ensuring compliance across multiple procurement platforms. Working closely with category managers and reporting to the Director of Corporate Procurement, you will play a critical role in driving operational efficiency, maintaining data integrity, and supporting strategic sourcing initiatives across a broad portfolio of categories. This is a 12-month contract assignment with the potential for extension.

Responsibilities

  • Work independently in key areas of data management, supplier management, compliance, and reporting
  • Connect with suppliers and onboard them through multiple programs, including Coupa, Risk Assessment, and EcoVadis
  • Monitor requisition requests within Coupa, draft contract templates specific to the supplier type, and hand off initial contracts to the Category Manager for negotiation and execution
  • Perform monthly reporting on contract status, contract planning, and savings captured across categories
  • Maintain Coupa data and roll it up into Salesforce as required
  • Perform supplier contact updates in Salesforce as required
  • Cross-train with other departments, including shadowing team members across functions
  • Manage deviated pricing contract maintenance and updates
  • Support other HSM departments with additional duties as assigned

Skills

  • Dedicated self-starter who takes initiative with minimal direction and grasps new concepts quickly
  • Solid contract management expertise, including familiarity with legal and business terms and strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work collaboratively with internal teams as well as externally with suppliers and industry partners
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information to stakeholders in a concise, well-organized manner tailored to the appropriate level of detail for the target audience
  • Strong negotiation skills and strategic business acumen
  • Excellent critical thinking combined with quantitative and qualitative analytical skills

Experience

  • 2+ years procurement analyst experience
  • Experience using Coupa is preferred
  • Indirect procurement experience is preferred

This is a rare opportunity to make a meaningful impact within one of the most recognized names in global hospitality. As part of a forward-thinking and collaborative team, you will gain valuable exposure to enterprise-level procurement operations, supplier relationship management, and cross-functional initiatives that drive real business results. If you are a motivated professional with a passion for data, systems, and strategic sourcing, this role offers the platform to grow your expertise and contribute to an organization that is shaping the future of hospitality supply chain management.

Manages the marketing budget to enable development of property specific campaigns, promotions and collateral to drive revenue and meet property objectives. Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national promotions pull through. Develops and implements property–wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer profile and property associates and provides a return on investment to the owner and Marriott International.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

Required:

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR

  • 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

Preferred:

  • 4 year college degree.
  • Demonstrated skills in supervising a team.
  • Lodging sales experience.
  • Hotel industry work experience, demonstrating progressive career growth and a pattern of exceptional performance.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Sales Activities

  • Manages the development of a strategic account plan for the demand generators in the market.
  • Manages the property's reactive and proactive sales efforts.
  • Determines and develops marketing communication activities, in conjunction with Regional Marketing Communications.
  • Provides customer intelligence in evaluating the market and economic trends that may lead to changes in sales strategy to meet or exceed customer expectations.
  • Reviews the Strategic Alignment Review (STAR) report, competitive shopping reports and uses other resources to maintain an awareness of the hotel’s market position.
  • Researches competitor’s sales team strategies to identify ways to grow occupancy and RevPAR and increase market share.
  • Attends sales strategy meetings to provide input on weekly and overall sales strategy.
  • Suggests innovative marketing ideas and develops deployment strategies to continue to grow market share.
  • Evaluates and supports participation and account deployment with Area Sales and Group Sales within the Sales Office.
  • Serves as the sales contact for the General Manager, property leadership team, Group Sales and Area Sales leaders.
  • Serves as the sales contact for customers; serves as the customer advocate.
  • Serves as hotel authority on sales processes and sales contracts.
  • Serves as the property sales liaison with Area Sales, Group Sales, Revenue Management, Event Management, Regional Marketing Communications and other hotel departments as appropriate.
  • Participates in sales calls with members of the Sales and Marketing team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
  • Identifies public relations opportunities and coordinates activities to augment the overall marketing communication strategy.
  • Supports the General Manager by coordinating crisis communications.
  • Executes and supports Marriott’s Customer Service Standards and hotel’s Brand Standards.
  • Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
  • Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand (e.g., , Marriott Hotels and Resorts (MHR) Spirit to Serve Daily Basics, Renaissance Hotels and Resorts (RHR) Savvy Service Basics, Courtyard, SpringHill Suites, Fairfield Inn Basics of the Day, Residence Inn Daily Huddle, or TownePlace Suites Morning Meeting).
  • Implements a seamless turnover from sales to operations and back to sales while consistently delivering high level of service.
  • Monitors the effective resolution of guest issues that arise as a result of the sales process by creating mechanisms to channel issues to property leadership and/or other appropriate stakeholders.
  • Maintains successful performance by increasing revenues, controlling expenses and providing a return on investment for the owner and Marriott International.
  • Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process and focuses on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of the hotel’s’ sales objectives.
  • Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national promotions pull through.
  • Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.

Building Successful Relationships

  • Develops strong partnerships with local organizations to further increase brand/product awareness.
  • Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships.
  • Develops strong community and public relations by maintaining property participation in local, regional and national tradeshows and client events.
  • Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and monitoring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
  • Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to Marriott.
  • Gains understanding of the hotel’s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.

Leadership

  • Functions as the leader of the property’s sales department for properties with bookings over 300 peak rooms and significant local catering revenue.
  • Develops sales goals and strategies and verifies alignment with the brand business strategy.
  • Executes the sales strategy in order to meet individual booking goals for both self and staff.
  • Coaches leaders of revenue generating departments in developing effective revenue strategies and setting aggressive goals that will drive the property's financial performance.
  • Verifies Sales team understands and is leveraging Marriott International (MI) demand engines to full potential.
  • Works with Human Resources, Engineering and Loss Prevention to monitor compliance with local, state and federal regulations and/or union requirements.
  • Partners with Human Resources to attract, develop and retain the right people in order to support the strategic priorities of the market.
  • Creates effective structures, processes, jobs and performance management systems are in place.
  • Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the Leadership Performance Process (LPP), aligns performance and rewards, addresses performance issues and holds staff accountable for successful results.
  • Forecasts talent needs and manages talent acquisition strategy with Human Resources (HR) to minimize lost time due to turnover.
  • Maintains an active list of the competition’s best sales people and executes a recruitment and acquisition plan with HR.
  • Supports tools and training resources to educate sales associates on winning catering solutions.
  • Champions leadership development and workforce planning priorities by assessing, selecting, retaining and developing diverse, high-caliber talent that can lead the organization today and strengthen the leadership bench for the future; continues to upgrade the sales & marketing talent; works with HR to anticipate future talent needs based on business growth plans.
  • Identifies, trains and mentors group sales associates; utilizes all available on the job training tools for associates.
  • Transfers functional knowledge and develops group sales skills of other discipline managers.
  • Provides day to day leadership to sales associates to achieve property sales objectives with overall responsibility for achieving booking goals and property revenues.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team:

Since inception of Flights in late 2019, momentum has surged, particularly in response to the transformative impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. Today, we are a fast-growing group of passionate individuals that thrive in a bustling, dynamic environment. Our sole objective is to propel the Flights vertical forward, in a competitive landscape. Operating with the agility of a startup within the broader Agoda ecosystem, we're driven by innovation and the relentless determination to scale and shape the future of flight bookings.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Strategic Project Manager to join our Flights Supply team. In this key role, you will manage and support a variety of strategic projects within the flights supply team, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive business growth and expansion.

You will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving the execution of key initiatives across departments such as product, supply, marketing, finance, and customer service. This includes setting clear project objectives, managing timelines, mitigating risks, and ensuring deliverables are met on time and within scope. By translating business data and insights into actionable strategies, you will ensure alignment and progress toward organizational goals.

This role is vital to the growth of Agoda Flights, contributing to its transformation from a new vertical into a core component of Agoda's operations. You will play an integral role in driving effective project execution and ensuring alignment with Agoda's broader business objectives.

In this role, you will get to:

Project Management and Execution:

  • Manage and oversee strategic projects for flights supply, ensuring initiatives move the dial, are executed on time and exceed expectations.
  • Develop and maintain project roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables, coordinating across multiple team in various departments to ensure successful implementation.
  • Monitor project progress and proactively address risks and challenges to maintain alignment with business objectives.
  • Support the development and deployment of tools and processes to improve team efficiency and productivity.

Stakeholder Management and Collaboration:

  • Act as a central point of contact between supply, operations, analytics, product, and finance teams at Agoda and other brands of Booking Holdings.
  • Work closely with Country Directors to understand their market needs and ensure alignment with broader organizational goals.
  • Facilitate communication and alignment across teams, ensuring all stakeholders are informed and engaged throughout project lifecycles.

Strategy, Performance Steering and Reporting:

  • Assist in defining OKRs and KPIs for the flights supply team, ensuring they align with overall company goals.
  • Track, analyze and guide team performance against key metrics, providing regular updates and actionable insights to collaborators and leadership alike.
  • Compile reports and updates for senior leadership to showcase progress, challenges, and outcomes of key initiatives.

Operational Support:

  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency across the flights supply team.
  • Support the creation of scalable workflows and best practices for cross-departmental collaboration.

What you will need to succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 4-5 years of relevant experience in a strategy consulting firm or in a tech company (project / program manager role)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly and concisely.
  • Proven track record of successful cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate strategic initiatives and drive business growth.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders
  • Ability to learn fast and understand new business dynamics.
  • Excitement to join a dynamic and innovative team within Agoda, with excellent growth prospects.

It’s great if you have:

  • Knowledge of SQL or willingness to invest time to learn.

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Accor Tech & Digital est le moteur de la tech, des solutions digitales et de la transformation au sein du Groupe. Nos 5 000 talents s'engagent à offrir les meilleures expériences digitales et tech à nos clients, nos hôtels et nos équipes dans 110 pays, et à façonner l'avenir de l'hospitalité.

Accor Tech & Digital, des métiers où l’intelligence est d’abord humaine !

Description du poste

Accor Tech & Digital, c’est le laboratoire d’innovation et de transformation technologique du leader mondial de l’hôtellerie.

Nos équipes, appelées Heartist®, concentrent le meilleur de l'hospitalité et le meilleur de la tech & du digital.

Notre ambition : offrir à nos clients des expériences personnalisées, mémorables et durables.

Ici, nous faisons naître de nouvelles façons de voyager dans chacun de nos 5 500 hôtels, au plus proche de nos 100 millions de clients dans 110 pays.

Ici, nous sommes au cœur d’un formidable terrain de jeu de transition technologique et de conception de produits digitaux et de services, pour nos clients et nos équipes en hôtels.

Ici, votre champ d’application ne connaîtra aucune frontière.

Alors, avec nous, osez avoir un impact sur le monde !

C’est ici que vous attend votre plus grand défi :

Au sein de la Tribe Distribution & Hotel Services du domaine Data, nous recherchons notre Data Product Director pour définir la vision et la roadmap de nos produits data, incluant notamment, une composante clé sur l'intégration de fonctionnalités d'Intelligence Artificielle.

Vous construirez une relation de travail pérenne avec vos interlocuteurs métiers et l’ensemble des parties prenantes clés de l’écosystème data, afin de vous assurer que la roadmap corresponde bien aux ambitions métiers et crée de la valeur pour le groupe Accor.

Vous travaillerez en binôme avec le responsable technique sur votre périmètre (Data Engineering Director) pour cadrer la feuille de route, en alignement avec les ambitions stratégiques métiers et data.

Votre Mission

  • En tant que Data Product Director, vous définissez, pilotez et développez la stratégie produit et l’usage de la donnée, en collaboration avec le Data Engineering Director du périmètre fonctionnel.
  • En particulier, vous travaillez à identifier avec vos interlocuteurs Business les opportunités de valorisation de la Data au service des objectifs stratégiques et opérationnels.
  • Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes Data Science & AI pour concevoir, développer et déployer des modèles et algorithmes intelligents au sein de nos produits.
  • Vous élaborez la roadmap du développement et d’amélioration continue des produits & services et en êtes le garant fonctionnel.
  • En partenariat avec le Data Engineering Director, vous travaillez à packager et à marketer l’offre Produit auprès de vos clients.
  • Vous travaillez en partenariat avec les autres Data Product Directors, Data Product Managers et Product Owners, ainsi que les équipes Data Engineering et Data Management, pour assurer la livraison des produits dans les délais et le budget imparti et assurez un suivi de la qualité des produits délivrés auprès des utilisateurs.
  • Dans ce cadre, vous êtes amené.e à animer des instances de pilotage et à communiquer sur la stratégie, les plans d'adoption et d’amélioration des produits dont vous avez la responsabilité.
  • Vous définissez des indicateurs de suivi de la valeur produit et reportez sur la réalisation des ambitions de votre domaine fonctionnel.
  • Vous assurez la gestion de l’équipe de Product Owners dont vous avez la responsabilité managériale.

Qualifications

  • Diplômé.e d’une Grande Ecole d’Ingénieur généraliste, informatique ou Master spécialisé en Big Data
  • 5 à 10 ans d’expérience en tant que chef de produit Data ou BI dans le développement de plateformes de données et produits associés et/ou d’applications de données
  • Expérience préalable réussie en management d'équipe
  • Forte compréhension des principes du Machine Learning, de l'Intelligence Artificielle et des statistiques, et de leur application dans des produits concrets
  • Connaissance des structures de bases de données et des processus d’ingestion / intégration / modélisation des données
  • Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles, très bonnes capacités à formaliser, esprit orienté client, capacité de synthèse et de communication « pédagogique »
  • Compétences analytiques, force de proposition dans la recherche de solution pour résoudre les problèmes ou optimiser le produit.
  • Bonne expérience de la distribution hôtelière souhaitable
  • Français et anglais courant

Informations supplémentaires

Et nous, quels sont nos engagements ?

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Assistant Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
  • Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We’ll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program

Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future

Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones

Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care

Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered

  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Position Summary

Under the supervision of the Events Manager, the Events Coordinator supports the planning, coordination, and follow-up of internal and external events. The role serves as the operational liaison between various departments, the Sales team, and clients to ensure the successful execution of all planned services. The Events Coordinator ensures a high standard of guest service and client experience throughout each event while contributing to its overall operational success.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES Event Coordination

  • Assist in the preparation of event documentation (function sheets, rooming lists, schedules, etc.);
  • Enter and manage rooming lists in the hotel's systems and ensure all relevant information is kept up to date;
  • Ensure meeting rooms, banquet areas, and other event spaces are properly prepared in accordance with function sheets and client requirements;
  • Inspect event rooms before each function and report any discrepancies;
  • Participate in pre-event coordination meetings (BEO Meetings) and communicate key information to the relevant operational teams;
  • Be present on-site during events to coordinate operations and ensure smooth execution;
  • Assist in resolving operational issues in collaboration with the relevant departments.

Client Relations & Communication

  • Act as the operational point of contact for clients during their events;
  • Welcome clients on-site, monitor the event's progress, and ensure their satisfaction throughout;
  • Escalate special requests or areas for improvement to the Events Manager;
  • Participate in client site inspections and property tours with the Sales team when required.

Administrative Follow-up & Reporting

  • Assist in monitoring guest satisfaction indicators and collecting client feedback after events;
  • Collaborate with the Finance department on billing-related matters under the supervision of the Events Manager;
  • Contribute to maintaining and updating client files and internal databases.

Client Relationship Management

  • Communicate with clients to gather feedback regarding their satisfaction and identify opportunities for improvement;
  • Report guest complaints or incidents to the direct supervisor;
  • Ensure a visible and supportive presence for clients throughout their event;
  • Conduct post-event follow-up with clients;
  • Review guest feedback and satisfaction results with the operational teams;
  • Coordinate and communicate all event details with clients.

Human Resources

  • Establish and maintain open, collaborative, and effective working relationships with all team members;
  • Use all available training tools to ensure the successful onboarding, training, and follow-up of new associates;
  • Ensure completion of all mandatory internal training and Marriott International virtual training courses;
  • Ensure team members complete all required internal and Marriott International virtual training programs;
  • Ensure hotel and/or Marriott International standards and procedures are consistently applied, and that any disciplinary actions are properly documented and compliant with hotel policies, procedures, and internal regulations;
  • Lead by example by promoting and embodying the company's vision and values:
    • Put people first;
    • Pursue excellence;
    • Embrace change;
    • Act with integrity;
    • Serve our world.
Required Competencies

Personal Attributes

  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills;
  • Responsive and proactive;
  • Warm and approachable personality;
  • Professional appearance and excellent grooming standards;
  • Flexible and available according to operational needs;
  • Strong attention to detail;
  • Ability to perform effectively under pressure.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Fluent spoken and written English;
  • Proficiency in a third language is an asset.

This job description is not exhaustive and may be amended or modified to meet exceptional operational requirements.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team:

Since inception of Flights in late 2019, momentum has surged, particularly in response to the transformative impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. Today, we are a fast-growing group of passionate individuals that thrive in a bustling, dynamic environment. Our sole objective is to propel the Flights vertical forward, in a competitive landscape. Operating with the agility of a startup within the broader Agoda ecosystem, we're driven by innovation and the relentless determination to scale and shape the future of flight bookings.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Strategic Project Manager to join our Flights Supply team. In this key role, you will manage and support a variety of strategic projects within the flights supply team, collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive business growth and expansion.

You will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and driving the execution of key initiatives across departments such as product, supply, marketing, finance, and customer service. This includes setting clear project objectives, managing timelines, mitigating risks, and ensuring deliverables are met on time and within scope. By translating business data and insights into actionable strategies, you will ensure alignment and progress toward organizational goals.

This role is vital to the growth of Agoda Flights, contributing to its transformation from a new vertical into a core component of Agoda's operations. You will play an integral role in driving effective project execution and ensuring alignment with Agoda's broader business objectives.

In this role, you will get to:

Project Management and Execution:

  • Manage and oversee strategic projects for flights supply, ensuring initiatives move the dial, are executed on time and exceed expectations.
  • Develop and maintain project roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables, coordinating across multiple team in various departments to ensure successful implementation.
  • Monitor project progress and proactively address risks and challenges to maintain alignment with business objectives.
  • Support the development and deployment of tools and processes to improve team efficiency and productivity.

Stakeholder Management and Collaboration:

  • Act as a central point of contact between supply, operations, analytics, product, and finance teams at Agoda and other brands of Booking Holdings.
  • Work closely with Country Directors to understand their market needs and ensure alignment with broader organizational goals.
  • Facilitate communication and alignment across teams, ensuring all stakeholders are informed and engaged throughout project lifecycles.

Strategy, Performance Steering and Reporting:

  • Assist in defining OKRs and KPIs for the flights supply team, ensuring they align with overall company goals.
  • Track, analyze and guide team performance against key metrics, providing regular updates and actionable insights to collaborators and leadership alike.
  • Compile reports and updates for senior leadership to showcase progress, challenges, and outcomes of key initiatives.

Operational Support:

  • Identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve operational efficiency across the flights supply team.
  • Support the creation of scalable workflows and best practices for cross-departmental collaboration.

What you will need to succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 4-5 years of relevant experience in a strategy consulting firm or in a tech company (project / program manager role)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly and concisely.
  • Proven track record of successful cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate strategic initiatives and drive business growth.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders
  • Ability to learn fast and understand new business dynamics.
  • Excitement to join a dynamic and innovative team within Agoda, with excellent growth prospects.

It’s great if you have:

  • Knowledge of SQL or willingness to invest time to learn.

job.job_description:
Company Description

 Join Accor – a professional journey at the heart of a committed, international and transforming group

Accor, a global leader in hospitality, present in more than 110 countries with 5,500 hotels, welcomes you to its offices located in Issy-les-Moulineaux.

This is where the Group’s global expertise comes together: strategy, finance, human resources, legal, technology, marketing, sustainability, communication, audit, procurement, etc.

Joining Accor means actively contributing to defining, structuring, and supporting the transformation of an international group, in direct connection with operational teams around the world.

Job Description

Accor Tech & Digital is the innovation and technological transformation lab of the world leader in hospitality.

Our teams, known as Heartists®, bring together the best of hospitality with the best of tech and digital. Our ambition is to provide our customers with personalized, memorable, and sustainable experiences.

Here, we create new ways to travel within each of our 5,500 hotels, connecting closely with our 100 million clients in 110 countries.

Here, we are at the heart of an incredible playground for technological transition and the design of digital products and services for our customers and hotel teams.

Here, your scope will know no boundaries;

So join us and dare to make an impact on the world!

This Is Where Your Greatest Challenge Awaits

Reporting to the SVP of Data Science & AI, you will join a team at the heart of the Accor Group’s transformation through data and artificial intelligence.

Within the Data department, the Data Science & AI vertical aims to define and implement the Group’s AI vision, to scale up the use of ML, GenAI and Agentic AI, and to maximise the business impact of these technologies on the customer experience, hotel operations and internal teams.

You will act as the bridge between business sponsors and the AI / Data Engineering teams, ensuring the right product is built, shipped, adopted and continuously improved.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

What You'll Do During a Typical Day

  • Partner with Engineering teams across web, mobile, and Core APIs to deliver high-quality authentication solutions while effectively managing dependencies and shared resources.

  • Contribute to Agile delivery through sprint planning, backlog refinement, roadmap reviews, and integration discussions to support successful product execution.

  • A prioritized authentication roadmap that improves login success, increases Join conversion, and enables secure, scalable partner integrations.

Benefits

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Role

A build role that owns the entire acquisition funnel for the named universe - from top-of-funnel demand generation to the deepest 1:1 account plays - weighted toward ABM depth. You run one tiered account-based motion: 1:1 & 1:few (ABM) where the value is, and a capped 1:many (Lead Gen) engine over the tail of the same named list. The art of the role is allocating finite team capacity across tiers - protecting 1:1 depth (the deep committee deals fund the whole program) while running an efficient 1:many engine. Player-coach: with a two-person team you personally carry the top 3–5 marquee accounts. Expect roughly 60% leadership / 40% own book; the discipline is protecting the leadership half when your own accounts heat up.

What You Will Do

  • Own the target universe and the full funnel: tier the named list with BD; decide 1:1, 1:few, or 1:many treatment; set goals, capacity allocation across tiers (:70% toward ABM), and operating rhythm.
  • Run a capped 1:many Lead Gen engine over the tail - templated, archetype-segmented campaigns built with the shared Marketing Ops Specialist, routed cleanly to BD - deliberately bounded so it cannot crowd out the deep work.
  • Carry the marquee accounts yourself (player-coach); co-own named accounts with BD; guide committee mapping; own the multi-product narrative and land-and-expand path.
  • Direct bespoke content and exec engagement; build the playbook; define and own account-level and funnel measurement with MarOps/RevOps; lead and grow the team; sell the program internally.

What You Will Need (required)

  • 6+ years in B2B marketing and/or sales, with 3+ years in ABM or named-account field marketing.
  • Full-funnel range - you can run both deep 1:1 ABM and scaled 1:many demand generation against a named list, with the judgment to allocate finite capacity (purely high-volume demand gen with no account depth is not the profile).
  • Player-coach appetite; demonstrated BD partnership; buying-committee fluency; multi-product selling; account + funnel measurement literacy; CRM/MAP fluency; people leadership; comfort building from scratch.

Nice to have

  • Travel/fintech/loyalty/marketplace or partnership-led experience; ABM-platform exposure; self-serve funnels; ITSMA/ABM certification; new-function or post-merger experience.

Why 70/30 (best-practice rationale)

At the leadership level, 70/30 keeps the function’s identity anchored in depth: the committee deals carry the revenue and are the fragile, hard-to-rebuild capability, while the scaled engine is a controlled feeder rather than a competing P&L. Capping Lead Gen at :30% of team capacity lets one Marketing Ops Specialist and a bounded automation motion serve the tail without pulling strategists off marquee accounts. Recommended default when the strategic named list is the primary prize.

How We Will Measure Success

Primary (70%): committee engagement depth, joint account plans adopted, exec milestones, pipeline influenced, multi-product expansion, and deal velocity on strategic accounts. Secondary (30%): qualified pipeline and meetings from the capped 1:many tier, funnel conversion, and graduation of warming tail accounts. Plus team growth and playbook quality.

Rejoignez La Maison pour viser l’excellence et vivre pleinement ce qui vous anime !

La Maison

We are a collection of 4 exclusive Luxury brands: Sofitel, Sofitel Legend and MGallery, Emblems across 60 countries, unlocking unique memorable moments in connection with the local destination.

Our signature: All our Talents express themselves with authenticity, playfulness in a diverse and inclusive environment, have the ability to surprise our customers with crafting exceptional tailor-made experiences and go the extra mile every day, while embracing local culture.

Join our Maison to strive for Excellence. It is a place where you live your purpose!

Description du poste

Notre offre

La Maison Sofitel, Sofitel Legend, MGallery & Emblems repose sur un socle de valeurs définissant notre culture d’entreprise. Ces valeurs fédèrent l’ensemble des collaborateurs autour de la réalisation d'objectifs et de principes communs. Elles définissent la manière dont nous interagissons avec nos clients, collègues et communautés et guident nos comportements.

Nos Valeurs Sont Les Suivantes

  • Passion et fierté : montrer un engagement sans pareil à nos marques, notre clientèle et toutes les personnes avec qui nous travaillons, en faisant preuve d’une certaine intelligence émotionnelle
  • Excellence : un sens des affaires transparent, grâce auquel nous activons tous les bons leviers pour que nos hôtels soient les meilleurs du marché
  • Responsabilité : nous sommes toutes et tous des entrepreneurs responsables et libres
  • Proximité : un esprit familial, qui se traduit par une grande solidarité et réactivité, notamment grâce au dialogue sur le terrain
  • Confiance et transparence : tout partager, sans retenue. Les retours ? Un cadeau dont il ne faut pas se priver
  • Une relation durable : aussi bien avec les propriétaires d’hôtels qu’avec nos talents. Pour créer un sentiment d’appartenance
  • Libre et sur mesure : un service personnalisé, encouragé par les expériences. De quoi dévoiler une nouvelle créativité

Si vous partagez ces valeurs, rejoignez-nous et vous pourrez ainsi vous épanouir en tant que collaborateur d’une équipe solidaire et inclusive.

Une carrière dans laquelle vous pouvez exprimer votre passion

Au sein de l’équipe Social Media & Influence (Direction Marketing) de la Maison Sofitel, MGallery & Emblems, vous serez directement rattaché(e) au Directeur Social Media et Influence, votre rôle est de contribuer au rayonnement de la marque MGallery sur les réseaux sociaux, assurer l’exécution et le suivi de la stratégie social media & influence de la marque et mesurer précisément sa performance. Vous serez basé(e) à Issy-les-Moulineaux.

Vos Principales Missions Seront Les Suivantes

  • Concevoir et formaliser une stratégie sociale media de l'influence en cohérence avec la vision de la marque, les objectifs commerciaux et l’audience ciblée.
  • Créer une feuille de route et un calendrier de contenu pour les campagnes des médias sociaux et d'influence, avec des objectifs spécifiques, des indicateurs de performance clés (KPI) et ROI pour les initiatives liées à la marque.
  • Diriger la création de contenu en apportant un point de vue fort et une connaissance approfondie de la marque, en utilisant des approches innovantes en termes de format, de structure et de présentation pour développer une présence et un engagement sur les réseaux sociaux.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes internes, les agences et partenaires pour produire un contenu hautement engageant.
  • Identifier et collaborer avec des influenceurs pertinents et des partenariats, maintenir les relations pour amplifier la visibilité, l'engagement et l'impact de la marque sur les réseaux sociaux.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe marketing de la marque pour garantir une exécution cohérente avec l'identité et la voix de la marque.
  • Mettre en place des workflow efficaces et des processus de validation du brief au post report, développer des toolkits, des guidelines and best practices pour nos hôtels.
  • Suivre les dernières tendances et organiser une veille structurée en testant les nouveaux outils et les nouveaux usages.
  • Suivre et mesurer les performances, en utilisant des outils d'analyse et de rapports pour évaluer leur efficacité et faire des recommandations pour l'optimisation.
  • Gérer les relations avec les agences en veillant à ce que les livrables répondent aux standards et aux objectifs de la marque.
  • Gérer le budget, les prévisions et concevoir des rapports post-activation
  • Gérer les situations de gestion de crise liées aux activités des médias sociaux et d’influence.

Le responsable des réseaux sociaux et de l'influence fera partie d'une petite équipe (un directeur et deux responsables des réseaux sociaux) et travaillera principalement sur une marque dédiée. Il/elle sera placé(e) sous la responsabilité du directeur des médias sociaux et de l'influence.

What We Offer

La Maison Sofitel, Sofitel Legend, MGallery & Emblems is founded on a set of values that define our distinctive culture. These values unite all our talents around the achievement of common goals and principles. They define the way we interact with our guests, colleagues and communities, and guide our behavior.

Our Values Are

  • Passion & pride: be passionately in love with our brands, our guests and our people. Use our E.Q.
  • Exellence: comprehensive business approach, driving all levers to be best-in-class hôteliers
  • Empowerment: we are all Entrepreneurs, fully accountable, with strong KPIs and freedom too
  • Trust & Transparency: share everything, no taboo. Feedback is a gift
  • Long-term relationship: with owners as well as talent. Creating a strong sense of belonging.
  • Bespoke & free: 100% experience-driven. Tailored services. Unlock creativity.
  • Proximity: Family spirit, responsiveness, solidarity & constant dialogue with the field

A career that lets your passion shine

Responsibilities

Within the Social Media & Influence team (Marketing Department) of Sofitel, MGallery & Emblems, you will report directly to the Social Media and Influence Director. Your role will be to contribute to the visibility and growth of the MGallery brand on social media, ensure the execution and monitoring of the brand’s social media & influence strategy, and accurately measure its performance. You will be based in Issy-les-Moulineaux.Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Design and formalize a social media and influencer strategy that is fully aligned with the brand’s vision, commercial objectives, and target audience.
  • Create a content roadmap and editorial calendar for social media and influencer campaigns, including specific objectives, key performance indicators (KPIs), and ROI for all brand-related initiatives.
  • Lead content creation by bringing a strong point of view and in-depth knowledge of the brand, using innovative approaches in terms of format, structure, and presentation to build presence and drive engagement on social platforms.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams, agencies, and partners to produce highly engaging content.
  • Identify and partner with relevant influencers and develop collaborations, while maintaining relationships to amplify the brand’s visibility, engagement, and impact on social media.
  • Work closely with the brand’s marketing team to ensure consistent execution that respects the brand’s identity and tone of voice.
  • Implement efficient workflows and validation processes from briefing to post-campaign reporting; develop toolkits, guidelines, and best practices for our hotels.
  • Monitor the latest trends and maintain a structured watch by testing new tools and emerging social practices.
  • Track and analyze performance using analytics and reporting tools to evaluate effectiveness and make optimization recommendations.
  • Manage relationships with agencies, ensuring deliverables meet the brand’s standards and objectives.
  • Manage the budget, forecasts, and post-activation reports.
  • Handle crisis management situations related to social media and influencer activities.

The Social Media & Influence Manager will be part of a small team (one Director and two Social Media Managers) and will work primarily on one dedicated brand. He/she will report to the Social Media and Influence Director.

Qualifications

Experience & Qualifications

  • Expérience (8 ans et plus) des réseaux sociaux et influence (organique et paid media) avec une connaissance approfondie des principales plateformes sociales.
  • Expertise solide en analyse et en reporting, capacités analytiques.
  • Excellente maitrise des outils d’IA et création de contenu social media.
  • Sens avéré de l’esthétique et souci du détail pour produire un contenu haut de gamme.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite.
  • Capacité à travailler avec les agences et à renforcer la collaboration.
  • Expérience dans des organisations matricielles internationales.
  • Curiosité, écoute
  • Maîtrise parfaite du français et de l'anglais, qui sera la langue de travail pour ce poste.

Votre contribution

  • Vous avez le niveau d’éducation bac + 5 – Master ;
  • Vous avez un minimum de 8 ans d'expérience professionnelle en gestion ou coordination de projets
  • Idéalement, vous connaissez le secteur de l’hôtellerie et/ou l’industrie du luxe ;
  • Vous avez un sens stratégique et de bonnes capacités d’analyses (data particulièrement) et de synthèse
  • Vous avez une excellence communication orale et écrite (excellente maitrise de la suite Office nécessaire) en français et en anglais
  • Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos excellentes compétences organisationnelles pour initier, organiser et diriger vos priorités et les projets sur lesquels vous travaillez ou contribuez ;
  • Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre relationnel et votre capacité à travailler efficacement en équipe ;
  • Vous avez une capacité à structurer des sujets complexes et de manière synthétique ;
  • Vous avez une forte capacité de travail sur de multiples projets ;
  • Vous avez un sens aigu du détail et le goût de l'excellence.
  • Vous avez une bonne compréhension du business modèle du groupe et des enjeux

Experience & Qualifications

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in social media and influencer marketing (both organic and paid media), with in-depth knowledge of the major social platforms.
  • Strong expertise in analytics and reporting, with excellent analytical skills.
  • Excellent command of AI tools and social media content creation.
  • Proven aesthetic sense and strong attention to detail to produce high-end, premium content.
  • Outstanding written communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with agencies and strengthen collaboration.
  • Experience working in international matrix organizations.
  • Curiosity and strong listening skills.
  • Perfect command of both French and English. English will be the working language for this position.

job.job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at one of our corporate offices in Dallas, TX or McLean, VA

This is your chance to be part of a Revenue Management Consolidated Center (RMCC) that is offering owned, managed, and franchised Hilton hotels world-class revenue management talent and tools. As a Senior Analyst, Project Support-Strategic Operations, you will support the team that's helping hotels grow market share and outperform competitors. On the Strategic Operations team reporting to the Manager, Project Support, you will work on projects including developing analytics data products and designing performance dashboards.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day:

  • Develop Python-based Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) pipelines to create reports and tools
  • Author complex SQL queries and stored procedures for data extraction, aggregation, and reporting
  • Build Excel-based financial and operational tools using VBA (macros, custom functions, PivotTable automation, Power Query integration)
  • Integrate with RESTful APIs, managing secure authentication and credential storage (e.g., keyring)
  • Profile pipeline performance — enhance Python code (cProfile) and SQL execution plans
  • Document ETL processes, data models, and maintain a centralized data catalog

How You'll Collaborate With Others:

  • Partner with RMCC teams, Analytics, BI, and Commercial Services teams to translate use cases into scalable data products
  • Mentor junior analysts and developers in Python, SQL, and VBA best practices; lead knowledge-sharing workshops
  • Provide strategic advisory to business and technical partners on analytics best practices and data-product adoption
  • Collaborate with partners to define and measure performance metrics and evaluate data-product impact

Projects You'll Take Ownership Of:

  • Architect performance-outlook dashboards and self-service reporting tools that surface revenue and commercial trends
  • Develop CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment of analytics data products
  • Design data models (star/snowflake schemas) to support reporting
  • Ensure compliance with security and data-governance policies, including secure credential management and access controls

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications:

  • Three (3) years professional experience in analytics/data-engineering roles
  • Experience authoring complex SQL (Redshift, SQL Server, MySQL) and stored procedures
  • Two (2) years coding development experience (macros, automation, PivotTables)
  • Proficient in Python (ETL frameworks, pandas, NumPy) and advanced Excel (Power Query, functions)
  • Experience in requirements elicitation for KPI frameworks and reporting structures, transforming business inputs into data stories and dashboard architectures that optimize operational performance.
  • This is a hybrid role and would require to be near one of two US office locations (Dallas or McLean)
  • Travel up to 10%

It Would Be Useful If You Have:

  • Understanding of data-modeling principles (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience in cross‑functional project management and requirements translation, converting business objectives into detailed technical specifications
  • Experience with BI tools: MicroStrategy, Alteryx, Power BI
  • Experience with Airtable, Salesforce, GitLab, and Power Automate
  • Front end website development

How We'll Help You Thrive

At Hilton, The Hospitality We're Known For Doesn't End With Our Guests. We Proudly Invest In Our Team Members' Wellbeing, Supporting You Through All Of Life's Moments. When You Join Hilton, Our Exceptional Care Extends To You With Unmatched Perks And Benefits, Including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $57,500 – $80,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Annual Incentive (Bonus) Plan, consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

ABOUT US

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Additional Information

Job Number26012445

Job CategoryManagement Development Programs/Interns

LocationTokyu Land Corporation Ebisu Bldg 2F, Tokyo, Tokyo, Japan, 150-0013 VIEW ON MAP

ScheduleFull Time

Located Remotely?N

Position Type Management

At Marriott International, you have the opportunity to grow in your career, work with teammates that feel like family, and help make our world a better place. As the #1 leader in hospitality worldwide, a career with Marriott provides an open road to opportunity and growth.

The Voyage Global Leadership Development Program

Voyage: Training tomorrow’s leaders today

Marriott International welcomes recent university graduates to experience the career development adventure of a lifetime and a world of leadership opportunities. Our global leadership development program, Voyage, propels participants on a mentored, learning-inspired journey to prepare you for a successful career. Voyage is a full-time, paid development program. As an associate and trainee, you’ll build upon the skills you developed in school by participating in real world assignments.

About The Journey

Voyage is an elite, award-winning program that provides a combination of hands-on, discipline-specific training and a leadership-focused curriculum. The program takes place at a Marriott International managed hotel, not a classroom, and is offered in 50+ countries. Voyage is available in the following disciplines:

  • Accounting & Finance
  • Culinary
  • Engineering
  • Event Operations
  • Event Planning
  • Food & Beverage Operations
  • Human Resources
  • Revenue Management
  • Rooms Operations
  • Sales & Marketing
  • Information Technology
  • Residences

When you join Voyage, you gain access to Marriott’s senior leaders and coaches and have many opportunities to stand out. You’ll participate in mini-rotations across the disciplines to learn firsthand how to manage various hotel functions and to connect with current and former Voyage participants through our social collaboration tools. Voyage is a 18 months full-time program. You’ll immediately be immersed in our rich culture and portfolio of global brands to learn how Marriott sets the standard of industry excellence.

The Experience You’ll Gain

Voyage participants learn by doing! You’ll be fully immersed in the day-to-day operations of a hotel. If accepted into this elite program, you will:

  • Cultivate customer relationships
  • Be a champion for innovation within the organization
  • Get exposure to managing projects & people
  • Improve processes & pitch new initiatives through your Voyage project
  • Take on special projects that will draw upon all your training

Destination: Marriott leadership

You’ll participate in management meetings and collaborate with Voyage participants worldwide. You’ll be expected to solve challenges, as well as offer ideas and innovative solutions. You will also have an opportunity to provide feedback on your curriculum and have an impact on future Voyage hires’ experiences. After graduation, you’ll be well-prepared to pursue your passion and take on new challenges. Many program graduates are ready to step into a Marriott supervisory or entry-level management role right away, because the program has provided a foundation for future leadership.

Ready to embark?

To become a Voyage participant, you must have graduated from a university or hotel school within the past year. Other qualifications include:

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent higher level education required (Associates degree acceptable for Culinary)
  • Superior critical thinking & interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to foster relationships & work collaboratively
  • Self-manage & be a self-starter
  • Real desire for personal & professional growth
  • Work authorization in the country you apply (local citizen or permanent resident)
  • Those currently enrolled in a college/university with an expected graduation date within 12 months of the date of application may also be considered.
  • Please note that the onboarding period may vary based on available positions. This application is for the 2026 Voyage Program intake. Kindly complete the video interview upon successful submission of your application online, and the hiring team will contact you if shortlisted.

To stay connected and receive updates on future opportunities, company news, and career tips, we invite you to join our Talent Community (careers.marriott.com/talent-community).

Want to learn more?

Visit Marriott.com/EarlyCareers

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get To Know Our Team

The People Team is a purveyor of opportunity, searching the globe for the most talented individuals and offering them an open, collaborative workplace. By prioritizing skill and potential, we have cultivated a powerful assembly of professionals through our drive for equal opportunity and diversity. We make the move to Agoda a breeze with assisted onboarding programs, and we continue to support and enrich our thousands of Agoda employees through individual growth with outstanding learning programs and talent development practices. .Our development of incredible benefits has ensured everyone can stay strong, healthy, and happy during their time at Agoda. Leading ambitious changes and making a positive impact in the lives of our employees, the People Team is a crucial and rewarding part of the Agoda family.

The Opportunity

Help build the teams powering Agoda’s global partner network

Agoda is a digital travel platform that helps people experience the world for less. Our Supply organization builds and strengthens Agoda’s global network of accommodation and travel partners, supporting areas such as partner operations, account management, business development, commercial strategy, and market growth.

As an Associate Talent Acquisition Partner supporting Supply, you will manage recruitment for assigned roles and help attract the talent that enables Agoda to grow its partner network and deliver value to partners and travelers worldwide.

You will work closely with candidates, Hiring Managers, recruiters, coordinators, and People Team partners to deliver high-quality hiring outcomes—efficiently, fairly, and with care.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage assigned recruitment processes end to end, from intake through offer and pre-onboarding.
  • Partner with Supply Hiring Managers to understand hiring needs, provide pipeline updates, and keep recruitment moving.
  • Deliver against agreed hiring targets, SLAs, timelines, and quality expectations.
  • Create a clear, professional, and engaging experience for every candidate.
  • Monitor pipeline health, funnel conversion, candidate freshness, Time in Stage, and offer acceptance.
  • Use data to identify risks and recommend practical actions to improve hiring outcomes.
  • Identify and escalate challenges such as low pipeline quality, candidate drop-off, delayed feedback, or interviewer availability.
  • Maintain accurate recruitment records and follow Agoda’s hiring policies, scorecard standards, and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with Recruitment Operations, Coordination, Offers, Onboarding, Global Mobility, Compensation and Benefits, HRBP, and other People Team partners.
  • Contribute to sourcing activities, recruitment events, referrals, team initiatives, and process improvements.
  • Actively seek feedback and build expertise in sourcing, screening, structured interviewing, stakeholder management, candidate experience, and recruitment analytics.

Required Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership and keeps recruitment moving without constant follow-up.
  • Understands the business context behind the roles they support.
  • Anticipates risks and acts before they affect the hiring outcome.
  • Uses data to understand pipeline performance and guide actions.
  • Communicates clearly, directly, and respectfully with candidates and stakeholders.
  • Makes sound decisions and knows when to escalate.
  • Protects fairness, confidentiality, compliance, and candidate experience.
  • Learns quickly, responds well to feedback, and demonstrates visible growth.
  • Builds credibility through reliability, preparation, and follow-through.

What you’ll need:

  • Experience or demonstrated interest in Talent Acquisition, recruitment, HR, staffing, or a related field.
  • Strong organization, prioritization, communication, and follow-through.
  • Ability to manage multiple roles, deadlines, and stakeholders.
  • Comfort using data, dashboards, spreadsheets, or recruitment systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and sound judgment with confidential information.
  • Curiosity, resilience, ownership, and willingness to learn.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, international environment.

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience managing requisitions or end-to-end recruitment processes.
  • Experience hiring for commercial, account management, business development, partner management, or operations roles.
  • Experience with an Applicant Tracking System.
  • Familiarity with recruitment metrics such as Time to Hire, Time to Fill, Offer Acceptance, Interview 1 to Hire, Time in Stage, and Candidate Freshness.
  • Experience recruiting in technology, e-commerce, online travel, hospitality, or another fast-moving industry.
  • Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.
