Job Summary

As a member of the Growth Delivery team, the FLEX Director, Technology Planning & Activation will be an integral part of a team responsible for discovery and implementation of technology capabilities that enable Marriott’s M&A initiatives and other growth opportunities. This Director will work across technology and other discipline teams, including external partners, to determine scope of work, budgets, and timelines, then execute against them. The Director will plan and implement the technical work required for Marriott to expand its brands and partnerships in support of strategic growth targets that position Marriott as the “World’s Favorite Travel Company”.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Required

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university, preferably in a business or technology discipline
  • 8+ years in business consulting, product/project management and/or technology, demonstrating progressive career growth and patterns of exceptional performance
  • Detail-oriented, with strong organizational skills and experience planning and executing initiatives across multiple teams
  • Ability to establish clear communication and storytelling via presentations, including business & technology objectives to guide teams, and status updates to stakeholders
  • Understands and able to discuss technology concepts and build consensus by translating between technical and nontechnical audiences
  • Experience evaluating technology approach trade-offs and leading exploration of new opportunities with technical team members
  • Demonstrated ability to identify, mitigate, and resolve project risks
  • Experience working with product managers, engineers, and vendors, on product enhancements or product roadmaps

Preferred

  • Experience managing budgets across teams
  • Experience working in multiple areas of technology
  • Experience building business cases to drive investment and resource decisions
  • Ability to work through ambiguous and open-ended business requirements and priorities and translate the same into a clear roadmap and definition of success

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

  • Lead key areas of planning and implementation for technology integration development and testing required to enable growth opportunities
  • Provide direction for the technology development, including cost estimation, budget management, scope and delivery strategy definition, and establish milestones/schedules

Description de l'entreprise

Les Demeures de Campagne, ce sont des lieux à 1h de Paris où les citadins en quête d’une parenthèse de bien-être se retrouvent pour profiter, en couple ou en famille, de la nature et d’une multitude d’activités. Ce sont aussi des lieux magiques pour organiser des séminaires ou des évènements professionnels inoubliables.

DEMEURES DE CAMPAGNE – LE DOMAINE DE MAFFLIERS, situé à l'orée de la forêt de l'Isle-Adam, cette véritable Demeure de Campagne propose : 7 AbriChics, 99 chambres, 8 suites, 2 offres de restauration : La Brasserie du Château & Augustine – La Table du Château. Plus de 1000 mètres carrés d'espaces réunions, 2 piscines, des activités loisirs et équestres… en pleine forêt, dans un parc de 35 hectares à moins d'une heure de Paris.

Mix clients : clientèle locale et hébergée | séminaires | évènements professionnels et privés

Description du poste

La/le responsable des ventes loisirs est en charge des demandes de A à Z.

Il / Elle veille à offrir les meilleures prestations tant du point de vue de la vente que du service tout en respectant la demande du client et en développant le chiffre d'affaires. En ce sens, il contribue par son action au quotidien à l’excellence opérationnelle visée par la marque Demeures de Campagne.

La/le responsable des ventes loisirs est en charge du développement commercial de ce segment en étant toujours force de proposition.

Technique Métier Et Relation Client

  • Réceptionne et répond aux demandes des clients loisirs (évènements privés, associations, repas sans réunion, hébergement uniquement, tournages, journée de réunion, teambuilding, groupes tourismes, …) dans un délai de 12 à 24h maximum
  • Assure un suivi régulier de ses demandes et qualifie tous ses dossiers
  • Veille à réaliser une négociation au plus juste des dossiers en partenariat avec le/la Directeur/trice commerciale.
  • Est force de propositions d’offres auprès des clients afin d’assurer des ventes additionnelles
  • A un rôle de contrôle sur la gestion les salles, les installations et les équipements et veille à la qualité tout en étant capable d’intervenir à chaque étape du service
  • Rectifie et répond aux demandes clients en fonction des exigences
  • Atteint les objectifs de budget et de qualité, définis par la direction
  • Assure d'une parfaite communication et interaction avec les différents services (cuisine, bar, animation, service en salle, service technique et entretien des espaces…) en lien avec son supérieur hiérarchique
  • Assure l’accueil, le suivi et le parfait déroulement de la prestation. Il est le garant de la qualité de la prestation avec le/la Directeur/trice commerciale et le/la directeur de la restauration. Il exerce un rôle de contrôle rigoureux
  • Veille à ce que la facturation soit bien postée jour par jour, et réalise les factures pour ses clients sous 3 jours maximum. S’occupe des débiteurs divers et rapprochements des acomptes en binôme avec le/la Directeur/trice commerciale.
  • Maîtrise parfaitement les différentes prestations (mise en place des salles de réunions, cocktails, soirées d'entreprise et soirées privées, repas, pauses, conférences…)
  • Garantit la satisfaction des clients et la qualité du service
  • Réalise le bilan chiffré et qualitatif des opérations menées

Développement Commercial

  • Prospecter de nouveaux clients sur le segment loisirs (B2B et B2C) : groupes loisirs, associations, tournages, CE…
  • Fidéliser le portefeuille existant de clients agences, Tour Opérator, …
  • Identifier de nouveaux marchés et opportunités de croissance
  • Participer à des salons, workshops et événements professionnels
  • Etre force de proposition auprès de son supérieur sur toutes les offres commercialisables

Stratégie & Pilotage

  • Mettre en œuvre le plan d’action commercial annuel
  • Réaliser une veille concurrentielle et analyser les tendances du marché
  • Produire des reportings réguliers

Collaboration Interne

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes marketing, réception, F&B, et hébergement
  • Coordonner les offres et packages adaptés à la clientèle loisirs
  • Assurer la bonne transmission des informations entre les services

Management Des Équipes / Implication Transverse

  • Participe à la création d’un environnement de travail propice à la réalisation des objectifs tout en communiquant efficacement avec les membres de l’équipe
  • Réagit de manière positive avec les autres services afin de garantir aux clients un accueil de qualité. Elle/il montre l’exemple en respectant les codes de la marque, les consignes concernant la tenue et la présentation.
  • Assure un lien permanent intra-services
  • Anime chaque semaine le point commercial de façon exemplaire

Hygiène / Sécurité des personnes / Environnement :

  • Veille au respect des réglementations locales en matière de santé et de sécurité
  • Veille à la propreté de son lieu de travail et son département
  • Connaît et applique les conduites à tenir en cas d’évacuation incendie
  • Connait et applique la politique du programme Planet 21

PROFIL RECHERCHE

  • Vous avez un excellent relationnel et de bonnes capacités à communiquer, à l'écrit comme à l'oral

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Excellent spoken and written Japanese skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

job.job_description:
About Us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

Role Overview

The Statutory Reporting Accountant will be responsible for the preparation and on time delivery of the relevant financial statements within the Transport business unit of Booking.com.

The individual will be the key point of contact for the audit team and be accountable for driving forward the audit and ensuring requests are delivered in a timely manner. These responsibilities will also include preparing any appropriate technical accounting papers, the draft version of the financial statements including notes, managing the review process with the auditors and ultimately obtaining the director level sign off.

The individual will be expected to have a working understanding of the full balance sheet and P&L and will be involved in other areas of the month end close as necessary. This individual will also play a key role in the monthly US GAAP reporting including P&L and Balance sheet commentaries and investigating and summarising key movements.

Key Job Responsibilities And Duties

  • Accountable for the first draft of the financial statements including all relevant reports and notes;
  • Preparation of technical accounting papers to address items such as provisions/judgements, implementation of new accounting standards, dividends etc;
  • Responsible for managing the audit review process including maintaining a good working relationship with auditors and tracking and driving the closure of review points;
  • Work to the overall audit plan, completing deliverables to deadline, flagging any risk areas immediately and ultimately getting the director level sign off of the financial statements;
  • Have a working understanding across the whole balance sheet and P&L in order to ensure appropriate accounting standards are applied;
  • Prepare monthly commentary for group reporting purposes;
  • Involved in other areas of the month end finance process as necessary e.g. balance sheet review and control review;


Role Qualifications And Requirements

  • ACA qualified (preferred), would consider ACCA for the right candidate;
  • 1 year post qualification experience preferable;
  • Experience of preparing and delivering financial statements under UK GAAP;
  • Strong interpersonal skills;
  • Strong work ethic; self-directed and resourceful;
  • Solution oriented and result driven;
  • Accountable and proactive, flexible and capable of working independently as well as working in a team;
  • Good communication and analytical skills;
  • Ability to multi-task and flexible attitude;


Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance:

Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:

  • Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave
  • Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)
  • Industry leading product discounts - up to 1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit


Inclusion at Booking.com:

Inclusion has been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.

Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.”

We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Application Process:

  • Let’s go places together: How we Hire
  • This role does not come with relocation assistance.


Booking.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive.

We're seeking for Graduates in Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Science to join our Online Marketing and Technology team in Barcelona . If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform.

Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands – over 7.7 million Prime members since launching in 2017.

More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions

Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts

We're the world’s leading travel subscription platform. We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.7 million members since launching in 2017. Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

The Online Marketing and Technology team

Our team is responsible for all online marketing activities for the five eDreams Odigeo brands globally: eDreams, Opodo, GOvoyages, Travellink, Liligo. We run one of the biggest and most successful online marketing programs in Travel and we are among the top Google, Meta, Microsoft Ads and Apple customers by spend in Europe - with which we closely collaborate and our strong relationship with them allow us to develop ad-hoc projects and to access new features, products and technologies before they’re widely released.

We are a group of talented people that on a daily basis use data, technology and strategic thinking to deliver online marketing campaigns in more than 40 different countries. Our team is composed of Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Product Owners and Online Marketers and we are all passionate about innovation and love to work in a collaborative and agile environment. If you have a background in Mathematics, Physics or Engineering and are looking for a job where you could leverage your curiosity, analytical and problem solving skills - we offer the right work environment, business challenges and huge amount of data for you to apply all of these skills while learning on a daily basis and - most importantly - having fun.

Join us and help us reach our ambitious goal of becoming the global leader in online travel!

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a SEM Analytics Executive in the Online Marketing and Technology team you will do:

  • Online Marketing: we apply strategic thinking combined with as many data driven insights as possible to design campaigns that have an impact. We design, create and manage campaigns with different business objectives (e.g. user acquisition and engagement, lead generation and brand awareness) to either drive traffic to our websites or to our apps;
  • Analytics: every interaction with our websites or apps generates data that can be leveraged to understand our customers and their experience with our products. We use such data to uncover opportunities and support decisions that enable marketing success by translating insights into meaningful actions and strategies;
  • Science: we design and develop models to measure the impact of what we do, along with deciding how to optimize our multi million marketing investments across the many dimensions we have (geographies, audiences, time, etc).
  • Technology: we use our brains to develop new solutions - while we design and build technologies to execute repetitive tasks or tasks that can be executed at scale only by machine.


We are looking for people who deeply question how things work and how things could be improved - people who are truly curious - while having a strong analytical mindset to support their decision making to join our team.

What you will learn:

  • Analyse data from our websites and apps, analytics tools (e.g. Google Analytics, AppsFlyer, Firebase, etc), advertising platforms (Facebook, Google, Instagram, etc) and many other data sources (BigQuery, Azure, etc ), as well as visualise results and translate insights into actions;
  • Design and manage the technical side of the online marketing campaigns across different platforms (e.g. Google Search, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, Apple, Netflix, Spotify etc);
  • Solve business problems using data, technology and strategic thinking;


Ultimately, we have formed some of the world class professionals in the online advertising and analytics industry and are now looking for talented individuals who can learn fast and become the next generation of industry experts.

What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • Graduate in Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Science. We have people with other academic backgrounds in our teams and are currently not looking for people with different backgrounds than the ones we just listed;
  • A talented individual with an analytical mindset that helps you to find and solve problems making data-driven decisions;
  • Truly curious and passionate about understanding how things work and how things could be improved;
  • Interested in applying your skills to the technology and digital marketing industry;
  • You work well with other talented people and strive for constantly improving your competencies and knowledge.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and the possibility of choosing your equipment and, even better, keeping it for free after 3 years.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • G row opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further!

Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Hotel Efficiency, Resource & Operations (HERO) Coordinator supports the engagement, activation, and execution of brand programs and initiatives designed to improve guest satisfaction, franchisee engagement, and operational efficiency across midscale and upper‑midscale hotel portfolios. Reporting to the Lead HERO Coordinator, this role partners closely with Area Directors, Brand Operations teams, and Choice Centers of Excellence (CoEs) to implement hotel action plans and ensure effective utilization of Choice’s programs, tools, and resources.

The HERO Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting franchised hotel owners and operators by driving participation in brand initiatives, connecting hotels to the appropriate CoE resources, and ensuring timely resolution of franchise support issues. Through consistent communication, documentation, and collaboration, this role contributes to improved hotel performance, franchisee satisfaction, and brand consistency.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Franchisee Support

  • Establish and maintain collaborative, professional relationships with franchise hotel owners and operators.
  • Provide timely feedback from owner‑operator engagements to Area Directors in advance of hotel visits.
  • Partner with Area Directors to support the development, execution, and monitoring of hotel action plans stemming from service, profitability, or total business reviews.
  • Maintain working knowledge of Brand Standards and influence effective adoption and implementation.
  • Support Area Directors with planning strategies and communication protocols during crisis or disaster situations.
  • Assist in communicating franchisee value propositions and ensure enabling tools are in place to drive profitability, return on capital (ROC), and guest experience outcomes.
  • Monitor owner and guest satisfaction trends and brand program execution.
  • Listen to, investigate, document, and escalate hotel issues while identifying opportunities for systemwide franchise support enhancements.

Operationalization & Execution of Brand Programs

  • Support the rollout and ongoing execution of new Brand Standards, initiatives, and programs.
  • Collaborate with brand and business implementation teams to ensure consistency and accuracy across program documentation and digital resources.
  • Participate in Voice of Franchisee communication processes by reviewing and providing feedback on hotel‑facing communications.
  • Share trending hotel feedback, challenges, and insights with Brand Operations leadership and Franchise Performance partners.
  • Participate in cross‑functional initiatives, representing the voice of the hotel and franchisee experience.

Application & Technology Support

  • Support midscale and upper‑midscale hotels in the effective use of brand applications, platforms, and operational tools.
  • Partner with Area Directors to ensure new hotels are accurately represented and onboarded within enterprise systems and applications.

Qualifications

Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years of hotel leadership or operational experience, with Choice‑branded hotel experience preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.

Education

  • Associate degree or bachelor’s degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence franchise owners and general managers with tact and professionalism.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively across cross‑functional teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Demonstrated ability to model Choice values, including being bold, acting quickly, listening actively, remaining curious, and operating with integrity.

job.job_description:

  • Documents actions by completing production and quality logs.
  • Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities; reading technical publications.
  • Accomplishes organization goals by accepting ownership for accomplishing new and different requests; exploring opportunities to add value to job accomplishments.
  • Demonstrates ability to setup a machine and run the job with minimal supervision.
  • Possesses basic math and computing knowledge, to include word processing, and email
  • Maintains safe and clean working environment by complying with procedures, rules, and regulations.
  • Is safety conscious and looks for opportunities to improve safety.
  • Contributes to team effort by assisting and accomplishing related tasks as needed.
  • Practices safety-conscious behaviors in all operational processes and procedures.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Must have minimum of four years verifiable experience as an industrial CNC machine operator and possess the following: a CNC operator certificate, or 2-year degree in - manufacturing technology, or PLC Programming, or Industrial Systems Technology, or Machine Tool Technology required
  • Must be proficient in reading and comprehending mechanical drawings and schematics.
  • Must have good mechanical ability with above average problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a variety of environments.
  • Is able to select fixtures, part holding and tooling to machine to specifications.
  • Can confirm conformance of finished work to specifications, using measuring instruments such as micrometers, calipers, dial indicators and gages.
  • Can identify workmanship defects and deficiencies and can initiate program changes as required.
  • Must have excellent written and verbal communication skills and provide outstanding customer service. Must work in a safe manner.
  • Must be able to comprehend and apply information contained in detailed and complex technical manuals, procedural manuals, blueprints, etc. with no assistance.
  • Must have the ability to work without close supervisory direction and to complete the job without assignment of tasks.
  • Perform other duties as assigned. Position will require overtime, weekend and holidays as needed.
  • Must meet the physical requirements which include the ability to lift at least 70 pounds.
  • Internal candidates must be performing satisfactorily in present position.
  • Will have a minimum 24-month residency.
  • Embraces a diverse set of people, thinking and styles.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • CNC Technology diploma
  • Thermal Spray experience (High Velocity Oxygen Fuel (HVOF), Plasma and Cold Spray)
  • ABB robotic programming experience
  • Thermal Spray machining experience
  • Able to operate thermal spray equipment (HVOF, plasma, flame, wire arc) coating process equipment.
  • Understand various thermal spray tasks like masking, grit blasting, coatings, measuring and unmasking.
  • Able to read, understand, interpret drawings, technical instructions to specific tasks.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success.   • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies.
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together.
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare.

Responsibilities

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Location: New York, Los Angeles, San Jose, San Francisco, Seattle, Austin, Chicago, London with other EG Locations up for discussion.

Within Expedia Group, the Experience Design (XD) organization brings together product design, content design, and research to shape experiences that help travelers confidently discover and explore the world.

We’re seeking a Director / Principal, Product Design – Search, to own and advance the design direction for Expedia Group’s search experiences. This role is calibrated as a senior individual‑contributor leadership position, with scope expected to evolve as the Search domain and organization continue to mature.

In this role, you’ll operate as a design and creative authority who leads through vision, judgment, and hands‑on craft—taking on the most complex experience challenges while setting standards others follow. You’ll lead the design of intelligent search as the foundation for travel discovery, planning, and shopping—using high‑fidelity design, systems thinking, and advanced prototyping at a global scale.

Introduction To The Team

We’re a multidisciplinary design team shaping the future of travel through human-centered, AI-powered experiences. Our mission is to help travelers imagine, plan, book, and manage every part of their journey across Expedia Group’s family of brands and platforms — with clarity, delight, and confidence.

In this position, you’ll lead and inspire a team designing Expedia Group’s search experience end to end, set a bold design vision, establish systems that raise the bar for quality, and partner closely with product, engineering, and data science to deliver intelligent, intuitive experiences at global scale—helping define what AI-driven travel design looks like for the entire industry.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own and lead the design direction for Expedia Group’s AI‑powered Search experiences, driving outcomes from concept through execution while orchestrating the work across interconnected search initiatives.
  • Define how travelers express intent, explore options, and understand results—bringing clarity, transparency, and trust to complex search interactions.
  • Work hands‑on with high‑fidelity design, prototyping, and systems thinking, while helping shape how search work is sequenced, scoped, and delivered to tackle the most complex discovery challenges.
  • Partner closely with senior leaders in Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science to coordinate priorities, align roadmaps, and ensure design effort is focused where it matters most.
  • Translate advanced AI and machine‑learning capabilities into intuitive, human‑centered experiences used by millions of travelers worldwide.
  • Establish and scale experience patterns, interaction models, and quality standards across brands and platforms, providing structure and cohesion across parallel search workstreams.
  • Influence and elevate design quality through critique, mentorship, and shared standards—leading by example and helping others deliver at a higher bar.
  • Collaborate across Expedia Group to align Search experiences with the company’s broader AI strategy, shared capabilities, and platform investments.
  • Represent the traveler in senior‑level and cross‑functional forums, influencing decisions that shape the future of travel discovery and intelligent search.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in product design with, at least, 4 years leading design teams at scale.
  • Expertise in search, discovery, or recommendation systems, with a deep understanding of how AI and ML shape relevance, ranking, and explainability.
  • A proven track record of designing experiences that simplify complex information and build trust with users.
  • Skilled in translating ambiguous technical opportunities into clear, inspiring product experiences.
  • Adept at building, scaling, and coaching design teams that deliver at both craft and strategic levels.
  • An exceptional communicator who can bring stakeholders along through strong storytelling and influence.
  • Energized by the challenge of creating travel experiences that feel intelligent, human, and memorable.
  • Deep understanding of AI and conversational design tools and methods, including prototyping with LLMs, prompt engineering, data-informed interaction design, and expert knowledge of modern design and prototyping platforms including but not limited to Figma, Cursor, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of semantic and natural language search, conversational interfaces, and AI explainability principles.
  • Experience working with data scientists and ML engineers to translate advanced models into user-facing experiences at scale.
  • Demonstrated strength in connecting design quality to measurable product outcomes through experimentation and data-driven metrics.
  • Track record of driving design excellence across multiple brands, platforms, and domains in a fast-moving, results-oriented environment.
  • Demonstrated experience taking products from concept to scaled adoption.

To fuel each employee’s passion for travel, we offer a wellness & travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and an International Airlines Travel Agent (IATAN) membership. View our full list of benefits.

As a Senior Manager, Sales Operations – Tools & AI Enablement, your key objective is to drive operational excellence across Priceline’s Accommodations business by identifying, implementing, and scaling tools, automation, and AI-driven solutions.

As an experienced leader, you will play a critical role in transforming how our operations teams work reducing friction, improving efficiency, and enhancing partner and internal user experiences. You will partner closely with Product, Technology, and Commercial teams to bring scalable solutions to life, using data and AI to modernize workflows and unlock meaningful business impact.

You will combine your operational expertise, problem-solving skills, and understanding of emerging technologies to identify opportunities, execute initiatives, and scale solutions that improve productivity, quality, and performance across the accommodations business.

  • Identify and lead high-impact opportunities to improve operational workflows through tools, automation, and AI, that improve speed and quality
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product and Commercial teams to define requirements and deliver scalable, user-centric solutions

  • Monitor performance of implemented solutions and continuously optimize based on data and feedback
  • Support pilot programs and scale successful initiatives across markets and teams
  • Translate business challenges into practical AI and automation use cases with measurable outcomes
  • Provide ongoing feedback to internal stakeholders to improve tooling, reporting, and operational processes
  • Manage and coordinate with external vendors and partners to accelerate delivery
  • Lead an operational team, setting the vision and objectives, while managing senior stakeholder requirements
  • Foster a culture of data-driven decision-making and performance accountability within the organization
  • Effectively communicate and present performance findings, strategies, and recommendations to senior management and key stakeholders

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (MBA preferred)
  • 8+ years of experience in operations, strategy, product, or process improvement roles
  • 3+ Years of experience as a People Leader
  • Entrepreneurial thinking, with a proven track record of implementing innovative ideas, processes or products in complex organizations
  • Experience working cross-functionally
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
  • Experience with implementing AI solutions, automation, or workflow tools, with the ability to apply them to real business problems
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and managing multiple initiatives simultaneously
  • Curious, solution-oriented, and motivated to challenge the status quo
  • A strong teammate with a “get it done” attitude and ownership mindset
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $135,000-$170,000.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

• Challenge yourself to drive the Financial Services Cobrand marketing strategy for Qantas Loyalty
  • Opportunity to lead a high performing team of marketing professionals

Qantas has always been dedicated to going above and beyond for their customers – both in the air, and on the ground. At Qantas Loyalty, we’re a huge part of that commitment. By taking the time to recognise and reward our members, we build stronger relationships with the people who matter most.


As the Senior Manager Marketing Financial Services, reporting to the Head of Marketing Financial Services, you will lead a highly skilled professional marketing team of 5 people, providing marketing leadership to support key commercial objectives and revenue targets for the Financial Services Cobrand Partners Portfolio and the broader Loyalty business.


You will be accountable for developing and facilitating components of the Financial Services marketing strategy, seeking to drive the acquisition, portfolio and member engagement for our Financial Services partners. You will develop and maintain influential relationships with stakeholders and partners, build & develop innovative marketing plans, provide sign off ensuring campaigns and collateral reflect a high standard of marketing that are engaging and innovative. You will work closely with internal colleagues including Commercial, Finance, Product, Legal and our new Marketing Centre of Excellence Banking to deliver effective outcomes for our Financial Services portfolio.


What You’ll Bring To The Role:

  • 10 years + experience leading a team within the Financial Services industry, with thorough knowledge of Financial Services marketing across a broad range of products.
  • Recent credit card experience required.
  • External partner relationship management and extensive experience in dealing with senior management in marketing and business roles including understanding of business strategies and applying them to marketing.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with an adaptable communication style.
  • Proven people leadership, development and workforce planning skills.
  • Strong understanding of how to extract insights from macro & micro business data & campaign performance to optimise future activity strategies.
  • Marketing leadership and expertise and with a deep understanding of the Commercial, Financial and Strategic objectives of the business.
  • Develop business and marketing plans for assigned product/brands, including offer strategies, sales plans and briefing of campaign activity strategies.
  • Ability to critically review and provide marketing input into commercial contracts.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and a desire to disrupt and deliver at speed.
  • Ability to adapt to the changing needs and priorities of the business.
  • Experience dealing with Legal and understanding and applying legal principles and constraints.
  • Proven ability for budgetary compliance and profit volume.
  • Ability to collaborate with various business functions on the design, distribution and product specifications/changes as needed.
  • Share learnings and best practice with other marketing counterparts to build knowledge amongst the wider marketing teams.


Why Qantas?

You’ll join a team where creativity and passion are encouraged. Our people come together to allow us to dream big and deliver successfully. There are many different opportunities across our team, which means you’ll be able to grow both personally and professionally at Qantas. Your development is a priority for us – so that you can maintain the high standards our customers have come to expect and can continue to develop over time. You’ll be supported from day 1 with on the job training and coaching as well as our formal training opportunities. While you may start in this role, we’ve got a great track record of supporting our people to take their career in so many different directions, the destinations are endless.


The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel:

  • We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays.

You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.
  • We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.


Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – apply today!


We’ve worked hard to create a culture that will challenge and excite you - and give you the support you need to really go places. Here everyone’s treated with the respect they deserve. And everyone has the potential to make the most of their skills.

job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Trip.com Group offers exceptional and comprehensive travel services, resources, and products across its platforms. We aspire to provide our 400 million+ customers worldwide with tools to plan and book their perfect trips.


We have more than 30,000 employees spread across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, and are actively expanding our global markets to grow and become the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands.


This is a hybrid role based out of Vancouver, Canada.


In this Role, you’ll get to

  • Drive the acquisition of new attraction, tour, and activity partners across the Americas, while managing and growing an existing portfolio of strategic supplier accounts. Identify high-potential partners and unlock incremental revenue opportunities.
  • Build strong, long-term supplier relationships by understanding partner needs and positioning the right Trip.com solutions to maximize product visibility, conversion, and revenue performance.
  • Act as a strategic consultant to partners by educating them on Trip.com’s platform capabilities, distribution ecosystem, marketing opportunities, and customer reach.
  • Own account performance end-to-end, ensuring competitive pricing, strong product content, healthy availability, and customer-first product offerings that deliver the best value to Trip.com users.
  • Conduct market intelligence and competitive analysis across product, pricing, supplier landscape, and consumer trends to identify growth opportunities and market gaps.
  • Partner closely with suppliers to drive campaign participation, promotional coverage, and merchandising opportunities across key sales moments and seasonal initiatives.
  • Translate local market insights into actionable recommendations to support product localization, commercial strategy, and platform optimization.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across commercial, operations, product, and marketing functions within a global, highly collaborative environment.
  • Navigate ambiguity and solve operational or commercial challenges proactively, helping build scalable solutions in a rapidly evolving business.


What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Fluent English communication skills (written and verbal) required. Mandarin and/or Spanish language skills are strong assets.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada at the time of hire.
  • 5+ years of experience in business development, account management, or revenue growth within tourism, or e-commerce. Previous experience at an Online Travel Agency (OTA) or travel marketplace is a strong plus, with familiarity with attractions, tours, or destination experiences highly valued.
  • Existing network with tourism boards, airlines, travel affiliates, attractions, or destination partners is a plus.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and execution-focused, with a strong sense of ownership. Proven ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to identify opportunities, overcome obstacles, and innovate under pressure.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-cultural environment with the ability to create structure from complexity.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn market and performance data into actionable business insights.
  • Excellent PowerPoint and presentation skills, with the ability to build clear and compelling pitch decks and business proposals.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM/account management tools.
  • Comfortable with regular business travel and cross-time-zone collaboration, with the flexibility to support partners and internal teams in a global, fast-paced environment.


Behavioral Requirements:

  • Integrity-driven — you lead with honesty, accountability, and strong professional ethics.
  • Customer-obsessed — you’re passionate about making travel experiences better for everyone.
  • Innovative and growth-minded — you constantly look for smarter ways to grow the business and improve how things are done.
  • A self-starter — you take initiative, move fast, and create momentum without waiting for perfect conditions.
  • Globally minded — you thrive in multicultural, international environments and communicate effectively across teams and markets.
  • A natural relationship builder — you know how to influence, build trust, and develop strong partnerships with industry leaders.
  • Resilient and adaptable — you stay focused and effective in fast-changing, ambiguous, and high-growth environments.


Why Trip.com Group

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. At Trip.com Group, you can define your own trip by setting a goal and celebrate your success by recognizing the progress you have made.


What’s more?

  • Our rapid business growth in global offers abundant career opportunities at various levels and in multiple functions
  • Internal transfer is encouraged, and global job rotation program enable you to pursue a global career path and make global impact
  • We provide learning opportunities to further your career in areas of leadership capability, soft skill and professional expertise.
  • We encourage flexible work arrangement
  • Have fun with company-sponsored greetings and activities at holidays, birthdays, and colorful team events.


Find out more job opportunities at https://careers.trip.com


Have a good trip, and see you soon!

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

At United, we have some of the best aircraft in the world. Our Technical Operations team is full of aircraft maintenance technicians, engineers, planners, ground equipment and facilities professionals, and supply chain teams that help make sure they’re well taken care of and ready to get our customers to their desired destinations. If you’re ready to work on our planes, join our Tech Ops experts and help keep our fleet in tip-top shape.

Key Responsibilities

  • Performs work generally recognized as Storekeeper's work in storeroom areas located in maintenance bases and line operations including receiving, issuing, provisioning, checking, classifying, inventorying and storing of supplies, equipment, parts and materials
  • Opening, packaging and sealing of boxes and crates
  • Work may be performed indoors and outdoors where employees may be exposed to wide variety of weather conditions, noises and fumes and machinery
  • Performance of duties, will include climb & work from ladders, bend & stoop in confined areas and stand and/or walk for extended periods of time
  • Heavy lifting, pushing and pulling in the loading and unloading of trucks, carts and conveyors
  • Fueling assigned vehicles
  • Transporting parts and materials between various locations, sorting and counting items and preparing labels and related ticketing documents
  • Reading and interpreting documents or instructions to build kits for use in aircraft change orders, first aid, in-flight and charter services
  • Responsibility for maintaining an orderly and safe work area and maintaining familiarity with operating procedures, general rules and regulations
  • Operating a variety of equipment with manual and automatic transmissions including forklifts, trucks, tractors, tugs, and electric carts
  • Working with hand tools, such as remote computer terminal sets, bag sealers, saws, mobile radios, shears, knives and staplers
  • Handling hazardous materials, flammable materials and/or hazardous waste
  • Converting units of weights and measurements
  • Using a computer to track inventory

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • High School Diploma, GED or education equivalent
  • Must be able to read, write and speak English fluently
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • Basic ability to convert units of weights and measurements
  • Must possess a valid state issued driver's license (suspended, expired, revoked or denied are not considered valid) and have an acceptable driving record
  • Must be flexible and willing to work any shift in a 24 hour/7 day a week operation including early mornings, afternoons, late nights, weekends, and holidays
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of testing/interview required to meet job qualifications
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Previous work in jobs requiring heavy lifting and safety awareness
  • Previous warehouse or related experience
  • Forklift operation experience
  • Proficient Microsoft Office Suites (Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Proficient computer skills
  • Inventory experience

The starting rate for this role is $21.35.

This is also a bonus eligible position (i.e. profit sharing).

We offer competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident & disability, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k), pension and flight privileges (subject to the respective collective bargaining agreement).

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Excellent spoken and written Japanese skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

The Project Director, Openings is responsible for managing a complex multistage onboarding process for a portfolio of New Construction, Conversion and rebranding projects that are entering the Choice Hotels system. This key role is the main point of contact with owners, management companies and/or their representatives from contract execution to opening their hotel. You will act as an advisor to our franchisees and developers throughout every stage of the opening process, ensuring construction completion, compliance with brand standards and product design, adherence to scheduled opening dates, and achievement of key milestones. By fulfilling these responsibilities, you will help ensure successful openings and contribute to the company’s strategic brand growth objectives.

NOTE: This position is remote‑based; however, candidates must be located within the Northeast region of the United States at the time of hire and throughout employment. Relocation assistance is not available for this role.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Deliver new hotel openings with project management, training, operational development, milestone tracking, and single-point-of-contact service.
  • Perform onsite/virtual consultation throughout the various stages of the opening process.
  • Oversee the hotel onboarding progress to ensure compliance with brand standards, design requirements, Rules & Regulations, and enforce the Property Improvement Plan (PIP) as needed.
  • Guide owners using a range of onboarding tools, including the openings portal and Choice Connect, which offers helpful resources throughout the onboarding process.
  • Manage the hotel data migration into Choice’s PROP-EL tool for accurate distribution on Choice channels and third-party sites.
  • Enforce and monitor our franchisees to use Choice approved vendors and services during the purchasing stages prior to opening.
  • Oversee and track hotel consultations and openings to ensure brand design and PIP/new construction compliance, monitor PIP completion for timely conversion property openings, and serve as liaison between owners and CHI Architecture and Design on new construction or conversion requirements.
  • Aide owners on opening obstacles, sourcing issues, and provide expedited solutions to avoid delays in opening.
  • Implement pre-opening training programs by Choice so that both owners and hotel managers are familiar with Choice’s operational procedures.
  • Communicate to compliance committee if an opening needs an extension or a project is not moving forward.

Employment Experience

  • 5+ years of relevant experience, including extensive hotel operations

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

  • 70-80% travel is required for this position

Education Requirements

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent years of experience

COMPENSATION & SALARY RANGE:

Salary Range: $114,907 - $135,000

This role is also eligible for an annual bonus under Choice’s Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Machine Learning Scientist II

Are you passionate about using machine learning to improve Customer Experience? Would you like to work in the fast-paced, competitive, customer-focused, and data-rich world of online travel?

Our Machine Learning and Data Science team are growing! We are looking to hire researchers and data scientists interested in breaking new ground to tackle some of the most complex customer experience problems in the travel domain. The focus of your job will be on developing state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms to power and enhance the customer experience across highly complex post-booking recommendations, customer service, and trip management use cases. You will tackle substantial technical challenges, from inference problems arising from long-tail traveler data to multi-objective optimization problems in the highly dynamic, operationally complex environment of customer service. Your passion for the craft of ML and AI will unlock tangible growth for our business by exploiting these rich data sets and building effective solutions for travelers and our partners.

This is your opportunity to build the core algorithms that help Expedia Group's Post Booking organization bring context and intelligence to every step of the traveler journey and redefine what service excellence in travel can be. We are looking for a hands-on scientist who is passionate about applying machine learning to complex prediction and optimization problems that drive an ecosystem that anticipates traveler needs, personalizes dynamic add-ons and upsells, and improves service experiences, making travel more seamless for millions of customers and partners worldwide.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design & Implement ML Solutions: Take ownership of the end-to-end ML lifecycle for your projects, from ideation and research to deployment and monitoring.
  • Test, Learn, and Iterate: Design and analyze tests to validate your models and quantify their business impact and design future iterations.
  • Collaborate and Communicate: Partner closely with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements, define problems, and communicate your findings and results effectively.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
  • 1+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Proven ability to design end-to-end ML solutions, including problem formulation, identification and preparation of data sources, algorithm selection, feature engineering, evaluation strategy, and production deployment and monitoring.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and its data science ecosystem (such as pandas, scikit-learn, PySpark) and proficiency in SQL, with experience following software engineering best practices and contributing to shared codebases.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including experience with the machine learning software development lifecycle from experimentation through operational monitoring.

Functional & Technical Skills

  • Expertise in applied ML: Deep, practical knowledge of machine learning theory (supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning) and statistical modeling and a strong command of experimental design (A/B testing) and causal inference to accurately measure impact. Able to design end-to-end ML solutions: framing the problem, choosing data sources, selecting algorithms, and defining evaluation strategy. Experience with the machine learning software development lifecycle, including experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration in production. Strong programming skills in at least one major ML language (e.g., Python, Scala, Java) plus SQL; writes clean, modular, maintainable code.
  • Technical Fluency: Strong programming skills in Python and its data science ecosystem (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, pySpark), plus proficiency in SQL. Follow software engineering best practices and contribute to the team's shared codebase.
  • First-Principles Problem Solver: Skilled at dissecting ambiguous problems and clearly communicating complex technical ideas.

Highly Desired Experience

  • Domain knowledge in customer service, recommendation systems, operational applications of ML, and/or e-commerce
  • Experience with reinforcement learning or other advanced ML techniques is a plus
  • Experience building and deploying models using GenAI/LLM technologies
  • Experience translating research and academic papers into improved model designs and techniques

Preferred Qualifications

  • MS or PhD in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, Physics, or a related discipline.
  • 2+ years of hands-on industry experience building, deploying, and iterating on machine learning models that solve real-world problems in production environments.
  • Proven ability to design end-to-end ML solutions, including problem formulation, identification and preparation of data sources, algorithm selection, feature engineering, evaluation strategy, and production deployment and monitoring.
