• This role is not eligible for sponsorship now or in the future AND is four days onsite hybrid at our Pike & Rose headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland. **

Job Summary

The Commercial FP&A Manager serves as a strategic partner to the marketing and/or commercial teams within Choice Hotels. This role provides comprehensive financial planning and analysis (in-year and long-term) to drive growth through the marketing and commercial functions. While specific areas may evolve, they include loyalty, revenue management, global and local accounts, e-commerce, global call centers, paid media, and creative marketing.

Responsibilities

Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Serve as a strategic finance partner to several functions within the commercial and marketing organizations, offering financial leadership and support.
  • Execute financial planning, including SG&A headcount and key metrics across all revenue and cost areas, ensuring alignment with organizational objectives.
  • Perform annual, monthly, and quarterly financial planning processes, including both short-term and long-range planning.
  • Conduct variance analysis against plan, identifying risks, opportunities, and actionable insights.
  • Develop and maintain advanced financial models and analytical tools to assess performance and inform decision-making.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement, reduce costs, and enhance operational efficiency.

Within Expedia Group, the Experience Design (XD) organization brings together product design, content design, and research to shape experiences that help travelers confidently discover and explore the world.

We’re seeking a Director / Principal, Product Design – Search, to own and advance the design direction for Expedia Group’s search experiences. This role is calibrated as a senior individual‑contributor leadership position, with scope expected to evolve as the Search domain and organization continue to mature.

In this role, you’ll operate as a design and creative authority who leads through vision, judgment, and hands‑on craft—taking on the most complex experience challenges while setting standards others follow. You’ll lead the design of intelligent search as the foundation for travel discovery, planning, and shopping—using high‑fidelity design, systems thinking, and advanced prototyping at a global scale.

Introduction To The Team

We’re a multidisciplinary design team shaping the future of travel through human-centered, AI-powered experiences. Our mission is to help travelers imagine, plan, book, and manage every part of their journey across Expedia Group’s family of brands and platforms — with clarity, delight, and confidence.

In this position, you’ll lead and inspire a team designing Expedia Group’s search experience end to end, set a bold design vision, establish systems that raise the bar for quality, and partner closely with product, engineering, and data science to deliver intelligent, intuitive experiences at global scale—helping define what AI-driven travel design looks like for the entire industry.

In This Role, You Will

  • Own and lead the design direction for Expedia Group’s AI‑powered Search experiences, driving outcomes from concept through execution while orchestrating the work across interconnected search initiatives.
  • Define how travelers express intent, explore options, and understand results—bringing clarity, transparency, and trust to complex search interactions.
  • Work hands‑on with high‑fidelity design, prototyping, and systems thinking, while helping shape how search work is sequenced, scoped, and delivered to tackle the most complex discovery challenges.
  • Partner closely with senior leaders in Product, Engineering, Research, and Data Science to coordinate priorities, align roadmaps, and ensure design effort is focused where it matters most.
  • Translate advanced AI and machine‑learning capabilities into intuitive, human‑centered experiences used by millions of travelers worldwide.
  • Establish and scale experience patterns, interaction models, and quality standards across brands and platforms, providing structure and cohesion across parallel search workstreams.
  • Influence and elevate design quality through critique, mentorship, and shared standards—leading by example and helping others deliver at a higher bar.
  • Collaborate across Expedia Group to align Search experiences with the company’s broader AI strategy, shared capabilities, and platform investments.
  • Represent the traveler in senior‑level and cross‑functional forums, influencing decisions that shape the future of travel discovery and intelligent search.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in product design with, at least, 4 years leading design teams at scale.
  • Expertise in search, discovery, or recommendation systems, with a deep understanding of how AI and ML shape relevance, ranking, and explainability.
  • A proven track record of designing experiences that simplify complex information and build trust with users.
  • Skilled in translating ambiguous technical opportunities into clear, inspiring product experiences.
  • Adept at building, scaling, and coaching design teams that deliver at both craft and strategic levels.
  • An exceptional communicator who can bring stakeholders along through strong storytelling and influence.
  • Energized by the challenge of creating travel experiences that feel intelligent, human, and memorable.
  • Deep understanding of AI and conversational design tools and methods, including prototyping with LLMs, prompt engineering, data-informed interaction design, and expert knowledge of modern design and prototyping platforms including but not limited to Figma, Cursor, etc.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of semantic and natural language search, conversational interfaces, and AI explainability principles.
  • Experience working with data scientists and ML engineers to translate advanced models into user-facing experiences at scale.
  • Demonstrated strength in connecting design quality to measurable product outcomes through experimentation and data-driven metrics.
  • Track record of driving design excellence across multiple brands, platforms, and domains in a fast-moving, results-oriented environment.
  • Demonstrated experience taking products from concept to scaled adoption.

Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

At United, we have some of the best aircraft in the world. Our Technical Operations team is full of aircraft maintenance technicians, engineers, planners, ground equipment and facilities professionals, and supply chain teams that help make sure they’re well taken care of and ready to get our customers to their desired destinations. If you’re ready to work on our planes, join our Tech Ops experts and help keep our fleet in tip-top shape.

Are you passionate about aviation? Would you like to maintain some of the biggest and best aircraft in the world? If so, there’s no better place to be than United Airlines. We’re looking for a full-time Aircraft Maintenance Technician (AMT) who has valid Airframe & Powerplant certification to join our Technical Operations team in one of United’s domestic HUBS.

In this vital role, you will provide service and maintenance for aircraft systems, Powerplant, Airframe and Components. You’ll handle a wide variety of duties that make every day different, including inspections, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, parts replacement and repair, as well as routine maintenance.

Keeping our fleet flight-ready

  • Strong mechanical competence and attention to detail are crucial for this critical position.
  • Unlike smaller regional airlines, you’ll have the opportunity to work on larger, highly sophisticated aircraft with United.
  • We will rely on you to be a great teammate, receiving and providing support as you collaborate professionally and seamlessly with your co-workers.
  • You will generally be working out in the elements, so you must be capable of handling weather extremes.
  • You will likely roll up your sleeves, but for those who enjoy hands-on work, it’s all part of the job.

Many routes to success

  • We offer initial training, specialty classes and recurrent training in technical areas and on other topics such as ethics and compliance.
  • With experience, drive and determination to excel, you can move into a variety of roles, including management, inspection, quality control, fleet planning and others.
  • After gaining seniority, you’ll have the opportunity to transfer to other locations within our outstanding network.

Flexibility And Dependability Are Essential

  • Since this is a union position based on seniority, you will be assigned an initial schedule designed to meet our needs at the airport.
  • You must be available for any shift within a 24/7 operation, weekends and holidays.
  • You may be required to work mandatory overtime, when necessary.
  • Punctuality and reliability are essential – we’ve got flight schedules to meet!

The rewards for your expertise and work ethic

  • Great benefits, including several plan options.
  • Flight privileges from day one: you and your family can fly anywhere in the world on stand-by.
  • Time off: you’ll have at least two days off in a row and can earn vacation days based on length of service.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • High School Diploma or GED/Educational Equivalent
  • FAA A&P License
  • Valid US Driver's License
  • Computer literacy
  • Must pass a background check and drug screen upon contingent job offer
  • An eagerness to learn and willingness to train
  • The ability to access elevated aircraft areas via ladders, lift trucks, boom lifts and other devices
  • The strength to lift 50 pounds, physical flexibility and the ability to work in confined spaces
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship

The starting rate for this role is $38.77.

Prime Associate Business Analyst - (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Prime Business Analyst to join our Prime Team in Barcelona (hybrid) to help define the broader talent strategy across multiple teams. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform.

Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands – over 7.7 million Prime members since launching in 2017.

More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions

Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts

We're the world’s leading travel subscription platform. We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.7 million members since launching in 2017. Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Prime Business Analyst in the Prime Analytics team you will be in charge of:

  • The Prime Business Analyst’s mission is to contribute to the Prime strategic roadmap with business insights, ie. to generate business insights from data analysis so that they can translate into improvements for the program.
  • Responsible for execution of key analysis, being the data entry point for the business team and including taking ownership of the database from the business side. Understand the business needs, gather the data and present the key insights: “Contribute to the Prime strategic roadmap with numbers”.
  • Elaborate business cases to support strategic product decisions: e.g. should we include more “benefits” into the program? What is the profitability of a free-trial?
  • Create dashboards and tracking: master the internal Business Intelligence tools to contribute to the monitoring and tracking of our business KPIs. Work with data engineering and data science teams to be able to leverage all our internal data
  • Contribute to the delivery of the Prime strategic projects: participate in the delivery of the key internal projects, giving support from the business side to ensure progress and effective delivery of the desired outcomes.
  • Work together with product and Marketing in the execution of the projects, giving support from the analytical and business side.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, etc.).
  • Experience in a role with a strong analytical component is a plus.
  • Knowledge of SQL, as well as experience in working with databases and large sets of data; and experience with Google DataStudio is required
  • Advanced Office skills. Strong experience with analytical tools, ideally with the Google toolset (spreadsheets, google docs, etc).
  • Strong analytical skills, fast-learner, with high attention to detail and focused on results and productivity.
  • A self-starter and team player, who also enjoys to have fun!
  • Business Proficiency in English.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here’s what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, Competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and the possibility of choosing your equipment and, even better, keeping it for free after 3 years.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our Priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You’ll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You’ll work in an Agile Mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it’s like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

The BPO Partner Manager is responsible for the strategy, design, and continuous evolution of BPO partner operating models, governance frameworks, and performance management strategies to drive consistent service delivery and improved business outcomes. This role influences alignment across internal and external stakeholders, leveraging data, insights, and subject matter expertise to shape enterprise-level BPO performance and partner strategy.

Program and Project Leadership – Plan, execute, and deliver strategic initiatives involving Business Partner operations, ensuring alignment with business goals, timelines, and contractual obligations, while shaping program governance, performance frameworks, and operating standards. Oversees contract governance by ensuring all aspects of the contract are up to date and enforced to include service level agreements, organizational policies, documentation, renewals, and escalation protocols in alignment with business objectives.

  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Navigating complex dependencies across departments (e.g., IT, Res Tech, Operations) to deliver seamless project execution, while driving alignment across stakeholders and shaping approaches to manage competing priorities and enterprise impacts.
  • Operational Inefficiencies: Identifying bottlenecks or gaps in partner processes and implementing solutions to improve speed, accuracy, and cost-effectiveness, while designing scalable approaches to address systemic issues and drive sustained performance outcomes.
  • Adaptability: The Program Manager must be comfortable working in ambiguous environments and proactively shaping processes to meet evolving business needs, including developing new approaches where processes are not clearly defined.
  • Innovation Council Liaison: Acting as a bridge between innovation teams and operations to pilot and scale new ideas or technologies, while influencing adoption and integration across partner operations to support long-term business outcomes.
  • System Integration: Collaborating with IT and Res Tech to introduce or enhance tools that support BP operations, ensuring system parity and functionality, while guiding enhancements that align with evolving operational strategy and partner needs.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on approach to address complex, ambiguous business challenges
  • Strong organizational and time management skills to drive alignment across multiple stakeholders and priorities
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment while balancing competing business needs and enterprise impact
  • Collaborative and solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to influence internal stakeholders and Business Partner leadership
  • High attention to detail and accountability with a focus on driving consistent, scalable performance outcomes
  • 6+ years of experience in project management within BPO, vendor management, or operations in a complex, matrixed environment
  • BPO or vendor management preferred
  • PMP, Six Sigma, or similar certification is a plus
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder influence skills
  • Proficiency in project management tools and data analysis platforms, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and business decisions

Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a Human Resources Coordinator, you’re not just supporting daily operations of the hotel’s HR function – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

  • Support daily HR operations: Perform multiple key HR functions such as recruitment, training, compensation, benefits, labor relations, compliance, safety, and performance management, ensuring compliance with corporate HR policies and federal/local regulations
  • Foster team member engagement: Support employee relations initiatives such as recognition programs, special events, and engagement activities to create a positive workplace culture
  • Maintain employment data in HR systems: Assist with data management, track employment transitions, generate reports, and process unemployment claims

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We'll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future

  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Analytics Partner, People Analytics

Introduction to Team

Our Corporate Functions are made up of teams that support Expedia Group, including Employee Communications, Finance, Legal, People Team, Inclusion and Diversity, and Global Social Impact and Sustainability.

As part of Expedia Group’s People Analytics team and sitting within our Analytics Partnership function, the Senior Analytics Partner is a senior expert and consultant who shapes and delivers the analytics agenda for our divisions and COEs. You operate comfortably at both the strategic and tactical levels, pairing big-picture thinking with a hands-on approach to analysis and execution. You put the traveler first by ensuring we leverage analytics to enable data-driven strategies and decision making that realize business impact.

In This Role, You Will

Analytics Delivery

  • Translate business and people priorities into analytics opportunities and strategies that drive measurable business impact.
  • Independently lead end-to-end analytics projects: clarify the business question, scope work into a clear SOW, translate complex business problems into the right analytical approach, iterate with stakeholders, and deliver executive-ready narratives and recommendations.
  • Turn complex data and analyses into simple, compelling visualizations and stories that inform decisions for both technical and non‑technical audience
  • Develop measurement strategies and define, build, and test new metrics that inform org health assessment, talent reviews, QBR/MBRS, and program/product impact.
  • Document and automate recurring analytics tasks and deliverables to improve efficiency, quality, and speed.
  • Serve as the bridge between customers (HR, business) and product team to help productize analytics into AI-native, simplified product experiences that are tied to real business decisions.

Partnerships and Consulting

  • Partner closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Partners, COEs, and senior business leaders see around corners and influence strategies and decisions through data.
  • Partner on identifying and delivering strategic analytics, metric development, and org health and talent insights to drive org effectiveness and business impact.
  • Empower partners to self‑serve using our people insights products, while personally taking on the more complex and ambiguous analytics needs.
  • Design and deliver engaging, consumable learning labs, office hours, and coaching to upskill partners on data literacy, product fluency, and AI-assisted analytics.
  • Support engagement surveys with division- or COE-level survey insights interpretation, delivery, and recommendations for actioning.
  • Manage intake and prioritization of analytics requests, using clear principles and deep business/org knowledge to ensure on-time delivery of high-impact work.
  • Coordinate feedback sessions for product design, UAT, pilots, and GTM strategy.

People Analytics Collaboration

  • Raise the bar with your Analytics Partners through peer feedback, reusable code and templates, thought leadership on new analytical methods, and business context to achieve a holistic view in driving business impact.
  • Partner with Machine Learning Science to validate and scale models for optimal business value.
  • Monitor data quality and needs, partnering with Data Engineering on new data sources, issue resolution, and table optimization.
  • Surface user needs and feedback to Product team to shape the roadmap, influence feature prioritization, and continuously improve the UX of our products; define business requirements for product development and enhancements.
  • Deliver knowledge exchange sessions for the entire People Analytics team to share best practices, project outcomes, and advance team awareness and capabilities.

Mindset & EG Behaviors

Role

You role model Expedia Group’s Behaviors, which define how we make decisions, collaborate, and deliver value for travelers and partners:

  • We Put the Traveler First – you anchor analytics priorities and contextualize insights in the impact they have on the teams who serve travelers and partners.
  • We Think Big – you see around corners, identifying opportunities others don’t, bring innovative approaches and ideas, and approach work through a systems lens
  • We Operate with Excellence – you raise the bar on execution through strong planning, documentation, analytics automation, and continuous improvement
  • We have an Ownership Mindset – you look at the business as if it’s your own, thinking beyond your role to build organizational data-driven decision making.
  • We Succeed Together – you foster collaboration and candor—giving feedback directly, challenging and debating respectfully, disagreeing when necessary and committing fully to deliver as one team.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in People Analytics and consulting/stakeholder-facing roles
  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Analytics/Data Science, Industrial/Organizational Psychology, or related quantitative/behavioral field.

Technical Skills

  • Fluent in R or Python, SQL, Tableau; experience with Qualtrics, DataBricks preferred.
  • Proven ability working with large, unstructured data, extracting from multiple data sources (e.g., Workday, engineering productivity, sales), and combining into the required datasets for analytics and modeling.
  • Advanced understanding of common data models, their assumptions, the business questions they can best answer, and data to best support the model.
  • Demonstrated experience in using advanced statistical methods (e.g., predictive modeling; ONA a plus) to solve a variety of business challenges, selecting statistical techniques without using unnecessarily complex methods.
  • Experience in designing and executing employee listening programs and results.
  • Proficiency in using AI to accelerate analytics (e.g., framing problems, prompt engineering, assessing quality of AI-generated code).
  • Proven capability to produce a high volume of analytics work at pace, with strong attention to detail.

Consulting/Partnering Skills

  • Demonstrated business acumen, problem-framing, and critical thinking; ability to align people analytics with business strategy and guide decision making.
  • Exceptional storytelling and communication skills, producing clear, simple, and executive‑ready narratives independently and presenting to senior leadership.
  • Experience operating in complex, global, matrixed organizations as a high‑influence individual contributor who leads through expertise, influence, and relationships rather than direct authority.
  • Success in building trusted relationships with HR partners and business leaders at all levels.
  • Resilience, agility, and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-changing environment.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $173,000.00 to $242,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $277,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Benefits And Perks

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life.

Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Role Purpose

Co-manage hotel projects, aligned with assigned Manager, Property Improvements, for an assigned territory of franchised hotels which may include a Property Improvement Plan (PIP) for a renovation and/or new development (ND) hotel construction project. Serve as a recognized architectural design expert for upscale IHG brand hotels. Manager, Review will focus primary responsibilities on Plan Review discipline as assigned per hiring manager.

Plan Review Responsibilities (some or all may apply)

Responsibilities include approving (or not approving) project plans, design boards, life safety plans and other related project submittals for a broad range of complex of PIP and ND projects to ensure conformance with Hotel Brand Vision and Hotel Design Guidelines, Hotel Brand Standards, IHG Brand Safety Standards, ADA requirements, and other related design criteria requirements. Provide design guidance and assistance to IHG franchisees and their design consultants through all phases of the PIP or ND projects, ensuring timely and successful completion of projects while promoting Great Hotels Guests Love.

May lead and review the work of less experienced staff by providing mentoring, technical guidance and/or training in daily activities. From time to time provide feedback to management and brand on product related issues / recommendations for improvements.

Key Accountabilities

  • Plan Review Responsibilities (some or all may apply)
  • Effectively manage an assigned territory by evaluating a steady flow of proposed ND and PIP renovation project designs, including evaluation against IHG Brand Standards, suitability of designs, materials, style and coordination for all areas of a hotel project.
  • Thoroughly review PIP documents to gain familiarity with project requirements as set forth by the PIP prior to commenting to franchisee on project submittals sent in for Design Review. Manager has the authority to accept submitted design modifications that are not as specifically listed in the PIP if the submitted design meets the intent of the PIP.
  • Perform Design Review for all submittals received for all projects within your assigned territory provide appropriate written responses to owner. Review site plans to ensure compliance with applicable laws, IHG Brand Standards, and provide suggestions on required changes or improvements to such plans. Monitor milestone dates for ND and PIP renovation projects to ensure projects are progressing on schedule.
  • Ensure that all documentation is maintained with project file.
  • Lead and conduct initial and periodic meetings with Principal Correspondents (Owners), architects, designers, and contractors to discuss renovation requirements, construction direction, and design plans for specific projects. Consult with/guide the project team members through the design process and into the construction/renovation phase to ensure consistency of product. Responsible for communicating any design or construction trend changes or improvements in order to keep the brand’s Architecture & Design requirements current and competitive.

job.job_description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

At United, we have some of the best aircraft in the world. Our Technical Operations team is full of aircraft maintenance technicians, engineers, planners, ground equipment and facilities professionals, and supply chain teams that help make sure they’re well taken care of and ready to get our customers to their desired destinations. If you’re ready to work on our planes, join our Tech Ops experts and help keep our fleet in tip-top shape.

Are you passionate about aviation? Would you like to maintain some of the biggest and best aircraft in the world? If so, there’s no better place to be than United Airlines. We’re looking for a full-time Aircraft Maintenance Technician (AMT) who has valid Airframe & Powerplant certification to join our Technical Operations team in one of United’s domestic HUBS.

In this vital role, you will provide service and maintenance for aircraft systems, Powerplant, Airframe and Components. You’ll handle a wide variety of duties that make every day different, including inspections, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, parts replacement and repair, as well as routine maintenance.

Keeping our fleet flight-ready

  • Strong mechanical competence and attention to detail are crucial for this critical position.
  • Unlike smaller regional airlines, you’ll have the opportunity to work on larger, highly sophisticated aircraft with United.
  • We will rely on you to be a great teammate, receiving and providing support as you collaborate professionally and seamlessly with your co-workers.
  • You will generally be working out in the elements, so you must be capable of handling weather extremes.
  • You will likely roll up your sleeves, but for those who enjoy hands-on work, it’s all part of the job.

Many routes to success

  • We offer initial training, specialty classes and recurrent training in technical areas and on other topics such as ethics and compliance.
  • With experience, drive and determination to excel, you can move into a variety of roles, including management, inspection, quality control, fleet planning and others.
  • After gaining seniority, you’ll have the opportunity to transfer to other locations within our outstanding network.

Flexibility And Dependability Are Essential

  • Since this is a union position based on seniority, you will be assigned an initial schedule designed to meet our needs at the airport.
  • You must be available for any shift within a 24/7 operation, weekends and holidays.
  • You may be required to work mandatory overtime, when necessary.
  • Punctuality and reliability are essential – we’ve got flight schedules to meet!

The rewards for your expertise and work ethic

  • Great benefits, including several plan options.
  • Flight privileges from day one: you and your family can fly anywhere in the world on stand-by.
  • Time off: you’ll have at least two days off in a row and can earn vacation days based on length of service.

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • High School Diploma or GED/Educational Equivalent
  • FAA A&P License
  • Valid US Driver's License
  • Computer literacy
  • Must pass a background check and drug screen upon contingent job offer
  • An eagerness to learn and willingness to train
  • The ability to access elevated aircraft areas via ladders, lift trucks, boom lifts and other devices
  • The strength to lift 50 pounds, physical flexibility and the ability to work in confined spaces
  • Legal authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship

The starting rate for this role is $38.77.

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Accor Tech & Digital est le moteur de la tech, des solutions digitales et de la transformation au sein du Groupe. Nos 5 000 talents s'engagent à offrir les meilleures expériences digitales et tech à nos clients, nos hôtels et nos équipes dans 110 pays, et à façonner l'avenir de l'hospitalité.

Accor Tech & Digital, des métiers où l'intelligence est d'abord humaine !

Description du poste

Accor Tech & Digital, c'est le laboratoire d'innovation et de transformation technologique du leader mondial de l'hôtellerie.

Nos équipes, appelées Heartist®, concentrent le meilleur de l'hospitalité et le meilleur de la tech & du digital. Notre ambition : offrir à nos clients des expériences personnalisées, mémorables et durables.

Ici, nous faisons naître de nouvelles façons de voyager dans chacun de nos 5 500 hôtels, au plus proche de nos 100 millions de clients dans 110 pays.

Ici, nous sommes au cœur d'un formidable terrain de jeu de transition technologique et de conception de produits digitaux.

Ici, votre champ d'application ne connaîtra aucune frontière.

Alors, avec nous, osez avoir un impact sur le monde !

C'est ici que vous attend votre plus grand défi :

Intégré à notre équipe de HR Business Partners, vous rejoignez une fonction RH au cœur des enjeux stratégiques du Groupe, avec une vision transverse sur l'ensemble des problématiques RH de notre organisation.

Votre Mission

Cette alternance est une immersion complète au cœur des problématiques RH stratégiques, avec des objectifs pédagogiques clairs pour développer vos compétences : compréhension approfondie du rôle d'un HRBP, maîtrise des outils de communication RH interne, analyse de données RH, gestion de projet, autonomie et proactivité.

Les Missions Principales Seront

  • Préparation et coordination des temps forts RH : participer à la planification et à l'organisation des événements RH majeurs (campagnes d'entretiens annuels, revues de salaires, enquêtes d'engagement, people review, etc.), contribuer à la collecte, la consolidation et l'analyse des données (effectifs, performance, rémunération), et assurer un support logistique et organisationnel (gestion d'agendas, préparation de supports, suivi de livrables, relances).
  • Communication RH interne et création de supports : développer des supports de communication clairs et impactants (présentations, newsletters, infographies, articles intranet, emails), participer à la rédaction de messages clés et à l'animation des canaux de communication interne, et concevoir des decks de présentation pour les « Townhalls » et autres comités (CODIR, COPIL).
  • Production de statistiques et reporting RH : extraire, consolider et fiabiliser les données RH via les systèmes d'information RH (SIRH), élaborer des tableaux de bord et des rapports RH (suivi des effectifs, taux de turnover, indicateurs de performance), et analyser les tendances pour présenter des synthèses pertinentes aux HRBP et aux managers.
  • Soutien aux projets HRBP et veille RH : apporter un soutien sur divers projets RH transverses (mise en place de formations, amélioration de processus, déploiement de nouveaux outils RH) et réaliser des veilles sur les tendances RH pour proposer des axes d'amélioration.

Qualifications

Et vous ?

  • Étudiant(e) en Bac+4/5 (Master 1 ou 2) en Ressources Humaines, Communication, École de Commerce, Sciences Politiques ou équivalent universitaire, avec une spécialisation RH.
  • Contrat d'apprentissage ou de professionnalisation - convention tripartite école/entreprise/alternant requise.
  • Durée : 1 an — rythme à définir avec l'école.
  • Date de début souhaitée : septembre 2026.

Compétences Requises

  • Excellente maîtrise du Pack Office, notamment Excel (fonctions avancées, tableaux croisés dynamiques) et PowerPoint (création de présentations professionnelles).
  • Bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et aisance à l'oral, appétence pour l'analyse de données et les statistiques.
  • Anglais parlé et écrit

Compétences Appréciées

  • Connaissance d'un outil de création graphique (Canva, InDesign).
  • Connaissance d'un SIRH

Informations supplémentaires

Et nous, quels sont nos engagements ?

— Sur le monde

  • Accor s'engage pour le monde qui nous entoure, avec une culture employeur forte centrée sur le développement de nos 300 000 talents.
  • Nous adoptons une approche d'amélioration continue pour réduire l'impact du digital sur l'environnement dans l'ensemble de nos projets.

— Sur votre carrière

  • Un encadrement de qualité avec un tuteur dédié et des missions responsabilisantes.
  • Des perspectives d'évolution au sein du Groupe à l'issue de votre alternance.
  • Les parcours de formation et d'évolution sont définis individuellement et collectivement pour que nous grandissions ensemble.

— Concrètement, Chez Accor Tech & Digital

  • Télétravail possible plusieurs jours par semaine depuis la France et options de travail flexibles (bureaux, hôtels, coworking via Worklib).
  • Chaque mercredi après-midi, consacrez votre temps à du travail de fond et à votre développement personnel.
  • Travail dans un environnement multiculturel et anglophone.
  • Amélioration continue & formations : Hackathons, partenariats technologiques d'exception, Digitech Academy & certifications.

Et aussi,

  • Rémunération selon la grille Accor, en fonction du niveau d'études et de l'ancienneté en alternance.
  • Remboursement de l'abonnement Navigo à hauteur de 75 %.
  • Remboursement de l'abonnement SNCF à hauteur de 50 % (cumulable avec le Navigo).
  • Tickets restaurant de 11 € en valeur faciale.
  • Indemnité mobilité douce (vélo, trottinette…).
  • Congés payés.
  • Accès au CSE (comité social et économique).
  • Enveloppe de 250 € pour l'équipement télétravail (sur présentation de facture).
  • Conditions de travail attractives : espaces collaboratifs, restaurants, espaces bien-être et sport sur site ou via Gymlib.

Votre talent et votre motivation sont nos seuls critères de sélection.

Nous valorisons la richesse des diverses nationalités, personnalités et parcours professionnels.

Nous nous adaptons aux besoins spécifiques de nos collaborateurs, notamment ceux en situation de handicap.

Nous encourageons toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, alors osez postuler !

Pour nous, le recrutement est avant tout une histoire de rencontres.

Ce poste vous attire ? Postulez et nous vous proposerons :

  • Un ou des entretiens avec les managers et les membres de l'équipe,
  • Un feedback personnalisé.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get To Know Our Team:

This position is located in Bangkok, Thailand.

Agoda launched Flights in 2019 and is now scaling rapidly to become a leading Flights OTA across APAC. With Thailand identified as a key growth market, we are expanding our commercial team to capture this opportunity.

The Opportunity:

As the Lead for Flights in Thailand, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Agoda’s market presence, driving partner strategy, and building the foundations for long-term success. This is a high-impact, highly visible role at the intersection of commercial negotiations, strategic partnerships, and cross-functional leadership.

You’ll operate with end-to-end ownership of the Thailand market: identifying and closing new partnerships, optimizing performance with existing partners, and ensuring Agoda delivers unmatched value to travelers and suppliers alike. While this is an individual contributor role, you will function as Agoda’s commercial face in-market, working directly with C-level executives of our partners, supported by global teams across Product, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and more.

This is a rare opportunity to join a start-up within a global leader, with the autonomy to move fast, take bold bets, and directly shape Agoda’s Flights success story.

What You’ll Do:

  • Set the strategy: define and execute market strategies for Thailand, balancing growth, profitability, and long-term competitive positioning.
  • Lead commercial negotiations: Own pricing, availability, and commercial terms with airline partners to maximize Agoda’s competitiveness.
  • Be the market voice: Act as the go-to expert on Thailand aviation and online travel, sharing insights with internal teams and shaping Agoda’s product and growth strategy.
  • Deliver partner success: Build deep, trusted executive-level relationships with suppliers, driving joint initiatives that enhance distribution, revenue, and customer experience.
  • Drive execution excellence: Ensure partners’ day-to-day needs are met by collaborating with Agoda’s regional supply teams, operations, and product specialists.
  • Analyze and optimize: Use data and insights to drive decision-making, identify opportunities, test solutions, and iterate quickly.
  • Innovate at scale: Conceptualize and launch new commercial models, distribution initiatives, and customer-facing features that unlock growth.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in the Flights / OTA / airline industry with strong exposure to commercial negotiations, distribution, and market strategy (experience in Thailand highly preferred).
  • Proven track record of delivering growth through partnerships, negotiations, and strategy execution.
  • Commercial acumen with the ability to balance short-term results and long-term market building.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills in English; able to manage complex conversations at senior levels.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with hands-on execution capabilities and comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Analytical rigor; demonstrated ability to use data to shape decisions and influence stakeholders.
  • Experience developing and executing end-to-end business plans that cut across commercial, operational, legal, and marketing dimensions.

Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The Senior Analyst, Crew Operations is responsible for the real-time planning, allocation, and delivery of crew resources across the operation. This role leverages data, operational expertise, and technology to ensure flights are staffed with qualified, legal, and compliant crew members while optimizing cost, efficiency, and operational reliability. Operating within a 24/7 environment, the Senior Analyst uses data-driven decision-making to solve complex operational challenges, manage disruptions, and support both immediate operational needs and long-term business priorities. This position partners closely with Flight Operations, In-Flight Service (IFS), Crew Technology, IT, Finance, Analytics, and Operations Management teams to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute real-time operational decisions to allocate crew resources and ensure full flight coverage across the network.
  • Manage and resolve operational disruptions while maintaining compliance with regulations, labor agreements, and company policies.
  • Optimize crew assignments to balance safety, service reliability, compliance, and cost efficiency.
  • Coordinate crew trip logistics, including scheduling adjustments and hotel accommodations.
  • Utilize legacy systems and next-generation optimization tools to support operational decision-making.
  • Serve as an active end user of emerging technologies and support implementation of new tools and processes.
  • Apply analytical and critical-thinking skills to determine optimal operational solutions.
  • Leverage data and operational insights to improve resource allocation and operational outcomes.
  • Partner with Flight Operations, IFS, Crew Technology, IT, Analytics, Finance, and Operations Management teams.
  • Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend scalable process and technology improvements.

Core Competencies

  • Operational decision-making in time-sensitive environments
  • Analytical thinking, problem solving, and critical reasoning
  • Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced setting
  • Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder engagement
  • Technology adoption and continuous improvement mindset
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Results orientation with attention to detail
  • Commitment to safety, compliance, and operational excellence

Work Environment

  • Fast-paced, operations-focused environment supporting a 24/7 network.
  • Shift-based schedule that may include nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • High level of collaboration with operational, technical, and business teams.
  • Will have a minimum 24-month residency.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.
  • Ability to make sound decisions under pressure in time-sensitive situations.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Flexibility to support a 24/7 operation, including shift work.
  • Commitment to safety, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
  • Experience in crew operations, airline scheduling, resource planning, or a related operational environment.
  • Knowledge of data analysis and data visualization concepts and tools.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Operations, Engineering, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Familiarity with crew management systems, optimization tools, or operational technologies.
  • Experience supporting technology implementations, change management, or process improvement initiatives.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience, Servant Leadership, and Teamwork – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees.   • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%

  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members

job.job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

This role is based at our corporate office in Dallas, TX or Remote

This is your opportunity to be part of a Customer Care Team that is revolutionizing human hospitality in a digital world. As a Senior Analyst Capacity Planning and Forecasting, you hold primary accountability for the headcount and hiring strategies that power Hilton Reservation and Customer Care contact centers globally. Unlike a traditional analyst role, you will focus on strategically balancing exceptional guest experiences, service level performance, and global cost optimization. You will use advanced business intelligence and predictive modeling to mitigate operational risk and lead long-term planning decisions.

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Forecasting, Planning and Analytics, you serve as the strategic consultant to our Partner Managers and external service providers. You lead the roadmap that brings global hiring decisions to life, distilling complex data into executive-level insights and owning global initiatives from concept through delivery.

What You'll Do During a Typical Day:

  • Lead recurring Workforce Management calls with external partners to synchronize on contact volume trends, performance gaps, and execution of staffing strategies.
  • Build optimized headcount and hiring plans by managing customer experience, service levels, and global cost efficiencies.
  • Be the primary contact for communicating hiring plan adjustments and staffing changes to Partner Managers to ensure seamless contact center coverage.
  • Maintain advanced staffing models using Python to create predictive targets for headcount and hiring needs.
  • Analyze contact flows and track staffing accuracy to measure operational efficiency across internal and external partner teams.
  • Use tools like MicroStrategy, Alteryx, and Power BI to query the Enterprise Data Warehouse and build automated reports to identify trends and discover root causes of results.
  • Translate complex forecast and capacity outputs into clear, data-driven operational guidance for business owners.

How You'll Collaborate With Others:

  • Engage with Partner Managers and external vendors to align on headcount requirements and contact volume support.
  • Translate staffing model outputs and operational variances into clear, actionable executive summaries for global leadership.
  • Collaborate with Workforce Management, Operations, and Engineering teams to operationalize hiring plans.
  • Work across teams and functions, embracing diverse perspectives to arrive at solutions to staff and support our customers.

Projects You'll Take Ownership Of:

  • Lead the development of staffing and hiring plans for assigned global business units.
  • Design complex hiring scenarios tied to growth, seasonality, and shifting operational needs.
  • Oversee the communication and reporting workflows that bridge internal planning with external partner performance.
  • Challenge the status quo by mastering new tools or languages to improve the capacity toolkit.

What It Takes to Make the Stay

You Have These Minimum Qualifications:

  • Two (2) years of experience in Capacity Planning or Modeling in a contact center environment
  • One (1) year of experience in Quantitative and Qualitative analysis including the use of statistical and predictive models
  • High level of proficiency in SQL-based BI tools (e.g., MicroStrategy, Alteryx, or Power BI)
  • Working knowledge of Python, including the skill to read, understand, and modify existing scripts
  • Expertise in communicating analytical findings to important partners and executives

It Would Be Useful If You Have:

  • Bachelor's Degree in a related quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science) or equivalent specialized experience.
  • Experience managing projects and timelines, working directly with partners
  • Experience using programming languages to build scripts such as R
  • Knowledge of database architecture and data modeling principles and techniques

How We'll Help You Thrive

At Hilton, The Hospitality We're Known For Doesn't End With Our Guests. We Proudly Invest In Our Team Members' Wellbeing, Supporting You Through All Of Life's Moments. When You Join Hilton, Our Exceptional Care Extends To You With Unmatched Perks And Benefits, Including*:

  • Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  • Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
  • Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
  • Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones
  • Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
  • Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
  • Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
  • Financial security for your future – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what's next
  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member's location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Hilton offers its eligible team members a comprehensive benefits package to support their mental and physical well-being, so they can Thrive personally and professionally. The pay range for this role is $60,000 – $85,000 and is determined based on applicable and specialized experience and location. Subject to plan terms and conditions, you will be eligible to participate in the Hilton Annual Incentive (Bonus) Plan, consistent with other team members at the same level and/or position within the Company.

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Machine Learning Scientist II

Are you passionate about using machine learning to improve Customer Experience? Would you like to work in the fast-paced, competitive, customer-focused, and data-rich world of online travel?

Our Machine Learning and Data Science team are growing! We are looking to hire researchers and data scientists interested in breaking new ground to tackle some of the most complex customer experience problems in the travel domain. The focus of your job will be on developing state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms to power and enhance the customer experience across highly complex post-booking recommendations, customer service, and trip management use cases. You will tackle substantial technical challenges, from inference problems arising from long-tail traveler data to multi-objective optimization problems in the highly dynamic, operationally complex environment of customer service. Your passion for the craft of ML and AI will unlock tangible growth for our business by exploiting these rich data sets and building effective solutions for travelers and our partners.

This is your opportunity to build the core algorithms that help Expedia Group's Post Booking organization bring context and intelligence to every step of the traveler journey and redefine what service excellence in travel can be. We are looking for a hands-on scientist who is passionate about applying machine learning to complex prediction and optimization problems that drive an ecosystem that anticipates traveler needs, personalizes dynamic add-ons and upsells, and improves service experiences, making travel more seamless for millions of customers and partners worldwide.

In This Role, You Will

  • Design & Implement ML Solutions: Take ownership of the end-to-end ML lifecycle for your projects, from ideation and research to deployment and monitoring.
  • Test, Learn, and Iterate: Design and analyze tests to validate your models and quantify their business impact and design future iterations.
  • Collaborate and Communicate: Partner closely with product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements, define problems, and communicate your findings and results effectively.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
  • 1+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Proven ability to design end-to-end ML solutions, including problem formulation, identification and preparation of data sources, algorithm selection, feature engineering, evaluation strategy, and production deployment and monitoring.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and its data science ecosystem (such as pandas, scikit-learn, PySpark) and proficiency in SQL, with experience following software engineering best practices and contributing to shared codebases.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including experience with the machine learning software development lifecycle from experimentation through operational monitoring.

Functional & Technical Skills

  • Expertise in applied ML: Deep, practical knowledge of machine learning theory (supervised/unsupervised learning, deep learning) and statistical modeling and a strong command of experimental design (A/B testing) and causal inference to accurately measure impact. Able to design end-to-end ML solutions: framing the problem, choosing data sources, selecting algorithms, and defining evaluation strategy. Experience with the machine learning software development lifecycle, including experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration in production. Strong programming skills in at least one major ML language (e.g., Python, Scala, Java) plus SQL; writes clean, modular, maintainable code.
  • Technical Fluency: Strong programming skills in Python and its data science ecosystem (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, pySpark), plus proficiency in SQL. Follow software engineering best practices and contribute to the team's shared codebase.
  • First-Principles Problem Solver: Skilled at dissecting ambiguous problems and clearly communicating complex technical ideas.

Highly Desired Experience

  • Domain knowledge in customer service, recommendation systems, operational applications of ML, and/or e-commerce
  • Experience with reinforcement learning or other advanced ML techniques is a plus
  • Experience building and deploying models using GenAI/LLM technologies
  • Experience translating research and academic papers into improved model designs and techniques

Preferred Qualifications

  • MS or PhD in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, Physics, or a related discipline.
  • 2+ years of hands-on industry experience building, deploying, and iterating on machine learning models that solve real-world problems in production environments.
  • Proven ability to design end-to-end ML solutions, including problem formulation, identification and preparation of data sources, algorithm selection, feature engineering, evaluation strategy, and production deployment and monitoring.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and its data science ecosystem (such as pandas, scikit-learn, PySpark) and proficiency in SQL, with experience following software engineering best practices and contributing to shared codebases.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including experience with the machine learning software development lifecycle from experimentation through operational monitoring.

The role supports recurring monthly and quarterly performance routines, market share reporting, revenue and commercial analytics, and ad hoc analysis that help stakeholders monitor business performance and identify opportunities across APEC.

The position works closely with Commercial Services Analytics team members and cross-functional stakeholders to gather data, validate outputs, prepare analytical summaries, and translate findings into clear, concise, and business-relevant insights. The Analyst will contribute to the development and maintenance of scalable reporting and visualization capabilities, including Power BI dashboards, and will support the preparation of leadership materials, performance updates, and special project analysis during the 6-month assignment.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education & Experience

  • 4-year bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Economics, Statistics, Finance, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline.
  • 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in analytics, business intelligence, commercial analysis, revenue strategy, reporting, dashboard development, or a related analytical function.
  • Hands-on experience working with corporate reports, dashboards, data preparation, and reporting visualizations.
  • Experience supporting data validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting to improve reporting accuracy and consistency.
  • Preferred: Working experience in Commercial, Revenue Management, Sales, Marketing, Loyalty, Customer, Travel, Hospitality, or related business intelligence environments.
  • Preferred: Experience working with cloud-based data platforms, APIs, automated data workflows, Power Platform, or related analytics tools.

Skills And Knowledge

  • Strong analytical capability, with the ability to work with large datasets, identify trends, validate findings, and summarize insights clearly.
  • Ability to connect commercial performance, market dynamics, revenue trends, and business context into practical analytical outputs.
  • Good data storytelling skills, with the ability to translate analysis into concise summaries, visual outputs, and business-facing materials.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and quality.
  • Ability to support recurring reporting deliverables, manage timelines, and prioritize multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a team, with a proactive approach to follow-up, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
  • Excellent command of the English language, with strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint is essential.
  • Experience with Power BI or Tableau, including dashboard development, data visualization, performance monitoring, and report enhancement.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and familiarity with database environments such as Snowflake is preferred.
  • Exposure to statistical analysis, forecasting, automation, Python, Power Platform, or related programming languages is advantageous.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

  • Support recurring monthly and quarterly performance reporting for APEC Commercial Services Analytics, including data preparation, validation, analysis, and summary of key trends.
  • Maintain and enhance analytical reports, dashboards, and data assets used for commercial performance management and decision support.
  • Assist in the development and improvement of Power BI dashboards and other visualization tools to support performance monitoring and stakeholder self-service.
  • Prepare data extracts, analysis, charts, and supporting materials for leadership communication decks, business reviews, Annual Business Planning, goal setting, and strategic initiatives.
  • Analyze commercial, revenue, market share, and performance data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring further review.
  • Translate analytical outputs into clear, concise, and business-relevant insights for internal stakeholders.
  • Support ad hoc requests from Commercial, Revenue Strategy, Market, Regional, and Global stakeholders by providing timely and accurate data analysis.
  • Work with team members and stakeholders to clarify business requirements, align on analytical needs, and ensure outputs are fit for purpose.
  • Conduct data validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting to ensure the accuracy and reliability of reporting outputs.
  • Document reporting logic, data sources, assumptions, and process steps to support continuity and knowledge transfer during the 6-month assignment.
  • Contribute to process improvement, automation, and standardization opportunities that improve reporting efficiency and analytical quality.
  • Support special projects as assigned, including analysis, dashboard updates, stakeholder materials, and performance deep dives.

Crowne Plaza Canberra is looking for a Guest Service Agent to grow a great team. As a Guest Service Agent for Crowne Plaza Canberra, you'll play a big part in our guest experience, including check-in and check-out, upselling, problem resolution, providing guest recognition and assisting our guests with any requests they may have. Your ability to deliver our guests a seamless and memorable Crowne Plaza Canberra experience will make you an integral member of the Front Office team.

This is a full-time role, which would suit a candidate with previous experience working in the hotel or hospitality industry.

Your day to day

Following are some ideal day to day activities but not limited to

  • Help guests - you’ll be happy to help if someone needs a toothbrush or directions for example.
  • Look smart – wear your uniform with pride and adhere to hotel grooming policy.
  • Regularly communicate with the team and other departments in order to maintain good relations & improve team engagement.
  • Champion the arrival experience of the hotel, greet all guests and offer appropriate greetings and ensure to recognize regular guests and IHG Rewards Club members
  • Handle guests' complaints and provide service recovery when applicable. Refer problems to the Duty Manager when assistance is required.
  • Process check in/ check-out functions, including general cashiering and processing of guest accounts.
  • Be knowledge about hotel and surroundings to be able to make thoughtful recommendations to our guests.
  • Use other safety, emergency equipment, plant materials tools and substances provided in the workplace as directed or as required in safety procedures.
  • Be knowledgeable on products we are selling – rooms, packages, car parking etc.
  • Understand the hotel product offering to be able to effectively explain to guests.

What We Need From You

  • Excellent personal presentation and positive energy.
  • Proven skills in guest relations, problem solving and time management; and ideally have a working knowledge of hotel property management systems such as Opera.
  • The ideal candidate will also have similar Front Office / Reception experience in a luxury environment focused on attentive guest service.
  • Team Player - working across all Departments to deliver Great Hotels Guest Love
  • Attention to detail – creating amazing guest service moments with the team
  • Flexibility - working, weekends and public holidays are all part of the job
  • Have the legal right to work in Australia.
  • The ability to work AM and PM shifts, including on weekends and public holidays.

You'll be rewarded for your hard work with a suite of benefits that supports you and your family's wellbeing, including:

  • Paid Birthday Leave
  • Hotel Perks like accommodation and Food & Beverage discounts
  • Enhanced parental leave
  • Proactive health days and flexible work options
  • Your career journey will be supported through our lifelong development program
  • IHG Career Milestone celebrations
  • Transfer of entitlements as you move and grow with IHG
  • Access to our discount retail platform that makes your pay go even further

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

We are proud to be IHG and we know that you will be too #Gofurthertogether.
