What you will do:

The Role’s Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Senior Product Designer on our Product Design team, your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing Engaging & innovative User Experiences: Craft engaging, easy-to-use mobile, web, and desktop design solutions that address both business objectives and user needs. Drive innovation by exploring emerging technologies and creative approaches, fostering a spirit of continuous improvement and encouraging the exploration of diverse solutions to enhance user experience.
  • User Psychology Expertise: Leverage deep knowledge of user psychology including their behaviours, motivations, and attitudes, particularly in the context of e-commerce, travel, and technology. Apply behavioural insights and cognitive principles, use data-driven insights into user motivations, emotions, and pain points to inform design choices.
  • Delivering Design Excellence: Produce wireframes, prototypes, journey maps, interaction flows, and design assets, collaborating closely with engineers to ensure seamless implementation. Utilizes the design system effectively and possesses strong skills in its application, while also contributing to its development.
  • Leveraging Research and Insights: Use qualitative and quantitative research, market trends, and best practices to inform design decisions. Participate in user research activities and usability studies to define data-based design solutions.
  • Designing with Business Impact: Leverage a deep understanding of business goals, KPIs, and metrics to inform and guide design decisions, connecting design strategies to measurable outcomes.
  • Crafting Solutions for E-Commerce Excellence: Utilize in-depth knowledge of e-commerce trends, understanding of consumer behaviour, user motivations, and how retail environments impact user experience and decision-making.
  • Stakeholder Management: Engage with stakeholders, align design goals with business objectives, and manage expectations throughout the project lifecycle. Effectively communicate the value of the designs, demonstrating how they contribute to business success, and influence stakeholders by showcasing the potential impact on user experience and key performance indicators.
  • Strategic Thinking: Drive high-level strategic design initiatives that align with organisational goals and market trends, contributing to the development of long-term organisational plans that align daily work with the company's vision and strategic direction. Collaborate with leadership to define overarching design visions, ensuring alignment with business growth, brand evolution, and competitive advantage.
  • Self-Development and Mentorship: Master self-development by continuously expanding your knowledge and skills, setting challenging and inspiring goals for yourself. Act as a role model for the team, actively seeking and accepting feedback to ensure continuous growth. Take an active role in mentoring and developing other team members, fostering growth and learning across the team.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • 5 to 7 years of professional experience in Product Design with a proven track record of contributing to the full development lifecycle of web, mobile, and/or software applications.
  • Experience in designing for e-commerce platforms across all platforms with a strong understanding of complex e-commerce business models.
  • Proven experience in data-driven decision-making: the ability to critically assess design challenges, analyse data, and make informed decisions, that improve the user experience and align with business goals.
  • Proven experience conducting usability testing and design research, independently or in collaboration with a UX research team; expertise in various UX research methods.
  • Self-starter who takes initiative, managing priorities, timelines and resources to overcome obstacles.Works with passion, does not give up, and overcomes setback. Iterates fast: try, fail, learn. Able to work effectively with others on a common task; taking actions that respect the needs and contributions of others; contributing to and accepting the consensus.
  • An online portfolio or samples of work showcasing your Product Design skills, including e-commerce design cases.
  • Fluent in English with strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Presentation skills, with the ability to communicate design decisions while fostering open, respectful team discussions.


Bonus Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in design or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Proficient in Sketch, Adobe Photoshop, or Illustrator.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Keen attention to detail, with expertise in interaction design, typography, colourcolor, and layout.
  • Team player with a positive attitude.
  • Experience in the travel industry or related sectors.


"Please note that applications without a link to a portfolio will not be considered for this role."

What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and the possibility of choosing your equipment and, even better, keeping it for free after 3 years.

  • Your Well-being is our Priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You’ll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You’ll work in an Agile Mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it’s like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

As part of Delta’s Global Health & Wellness team, the Leaves & Absences Transformation function plays a critical role in supporting employees during some of the most important moments of their lives—from medical and family leave to return‑to‑work transitions. This team partners closely with cross‑functional stakeholders to design and deliver a more seamless, compassionate, and modern employee leave experience. Supporting a large, diverse global workforce, Leaves & Absences Transformation is at the center of Delta’s commitment to care, wellbeing, and operational excellence across the employee journey.

Responsibilities

As a Leaves & Absences Transformation Co‑Op, you will partner closely with Health & Wellness, HR, Operations, and Technology teams to support the redesign of Delta’s employee leave experience. Key responsibilities include:

  • Support the end‑to‑end redesign of the employee leave journey, with a focus on simplifying processes, improving clarity, and enhancing moments of care across medical, family, and return‑to‑work leaves.
  • Analyze employee experience data, operational metrics, and feedback to identify pain points, trends, and opportunities for improvement within leave programs.
  • Apply project management and change management principles to support transformation initiatives from concept through implementation.
  • Collaborate cross‑functionally to document current‑state processes and help design future‑state workflows that improve efficiency, consistency, and employee experience.
  • Assist with process engineering and internal consulting efforts to streamline leave operations and reduce friction for employees and leaders.
  • Develop insights, recommendations, and presentations that translate data and findings into actionable improvements.
  • Support pilots, testing, and rollout of new tools, processes, or communications related to the leave experience.
  • Contribute to a culture of empathy, care, and continuous improvement by bringing a human‑centered lens to transformation work.

Note: Students must not take academic classes during Co-Op semesters. Please confirm with your university and academic advisor that this schedule aligns with your curriculum.

  • The Co-op position requires a candidate to be enrolled as an undergraduate (sophomore or above) that has successfully completed a minimum of 30 semester hours.
  • Must have a minimum 2.5 GPA and be able to maintain the minimum GPA.
  • Working as a Co-op does not guarantee a full-time opportunity upon graduation. This position is intended to provide you with educational, and professional work experience to prepare you for the workforce.
  • This position requires you to work for 3 alternating semesters. You cannot actively take any courses (inclusive of online or in-person) and work as a Co-op at the same time, which may delay your graduation by 1-2 semesters.
  • Students must be able to complete 3 alternating rotations in Atlanta, GA in line with the below schedule:
    • Fall 2026 - 1st rotation
    • Summer 2027 - 2nd rotation
    • Spring 2028 - 3rd rotation
What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

Overview

Join a growing team as a Payroll Coordinator at Enterprise Mobility!

Be part of a fast-growing, high-impact department that plays a critical role in our mission to become the world’s most trusted mobility company. As a Payroll Coordinator, you’ll gain hands-on experience with multi-state payroll processing for a diverse employee base—hourly, salaried, full-time, and part-time. This role offers a clear career path within the payroll department and the chance to develop expertise in corporate payroll operations. If you're highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrive on delivering excellent customer service, this is your opportunity to grow with a team that’s expanding and evolving.

This role is located at the Enterprise Mobility Corporate Headquarters in Clayton, MO and offers a hybrid schedule.

Enterprise offers an excellent package with market-competitive pay, comprehensive healthcare packages, 401k matching & profit sharing, schedule flexibility, paid time off, and organizational growth potential.

Compensation decisions will be made based on factors that include but are not limited to experience, education, location and skill level

Company Overview

Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions, owning and operating the Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental and Alamo Rent A Car brands through its integrated global network of independent regional subsidiaries. Enterprise Mobility and its affiliates offer extensive car rental, carsharing, truck rental, fleet management, retail car sales, as well as travel management and other transportation services, to make travel easier and more convenient for customers.

Privately held by the Taylor family of St. Louis, Enterprise Mobility together with its affiliate Enterprise Fleet Management manages a diverse fleet of 2.4 million vehicles and accounted for nearly $39 billion in revenue through a network of more than 9,500 fully-staffed neighborhood and airport rental locations in more than 90 countries and territories.

Responsibilities

We are hiring now for immediate openings. Responsibilities include:

Payroll Processing & Accuracy

Employee Support & Communication

  • Answer routine payroll and payroll tax–related questions from employees and Groups with clarity and professionalism.

Reporting, Projects & Continuous Support

  • Assist in the completion of ad hoc requests and special projects to support departmental needs.

Competency Based

  • Executing
  • Working With a Team
  • Customer Service
  • Detail-Oriented
  • Communication
  • Resilience
  • Flexibility

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

Qualifications

Minimum:

  • H.S. Diploma/GED
  • Must have 1 year minimum of payroll experience
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States

Preferred

job.job_description:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Lead Hotel Efficiency, Resource & Operations (HERO) Coordinator supports the engagement, activation, and operational success of brand programs and initiatives across a portfolio of midscale and upper‑midscale properties. Reporting to the Vice President of Franchise Performance, this role serves as a subject matter resource and operational partner, ensuring strong service delivery, program adoption, and franchisee satisfaction.

The Lead HERO Coordinator provides guidance and day‑to‑day support to HERO Coordinators within an assigned region, promotes collaboration across Franchise Performance leadership and Centers of Excellence, and acts as a key connector between hotel owners/operators and enterprise resources. This role plays a critical part in driving guest satisfaction, operational efficiency, and systemwide program effectiveness.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Franchisee & Portfolio Support

  • Establish and maintain strong, professional relationships with hotel owners and operators.
  • Provide insights, analysis, and recommendations to Area Directors to support hotel performance planning and follow‑through.
  • Support the execution of hotel action plans generated from service, profitability, or total business reviews.
  • Maintain current knowledge of brand standards and influence effective implementation.
  • Support crisis and disaster communication strategies in partnership with Area Directors.
  • Monitor owner and guest satisfaction trends and escalate insights to Brand Operations and Centers of Excellence.
  • Ensure timely resolution of franchise support issues and identify opportunities for systemwide improvements.

Operational Execution of Brand Programs

  • Support the rollout and operationalization of new brand standards, initiatives, and programs.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional partners to ensure consistency and clarity of program documentation and tools.
  • Participate in Voice of Franchisee communication processes, reviewing and providing feedback on hotel‑facing communications.
  • Represent the voice of the hotel in cross‑functional initiatives and projects.
  • Support hotels in navigating brand platforms, systems, and enterprise resources including Revenue Management, Global Sales, Distribution, Loyalty, Reservations, Customer Care, and ChoiceU.

Team Enablement & Collaboration

  • Provide functional guidance and support to assigned HERO Coordinators to ensure consistent service delivery.
  • Promote knowledge sharing, collaboration, and engagement across the HERO team.
  • Share feedback and insights with Franchise Performance leadership regarding owner engagement trends and program effectiveness.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts for HERO service delivery and franchisee experience.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of hotel leadership or operations experience, with Choice‑branded hotel experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting hotel owners and operators in a franchise or multi‑property environment.
  • Experience collaborating cross‑functionally to support operational initiatives and program adoption.

Education

  • Associate degree or bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and work experience.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to influence, build relationships, and hold stakeholders accountable with professionalism and tact.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to identify trends and recommend improvements.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Ability to model Choice values: be bold, be quick, listen, be curious, and act with integrity.

Travel

  • Ability to travel up to 10%, as needed.

WORK LOCATION:

This position is based at Choice Hotels’ Scottsdale, Arizona office. The selected candidate must be able to commit to this location requirement and adhere to the company’s hybrid work schedule, which consists of four days onsite and one day remote per week.

NOTE:

This position is not eligible for relocation assistance or sponsorship.

Choice prioritizes our associate wellbeing by offering a comprehensive benefits program that is both competitive and flexible to help you achieve your wellbeing goals - here are just a few:

  • Competitive compensation and benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Leave and paid time-off for holidays, vacation, personal, family, volunteer, sick, jury duty, bereavement, military, and religious observance
  • Financial benefits for retirement and health savings
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Discounts at Choice hotels worldwide

About Choice

Choice Hotels International, Inc. (NYSE: CHH), is one of the largest lodging franchisors in the world. With 7,500 hotels in 45+ countries and territories, we offer a range of high-quality lodging options in the upper upscale, upper midscale, midscale, extended stay, and economy segments. We’re the hotel company for those who choose to bet on themselves — the striver, the dreamer, the entrepreneur — because that’s who we are, too.

At Choice, we are united by the simple belief that tomorrow will be even better than today — for associates, our company, and our franchisees. At our worldwide corporate headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, at our technology center in Scottsdale, Arizona, and through our associates around the globe, every voice is heard and every idea is listened to, no matter what area of the company they come from. We are united in supporting the entrepreneurial dreams of our thousands of franchise owners, which propels us forward — giving our work at Choice a purpose larger than our business.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Introduction to the Team

We create and deliver tailored marketing strategies for Expedia Group’s brands, focusing on establishing strong connections and cohesive experiences for travelers and partners. We leverage our functional expertise and creative excellence to build trust and loyalty for our brands through innovative marketing approaches and technology.

Expedia Group is seeking a highly technical, builder-mindset Principal Product Manager to own Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). As AI agents increasingly mediate how travelers discover and choose, AEO has rapidly become a primary channel for reaching them. AEO ensures EG’s brands, supply, and content are surfaced and cited by horizontal AI agents that retrieve and synthesize information on behalf of travelers.

This is a senior individual contributor role, designed for a builder. The Principal PM will own the channel-level thesis, roadmap, technical execution, measurement, and performance outcomes end to end. The role carries a dotted line into a dedicated engineering pod and is empowered to move quickly. This role reports to the Head of Organic & Agentic Search.

In This Role, You Will

Channel Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the AEO strategy, roadmap, and outcomes end to end, sequencing investment across the full retrieval stack.
  • Map the full AEO journey: from how LLMs are trained and source data, to how live retrieval surfaces select and rank content, to how bots land on EG gateways and assets. Use the journey to identify where intervention compounds.
  • Translate the evolving LLM and answer-engine landscape into clear strategic prioritization decisions.

Market Intelligence & Thesis Building

  • Monitor the frontier AI ecosystem continuously: model releases, product updates, and roadmap signals from frontier labs and answer-engine platforms.
  • Track industry news, academic research, and emerging protocols relevant to retrieval, agent behavior, and answer-engine mechanics.
  • Build and maintain a structured point of view on where the answer-engine market is heading, what changes mean for EG, and which shifts demand action versus observation.
  • Develop relationships with frontier labs, answer-engine platforms, and AI-native peers to maintain primary-source signal rather than relying on secondary coverage.
  • Synthesize research, market signal, and EG’s own data into theses that inform channel strategy, product investment, and the broader organization’s view of agentic search.

Retrieval & Access Optimization

  • Drive optimization across the live retrieval path, from web and agent indices through to landing on EG surfaces.
  • Identify and pull the high-leverage levers across gateway configuration, filetype strategy, and content structure that govern bot access and comprehension.
  • Lead technical enhancements on filetypes, sizes, indexation, bot definitions, permissions, and gateway routing to maximize accessibility for both model training and live retrieval.
  • Own optimization of the AEO bot journey end to end.

Measurement & Analytics

  • Define and operate the AEO measurement system, including bot crawl analytics, indexation tracking, AI visibility metrics, and downstream traffic and revenue signals.
  • Establish leading and lagging indicators that ladder to channel North Star metrics, with rigorous, decision-grade measurement.
  • Own AEO performance in internal and external forums, translating technical signal into clear narratives for executive and external audiences.

Product Development & Systemization

  • Translate channel learnings into durable products and systems. For example: atomizing pages to better understand bot preferences, or scaling a portfolio of filetypes and routing logic served to different bots.
  • Apply a desirability / feasibility / viability lens to rank what to productionalize, recognizing that not every learning warrants a system.
  • Lead a dedicated engineering pod via dotted-line authority, using agents and automation to amplify output.
  • Continuously monitor LLM and answer-engine platforms for algorithm updates, product changes, and errors that materially impact AEO performance, and lead rapid response when they do.

Executive Communications & Presentations

  • Translate complex retrieval mechanics, measurement results, and channel strategy into clear, concise narratives for C-suite, board, and senior cross-functional audiences.
  • Produce executive-grade written and visual artifacts: strategy documents, decision memos, performance readouts, and presentations that build conviction and drive decisions.
  • Represent AEO in senior internal forums and selected external venues, framing trade-offs and recommendations with the structure and clarity expected at the executive level.
  • Operate with strong executive presence: synthesize fast-moving information into a clear point of view and defend it under scrutiny.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product management, growth, or technical product leadership, with increasing scope and ownership

job.job_description:
This highly visible and strategic role sits within the Architecture, Corporate, AI & Data (ARCAID) organization and serves as the primary Product Operations partner to the SVP and tower leadership team. The role is embedded within ARCAID and aligned to the Product Operations & Performance Center of Operations model — bringing discipline, rigor, and structure to a tower operating at the leading edge of AI, data, architecture, and corporate technology.

The Director will act as a trusted operator to Wei Manfredi and her leadership team — shaping and articulating ARCAID's strategy, standing up the operating rhythms that don't exist today (SteerCos, priority reviews, executive readouts), and translating complex AI, data, and architecture concepts into simple, compelling messaging for senior audiences including Board-level forums, Executive Committee (EC), Senior Leadership Team (SLT), Extended Leadership Team (ELT), and external business partners.

Your Day to Day

Strategy, Narrative & Positioning

  • Partner with the SVP and ARCAID leadership to define, evolve, and communicate a clear tower strategy that aligns to the broader P&T vision and priorities.
  • Own the ARCAID narrative — translating complex AI, architecture, data, and corporate technology concepts into simple, straightforward messaging tailored to executive and business audiences.
  • Develop and maintain messaging frameworks, value propositions, and strategic 1-pagers that clearly articulate the impact and direction of ARCAID initiatives.

Executive Communication & Storytelling

  • Develop high-quality executive materials (EC/SLT/ELT readouts, Board updates, OA forums, strategic presentations) that drive clarity, alignment, and informed decision-making.
  • Craft compelling narratives that simplify complex topics into clear, structured, and persuasive messaging for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ensure consistency and cohesion in how ARCAID's strategy, priorities, and progress are communicated internally and externally.

Operational Discipline & Delivery Management

  • Establish and reinforce a clear operating rhythm across ARCAID — including LT meetings, priority check-ins, quarterly lookbacks/QBRs, SteerCos, and weekly CPTO updates.
  • Bring structure to areas where structure doesn't exist today — standing up SteerCos, priority reviews, and governance forums with primary business stakeholders.
  • Partner with the Agile CoE and Portfolio Management to drive consistent delivery practices, including annual planning, product roadmaps, prioritization, KPIs/OKRs, and priority reporting.
  • Monitor tower KPIs and financial performance, acting as a conduit to Finance on budget vs. spend, business cases, vendor management, and the pipeline of new investments.

Business & Commercial Partnership

  • Partner closely with business and commercial stakeholders (e.g., GCM, Finance, HR, Loyalty, Owner Relations) to drive ARCAID priorities through the business.
  • Act as a connective layer between ARCAID and internal P&T towers (DDC, EPI, GTX, ETS, GC) to surface dependencies, align on shared priorities, and ensure cohesive delivery of horizontal capabilities.
  • Represent ARCAID's strategy and value proposition across cross-functional forums on behalf of tower leadership.

Special Projects & Strategic Execution

  • Swarm high-impact, cross-functional initiatives (e.g., AI Step Change, Gemini Enterprise, AI CoE, Data Engineering, Corporate Products) to accelerate execution and bring consistent operational governance.
  • Ensure initiatives are grounded in clear objectives, measurable outcomes, and ongoing visibility to leadership.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to Wei — proactively identifying risks, gaps, and opportunities and helping the tower stay aligned to its strategic direction.

What We Need From You

  • 7–10 years of progressive experience across strategy, product management, product marketing, or product operations roles within technology-driven organizations.
  • Demonstrated success in strategic planning, narrative development, and executive communication for senior leadership audiences.
  • Strong track record of influencing senior stakeholders and operating effectively in complex, matrixed environments.
  • Experience working within technology organizations, with exposure to AI, data, architecture, and platform-based capabilities.
  • Proven ability to establish operating rhythms, governance forums, and executive reporting structures from the ground up.
  • Experience partnering with commercial/business stakeholders (Finance, HR, GCM, Regions, Legal) to drive technology priorities through the business.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build alignment and trust across all levels of the organization.
  • Experience:
    • Product background — brings a product mindset grounded in customer value, iterative improvement, and outcomes over outputs.
    • Effective storytelling — proven ability to craft compelling narratives and executive-level messaging that simplify complex topics.
    • Rigor and discipline — operates with structure, follow-through, and a bias for closure; brings order to complex, ambiguous environments.
    • Drives ideas through the business — able to move an idea from concept to alignment to execution by influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.
    • Business partnership — partners closely with business and commercial stakeholders to build trust, secure buy-in, and unlock decisions.
    • Brings structure to white space — comfortable establishing SteerCos, priority reviews, and governance where none exist today.
    • Comfortable in ambiguity — thrives operating in white space, defining the "how" while shaping the "what."
    • Translates complex technology — turns AI, data, and architecture concepts into simple, straightforward messaging for any audience.
Travel - 10%

Location - Our hybrid work structure is an expectation of three (3) days a week in office. This expectation may be adjusted to evolve with the changing needs of the business.

As a connector and brand steward, this role balances enterprise objectives with market dynamics, exercises sound judgment in ambiguous, matrixed environments, champions operational excellence, and inspires teams to deliver differentiated results. The successful candidate will join the Credit Card billing/refund/accounting Unit in SIA Finance Division. Jointly with three other Analysts, each will manage his/her own portfolio of transactions by credit card brands processed through the various payment gateways. He/She will ensure timely, accurate and complete billings and refunds of all credit card transactions under his/her charge as well as handle billing disputes, review reconciliation of billings/refunds against settlements and clearance of credit card related suspense accounts in compliance with accounting standards and the Company’s contractual obligations. Over and above these operational duties, the incumbent is expected to work with Projects/IT business units in conceptualising, testing and implementing enhancements to the accounting systems to facilitate the implementation of new marketing initiatives and industry changes and/or address gaps in the payment process flow. Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure timely, accurate and complete processing of all credit card billings and refunds for tickets and other accountable documents.
  • Ensure the prompt handling, investigation and resolution of all credit card retrieval requests and chargeback disputes with Acquiring Banks and Credit Card Companies within specified timelines.
  • Ensure timely reconciliation of billings and refunds against settlements to enable clearance of credit card related accounts in general ledger.

  • Projects - participate in and/or manage projects which have system and/or business impact on Passenger Revenue Control department’s work processes as assigned by his/her superior. This

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. We are looking for a Senior Search Analyst to work on data-led analytical elements of our paid search program. You will be part of a dynamic and innovative team where autonomous decision-making, self-motivation and flexible thinking is encouraged. You will play a crucial role in shaping the future success of the company.

About The Role

In this role you will join the Search Engine Marketing (SEM) bidding team, who own and manage the data-led systems that ensure we’re making the most out of our paid search advertising spend. Your contribution will have a direct impact on paid search bidding strategies, optimizing existing automated systems and using data to help identify new opportunities or problem areas in paid search marketing. You will work in collaboration with the wider SEM team, Data Science and Data Engineering teams to actively measure and manage the performance and optimization of our paid search program across UK & FIGS markets. Furthermore, you will help the team adopt AI. This means finding real-world applications for AI tools to make our systems run faster, improve the quality of our data analysis and uncover deeper analytical insights.

What You'll Do

  • Produce original analyses to identify and explore opportunities to optimize our search engine marketing (SEM) bidding strategies towards maximizing revenue.
  • Seek out and implement improvements to our existing automated paid marketing systems.
  • Plan and execute measurement tests and experiments to evaluate the impact of different bidding strategies and apply findings to improve performance.
  • Apply analytical techniques to measure the true return of our SEM spend.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams such as Marketing and Data Science/Machine Learning to align on strategies, share insights, and ensure objectives are met.
  • Check on marketing performance daily and regularly report outward to the wider team and upward to the leadership team about trends, wins, and future plans.
  • Leverage AI tools and technologies for day-to-day tasks & systems to enhance efficiency, generate insights and streamline workflows.
  • Stay informed and proactively implement emerging ad technologies, best practices in media systems management and bidding optimization, process improvements and automation to enhance performance.

Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business / Maths / Statistics or a related quantitative field.
  • 2+ years experience working in a data analytics position, preferably in a digital marketing environment.
  • Ability to turn complex data into compelling storytelling and actionable recommendations.
  • Expertise in interrogating data using SQL and writing custom SQL queries, and understanding of database structures.
  • Understanding of statistical analysis techniques used for experimental design such as regression analysis, hypothesis testing, multivariate analysis and time series analysis.
  • Experience using AI tools in your day-to-day workflow, with a genuine eagerness to expand your knowledge and application of AI within SEM, data and bidding.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively present findings, explain complex concepts and influence stakeholder decisions making.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks and meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Has a genuine passion for learning and self-improvement, continuously seeking out new opportunities to expand knowledge and skills.
  • Prior exposure to Paid Search, Bidding, and Marketing KPIs is a strong plus.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Excellent spoken and written Japanese skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

Company Description

About Orient Express

Artisan of travel since 1883, Orient Express sublimates the art of travel with its luxury trains, hotels, and sailing yachts. The brand has just launched its first hotel, Orient Express La Minerva, in Rome – which will be followed by Orient Express Venezia at Palazzo Donà Giovannelli in 2026. The experience continues with the recent launch of La Dolce Vita Orient Express train, followed by Orient Express Corinthian in 2026, the first of two Orient Express Sailing Yachts, and finally, the return of L’Orient Express train to railways. Since 2022, Orient Express is part of Accor Group’s leading collection of luxury brands with a century-old legacy in the hotels and fine- dining sectors. In 2024, Accor and LVMH entered into a strategic partnership to accelerate the development of Orient Express. Follow the journey at @orientexpress on Instagram or visit the website at www.orient-express.com.

About Orient Express Sailing Yachts

140 years after the launch of its first luxury trains, the Orient Express legend continues with the launch of the world's largest sailing ships, the Orient Express Corinthian. A revolution in maritime history, and a fabulous project that pushes back the limits of what is possible. The result of a unique French partnership between Accor, the world leader in hospitality, and Chantiers de l'Atlantique, the world's leading cruise ship builder. This extraordinary sailing ship of the future, with its spectacular interiors, will set sail in 2026.

Job Description

JOB DESCRIPTION

As an Operation Finance Analyst, reporting to the Operation Finance Manager, you will support the Finance Operations team in monitoring the financial performance of the vessels and ensuring the reliability of operational financial information. Working with operations teams, you will contribute to reporting, financial analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Operational performance monitoring
  • Prepare and consolidate financial data for both vessels
  • Support the monitoring of key financial and operational KPIs
  • Assist in the analysis of cruise performance across revenues and cost
  • Contribute to the preparation of management reports
  • Contribute to ad hoc analyses
  • Budgeting & forecasting
  • Consolidate operational assumptions received from business teams
  • Support the preparation of reforecasts
  • Perform variance analyses between actuals, budget and forecast
  • Finance systems & data quality
  • Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of financial data within the PMS and ERP
  • Contribute to improving data quality and reporting reliability
  • Participate in testing new functionalities and process enhancements
  • Financial processes & internal controls
  • Support monthly closing activities and accounting controls
  • Assist in documenting finance procedures and operational processes, contribute to internal control activities and follow-up of identified issues
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Work with onboard finance officers and operational teams
  • Collaborate with Accounting, Reporting and other Finance functions
  • Contribute to cross-functional projects supporting Finance Operations

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree (Finance, Accounting, Business School or equivalent)
  • 0–2 years of experience (including internships/apprenticeships) in finance, audit, or controlling
  • Proactive mindset and willingness to learn
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High level of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Excel skills
  • Good understanding of financial analysis, budgeting, and forecasting
  • Knowledge of ERP systems and data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) is a plus
  • Good communication skills
  • English mandatory

Your success will come from your ability to help teams achieve their goals and deliver on commitments to their customers. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.


Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.8 million Prime members since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo

Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As an Agile Coach in the Agile Team you will be in charge of:

  • Collaborate with other Agile Coaches to develop a unified agile strategy, create cross-area collaboration frameworks, share best practices, and ensure consistent agile evolution and collaboration across the organization.
  • Guide executives, business units, and technology teams on change management and implementing Agile principles & values, helping them to build, grow, and continuously improve a thriving agile organization at scale;
  • Empower teams to make data-driven decisions, fostering cross-collaborations, reducing complexity, improving communication to ensure clear prioritisation of initiatives to maximise impact and reach eDOs strategic goals.
  • Design and support teams in the deployment of the eDOs development approach to optimise resource allocation, development of customer-centric products and services, and ultimately deliver value;
  • Provide Agile coaching and training to Product Owners, Dev Teams, and the wider business, coaching teams in all aspects of Kanban;
  • Expose our product and technology teams to the latest innovative thinking and ideas from the Lean and Agile community to increase agility, using Lean, Kanban, and other agile thinking to encourage a culture of experimentation, learning and continuous improvement;
  • Create, build, and facilitate or deliver customized workshops and training sessions.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • 3+ years’ experience in technology organizations with Agile/Kanban coaching experience;
  • Deep knowledge of Agile principles and practices and the ability to transfer that understanding at all levels of the organization;
  • Results driven ability to execute and embed
  • Consulting and facilitation skills in coaching technical and business teams in the adoption and improvement of Agile methodologies;
  • Conflict management skills
  • High degree of emotional intelligence and the ability to build strong relationships across various levels of the organisation
  • Excellent presentation and training skills;
  • Fluency in English is a requirement


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or other AI-powered coding assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into software development workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to debug code, streamline development processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.
  • Collaboration with AI: Experience or interest in collaborating closely with AI tools as “pair programmers” to complement traditional software development practices.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and the possibility of choosing your equipment and, even better, keeping it for free after 3 years.

  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

The Procurement Analytics, Data Infrastructure & Data Products Manager will design, build, and evolve analytics platforms, data products, and master data foundations that support the Procurement and Supply Chain organization. This role partners closely with Strategic Sourcing, Finance, Operations, and IT to enable fact-based decisions through scalable data models, spend cubes, dashboards, and curated analytics products across Direct and Indirect spend.

This role is designed for a hands-on builder with a strong product mindset, combining data architecture, BI engineering, and financial acumen to translate complex procurement data into actionable insights that drive sourcing strategies, supplier performance, and enterprise cost optimization.

Key Responsibilities

Procurement Data Infrastructure & Architecture

  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end data infrastructure including ingestion, transformation, modeling, and semantic layers.
  • Develop analytical cubes covering supplier, category, contract, volume, rate, and spend hierarchies.
  • Integrate contracts, purchase orders, invoices, finance actuals, and operational data into a single source of truth.
  • Establish governance and quality standards for supplier master, category hierarchies, and contract/rate data.

Spend, Financial & Should-Cost Analytics

  • Partner with Finance to align analytics to budgets, forecasts, P&L impacts, and savings baselines.
  • Deliver volume, rate, mix, price variance, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analytics.
  • Connect negotiated rates and should-cost assumptions to actual spend to identify leakage and compliance gaps.

Reporting, Dashboards & Self-Service Enablement

  • Build scalable dashboards and reporting solutions (Power BI / Tableau) delivering executive-ready insights.
  • Develop intuitive, self-service analytics products embedded into regular business rhythms.
  • Translate complex datasets into clear, decision-oriented narratives for leadership.

Offshore Analytics & Data Engineering Partnership (Dotted-Line)

  • Provide functional (dotted-line) leadership to offshore analytics and data engineering teams supporting Procurement analytics.
  • Translate business requirements into clear technical direction, reviewing deliverables to ensure quality, scalability, and alignment to standards.
  • Leverage offshore capacity to accelerate delivery while retaining hands-on ownership of solution design and analytics outcomes.
  • Define and govern the ETL / ELT architecture and data pipeline requirements, including source integration, transformations, orchestration, and data quality controls, while providing functional (dotted‑line) direction to offshore teams responsible for building and maintaining the pipelines.

Product Ownership & Enablement

  • Act as analytics product owner by defining use cases, maintaining delivery roadmaps, and prioritizing enhancements based on business value.
  • Enable adoption through structured trainings, equipping category teams to self‑serve analytics by delivering hands‑on training, practical playbooks, and by embedding data products into core operating rhythms.

Future-Ready Data Foundation

  • Design AI-ready data structures and semantic layers enabling future ML, AI, and LLM-based procurement use cases.
  • Partner with IT and engineering teams on scalable, enterprise-grade cloud data architecture.

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years in analytics, BI, or data engineering roles supporting Procurement, Supply Chain, or Finance.
  • Advanced SQL and data modeling skills, including experience with cloud-based analytics data platforms (preferred: Microsoft Fabric or AWS).
  • Strong understanding of procurement financials including Direct and Indirect spend.
  • Experience building BI dashboards and semantic models (Power BI / Tableau).
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills and product mindset.
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data.
  • Embraces diverse people, thinking, and styles.
  • Possesses a high school diploma, GED, or high school equivalency.
  • Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States.

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Finance, Engineering, MIS, Analytics, or related field.

Benefits And Perks To Help You Keep Climbing

Our culture is rooted in a shared dedication to living our values – Care, Integrity, Resilience and Servant Leadership – every day, in everything we do. At Delta, our people are our success. At the heart of what we offer is our focus on Sharing Success with Delta employees. Exploring a career at Delta gives you a chance to see the world while earning great compensation and benefits to help you keep climbing along the way:

  • Competitive salary, industry-leading proﬁt sharing program, and performance incentives
  • 401(k) with generous company contributions up to 9%
  • New hires are eligible for up to 2-weeks of vacation. This is earned for use in the following vacation year (April 1 – March 31)
  • In addition to vacation, new hires are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid personal time within a 12-month period
    • 10 paid holidays per calendar year
  • Birthing parents are eligible for 12-weeks of paid maternity/parental leave
  • Non-birthing parents are eligible for 2-weeks of paid parental leave
  • Comprehensive health beneﬁts including medical, dental, vision, short/long term disability and life insurance beneﬁts
  • Family care assistance through fertility support, surrogacy and adoption assistance, lactation support, subsidized back-up care, and programs that help with loved ones in all stages
  • Holistic Wellbeing programs to support physical, emotional, social, and financial health, including access to an employee assistance program offering support for you and anyone in your household, free financial coaching, and extensive resources supporting mental health
  • Domestic and International space-available flight privileges for employees and eligible family members
  • Career development programs to achieve your long-term career goals
  • World-wide partnerships to engage in community service and innovative goals created to focus on sustainability and reducing our carbon footprint
  • Business Resource Groups created to connect employees with common interests to promote inclusion, provide perspective and help implement strategies
  • Recognition rewards and awards through the platform Unstoppable Together
  • Access to over 500 discounts, specialty savings and voluntary benefits through Deltaperks such as car and hotel rentals and auto, home, and pet insurance, legal services, and childcare

At Enterprise Mobility™ we are paving a new way forward by creating better experiences for how we move. We give people around the world the ability to connect in ways that suit their unique needs. Overview

Gain real-world business, accounting, and financial training that will teach you all aspects of financial management pertaining to running a successful business. Our program fully prepares you to become a Controller/VP of Finance of your own financial operation. A key partner in our organization, the Controller/VP of Finance oversees all aspects of financial management and provides balance to the partnership formed with the marketing and operational pieces of our business. As an Accountant, you can count on a career path with a clear beginning and an open end that’s full of opportunities. With training, development, mentoring, and a culture of promotion from within, you’ll always be progressing in your career.

This position is located at one of our Group Headquarters in Wayne, PA. Our office is located at: 585 E Swedesford Road, Suite 200, Wayne, PA 19087.

The target compensation for this position is $60,000 - $62,000 annually, which is based on an hourly rate of $28.00, plus any applicable overtime compensation for a 42-hour workweek.

We offer a robust Total Rewards Package including, but not limited to:

  • Paid Time Off, starting with 5 days upon hire and receiving a total of 12 days your first year, plus 6 holidays.
  • Health, Dental, Vision insurance; Life Insurance; Prescription coverage
  • Employee discounts on car rentals, car purchases and much more!
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match and profit sharing

Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions, owning and operating the Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental and Alamo Rent A Car brands through its integrated global network of independent regional subsidiaries. Enterprise Mobility and its affiliates offer extensive car rental, carsharing, truck rental, fleet management, retail car sales, as well as travel management and other transportation services, to make travel easier and more convenient for customers.

Job Description

As a key member of the Feasibility & Investment Analysis (F&IA) team, you will support Hilton’s growth across Asia Pacific (APAC) by delivering market insights and investment analysis for new hotel opportunities. This role will be responsible for performing a range of market and financial analyses, including but not limited to: market studies, feasibility assessments, impact analyses, management and franchise contract valuations, cash flow waterfalls, debt and equity investment NPVs and IRRs, M&A evaluations, and special projects related to asset management and strategic analysis for new brand rollouts.

You will work closely with the Lead Underwriters across the APAC region, delivering high-quality analysis and expert advice to key business stakeholders.

This position is based in the Singapore Area Office, with moderate travel required within the APAC region.

Responsibilities

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

Your role is important, and below are some of the fundamental job duties that make your work unique.

What Your Day-to-day Will Be Like

  • Conduct market / proforma analysis: Focus on assessing proposed hotels by evaluating site utility for hotel operations, analyzing the local market and city, understanding demand patterns, identifying competitive sets, and forecasting demand, average daily rates, and benchmarking costs against Hilton properties, competitors, and industry standards.
  • Perform investment and valuation analysis to support decision-making across various internal stakeholders including Development, Real Estate & Asset Management, Operations, Finance, and Executive Management.
  • Utilize, maintain and update sophisticated financial models to support in-depth analysis.
  • Prepare clear and concise analytical reports and memoranda summarizing findings, methodologies, and recommendations for internal stakeholders.
  • Conduct meetings with internal stakeholders, including senior executives, presenting relevant findings on key projects and soliciting inputs to further strengthen our analysis and findings.

How You Will Collaborate With Others

  • Work closely with Lead Underwriters across the APAC region to support feasibility assessments and investment evaluations for development opportunities.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to provide analytical insights that inform strategic decisions.
  • Participate in internal meetings, development conferences, and relevant hotel investment conferences.
  • Collaborate with other F&IA team members and internal stakeholders on strategic projects including but not limited to brand launches, development strategy, productivity and efficiency enhancements, and related.

What Projects Or Deliverables You Will Take Ownership Of

  • Ownership of feasibility studies and investment analyses that support development approvals and investment decision-making across the APAC region.
  • Maintain and enhance financial models, market intelligence databases, and analytical tools used to evaluate hotel development and investment opportunities.

Qualifications

WHY YOU’LL BE A GREAT FIT

You Have These Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, finance, real estate, or a related field.
  • 0 to 2+ years of experience in hospitality consulting, asset management, feasibility, and/or investment analysis, or a demonstrated ability to perform these functions effectively.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; advanced Excel modelling capabilities and knowledge of other analytical tools.
  • Fluency in English with exceptional communication skills.
  • Ability to conduct fieldwork and travel within the APAC region as required.
  • Commitment to discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive information.

It Would Be Useful If You Have

  • In-depth understanding of investment and valuation approaches, particularly as they apply to hotel projects.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex analyses into clear insights for stakeholders.
  • A team-oriented mindset with the initiative to take ownership of projects and collaborate effectively across departments.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining a high-quality output.
  • Understanding of and proficiency in the use of AI tools
  • Interpersonal skills that allow you to represent Hilton with professionalism, including when dealing with external stakeholders.
  • Foreign language skills are a plus.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

job.job_description:
Job Description

The successful candidate will join the Flight Services & Fuel Efficiency department in SIA Operations Control Centre (TMM).

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor the progress of SIA flights and disseminate relevant flight information to parties concerned.
  • Consistently evaluate route and operational safety information, such as curtailment of airport facilities, including runways and fueling facilities, industrial unrest, meteorological warnings, and crew flight time limitations, while assessing their impact on flights.
  • Keep the operations crew informed via ACARS when necessary.
  • Work to minimise flight delays and passenger inconvenience.
  • Arrange additional flights, charters and/or relief flights as required.
  • Coordinate and handle delays or special diversions to enroute stations or airports when commercial, economic, or technical circumstances require it.
  • Act under stipulated procedures for accidents/incidents involving SIA aircraft and property, as well as for emergencies such as hijackings, bomb threats and/or medical emergencies involving SIA or Star-Alliance partner flights in Singapore.
  • Analyse the cause of flight delays and their subsequent handling with the objective of improving the handling techniques to avoid or minimise their recurrence.
  • Monitor flight progress (Flight Following) & revise/update flight plans, noting changes in critical fuel scenarios for (EDTO) (Extended Diversion Time Operation)
  • Communicate with Technical Crew and Flight Dispatchers on changes to flight plan when necessary; in-flight re-routing due to revised operating conditions, airspace and/or weather-related matters, further route optimisation, etc.
  • Provide flight planning support during IRROPS.
  • Monitor significant weather (e.g., Typhoon, Volcanic Ash, severe weather around terminal airspaces) and provide the necessary rerouting and information for operational resilience.
  • Monitor ad-hoc significant disruption to air routes/airspaces.
  • Coordinate arrival & departure sequencing, European Delay Management, Tactical Cost Index Adjustment and others.
  • Maintain Flight Dispatch currency.
  • Support fuel initiative operations
  • Ensure SIN ATFM Management Measures are communicated to the crew.
  • Any other duties as assigned by the department.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree, preferably with a background in Flight Operations or pilots ATPL
  • As this is an operational role, you will need to be able to work on shift duties

Successful candidates will undergo a suitable training program that typically runs for 12 months. Training duration for candidates with relevant experience will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis. The trainee must successfully complete the training program and competency assessments before being appointed as Flight Controller.

Successful candidates are required to sign a bond for the duration of training and two years thereafter.

We thank all candidates for your interest in Singapore Airlines, and regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

We are looking for an experienced sales professional to join our Key Accounts team within the Global Partner Solutions business. Our team builds exceptional, strategic, and long-term relationships with the largest and most valuable hotel companies across the globe. We find ways to solve our clients’ many business challenges with a variety of Tripadvisor solutions, thereby supporting our customers and driving revenue for Tripadvisor. We work across multiple internal and external stakeholders to ensure we find the right strategy for each of our partners.

As a Senior Key Account Executive at Tripadvisor, you will be in a hybrid role which is the perfect balance of customer retention & new customer acquisition. You will work with both existing and new customers, engage in a consultative sales approach, demonstrate our business value and ultimately sell Tripadvisor solutions to our clients. You will have access to training, processes and tools to support success in this role. The ideal candidate will have strong sales DNA, be results-driven, execution-focused and customer-oriented.

You are the right person for this role if you are proactive, motivated, strategic, organized, and able to work well in a fast-paced, highly-driven and entrepreneurial environment. This role requires excellent sales and communications skills as well as effective relationship-building talents. Beyond that, we are seeking sales experience in e-commerce, SAS, and other digital platforms along with demonstrated success with exceeding sales targets.

Job Location Singapore (Hybrid), Japan ( Remote)

What You’ll Do

  • You will own a book of business, constituted by our existing clients who use our business subscription and our Advertising solutions. You will nurture, manage and retain this book of business and carry associated quota/targets.
  • You will also work on the whitespace/greenfield in your assigned territory and execute net-new customer acquisition deals from this segment of your market.
  • Expand the relationships with existing customers by continuously proposing solutions that meet their objectives (cross-sell / upsell)
  • Work with key stakeholders from the customer organizations and provide in-depth product demonstrations along with the ability to negotiate commercials and close new business.
  • Achieve and exceed agreed sales targets monthly and quarterly on KPIs like revenue-growth, customer retention, number of new customers acquired & other related KPIs.
  • Serve as the link of communication between key customers and internal teams and work towards a faster issue-resolution.

Skills And Experience

  • Minimum 3 years sales experience, preferably owning the entire sales cycle end-to-end.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset
  • Bachelor’s Degree from a reputed University.
  • Relevant experience in Inside Sales or Field Sales. Preferably in Acquisition or Business Development
  • Bi-lingual (Fluent in Japanese & English )
  • Excellent written and oral communication in the relevant language/s of the country covered
  • Demonstrated sales aptitude (negotiation & closing) with relentlessly high standards
  • Not intimidated by technical interaction, co-browsing with customers on video calls.
  • Target driven and proven self-starter with ability to deliver on initiatives without constant supervision
  • Territory and pipeline management experience using a CRM (Salesforce/Hubspot)
  • Coachability, openness to feedback and dedication to consistent self-improvement

What We Offer

  • Flexible activity-based working fostered collaboration and productivity
  • Inclusive global travelers community welcoming diverse perspectives
  • Competitive salary package including performance bonuses
  • Development programs, managerial courses, and learning series
  • Health insurance covers medical, dental, and vision for families (varies by country)
  • Lifestyle Reimbursement Benefit for personal travel, and physical, mental, and financial wellness
  • Several paid time off programs, including time to bond with new children and care for family members. Paid public holidays, and year-end office shutdown
  • Employee assistance program for short-term counseling and free Calm app subscription
  • State-of-the-art offices: dining, coffee points, and leisure areas

Our Cultural Pillars

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!
