About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Excellent spoken and written Japanese skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

C’est ici que vous attend votre plus grand défi :

Votre Mission

Qualifications

Informations supplémentaires

Et nous, quels sont nos engagements ?

  • Sur le monde
  • Accor s’engage pour le monde qui nous entoure, avec une culture employeur forte centrée sur le développement de nos 300 000 talents.

Nous sommes engagés pour la Diversité & l’Inclusion :

« La diversité & l’Inclusion pour Accor, c’est accueillir chacun et chacune dans le respect de ses différences en donnant la priorité aux seules qualités et compétences.

Senior Paid Social Specialist - (Hybrid)

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, " What's the next step?’’ Start your journey with us!

We're seeking an experienced Senior Paid Social Specialist to join our Online Display & Video Marketing team. This position, reporting into the Display & Video Advertising Manager, will contribute with the rest of the team to deliver on our ambitious growth expectations. In this role you will work with the rest of the team in designing the strategy and executing, measuring and optimising both acquisition and re-engagement campaigns across several media providers, including, but not limited to, Meta, TikTok, Youtube, Pinterest, Spotify, Snapchat.

If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.

  • We pioneered Prime, the first and world’s leading travel subscription programme since launching in 2017.
  • Millions of Prime members every year across multiple markets.
  • 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
  • This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.
  • Diversity is our strength that’s why our eDOers are coming from different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts


Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Senior Paid Social Specialist in the Online Display & Video Marketing team you will be in charge of:

  • Design and execute full funnel marketing campaigns – from awareness/branding to performance-based acquisition, retargeting and re-engagement – across different paid social providers and geographies for both Web and App platforms;
  • Own the campaign performance to ensure campaign targets are met (sales, cost per sale, ROAS, brand awareness, reach, etc) through continuous analysis and optimization;
  • Design the agenda for the assigned media and campaigns, across all the key enablers including campaign setup, measurement, creative, tracking;
  • Preparation of regular reports with clear, actionable insights;
  • Design and execute A/B testing for media buying, audiences, content/promotions and creatives;
  • Collaborate with providers (Meta, TikTok, etc.) in order to maximise the full potential of each platform/media (testing new features, digesting new data, etc);
  • Create new/improve current best practices and document processes for campaign launch and ongoing optimization;
  • Collaborate with the internal creative team as well as external creative agencies to ensure creatives do align to the requirements from publishers;
  • Help defining the budget and generate investment scenarios for the launch of new campaigns;


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

Job Description

Welcome to Waldorf Astoria Sydney

The Property

Nestled in the prestigious One Circular Quay, due to open in 2027, the Waldorf Astoria Sydney sets a new benchmark for elegance, offering sweeping, uninterrupted views of Sydney’s iconic Harbour Bridge and Opera House. This sophisticated 227-room landmark introduces the brand’s legendary hospitality to Australasia for the very first time.

The hotel features 2 restaurants, a rooftop bar and a serene luxury spa, along with a grand ballroom and refined meeting space, making it an exceptional setting for both lavish celebrations and distinguished gatherings.

As Hilton’s inaugural luxury debut in the region, Waldorf Astoria Sydney represents a defining moment—one of distinction, sophistication, and unmistakable allure.

The Role

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing a commercial strategy covering all segments and channels to maximize total revenue and profit performance, as well as market share penetration of the hotel. As a Commercial Director, you’re not just leading commercial strategy across multiple segments and revenue streams – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Own commercial strategy and execution: Develop and implement integrated commercial strategies across all revenue streams — including Group, Conference, and Events (GCE), Rooms, Food and Beverage, Leisure, and Spa — to drive top-line performance and market share growth
  • Maximize revenue and profitability: Partner with General Managers and Finance to ensure commercial decisions support revenue goals, optimize cost of sales, and deliver profit and margin targets
  • Lead pricing and forecasting strategy: Oversee revenue management practices, including pricing, rate strategies, demand forecasting, and business reviews, to optimize revenue across all segments
  • Align sales and marketing efforts: Coordinate on-property and regional sales, marketing, eCommerce, and public relations activities to support brand positioning and drive demand
  • Adapt to market dynamics: Monitor trends, assess competitive landscape, and adjust commercial strategies to stay ahead in evolving market conditions
  • Strengthen stakeholder relationships: Build trusted relationships with owners, operators, Hilton corporate teams, and external partners to align goals and create long-term commercial value
  • Cultivate a high-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Extensive experience in sales & marketing leadership, with at least 7-10 years in a senior S&M role, preferably in international ultra luxury hotel brand hotels.
  • Proven track record in hotel pre-opening experience.
  • Proven experience presenting strategic plans to senior executives and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong background in cross-functional collaboration within matrixed environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze financial data to inform strategic and tactical decisions.
  • Track record of identifying and evaluating new business opportunities.
  • Experience in multi-complex hotel or travel industry operations.
  • Cross-disciplinary exposure to Marketing, E-commerce, and Finance functions.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get To Know Our Team:

This position is located in Bangkok, Thailand.

Agoda launched Flights in 2019 and is now scaling rapidly to become a leading Flights OTA across APAC. With Thailand identified as a key growth market, we are expanding our commercial team to capture this opportunity.

The Opportunity:

As the Senior Manager for Flights in Thailand, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Agoda’s market presence, driving partner strategy, and building the foundations for long-term success. This is a high-impact, highly visible role at the intersection of commercial negotiations, strategic partnerships, and cross-functional leadership.

You’ll operate with end-to-end ownership of the Thailand market: identifying and closing new partnerships, optimizing performance with existing partners, and ensuring Agoda delivers unmatched value to travelers and suppliers alike. While this is an individual contributor role, you will function as Agoda’s commercial face in-market, working directly with C-level executives of our partners, supported by global teams across Product, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and more.

This is a rare opportunity to join a start-up within a global leader, with the autonomy to move fast, take bold bets, and directly shape Agoda’s Flights success story.

What You’ll Do:

  • Set the strategy: define and execute market strategies for Thailand, balancing growth, profitability, and long-term competitive positioning.
  • Lead commercial negotiations: Own pricing, availability, and commercial terms with airline partners to maximize Agoda’s competitiveness.
  • Be the market voice: Act as the go-to expert on Thailand aviation and online travel, sharing insights with internal teams and shaping Agoda’s product and growth strategy.
  • Deliver partner success: Build deep, trusted executive-level relationships with suppliers, driving joint initiatives that enhance distribution, revenue, and customer experience.
  • Drive execution excellence: Ensure partners’ day-to-day needs are met by collaborating with Agoda’s regional supply teams, operations, and product specialists.
  • Analyze and optimize: Use data and insights to drive decision-making, identify opportunities, test solutions, and iterate quickly.
  • Innovate at scale: Conceptualize and launch new commercial models, distribution initiatives, and customer-facing features that unlock growth.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in the Flights / OTA / airline industry with strong exposure to commercial negotiations, distribution, and market strategy (experience in Thailand highly preferred).
  • Proven track record of delivering growth through partnerships, negotiations, and strategy execution.
  • Commercial acumen with the ability to balance short-term results and long-term market building.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills in English; able to manage complex conversations at senior levels.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with hands-on execution capabilities and comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
  • Analytical rigor; demonstrated ability to use data to shape decisions and influence stakeholders.
  • Experience developing and executing end-to-end business plans that cut across commercial, operational, legal, and marketing dimensions.

The Best Talent Deserves The Best Benefits

Overview

The Supply Chain Category Management Specialist manages strategic supplier relationships and fleet-related service categories, including License & Title, Aftermarket Equipment, Vehicle Transport, Maintenance, and other service categories. This role partners closely with internal stakeholders and suppliers to drive cost savings, revenue growth, operational efficiency, supplier performance, and risk mitigation.

In This Role, You Will

  • Develop and execute category and sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Lead sourcing initiatives, supplier selection, and contract negotiations to optimize cost, performance, and revenue opportunities.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and supplier partners.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce costs, and increase revenue through data and market analysis.
  • Ensure contracts and supplier agreements comply with company policies, business requirements, and SLAs.

This position is located at our Corporate Headquarters in Clayton, MO.

 

Enterprise offers an excellent benefits package with market-competitive pay, comprehensive healthcare packages, 401k matching & profit sharing, schedule flexibility, paid time off, and organizational growth potential.

Compensation decisions will be made based on factors that include but are not limited to experience, education, location and skill level.

 

Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions, owning and operating the Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental and Alamo Rent A Car brands through its integrated global network of independent regional subsidiaries. Enterprise Mobility and its affiliates offer extensive car rental, carsharing, truck rental, fleet management, retail car sales, as well as travel management and other transportation services, to make travel easier and more convenient for customers.  

  

Privately held by the Taylor family of St. Louis, Enterprise Mobility together with its affiliate Enterprise Fleet Management manages a diverse fleet of 2.4 million vehicles and accounted for nearly $39 billion in revenue through a network of more than 9,500 fully-staffed neighborhood and airport rental locations in more than 90 countries and territories. 

Responsibilities

We are hiring now for immediate openings. Responsibilities include:

  • Manage assigned Supply Chain Management categories, including strategy development, supplier selection, implementation, and recommendations for enhancements
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand objectives, develop category plans and/or contractual roadmaps, advise on various supply alternatives, and provide cost analyses on owned categories and product portfolios
  • Manage supplier selection process, evaluate processes and competitive pricing/bids, conduct sourcing reviews, and analyze proposals to ensure the best-fit supplier is recommended to the business
  • Lead business partners through RFIs, RFQs, and RFPs (RFxs) in the procurement system, and translate requirements into agreements and/or manage contract negotiations as necessary
  • Draft and maintain contracts, such as master service agreements, statements of work, non-disclosure agreements, addendums, and other related documents
  • Evaluate and report on existing supplier performance and expenditures through annual reviews, contractual audits, and on-site supplier assessment visits, as needed
  • Develop and maintain relationships with strategic partners, act as liaison between the company, accounts payable, and assigned suppliers to ensure timely and accurate payment of invoices
  • Resolve supply chain vendor performance issues, contractual/compliance problems, or supply chain constraints
  • Ensure security and privacy programs and policies are incorporated into sourcing and contract negotiations
  • Stay abreast of technologies, materials, and logistical opportunities to reduce cost and improve speed to market
  • Participate in training of new team members

In addition to these job functions, candidates will also need to display proficiency in the following Competencies:

  • Ethics & Values
  • Communication
  • Flexibility
  • Planning and Organizing
  • Problem Solving
  • Results-Oriented
  • Working with a Team
  • Persuading and Influencing

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Two (2+) years of drafting and negotiating commercial contracts
  • Three (3+) years of Supply Chain Management experience with Sourcing, Supplier Relationship Management, and Financial Analysis
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States and not require work authorization sponsorship by our company for this position now or in the future

Preferred

  • Demonstrated sourcing (RFx) experience
  • Source to Pay/Coupa/Supply Chain related technology experience
  • Certified Purchasing Manager (CPM) and/or Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM) certification(s)

Leadership & Team Development

Owner & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Understand key needs of owner groups, investment firms, REITs, and franchise advisory council members to sharpen IHG's development value proposition.
  • Act as a strategic advisor to the Chief Development Officer on matters of organizational design, market prioritization, deal structuring innovation, and competitive response.

What We Need From You

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Real Estate, Hospitality Management, or related field; MBA or advanced degree strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated success designing and implementing sales enablement programs, GTM strategies, or business development platforms in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Ability to translate complex data into compelling narratives for executive and owner audiences.
  • Proven ability to lead, coach, and inspire high-performing teams in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; able to represent IHG with credibility and influence at the highest levels of owner and investor organizations.

Preferred

This role sits at the intersection of Data, Engineering, Analytics, and Media platforms, ensuring that all customer interactions and marketing activities are accurately captured, measured, and compliant with evolving regulations. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

J oin the world's leading travel subscription platform.

Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands – over 7.7 million Prime members since launching in 2017.

More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions

Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts

We're the world’s leading travel subscription platform. We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.7 million members since launching in 2017. Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What You Will Do

The Role’s Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Performance Marketing Product Owner in the Marketing Measurement & Data Activation Team you will be in charge of:

  • Reporting to the Head of Marketing Measurement & Data Activation, you will define the data-enablement roadmap for each media platform (e.g., Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube) and measurement partner (e.g., Appsflyer, Google Analytics).
  • You will orchestrate, together with a dedicated engineering team, the implementation of web and app tracking, audience creation, and data feeds for marketing campaigns. You will also collaborate closely with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure our tracking framework remains fully aligned with GDPR and privacy requirements.
  • Define and lead the media tracking and data activation agenda — setting priorities, identifying opportunities, and ensuring robust, timely, and future-proof implementations across all channels and platforms.
  • Advise marketing teams on technical feasibility and guide them on how new marketing strategies can be operationalized and measured.
  • Define specifications for event tracking across web and mobile (Google Analytics, Appsflyer, GTM, SDKs, Data Layers) and coordinate implementation with the dedicated engineering team.
  • Build and manage audience segments across platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Criteo, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Apple Ads, and additional DSPs.
  • Audit existing tracking implementations for accuracy, completeness, and compliance, and establish processes for ongoing monitoring and validation.
  • Troubleshoot tracking and tagging issues, working closely with development teams to identify root causes and implement fixes.
  • Conduct ad-hoc analyses to detect tracking gaps, quantify business impact, and evaluate the value of new or improved tracking implementations.
  • Document tracking setups, audience definitions, and compliance decisions to ensure transparency, scalability, and smooth handover.
  • Stay current on new products, features, and best practices across media and measurement platforms.


What you need to succeed:

Good to have

  • 3+ years of experience in analytics implementation, MarTech, AdTech, or closely related fields.
  • Master’s degree in a technical or scientific discipline (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Chemistry, etc.).
  • Expertise with implementing conversion tracking across marketing platforms (pixel, CAPI, API/Events, Enhanced Conversions or equivalent), as well as audience setup, product/data feed catalogues, conversion windows, and attribution configurations.
  • Strong understanding of web and app analytics fundamentals, including event structures, conversion tracking, and data layer design.
  • Experience with the tracking and measurement ecosystems of major media platforms, such as Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Apple Ads, Criteo, and others.
  • Exceptional attention to detail with a rigorous approach to accuracy and quality. Problem-solving mindset, with strong troubleshooting and QA capabilities. Proactive, fast learner, and naturally curious about data privacy, tracking technologies, and the evolving marketing tech landscape.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.


What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:

  • A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
  • Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
  • Grow opportunities to empower your career and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
  • Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
  • Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

Role Purpose

Drives system-enabled commercial performance by ensuring pricing tools, platforms and processes (N2Pricing, GRS/Concerto, BI) are fully adopted, consistently executed and continuously optimized. Serves as the N2Pricing SME and execution engine, translating system data into revenue-driving actions, monitoring adoption/productivity, resolving issues and closing the feedback loop between field users and system teams.

Key Accountabilities

  • Serve as the N2Pricing SME, driving awareness, adoption, and effective utilization across the field.
  • Monitor adoption, usage, and performance metrics to identify opportunities and close execution gaps.
  • Partner with System Health Coaches and field teams to reinforce best practices and optimize system performance.
  • Act as a bridge between field users and Product/System teams, providing actionable feedback to improve capabilities and user experience.
  • Lead business readiness and adoption efforts for new commercial systems, enhancements, and releases.
  • Support integration of Sales & Catering capabilities within pricing, revenue management, and commercial workflows.
  • Maintain playbooks, SOPs, and operational standards to ensure consistent execution and a single source of truth.
  • Partner with Engagement and Enablement teams to drive role-based training, communications, and upskilling initiatives.
    • Release & Implementation Support: Support system upgrades, releases and business readiness activities including communications, training alignment and follow-up.
    • Roadmap Awareness & Product Feedback: Maintain working knowledge of GRS/Concerto and ReVision roadmaps; translate releases into impact summaries and readiness plans.
    • S&C Workflow Support: Identify and flag Sales & Catering process/system gaps impacting group and sales execution.
    • Playbook & Standards Maintenance: Keep playbooks, SOPs and job aids current; reinforce standard processes and usage expectations at scale.
Key Metrics

  • RevPAR, RGI, Direct/Digital & Loyalty Contribution, Group RGI Growth
  • Revenue Capture ≥96%; Decision Adoption higher; Auto-Deploy ≥15%
  • Non-Strategic Override Mix and System Non-Engagement lower
  • Differential Rule Usage higher; adoption/productivity uplift; issue resolution, release adoption and playbook currency on-time/current

Required Education, Experience And Technical Skills

  • Educational Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality, Analytics or related field
  • Experience: 4+ years in revenue management, commercial services, or hospitality systems/operations
  • Experience: 2+ years in performance analysis, revenue optimization or field-support functions
  • Experience with system rollouts, business readiness or commercial change management
  • Technical Skills: N2Pricing/RM platforms; Revenue Capture, Decision Adoption, RGI, MPI, ARI, RevPAR; BI dashboards; GRS/Concerto roadmap; Salesforce/field-support tools

Applied Operational Knowledge & Industry Experience

  • Deep understanding of Commercial Services workflows and hotel operations
  • Working knowledge of CXO service levels: Core, Plus and Signature
  • Understanding of pricing, revenue management and system-enabled performance levers

Decision Governance – Scope

  • Ownership: N2Pricing execution/validation; performance and revenue opportunity identification; adoption monitoring/reporting; field issue resolution; playbook maintenance
  • Accountable For: accurate and consistent system execution; Revenue Capture and adoption uplift; delivery of market/portfolio revenue opportunities; documentation currency

Competencies And Capabilities

  • N2Pricing execution and validation: Supports accurate change execution and workflow alignment.
  • Revenue opportunity management: Uses N2Pricing/BI insights to identify and convert opportunities
  • KPI diagnosis and adoption: Monitors Revenue Capture, Decision Adoption, auto-deploy and non-engagement metrics
  • Field and system coordination: Documents, escalates and closes loop on issues and feedback
  • Readiness and standards: Supports releases, playbooks, SOPs and job aids

Location -This role is remote USA

Job Description

An exciting opportunity is available for a Director of Loyalty B2B & Partnerships to join our team in Sydney. This role is responsible growing and activating our Pacific loyalty partnerships portfolio while also owning the Loyalty B2B value proposition and B2B marketing agenda across the full MEA APAC region — Middle East, Africa, Turkey, Asia and the Pacific.

We’re looking for an experienced loyalty partnerships leader, who can support Accor in strengthening their market leading partnerships across a variety of industries including airlines, financial services, mobility and retail. This position requires someone with strong communication and stakeholder management experience, as well as project management and commercial acumen to drive market-leading results. This role will enhance the performance of partners in the ALL loyalty ecosystem, whilst strengthening the awareness and growth of ALL Accor as the leading hotel lifestyle loyalty programme in the region.

This role is based in Accor’s corporate office in Sydney.

Getting To Know The Role And Your Responsibilities

  • Define strategic objectives and priorities for loyalty partnerships in line with market conditions and business goals, and drive the roadmap of initiatives with full stakeholder alignment.
  • Serve as the main contact for Strategic and Regional Partners — coordinating joint campaigns, exploring new opportunities and executing strategies to support portfolio revenue growth.
  • Lead end-to-end integration and onboarding of new partners, including contracting, legal coordination and commercial negotiation within the central framework.
  • Drive the continued development and strengthening of the ALL Accor loyalty partnership ecosystem, ensuring Accor maintains a market-leading position across the Pacific region
  • Monitor KPIs, review performance regularly and report insights to stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with internal teams — including Loyalty Operations, Brands and Marketing — to activate partnership plans, promote partners to hotels and unlock advertising opportunities through owned channels.
  • Develop opportunities with national tourism bodies across Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific Islands in conjunction with regional commercial leaders and the MEA APAC Marketing team.
  • Develop and maintain the ALL Accor B2B value proposition for corporate, MICE and group audiences.
  • Lead full-funnel B2B marketing strategy and execution across 40+ countries.
  • Partner closely with global Loyalty, Sales and Marketing Collective teams to drive enrolment, activation and retention.
  • Act as an ambassador for Accor and ALL at partner and industry events.

Qualifications

What we need from you

  • 10+ years in senior commercial leadership — ideally within hospitality, or equivalent partnerships leadership in financial services, airlines or the broader loyalty industry.
  • Master's degree in Marketing, Business, Business Management, Hospitality or a related field.
  • A track record of driving strategy and creative for customer loyalty programs.
  • Multi-market experience and comfort operating in a matrix-reporting environment.
  • Advanced partnership development, contracting and account management skills.
  • An entrepreneurial and strategic mindset, with a sharp eye for untapped potential and innovative partnership models
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills
  • Strong project management experience
  • Role model in Accor Values and Heartist Culture

Additional Information

We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

Suitably experienced and qualified applicants who currently have full working rights in Australia will only be considered.

Candidate screening and interviews may be conducted prior to the closing date of the advertisement. Accor reserves the right to close applications for the position prior to the advertised date. We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

WELCOME TO A WORLD OF OPPORTUNITIES AT THE UK’s #1 GREAT PLACE TO WORK 2026

 Proudly voted by our Team Members

A World of Rewards

  • Complimentary, nourishing meals provided while on duty
  • Exceptional development programmes, designed to support and accelerate your growth at every stage

We are looking for hospitality professionals who are passionate about delivering an exceptional fives star guest experience, consistently upholding the worldclass service standards recognised by Forbes.

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day:

We are looking for hospitality professionals who are passionate about delivering an exceptional fives star guest experience, consistently upholding the worldclass service standards recognised by Forbes.

What will I be doing?

A Guest Relations Assistant Manager supports our Guests and ensures seamless communication of their preferences and requirements across the hotel, delivering an exceptional and highly personalised Guest experience.

Responsibilities

As a Guest Relations Assistant Manager, you will anticipate and attend to the needs of our Guests while coordinating with operational teams to ensure flawless execution throughout the Guest journey. Entrusted with shaping first impressions, you will perform the following responsibilities to the highest standards:

  • Support the Guest Relations Manager with the daily operations of the department
  • Review Guest arrival reports in advance and liaise closely with Housekeeping regarding room allocations
  • Manage special room assignments and oversee suite occupancies with precision and discretion
  • Assist in welcoming our Guests, escorting them to the Lounge for check-in and their rooms as appropriate
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for our Guests, ensuring all departments are fully briefed on individual preferences and requirements
  • Maintain accurate inventory control of Guest amenities
  • Demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of all hotel products, services, and facilities
  • Consistently project a polished and professional presence, with a strong emphasis on hospitality and Guest engagement

What are we looking for?

Role

Guest Relations Assistant Managers representing Hilton brands consistently act in the best interests of our Guests while collaborating seamlessly with fellow Team Members. To succeed in this role, you will demonstrate the following qualities and competencies:

  • A refined ability to listen attentively and respond effectively to high ‑ expectation Guest needs
  • Exceptional leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills
  • A strong sense of accountability, resilience, and professionalism
  • A genuine commitment to consistently delivering elevated Guest service standards
  • The ability to remain composed and effective in high ‑ pressure situations
  • Flexibility and adaptability across a variety of operational scenarios
  • Impeccable grooming and presentation standards reflective of luxury hospitality

It would be advantageous in this position for you to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

  • Proven experience in a managerial capacity within a Guest Relations function, ideally in a luxury hospitality environment
  • A genuine passion for delivering highly personalised and memorable Guest experiences
  • A degree or diploma in Hotel Management or an equivalent qualification

Qualifications

What It Takes to Make the Stay

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. Role Purpose

Dedicated commercial engine for selling and converting IHG hotels into new service levels (Core, Plus and Signature). Proactively prospects, qualifies and closes service-level opportunities across AMER, translates service strategy into owner-facing value propositions, manages a measurable sales pipeline, and partners with Operations for seamless handoff and value realization.

Service-Level Sales Strategy & Targeting:

Business Development Execution:

  • Lead outbound prospecting, consultative outreach, owner-facing discovery, value presentations, objection navigation and service-level commitment closure.

Pipeline Management & Conversion Tracking:

  • Build and manage pipelines in Salesforce or designated CRM; track volume, velocity and conversion rate by service tier; report pipeline health and risks.

Event-Driven Activation & Owner Engagement:

  • Leverage owner events and forums to showcase services; capture leads; build proposals, case studies, ROI models and negotiation tactics.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Operational Handoff:

Value Proposition & Continuous Improvement:

Key Metrics

  • Service-level adoption growth; tier migration / upgrade conversion; incremental revenue contribution

Technical Skills: CRM/pipeline tools; pricing platforms; BI dashboards and performance reporting.

Competencies:

  • Advanced: consultative selling, owner relationship management, pipeline discipline.

Capabilities:

Job Summary

The global distribution landscape in the lodging industry continues to expand and become more complex, and Marriott International recognizes the development and execution of an enhanced future intermediary partner relationship strategy as a key strategic focus. The Distribution team led by the Vice President Channel Distribution oversees Marriott’s approach to channel strategy partnership, account management and commercial relationships as it relates to Online Travel Agents (OTA), Wholesalers, Global Distribution Systems (GDS), Travel Management Companies (TMC), Small and Medium Businesses (SMB), Restaurants and Bars (R&B) Intermediaries, and other emerging distribution channels. As part of Marriott’s Distribution team, the Director Distribution APEC reports to the Senior Director Distribution APEC and Vice President Food and Beverage APEC.

The Director Distribution APEC is accountable for assigned initiatives to support Marriott’s Global Distribution Strategy in APEC with focus on a) managing the day-to-day relationship with assigned OTA, Wholesale and R&B account portfolio by building/maintaining strong trusted relationships with account partners and internal Marriott partners that are accountable for delivering against mutually defined account goals and KPIs, b) transforming and modernizing traditional and offline B2B Wholesale and R&B relationships to create efficiencies and improve content controls by taking advantage of new tools and technology, c) supporting business development for new Channel Partners, d) supporting Marriott’s global channel distribution strategy and developing region specific recommendations, and e) providing distribution strategy guidance and education to continent stakeholders.

This position will be located at the Marriott Corporate Office in Singapore.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

  • 8+ years’ experience in the hospitality industry, demonstrating progressive career growth and proven exceptional performance AND
  • 8+ years’ experience in similar positions with focus on strategic account management, business development, sales & marketing and/or revenue management.
  • 4-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or related major
  • Experience in managing and defining transformational strategies for business units.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver results under difficult conditions, particularly when faced with complexity and ambiguity.
  • Passion for sales excellence and business development
  • Strong account management, negotiating and influencing skills.
  • Ability to manage complex account relationships, develop/execute focused account plans, and manage large scale account implementation projects in cooperation with subject matter experts in HQ and Continents.
  • Ability to work well within all levels of the organization, especially internal and external senior management.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

  • Builds and maintains strong trusted relationship with assigned account portfolio.
  • Develops detailed account plans, establishes KPIs and measures success against those KPIs.
  • Develops and executes a centralized commercial and contracts strategy with defined accounts, including prioritizing accounts to be technology enabled, and establish bi-lateral technology investment and commitments.
  • Works closely with continent leadership teams to drive compliance of channel distribution contracts and distribution control.
  • Supports Senior Director Distribution APEC and VP Food and Beverage APEC in identifying and establishing new innovative commercial relationships with channel distribution partners to further Marriott’s competitive position in APEC.
  • Functions as a strategic senior technical expert within the department.
  • Demonstrates advanced knowledge of job-relevant issues, products, systems, and processes.
  • Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
  • Thinks creatively and practically to develop, execute, and implement new project plans.
  • Generates and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.
  • Keeps up-to-date technically and applies new knowledge to job.
  • Performs other reasonable duties as required for this position.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get To Know Our Team:

The People Team is a purveyor of opportunity, searching the globe for the most talented individuals and offering them an open, collaborative workplace. By prioritizing skill and potential, we have cultivated a powerful assembly of professionals through our drive for equal opportunity and diversity. We make the move to Agoda a breeze with assisted onboarding programs, and we continue to support and enrich our thousands of Agoda employees through individual growth with outstanding learning programs and various means of assistance. Our development of incredible benefits has ensured everyone can stay strong, healthy, and happy during their time at Agoda. Leading ambitious changes and making a positive impact in the lives of our employees, the People Team is a crucial and rewarding part of the Agoda family.

The Opportunity:

As Director of Organizational Performance in the People Development & Performance team, you will be partnering with senior leaders across Agoda to drive programs and initiatives aimed at strengthening and evolving how we measure and assess organizational effectiveness, and drive interrelated performance management and adjacent talent management platforms and processes such as talent identification, succession planning, and more. Design and implementation of programs will require close partnership across the People Team and project teams in each department. You will have the opportunity to help shape Agoda’s organizational and performance management strategies globally to support achieving our vision and multi-year strategy.

What You’ll Do:

  • Closely partner with senior departmental leaders and senior business partners and colleagues in the People Team (e.g., HRBPs, Compensation & Benefits, Learning & Development, etc.) to understand business strategy and current organizational context to identify and address opportunities to develop a high performing culture in their teams
  • Manage platforms and cycles for performance calibration, talent review, performance review and succession planning across the company
  • Analyze performance, org structure/complexity, and talent movement data to identify issues and recommend practical improvements to talent processes for rapid implementation
  • Lead and develop a team (both directly and on project basis) to deliver platforms and programs on an all-Agoda and priority departmental program basis
  • Ably represent People Team in Agoda leadership forums, and represents Agoda in interactions with related brand companies in people-related topics aimed at sharing and learning best practices, harmonizing policies where appropriate such as inter-brand transfer
  • Mentor and develop other professionals in a maturing People function
  • Translate people analytics into clear updates for stakeholders, shaping strategy and measuring program impact (e.g., exit drivers, retention, engagement, and performance-management trends)

What You'll Need to Succeed:

  • 12+ years of experience in internal HR partnering, talent management and organizational consulting experience in large organization preferably in the tech industry, or strategic or management consulting experience
  • Acute business acumen and understanding of how organizational structures and dynamics relate to execution
  • Deep experience implementing, operating, and improving performance management platforms and processes, preferably in fast moving Tech environments
  • Deep understanding of the systems and associated data across the employee lifecycle and attendant business processes across full employee lifecycle
  • Excellent executive presence and the ability to clearly articulate messages to a variety of audiences
  • Ability to bring business perspectives and facilitate outcomes is more important than experience in HR roles
  • Excellent judgment, self-motivated, curious and trustworthy
  • Outstanding ability to lead a team with strong ability to prioritize and guide robust, detailed execution
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability backed with excellent data sense
  • High level of discretion, confidentiality, and ethics
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate across a diverse, multicultural organization
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and change; brings structure and drive to deliver results
  • Humility, sense of humor, flexibility, good interpersonal skills and the ability to lead difficult conversations are a must
  • Undergraduate degree from a top university expected, advanced degrees welcome
  • This role is Based in Bangkok – Relocation Support Provided**

Job Summary

The Director of Marketing Strategy & Performance will lead Marriott International’s Marketing Return on Investment (ROI) global program and spearhead high-impact strategic initiatives to build and scale best-in-class marketing performance capabilities. This role is accountable for advancing a rigorous, insight-driven approach to marketing investment decisions that optimize effectiveness, accelerate growth, and strengthen long-term brand value.

This leader will own the vision, design, and execution of Marriott International’s marketing measurement framework, including standing up advanced capabilities such as marketing mix modeling (MMM), experimentation, and performance analytics, in partnership with analytics teams. The Director will translate complex data into actionable insights to create data-driven guidance that informs revenue optimization and brand-building strategies. A core expectation of the role is to lead change management and champion these capabilities across the global marketing organization, embedding measurement into planning, investment, and decision-making processes.

The ideal candidate will have experience with marketing and measurement, e.g. A/B testing, media mix models (MMM), as well as a strong business sense, problem solving capabilities, and a willingness to rapidly ramp up on a new way of working. The role is built for a self-starter, quantitative thinker, someone comfortable pushing for structured insights amidst a global and complex organization, and someone excited about building a data-driven marketing organization\

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Excellent spoken and written Japanese skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Excellent spoken and written Japanese skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Associate Manager, Co-Brand Marketing Japan

IHGの日本の共同ブランド・クレジットカード・ポートフォリオにおいて、新規顧客獲得（非会員）および既存会員向けマーケティングの企画・実行を支援していただきます。

カード会員のライフサイクル全体にわたるマーケティング施策の効果的な実施を支援するとともに、社内のチーム、外部代理店、パートナーとの主要な窓口としての役割を担います。

カード新規獲得および継続的な会員エンゲージメントを促進するマーケティング資料の作成を調整し、事業目標を達成するための戦術的な提案を行い、チャネルのパフォーマンスを最適化します。

職務内容

年次共同ブランド・新規獲得（非会員）およびポートフォリオ（会員）マーケティング計画の策定と実行を支援し、ダイレクトメール、Eメール、ウェブサイト、アプリ、その他の会員向けコミュニケーションなど、利用可能なすべてのチャネルを効果的に活用します。パフォーマンスの継続的な改善を促進するプロセスおよび実行体制を構築します。

社内チーム、代理店、ベンダー、外部パートナーと連携し、ターゲット層の選定、クリエイティブアプローチ、オファー／インセンティブの構成、制作の詳細など、キャンペーンの仕様を策定します。また、マネージャーに提案を提示して承認を得た上で、承認された施策を実行します。

各キャンペーンや施策において、正確な測定と分析を可能にする適切な管理体制が整っていることを確認します。パフォーマンス、インサイト、および推奨される最適化策をまとめます。

広告代理店やフルフィルメント業者との日常的な関係を管理し、すべての顧客獲得およびポートフォリオ関連資料の高品質かつタイムリーな提供を確保する。

部門横断的なステークホルダーと連携し、マーケティング施策の円滑な実行を支援する。また、緊密な協力関係を構築・維持し、連携と成果を最大化する。

マーケティングミックス全体における競合他社の動向を監視し、顧客獲得効率とカード会員のエンゲージメントを向上させるための提言を行う。

必要に応じて、シニアマネージャーを補佐し、その他のマーケティングプロジェクトや施策を支援する。

募集要項

学歴

マーケティング、ビジネス、または関連分野の学士号または修士号、あるいは同等の学歴と関連実務経験の組み合わせ。

必須の経験と専門知識

企業マーケティング環境において、キャンペーン開発、クロスチャネルでの実行、クリエイティブ制作に携わった、2～5年の段階的な実務経験。

顧客獲得および／またはポートフォリオ（顧客維持、エンゲージメント、ライフサイクル）マーケティングの支援経験がある方を強く歓迎します。

外部の代理店、パートナー、またはベンダーとの協業経験。

技術的スキルおよび知識

日本語および英語の流暢な能力（会話・文章）が必須

キャンペーン管理、コミュニケーション計画、市場投入戦略、およびマーケティングツールの使用経験。

プロモーション、チャネル、またはフリークエンシーマーケティングにおける実績のある経験が望ましい。

マーケティングの概念や原則（測定や最適化を含む）について深い理解があること。

優れた問題解決能力および分析能力を有すること。

社内チーム、パートナー、ベンダーとの間で、明確かつ効果的な口頭および書面によるコミュニケーション能力を有すること。

優れた組織力および時間管理能力を有し、複数のプロジェクトを同時に管理できること。

チームワークを重視する姿勢を持ち、優れた対人スキルと、問題解決に向けた積極的なアプローチができること。

プレゼンテーションおよびファシリテーションのスキルを実証できること。

Excel、Word、PowerPointの熟練した操作能力が必須です。

Associate Manager, Japan Co-Brand Marketing

You will support the development and execution of both Acquisition (non-cardmember) and Portfolio (cardmember) marketing for IHG’s Japan Co-Brand credit card portfolio.

In this role, you will help ensure effective implementation of marketing initiatives across the full cardmember lifecycle and serve as a key point of contact with internal teams, external agencies, and partners.

You will coordinate the production of marketing materials that drive card acquisition and ongoing cardmember engagement, make tactical recommendations to meet business objectives, and optimize channel performance.

Key Accountabilities

Assist in the development and execution of an annual Co-Brand Acquisition (non-cardmember) and Portfolio (cardmember) marketing plan, ensuring effective use of all available channels including, but not limited to, direct mail, email, website, app, and other member communications. Develop processes and delivery systems that drive continuous improvement in performance.

Partner with internal teams, agencies, vendors, and external partners to develop campaign specifications, including target audience selection, creative approach, offer/incentive structure, and production details; present recommendations to the Manager for approval and execute approved initiatives.

Ensure each campaign or initiative includes appropriate controls to enable accurate measurement and analysis; summarize performance, insights, and recommended optimizations for future iterations.

Manage day-to-day relationships with advertising agencies and fulfillment vendors, ensuring high quality and timely delivery of all Acquisition and Portfolio materials.

Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to support successful execution of marketing initiatives; build and maintain strong working relationships to maximize alignment and outcomes.

Monitor competitive activity across the marketing mix and provide recommendations to improve acquisition efficiency and cardmember engagement.

Support the Senior Manager with additional marketing projects and initiatives as needed.

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

Critical Experience & Expertise

2–5 years of progressive experience in a corporate marketing environment, with exposure to campaign development, cross-channel execution, and creative production.

Experience supporting customer acquisition and/or portfolio (retention, engagement, lifecycle) marketing strongly preferred.

Experience working with external agencies, partners, or vendors.

Technical Skills & Knowledge

Fluency in both Japanese and English (spoken and written) required

Experience with campaign management, communications planning, go-to-market strategies, and marketing tools.

Demonstrated Experience In Promotional, Channel, Or Frequency Marketing Preferred.

Strong understanding of marketing concepts and principles, including measurement and optimization.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Clear, effective verbal and written communication skills across internal teams, partners, and vendors.

Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives.

Team-oriented mindset with strong interpersonal skills and a proactive approach to problem solving.

Demonstrated presentation and facilitation skills.

Proficiency in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint required.

At IHG Hotels & Resorts, we work together to deliver True Hospitality for Good on a global scale. About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Excellent spoken and written Japanese skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

Description de l'entreprise

Rejoignez-nous chez Accor, là où la vie bat au rythme de la passion !

Pionnier dans l'art de l'hospitalité responsable, le groupe Accor rassemble plus de 45 marques, 5 500 hôtels, 10 000 restaurants et destinations lifestyle, dans 110 pays.
