job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Senior or Sales Manager, MICE, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

Sales & Business Development

  • Prospect and secure MICE and group business from key markets and assigned corporate accounts.
  • Develop and maintain detailed account plans in Salesforce; ensure timely updates of all sales activities.
  • Conduct client meetings, lead site inspections, and organize familiarization trips and client entertainment (flexibility for evenings/weekends required).
  • Represent the hotel at trade shows, networking events, and sales trips to generate new leads.
  • Collaborate with Hilton Sales network, TMCs, and MICE partners to strengthen relationships and drive new business.
  • Support corporate sales activities when required ensuring seamless collaboration across segments, including
  • Manage corporate RFP processes and maintain accurate trackers; ensure rates are correctly loaded in GDS.
  • Utilize third party tools such as TravelClick Hotelligence (Agency 360) to analyze market trends and identify new business opportunities

Account Management

  • Maintain strong relationships with existing clients to maximize repeat business.
  • Ensure timely responses to inquiries and proposals to improve conversion rates.
  • Monitor account performance and implement strategies to achieve revenue goals.

Conference & Events

  • Work closely with the Events team to ensure smooth handover of confirmed business.
  • Support initiatives to increase conversion and optimize space utilization.

Revenue & Reporting

  • Support pricing strategies and competitor analysis in collaboration with Revenue Management.
  • Assist in preparing monthly activity reports detailing confirmed and provisional business.
  • Contribute to annual sales forecasts and revenue plans.

Systems & Compliance

  • Ensure accurate data management in all sales systems.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Hilton systems, procedures, and brand standards.

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 to 3 years’ experience in hotel/event sales, preferably in MICE or group segments.
  • Strong selling, negotiation, and lead management skills.
  • Commercial acumen with experience in forecasting and analytics.
  • Excellent communication, planning, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to build strong client relationships and deliver exceptional customer service.
  • Flexibility to travel and work evenings/weekends as required.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce, GDS, and revenue management tools is an advantage.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

Location Barnard's Inn 86 Fetter Lane, London, London, United Kingdom, EC4A 1ENVIEW ON MAP

Position Type Management

Position Summary

The Market Director HR (MDHR), Luxury UKI & Western Europe acts as the senior HR business partner for Marriott International’s luxury brands across the UKI and Western Europe. This role translates business strategy into people practices that build organizational capability, drive performance, and support business growth.

The MDHR partners closely with HR Centers of Excellence and business leaders to ensure effective delivery of Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Employee Relations, Total Rewards, and Learning & Development initiatives. Reporting HR Leaders across the luxury portfolio, this role plays a critical part in building a high-performance culture, strengthening leadership capability, and ensuring compliance with local regulations and Marriott standards.

The successful candidate will lead complex regional initiatives, influence senior stakeholders, and drive measurable business outcomes across a diverse, multi-brand luxury hotel portfolio.

Scope

Location: London

Hybrid Model: Hybrid

Travel Requirement: Approximately 40%

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and implement strategic HR initiatives across the luxury portfolio in the UKI and Western Europe region.
  • Partner with Regional Vice Presidents, General Managers, and HR Leaders to align people strategies with business objectives.
  • Drive talent acquisition, workforce planning, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.
  • Oversee the recruitment and development of property HR Leaders across the region.
  • Lead human capital reviews and support organizational effectiveness and talent management strategies.
  • Provide expert guidance on complex employee and labor relations matters while ensuring compliance with local legislation and company policies.
  • Analyze workforce and associate engagement data to identify trends and implement improvement strategies.
  • Support acquisitions, divestitures, and new hotel openings by providing strategic HR leadership and transition planning.
  • Champion a culture of ethics, inclusion, collaboration, and peak performance across the region.
  • Foster strong stakeholder relationships and drive execution of continent-wide HR programs and initiatives.

Candidate Profile

Experience

  • Minimum 6–8 years of progressive Human Resources leadership experience or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives within large, matrixed, international organizations.
  • Strong experience within luxury hospitality brands and/or hotels.
  • Proven track record of influencing senior stakeholders and leading change across multiple geographies.
  • Experience working across EMEA markets is strongly preferred.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) in Business, Hospitality, Operations, Finance, or a related field preferred.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strategic HR leadership and organizational effectiveness expertise.
  • Strong talent acquisition, succession planning, and workforce planning capabilities.
  • Deep knowledge of employee relations, labor relations, and compliance practices.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Strong commercial acumen and data-driven decision-making ability.
  • Ability to lead through complexity, ambiguity, and organizational change.
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills in a matrixed environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and inspire high-performing teams.
  • Embodies Marriott's leadership principles:
    • Curious – embraces new ideas and continuous improvement.
    • Courageous – challenges convention and drives change.
    • Connected – builds trusted partnerships and fosters collaboration.
WHY JOIN MARRIOTT INTERNATIONAL?

At Marriott International, you'll have the opportunity to shape the people strategy behind some of the world's most iconic luxury hospitality brands. Working across diverse markets and cultures, you'll influence business outcomes, develop exceptional talent, and contribute to a high-performance organization that values innovation, inclusion, and leadership excellence.

Marriott International has been recognized as one of Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work For™ in 2026 by Great Place to Work®. This is a reflection of our people-first culture, commitment to wellbeing, and collaborative workplace. This accolade joins a growing list of regional honors, reinforcing our dedication to creating an exceptional environment where associates thrive.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.  We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Description de l'entreprise

Rejoignez Accor – une aventure professionnelle au cœur d’un groupe engagé, international et en transformation

Accor, leader mondial de l’hospitalité, présent dans plus de 110 pays avec 5 500 hôtels, vous ouvre ses portes, situées à Issy-les-Moulineaux.

C’est ici que convergent les expertises globales du Groupe : stratégie, finance, ressources humaines, juridique, technologies, marketing, développement durable, communication, audit, achats, etc.

Rejoindre Accor, c’est participer activement à la définition, à la structuration et à l’accompagnement de la transformation d’un groupe international, en lien direct avec les équipes opérationnelles dans le monde entier.

Description du poste

Services Rémunération

  • Fournir des services C&B: créer des grilles salariales orientées marché, benchmarking continu des packages
  • Accompagner les P&CBP dans la construction et la validation des propositions de rémunération pour leurs périmètres respectifs

Pilotage des processus et campagnes de rémunération :

  • Coordonner le processus STIP (Short-Term Incentive Plan) dans son déploiement et le suivi, en collaboration avec les P&CBP, les leaders et la finance corporate sur les provisions d'incentives
  • Coordonner des campagnes d'intéressement à long terme (LTI) en coordination C&B Groupe et en support des P&CBP
  • Coordonner et administrer le processus annuel de révision salariale en partenariat étroit avec les P&CBP, incluant la préparation des guidelines, l'accompagnement des P&CBP dans leur déploiement, le suivi.
  • Participer aux processus de budget et de reporting des coûts de personnel en collaboration avec les P&CBP
  • Piloter les évaluations de postes en collaboration avec les P&CBP

Analyse / Benchmarking

  • Générer des synthèses de marché et des fourchettes salariales, et répondre aux demandes ponctuelles de données de marché des P&CBP
  • Participer aux enquêtes salariales ad hoc
  • Fournir des analyses sur les packages (transparence des rémunérations, équité salariale, benchmark externe) sur leurs populations respectives
  • Fournir des dashboards et reporting réguliers aux P&CBP sur leur périmètre

Conduite Du Changement

  • Accompagner les P&CBP dans l'appropriation des nouveaux outils et processus C&B
  • Recueillir les feedbacks des P&CBP pour améliorer continuellement les processus et outils C&B

Qualifications

  • Diplôme supérieur en Ressources Humaines, Finance, Comptabilité, Management ou équivalent (Bac+5/Master)
  • Minimum 8/10 ans d'expérience confirmée en tant que Compensation Manager
  • Spécialiste/Manager Compensation
  • Organisation et priorisation
  • Pédagogie
  • Fortes compétences analytiques
  • Sens de la confidentialité
  • Anglais : niveau professionnel confirmé

Informations supplémentaires

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Et nous, quels sont nos engagements ?

  • Sur le monde
  • Accor s’engage pour le monde qui nous entoure, avec une culture employeur forte centrée sur le développement de nos 300 000 talents.
  • Nous adoptons une approche d'amélioration continue pour réduire l'impact du digital sur l'environnement dans l’ensemble de nos projets.
  • Sur votre carrière
  • Nous permettons à tous nos collaborateurs de maîtriser leur équilibre vie-perso / pro et leur offrons les moyens de façonner leur environnement de travail à leur image.
  • Un Talent Management dédié, une amélioration continue et des parcours de formation et d’évolution sont définis à la fois individuellement et collectivement pour que nous grandissions ensemble, au quotidien.
  • Concrètement, chez Accor :
  • Télétravail possible plusieurs jours par semaine depuis la France et options de travail flexibles : travaillez depuis chez vous, nos bureaux, ou même nos hôtels et espaces de coworking grâce à Worklib.

et aussi,

  • Programme ALL - Heartist® : tarifs préférentiels et offres flash pour des séjours et expériences inoubliables dans toutes nos adresses Accor et chez nos partenaires, dans le monde entier.
  • Programme de volontariat Heartist® for good : 1 jour offert sur votre temps de travail pour vous engager en faveur d’une association.
  • Un CSE qui vous accompagne dans le financement de vos activités culturelles et sportives.
  • Forfait Mobilité durable pour l’utilisation d’un moyen de déplacement « vert » ou un dispositif « vélo de fonction » en partenariat avec Zenride
  • Prise en charge des abonnements de transports publics urbains entre le domicile et le lieu de travail, au barème de la Loi Finance.
  • Tickets restaurant de 11€ en valeur faciale.
  • Une mutuelle obligatoire financée à 50% par Accor sans frais supplémentaire en cas d'adhésion de vos ayants droits.
  • Sans oublier des conditions de travail attractives avec des espaces de travail collaboratifs, des restaurants, espaces de jeux ou encore des espaces de bien-être et de Sport sur site ou grâce à Gymlib.

Votre talent et votre motivation sont nos seuls critères de sélection.

Nous valorisons la richesse des diverses nationalités, personnalités et parcours professionnels.

Nous savons nous adapter aux besoins spécifiques de nos collaborateurs, notamment ceux en situation de handicap.

Nous encourageons toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, alors osez postuler !

Pour nous, le recrutement est avant tout une histoire de rencontres.

Cette mission vous attire ? Postulez et nous vous proposerons :

  • Un échange avec notre équipe recrutement pour vous présenter les lignes essentielles du poste ou vous orienter vers le rôle qui peut vous correspondre,
  • Un ou des entretiens avec les managers et les membres de l’équipe,
  • Pour certains postes, vous pourriez également être amené à effectuer un test ou une étude de cas, ainsi qu’un questionnaire sur votre personnalité et vos motivations.
  • Un entretien final avec notre équipe des Ressources Humaines pour échanger sur la culture de notre Groupe, l’environnement de travail, notre programme de formation et les perspectives de carrière, ainsi que les différents avantages du Groupe.
  • Un feedback personnalisé.

job.job_description:
Job Description

最高のホスピタリティは、あなたから始まります。

誰かの1日を明るくする姿を想像してみてください。当ホテルチームの一員になれば、まさに毎日、そんな体験ができるのです！担当する法人顧客の管理、新規事業の開拓、客室、ケータリング、飲食部門からのホテル全体の収益向上、ビジネスニーズへの対応、新たなビジネスチャンスの開拓、そしてプロモーション活動や販売チャネルを通じた既存事業の拡大など、多岐にわたる業務を担当していただきます。セールスマネージャー／アシスタントセールスマネージャー／シニアセールスマネージャーとして、単に団体客の売上を創出し管理するだけでなく、すべてのお客様に忘れられない滞在体験を提供することで、ホスピタリティの温かさと輝きを広げていくのです。

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will manage designated corporate accounts, develop and solicit new business, drive total hotel revenue from rooms, catering, and F&B outlets, address business needs, explore new opportunities, and expand existing business through promotional efforts and sales channels. As a Sales Manager/Assistant Sales Manager/Senior Sales Manager, you’re not just generating and managing group sales – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Responsibilities

典型的な一日の業務内容は以下のとおりです。

  • 見込み顧客へのホテル代表としての対応：グループルーム、会議室、飲食サービスをお探しの顧客にとって、主要な窓口となります。
  • 新規ビジネス機会の創出：問い合わせへの対応、新規顧客へのアプローチ、見込み客の選定、積極的な営業活動による潜在顧客の獲得を行います。
  • 販売サイクル全体の管理：施設訪問、顧客接待、提案書の作成、料金設定、契約交渉、そして契約履行までのアカウント管理を行います。
  • 戦略的な販売計画の策定：収益目標と客室稼働率目標を達成または上回るための戦略を策定・実行し、業績と市場状況に応じて調整します。
  • 販売実績の分析：失注レポートを評価し、コンバージョン率と競争力を強化する機会を特定します。
  • 卓越したサービス提供のサポート：各部門と連携し、契約サービスの履行を調整し、最高水準の顧客満足度を維持します。
  • チームの育成とモチベーション向上：チームメンバーの監督とサポート、業績のモニタリング、コーチング、そして前向きで生産的な職場環境の醸成を行います。

Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:

  • Represent the hotel to prospective clients: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers seeking group rooms, meeting space, and food and beverage services
  • Drive new business opportunities: Respond to inquiries, initiate outreach, qualify leads, and solicit potential clients through proactive sales efforts
  • Manage the full sales cycle: Conduct site visits, entertain clients, prepare proposals, determine rates, negotiate contracts, and service accounts through fulfillment
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Create and execute strategies to achieve or exceed revenue and room night goals, adjusting based on performance and market conditions
  • Analyze sales performance: Evaluate lost business reports and identify opportunities to strengthen conversion and competitiveness
  • Support exceptional service delivery: Collaborate across departments to coordinate the fulfillment of contracted services and uphold the highest standards of client satisfaction
  • Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

Qualifications

ヒルトンでは、コアバリューが成功に必要な要素を明確にし、すべてのチームメンバーに求める資質を導きます。

ホスピタリティの光と温かさを広める情熱。誠実に行動し、常に正しいことを行うこと。リーダーシップを通して他者を鼓舞すること。チームワークこそが最良の結果を生み出すという信念。オーナーシップと責任感。そして、今この瞬間に集中し、あらゆる瞬間に迅速さと規律をもって取り組み、それが永続的な影響を与えることを理解すること。

さらに、この職 務には以下の最低限の資格が必要です。

  • ホスピタリティ、ビジネス、または関連分野の学位または卒業証書
  • ホテルにおける法人、MICE、または団体客室販売の実務経験3年以上
  • 収益向上と主要顧客管理における実績
  • 優れた交渉力、プレゼンテーション能力、および関係構築能力
  • ホテルシステム（例：Delphi、Salesforce、OnQ、Market Planner Survey）に関する高度な技術スキル
  • 販売データと市場動向を分析し、戦略策定に役立てる能力
  • 優れたコミュニケーション能力とリーダーシップ、そして協調性

At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

  • Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in hotel Corporate, MICE, or Group room sales
  • Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
  • Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)
  • Ability to analyze sales data and market trends to inform strategy
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

OR

Executing Event Operations

  • Solve problems and/or suggest alternatives to previous arrangements if necessary.

Managing Profitability

Providing Exceptional Customer Service

  • Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.

  • Follows up with customer post-event.

Customer Support Associate

Responsibilities

First Level Support

Support Duties

  • Keep close contact with the customer and provide the solution mainly over phone, e-mail, My Amadeus Services and with the help of remote tools.
  • Quickly and efficiently turnaround cases assigned to the group and proactively resolve problems within agreed service levels using logical, efficient and structured root cause analysis approach to troubleshooting, through asking appropriate diagnostic questions. Distinguish between problem symptoms, and problem cause.

Experience in customer support and/or service roles (training, purchaser, functional, technical roles).

Business Understanding

Travel industry knowledge and business expertise.

Understanding of Amadeus Solutions and Services portfolio (preferred).

Computing Skills

MS Office suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

Understanding of computer systems and technical terminology.

Other Competencies

Strong problem‑solving, analytical, and statistical skills with high attention to detail.

Customer‑focused mindset; ability to understand commercial impact.

Proactive, adaptable to change, able to work with minimal supervision.

Ability to influence and collaborate.

Experience Working In a Global Company Is An Advantage.

job.job_description:
Description de l'entreprise

Accor Tech & Digital est le moteur de la tech, des solutions digitales et de la transformation au sein du Groupe. Nos 5 000 talents s'engagent à offrir les meilleures expériences digitales et tech à nos clients, nos hôtels et nos équipes dans 110 pays, et à façonner l'avenir de l'hospitalité.

Accor Tech & Digital, des métiers où l’intelligence est d’abord humaine !

Description du poste

Accor Tech & Digital, c’est le laboratoire d’innovation et de transformation technologique du leader mondial de l’hôtellerie.

Nos équipes, appelées Heartist®, concentrent le meilleur de l'hospitalité et le meilleur de la tech & du digital.

Notre ambition : offrir à nos clients des expériences personnalisées, mémorables et durables.

Ici, nous faisons naître de nouvelles façons de voyager dans chacun de nos 5 500 hôtels, au plus proche de nos 100 millions de clients dans 110 pays.

Ici, nous sommes au cœur d’un formidable terrain de jeu de transition technologique et de conception de produits digitaux et de services, pour nos clients et nos équipes en hôtels.

Ici, votre champ d’application ne connaîtra aucune frontière.

Alors, avec nous, osez avoir un impact sur le monde !

C’est ici que vous attend votre plus grand défi :

Au sein du département Digital, Business et Commercial du groupe Accor, vous êtes intégré(e) à

l’équipe Brand, Marketing & Sponsorship de ALL Accor, dont la mission est de faire rayonner la

marque B2C du groupe à l’échelle mondiale.

Dans un environnement fortement concurrentiel et culturellement exposé, le/la Directeur/trice

Global PR & Earned pilote la stratégie de visibilité, de réputation et d’influence de la marque.

Ce rôle place le earned media et le PR stratégique au cœur du dispositif, avec pour ambition de

transformer chaque prise de parole de la marque en conversation, en résonance culturelle et en

valeur réputationnelle durable.

Vous êtes responsable de la construction d’un storytelling global cohérent, aspirationnel et

différenciant, en lien avec les attentes sociétales, culturelles et lifestyle des audiences de la marque

Votre Mission

  • Stratégie Relations Presse & Earned Media
    • Définir et piloter la stratégie globale de Relations Presse et d’Earned Media au service de la réputation, de la désirabilité et de la croissance de la marque.
    • Construire un storytelling global différenciant et transformer les initiatives de marque en opportunités de visibilité et de conversation.
    • Développer et animer un réseau international de médias, journalistes et relais d’opinion stratégiques.
    • Maximiser l’impact médiatique et culturel des campagnes, partenariats, lancements et activations.
    • Garantir la cohérence des prises de parole avec la plateforme de communication, les priorités business et les enjeux réputationnels.
    • Piloter les agences et partenaires PR dans une logique d’excellence, d’innovation et de performance.
    • Définir et amplifier la gouvernance autour de ce levier

  • KOL & Influence
    • Définir et déployer la stratégie globale de KOL & Earn media afin de renforcer la visibilité, la crédibilité et la désirabilité de la marque.
    • Construire et animer un écosystème international de KOL et partenaires stratégiques, notamment sur la dimension Loyalty & VIP.
    • Orchestrer les leviers influence et earned media dans une approche intégrée et orientée impact.
    • Amplifier les temps fort de marque avec des activations génératrices d’engagement, de conversations et de résonance culturelle.
    • Identifier les opportunités permettant à la marque de créer des « cultural moments » à forte portée internationale.
    • Mesurer et optimiser la contribution de l’influence aux objectifs de réputation, de considération et de préférence de marque.
    • Piloter l’invitation de VIP & KOL pour construire une communauté forte et engagée

  • Thought Leadership & Executive Visibility
    • Développer les plateformes de thought leadership positionnant ALL Accor comme une référence sur les grands enjeux du voyage, de l’hospitalité, du lifestyle et de la fidélisation.
    • Définir les territoires d’expression et les narratifs renforçant l’autorité et l’influence de la marque.
    • Identifier et coordonner les opportunités d’expression à forte valeur ajoutée : médias, conférences, événements…

  • Management, Pilotage de l’Activité & Budget
    • Manager et développer une équipe d’experts PR, Influence et Réputation, en favorisant une culture d’excellence, de créativité et de performance.
    • Structurer la gouvernance et renforcer la collaboration avec les équipes Marketing, Brand, Business, Régions et Marques du Groupe.
    • Piloter les agences, partenaires externes et budgets associés dans une logique d’efficacité et de retour sur investissement.
    • Définir et suivre les indicateurs de performance afin de mesurer l’impact sur la réputation, la visibilité, la considération et la préférence de marque.
    • Développer une culture data-driven fondée sur l’analyse, les insights et l’amélioration continue.
    • Assurer une veille active des enjeux réputationnels et d’influence.
Qualifications

Et vous ?

  • Expérience
    • 10 à 12 ans d’expérience en communication internationale, PR, earned media, social et influence.
    • Expérience confirmée dans des environnements internationaux, matriciels et complexes.
    • Historique de pilotage de stratégies globales multi-marchés avec adaptation locale.
    • Expérience dans des univers premium, lifestyle, travel, hospitality, luxury ou entertainment fortement exposés médiatiquement.
    • Expérience avérée en gestion de réputation et communication sensible.

  • Compétences clés
    • Expertise reconnue en relations médias internationales et stratégies PR & Earned Media.
    • Forte capacité à générer de la couverture médiatique et des conversations culturelles.
    • Solide maîtrise des enjeux de réputation, d’influence et de brand perception.
    • Expérience en executive visibility et thought leadership.
    • Excellente compréhension des mécanismes social media et influence marketing.
    • Culture data-driven appliquée à la réputation et à l’impact média.
    • Forte sensibilité créative et culturelle.
    • Réseau international solide et établi auprès des médias, leaders d’opinion, KOL, influenceurs, et acteurs clés de l’écosystème.

  • Soft skills
    • Leadership naturel et capacité à embarquer des équipes et des parties prenantes multiples.
    • Forte capacité d’influence dans des environnements complexes et internationaux.
    • Excellente gestion des situations sensibles et des enjeux réputationnels.
    • Vision stratégique et forte sensibilité culturelle.
    • Agilité, résilience et capacité à évoluer dans des environnements rapides.
    • Excellente communication orale et écrite (FR/EN courant)
Informations supplémentaires

Et nous, quels sont nos engagements ?

  • Sur le monde
  • Accor s’engage pour le monde qui nous entoure, avec une culture employeur forte centrée sur le développement de nos 300 000 talents.
  • Nous adoptons une approche d'amélioration continue pour réduire l'impact du digital sur l'environnement dans l’ensemble de nos projets.
  • Sur votre carrière
  • Nous permettons à tous nos collaborateurs de maîtriser leur équilibre vie-perso / vie-pro et leur offrons les moyens de façonner leur environnement de travail à leur image.
  • Les parcours de formation et d’évolution sont définis à la fois individuellement et collectivement pour que nous grandissions ensemble, au quotidien.
  • Concrètement, chez Accor Tech & Digital :
  • Télétravail possible plusieurs jours par semaine depuis la France et options de travail flexibles : travaillez depuis chez vous, nos bureaux, ou même nos hôtels et espaces de coworking grâce à Worklib.
  • Chaque mercredi après-midi, consacrez votre temps à du travail de fond et à votre développement personnel.
  • Travail dans un environnement multiculturel et anglophone.
  • Amélioration continue & formations : Hackathons, partenariats technologiques d’exception, talent management dédié, certifications et plateforme de formation dédiée.

et aussi,

  • Programme ALL - Heartist® : tarifs préférentiels et offres flash pour des séjours et expériences inoubliables dans toutes nos adresses Accor et chez nos partenaires, dans le monde entier.
  • Programme de volontariat Heartist® for good : 1 jour offert sur votre temps de travail pour vous engager en faveur d’une association.
  • Un CSE qui vous accompagne dans le financement de vos activités culturelles et sportives.
  • Forfait Mobilité durable pour l’utilisation d’un moyen de déplacement « vert » ou un dispositif « vélo de fonction » en partenariat avec Zenride
  • Prise en charge des abonnements de transports publics urbains entre le domicile et le lieu de travail, au barème de la Loi Finance.
  • Tickets restaurant de 11€ en valeur faciale.
  • Une mutuelle obligatoire financée à 50% par Accor sans frais supplémentaire en cas d'adhésion de vos ayants droits.
  • Sans oublier des conditions de travail attractives avec des espaces de travail collaboratifs, des restaurants, espaces de jeux ou encore des espaces de bien-être et de Sport sur site ou grâce à Gymlib.

Votre talent et votre motivation sont nos seuls critères de sélection.

Nous valorisons la richesse des diverses nationalités, personnalités et parcours professionnels.

Nous savons nous adapter aux besoins spécifiques de nos collaborateurs, notamment ceux en situation de handicap.

Nous encourageons toutes les candidatures, sans distinction de genre, alors osez postuler !

Pour nous, le recrutement est avant tout une histoire de rencontres.

Cette mission vous attire ? Postulez et nous vous proposerons :

  • Un échange avec notre équipe recrutement pour vous présenter les lignes essentielles du poste ou vous orienter vers le rôle qui peut vous correspondre,
  • Un ou des entretiens avec les managers et les membres de l’équipe,
  • Pour certains postes, vous pourriez également être amené à effectuer un test ou une étude de cas, ainsi qu’un questionnaire sur votre personnalité et vos motivations.
  • Un entretien final avec notre équipe des Ressources Humaines pour échanger sur la culture de notre Groupe, l’environnement de travail, notre programme de formation et les perspectives de carrière, ainsi que les différents avantages du Groupe.
  • Un feedback personnalisé.

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Team  

Agoda’s Customer Experience Group delivers critical support to customers and partners across markets, channels, and business lines. As our operations scale in complexity, Senior Regional Managers play a pivotal role in ensuring regional resiliency, standardization, and sustained performance across multiple sites and partners.  

 

About The Role  

The Senior Regional Manager is accountable for end-to-end performance of a regional customer/partner operations area, typically spanning multiple countries, sites, or vendor partners. This role translates company strategy into a cohesive regional roadmap, balances cross site tradeoffs, and ensures consistent, high quality service delivery at scale.  

You will act as the regional authority on customer operations performance, risks, and improvement initiatives, while developing strong leadership benches and resilient operating models.  

Key Responsibilities  

Regional & Operational Ownership 

  • Lead multi-site, multi-country customer operations (including inhouse and BPO partners where applicable) 
  • Own end to end regional outcomes, including service quality, efficiency, resiliency, and cost to serve 
  • Balance cross site tradeoffs across capacity, language coverage, channel mix, routing, and vendor strategy   

Strategy & Roadmap  

  • Translate CEG strategy into a 12–18 month regional roadmap, prioritizing initiatives that deliver measurable customer and business impact 
  • Anticipate demand shifts (seasonality, launches, policy or regulatory changes) and lead proactive regional adjustments 
  • Sponsor and govern cross site initiatives to ensure consistency and scalability  

Improvement, Innovation & Resiliency  

  • Scale adoption of tools, technologies, and best practices across sites 
  • Institutionalize experimentation standards, operational rigor, and learning across the regional leadership team 
  • Strengthen regional resiliency through standardized playbooks (e.g. surge, BCP, knowledge governance)  

Stakeholder Leadership  

  • Serve as the regional “go to” for customer operations performance, risks, and initiatives 
  • Bring together WFM, QA, Training, Analytics, Product/Tech, Policy, and Commercial partners to land regionwide solutions 
  • Communicate regional performance, scenarios, and recommendations to senior stakeholders with minimal supervision  

People & Organization Leadership  

  • Lead through Regional Managers and/or Vendor Managers, setting a high bar for performance management and leadership capability 
  • Design and evolve regional org structures, language pools, and shift strategies to meet KPIs 
  • Build successor ready pipelines, enable cross site talent mobility, and develop future senior leaders 
  • Address underperformance decisively, fairly, and in line with Agoda values  

What You’ll Bring  

  • Excellent spoken and written Japanese skills, and Business level of English
  • Extensive demonstrated experience leading largescale, multisite or multi-country operations 
  • Proven ability to own regional outcomes and manage complexity across markets and partners 
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution excellence with strong analytical and experimentation mindset   
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to dive into detail to understand issue complexity, propose actionable plans, and collaborate effectively with stakeholders
  • Advanced stakeholder management and influencing skills, including Senior Leadership exposure 
  • A track record of developing leaders and building resilient organizations  

Nice to Have  

  • Experience managing outsourced/vendor operations at scale
  • Deep exposure to regulatory-complex or high-growth markets

Why Agoda 

  • Hybrid Work 
  • Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives
  • Annual discretionary performance bonus
  • Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits
  • Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products
  • Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year
  • An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued
  • Agoda choice(welfare points)
  • $400 USD allowance to set up your home office(one time payment)

Senior Travel Consultant (Remote or Hybrid)

Full time, Spain, Germany, France, Poland or UK

If you live in the Warsaw area, you will need to work in-office for 50% of working time monthly. If you are located in the Kraków and Rzeszów areas, you will need to work in-office at least 1 day per week.

As a Senior Travel Consultant, you are the face of our company. You’ll communicate and respond to requests for dedicated client- Airbus, helping them travel smart and achieve more. Do you communicate effortlessly and have customer service at heart? – Read on!

About You

job.job_description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

Now is an exciting time to be part of Delta's Reservations Technology and Innovation team as we redefine customer and employee experiences by setting new technology standards for thousands of Reservations and Care employees. We are seeking a Product Owner Specialist to support product development and improvements in our primary Sales and Service digital platforms for our Reservations specialists.

Responsibilities (not Comprehensive)

  • Provide leadership and direction to Analysts in reviewing, communicating, and translating business needs for both technical and non-technical audiences and stakeholders
  • Direct the work of squad/pods within Information Technology to prioritize the sprint backlog, balancing requirements of business stakeholders
  • Directly work with internal and external design resources to create UX/UI experiences to support new product functionality for both informational and transactional customer needs
  • Collaborate with other Product Owners, Product Managers, and stakeholders to refine features and stories and accept completed stories, ensuring they meet all predefined criteria
  • Coordinate with other Product Owners across the organization to align cross-squad efforts and maintain coherence in product development
  • Translate product development goals into requirements including features user stories, and acceptance test criteria
  • Attend regular ceremonies with the Information Technology team including backlog grooming, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint review/demos, and retrospectives
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to increase revenue, customer satisfaction, employee satisfaction, and operational efficiency
  • Provide regular status reports to key stakeholders, sponsors, project managers, and others involved in the project
  • Play an integral role in engagement, communication, change management, feedback loops, and overall leadership visibility across the system
  • Develop both strategic and tactical plans that create a safety-conscious environment resulting in employee safety and wellbeing

Additional Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of writing user stories and ensure they clearly convey the required functionality to the IT development teams
  • Actively participate in all squad ceremonies, including sprint demos, planning, and retrospectives
  • Provide continuous feedback during sprint demos and lead discussions to ensure effective iterations of product features
  • Maintain open lines of communication with stakeholders to review product progress and outcomes
  • Work closely with stakeholders and Product Managers to contribute to the overarching product vision and strategy with data-backed ideation and iterative solutioning
  • Champion agile methodologies within the squad, promoting best practices and continuous improvement
  • Utilize tools like Agility and Aha! for effective project management and ensure data hygiene to track progress accurately

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Agile Product Management training and experience
  • Proven experience as a Product Owner (or similar role), in a dynamic agile environment Demonstrated initiative and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Proficiency in written and oral communications and ability to produce concise, relevant, documents and presentations
  • Curious mindset, willing to ask “why” until root causes of use cases are identified
  • Must be performing satisfactorily in present position
  • Consistently prioritizes safety and security of self, others, and personal data

At Enterprise Mobility™ we are paving a new way forward by creating better experiences for how we move. We give people around the world the ability to connect in ways that suit their unique needs. It’s how we grew from a pioneer with a fleet of seven cars to a global mobility leader with more than 90,000 team members around the world. And it’s what will continue to drive the future of the organization and mobility itself.

job.job_description:
Overview

Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions, owning and operating the Enterprise Rent-A-Car, National Car Rental and Alamo Rent A Car brands through its integrated global network of independent regional subsidiaries. Enterprise Mobility and its affiliates offer extensive car rental, carsharing, truck rental, fleet management, retail car sales, as well as travel management and other transportation services, to make travel easier and more convenient for customers.

Privately held by the Taylor family of St. Louis, Enterprise Mobility together with its affiliate Enterprise Fleet Management manages a diverse fleet of 2.4 million vehicles and accounted for nearly $39 billion in revenue through a network of more than 9,500 fully-staffed neighborhood and airport rental locations in more than 90 countries and territories.

At the center of it all, our dedicated IT teams innovate, design and develop the technology that is redefining how customers rent, buy and share vehicles from our family of brands. Here, you will be part of a diverse and talented team that creates and delivers powerful technology solutions for our customers and employees across the world with the resources and support to develop in a variety of career paths.

As an Enterprise Mobility team member, we offer an excellent package with market-competitive pay, comprehensive healthcare packages, 401k matching & profit sharing, schedule flexibility, work from home opportunities, paid time off, and organizational growth potential.

This position offers the opportunity to work fully remote within the United States (except for Alaska and/or Hawaii). Team members who choose virtual / remote work should have an adequate space to serve as their home office, and must be able to work a schedule within U.S. Central Standard Time core business hours. This position will require employees to come on site to one of our St. Louis campus locations a few times per year for meetings/events or as needed.

Responsibilities

As an IT Manager on the Network Operations team, you will be responsible for leading the day-to-day operations of the team, providing overall guidance and supervision. You will ensure all members of assigned technical teams are effective and fully utilized, and provide leadership in key interactions with others to define, analyze, and deliver customer solutions. You will be responsible for building trust to influence peers and others to break down barriers and drive results. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to work across multiple teams to help deliver innovative solutions in support of Enterprise Mobility's technology strategy. You will need to collaborate with leaders and teams throughout IT to ensure alignment and partnership.

As an IT Manager, you will be responsible for defining the goals, objectives, processes, and resources to support the overall Network Operations. This is an ideal role for a leader looking for an opportunity to make a significant impact, and develop and grow in a team-oriented environment. You’ll have the chance to work with senior leaders in the organization, so collaboration and influence skills will be key.

  • Leadership & Team Management:
  • Oversee and manage a team of network engineers with a focus on agility and continuous improvement, providing 24/7 support
  • Provide leadership, guidance, and support to ensure effective team performance and development
  • Coordinate with senior management and other departments to align NetOps objectives with organizational goals
  • Maintain and monitor required staffing levels and schedule to ensure that the team can meet the demand and respond in a timely manner to network and server anomalies and outages
  • Handle escalations, both internal/external, and manage support from different levels, which includes quarter backing P1 incidents
  • Manage tools, systems, and procedures to ensure dynamic management of issues and customer management
  • Ability to balance risk with business priorities and applies the appropriate sense of urgency to issues
  • Network Infrastructure Oversight:
    • Provide overall expertise with all Network Operations functions
    • Supervise network operations across 9 data centers (7 in North America and 2 in Europe), including managing Cisco IOS, Arista and Nexus devices, Palo Alto firewalls, F5 load balancers, and Infoblox DDI appliances
    • Manage WAN connectivity for multiple corporate campuses and over 6,000 branches in North America. Oversee the use of VMWare VeloCloud routers and Meraki APs and switches.
  • Break/Fix and Service Delivery:
  • Oversee the resolution of break/fix issues and ensure high standards of service delivery
  • Act as an escalation point for complex issues and outages impacting high-revenue locations
  • Partner with third-party providers for tier 1 support and manage escalation processes
  • Project Management:
    • Lead and coordinate larger network projects, ensuring timely and successful completion
    • Collaborate with project teams to plan, execute, and monitor network infrastructure projects
    • Operational Excellence:
      • Identify, influence, and drive opportunities to further our cloud networking objectives
      • Own and drive multiple simultaneous efforts and roadmaps within the area through close coordination with various IT teams and external vendors
      • Develop and implement processes and procedures to optimize network operations and improve efficiency
      • Monitor performance metrics and ensure compliance with service level agreements (SLAs)
      • Ensure continual process improvement within the Network Operations, including but not limited to: automation of Network Operations tasks and reporting, implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring initiatives, and routine administration task
    Equal Opportunity Employer/Disability/Veterans

    Qualifications

    Required:

    • Must be presently authorized to work in the U.S. without a requirement for work authorization sponsorship by our company for this position now or in the future
    • Must reside in the United States (does not include Alaska or Hawaii)
    • Must be able to work a schedule within U.S. Central Standard Time core business hours.
    • Must be committed to incorporating security into all decisions and daily job responsibilities
    • 6+ years of related experience
    • 2+ years of people management experience, to include hiring, 1-1 meetings, career coaching/ mentoring, performance reviews, salary reviews, etc.
    • Must be able to work 4 pm CST to 1 am CST.
    • Experience and knowledge of network technologies that support LAN/WAN, cloud, and broadband (VPN, DHCP, DNS, VLANS, as well as others not listed)
    • Experience and knowledge of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, SNMP/ RMON, and RDP
    • Experience of working in an Agile/Scrum development environment and working within sprint teams, using tools such as Jira and Confluence
    • Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to articulate technical concepts to a non-technical audience

    Preferred

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Management Information Systems, or related field preferred
    • Experience with the following Network Technologies is preferred:
    • Prefer experience working in a large technology/ network environment
    • Awareness and understanding of AWS or Azure technologies, products, and services
    • Awareness and understanding of core networking concepts and technologies
    • Ability to challenge current solutions, determine appropriate solutions, and ensure there is alignment across the organization
    • Adept at improving outcomes through proactive coaching and development at all levels
    • JIRA and SeriveNow background

job.job_description:
Job Summary

The Director, Billing is responsible for leading the vision, strategy, and execution of Choice Hotels’ global billing operations, overseeing the accurate processing of more than $1B in annual invoicing. This role ensures the integrity, scalability, and compliance of all billing activities across domestic and international portfolios. The Director provides strategic leadership for billing transformation, automation, and process optimization while enhancing the customer experience. This role leads a team of four direct reports and partners cross-functionally with Finance, Technology, Legal, and Operations to support financial performance and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

Global Billing Strategy & Financial Performance

  • Lead end-to-end global billing operations, ensuring accurate and timely invoicing across all brands, products, and regions.
  • Oversee billing for royalties, marketing and reservation fees, loyalty assessments, commissions, procurement, and other contract-based revenue streams.
  • Establish, monitor, and report on KPIs (billing accuracy, dispute rates, cycle times, revenue leakage, customer inquiries).
  • Partner with Accounting to ensure proper revenue recognition, reconciliations, accruals, and audit readiness.
  • Analyze billing data trends to proactively identify discrepancies and implement corrective actions.
  • Deliver executive-level reporting on billing performance, risks, dispute trends, and customer engagement.
  • Provide strategic insights and recommendations to Finance leadership to improve revenue realization and operational performance.

Strategic Leadership

  • Own billing policies, governance, procedures, and internal controls to ensure global consistency and compliance.
  • Serve as subject matter expert on franchise billing structures, contractual fee models, and procurement vendor billing.
  • Identify operational risks and revenue leakage and implement structural improvements to enhance scalability and financial integrity.
  • Partner with executive leadership and auditors to improve audit processes, reduce inefficiencies, and optimize audit outcomes.
  • Translate enterprise and departmental strategies into actionable operational objectives for the billing function.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex franchise and procurement billing matters.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Legal, Franchise Operations, Loyalty, Marketing, and Brand teams to resolve billing issues and interpret contractual obligations.
  • Proactively communicate with stakeholders and customers regarding invoices, changes, and policy updates.
  • Balance financial accountability with strong franchisee and customer relationships.

Process Improvement & Innovation

  • Drive global billing process standardization while accommodating regional and contractual variations.
  • Lead transformation initiatives, including billing system implementations, automation, and workflow optimization.
  • Implement system-driven controls to reduce manual processes and improve accuracy and efficiency.
  • Conduct root-cause analyses of disputes and implement long-term solutions.
  • Ensure SOX compliance, audit readiness, and complete documentation of processes.

People Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing billing team with clear accountability and performance expectations.
  • Manage, mentor, and support 4 direct reports, fostering engagement, development, and retention.
  • Build workforce and succession plans aligned to business needs.
  • Promote a culture of operational excellence, continuous improvement, and customer focus.

Qualifications

Employment Experience

  • Minimum 10+ years of progressive experience in billing operations, revenue operations, accounts receivable, or financial operations.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing teams (including people leaders and/or complex functions).
  • Experience leading large-scale system implementations, finance transformation initiatives, or operating model changes.
  • Experience in hospitality, franchising, or contract-based revenue models preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of franchise billing structures, contractual fee models, and revenue recognition principles.
  • Experience with ERP/EPM systems (Oracle Fusion preferred) and customer billing platforms.
  • Advanced Excel skills (Power Query, Power Pivot, modeling).
  • Experience with process documentation, internal controls, and gap analysis.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook).

Additional Skills & Competencies

  • Strategic thinker with ability to translate enterprise objectives into operational execution.
  • Strong leadership and influencing skills across senior stakeholders.
  • Proven change management and transformation leadership capabilities.
  • Excellent communication skills, including executive-level presentations.
  • High business acumen, operational discipline, and risk awareness.
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, complex environment while balancing financial rigor and customer experience.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience required.

WORK LOCATION:

This position is based at Choice Hotels’ Pike & Rose headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland. The selected candidate must be able to commit to this location requirement and adhere to the company’s hybrid work schedule, which consists of four days onsite and one day remote per week.

NOTE:

This position is not eligible for relocation assistance or sponsorship.

Salary Range

The salary range for this position is $142,000 to $167,000 annually. In addition to the annual salary, this role is eligible for an annual bonus based on the terms of Choice's Management Incentive Plan (MIP).

The pay range listed is for this position and is what Choice Hotels reasonably expects to pay. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the pay range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, qualifications, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, and business or organizational needs.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Care at GetYourGuide is in the middle of a fundamental transformation — and it's one of the most important bets we're making as a company. We're moving from traditional human-led support to an LLM-powered model, where AI handles the majority of interactions and our human teams focus on the cases that genuinely need them. That shift changes everything: how we staff, how we plan, how we measure, and what "great care" even looks like.

The Care Experience & Strategy team sits at the centre of this change. We're the function that turns operational complexity into clarity — owning the forecasting, analytics, and strategic planning that keep Care running as the model underneath it evolves. This isn't a team that maintains what exists. It's a team that's actively rebuilding how a world-class support organisation operates in an AI-first world. If you're energised by building something new rather than running something established, this is where you want to be.

Your mission

As Manager of Workforce Management, you'll own the forecasting and planning capability that Care's transformation depends on. Reporting to the Head of Care Experience & Strategy, you'll lead a team of three WFM specialists to replace our manual, Google Sheets-based forecasting models with an AI and automations driven approach — cutting forecast run time from ~23 hours to under 2 hours, while sharpening the accuracy our operations rely on. This is a build role, not a maintain role. You'll set the direction, make the calls on methodology and tooling, and take your team along with you.

  • Lead the end-to-end transformation of our forecasting capability, replacing manual Google Sheets-based models with an AI-driven solution that improves both speed and accuracy.
  • Build and mature forecasting models for emerging lines of business, ensuring our planning capability scales alongside GetYourGuide's growth
  • Develop a scenario modelling capability that enables Care leadership to stress-test assumptions, model trade-offs, and make faster, more confident operational decisions
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of three WFM specialists — setting clear goals, giving regular feedback, and creating an environment where the team can do their best work
  • Drive AI adoption within your team — identifying new use cases, building workflows and automations, and helping your team develop their own AI capabilities
  • Partner closely with Care Operations, Finance, and Technology stakeholders to ensure forecasting outputs are understood, trusted, and acted upon
  • Define and own the metrics that measure forecast quality, model performance, and planning effectiveness — using data to continuously improve
  • Strengthen the continuous feedback loop between Realtime Management insights and future forecasts, driving continuous improvement of our forecasting accuracy

Your toolkit

  • 5+ years of professional experience, with at least 3 in workforce management, operations analytics, or a related planning function, ideally within a customer care, support, or contact centre environment
  • Proven track record of building or significantly improving forecasting models, with a strong grasp of forecasting methodologies and their practical trade-offs
  • Demonstrated experience applying automation and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of your work — you can share concrete examples of workflows or automations you've built and the impact they had
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with large datasets, building models, and translating complex outputs into clear operational recommendations
  • Experience leading a small team of specialists, with the ability to set direction, develop people, and maintain high standards
  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills — you can translate technical forecasting concepts into language that resonates with operational and senior leadership audiences
  • A bias for action and continuous improvement — you don't wait to be told something is broken before fixing it

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience with WFM platforms (e.g. Verint, NICE, Assembled, or similar)
  • Familiarity with Python, SQL, or other tools used for data modelling and automation
  • Experience building forecasting models in a multi-channel or multi-LOB care environment
  • Exposure to scenario planning or capacity modelling in an operational context

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

job.job_description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

On the Strategy team reporting to the Senior Director, Strategy, you will provide consultative support on articulating, substantiating, and operationalizing strategy and centralized planning tools.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Senior Economist

Expedia Group's Economics and Experimentation Science team is looking for a Senior Economist to drive causal inference and marketplace optimization at scale—impacting billions of dollars in transaction value across one of the world's largest travel platforms. 

You'll tackle high-stakes problems, including measuring incrementality in two-sided marketplaces, quantifying long-term value of customer behavior signals, and designing quasi-experimental methods to evaluate product changes that can't be measured using A/B testing techniques. Your work will directly shape how Expedia Group balances traveler experience, partner economics, and platform health. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with high autonomy. You'll own end-to-end method development initiatives, influence product strategy at the executive level, and set technical standards for causal inference across the organization. You'll collaborate closely with ML engineers, data scientists, analysts, and product leaders who value rigorous econometric thinking.

 

In this role, you will: 

  • Build scalable econometric models (panel data methods, DiD, RDD, IV) to measure elasticity, changes in supplier behavior, and customer lifetime value in the presence of endogeneity, simultaneity, and platform dynamics 
  • Establish the technical roadmap for long-term impact measurement, moving beyond short-term experiment metrics to quantify sustained effects on customer retention, partner engagement, and marketplace equilibrium 
  • Design and execute causal measurement frameworks for marketplace interventions, including geo experiments, difference-in-differences, synthetic controls, and instrumental variable approaches, to isolate the true causal effect of product changes 
  • Partner with ML teams to integrate causal inference into production systems, informing ranking algorithms, pricing optimization, and recommendation engines with econometrically validated insights 
  • Translate complex econometric findings into clear executive narratives that drive multi-million-dollar product decisions, presenting to executive stakeholders with clarity and conviction 
  • Mentor data scientists and economists across the organization, elevating the rigor of causal reasoning and experimental design 

Experience and Qualifications: 

  • PhD in Economics, Applied Economics, Econometrics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field 
  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience 
  • Solid foundation in microeconomic theory and applied econometrics, with the ability to apply appropriate causal inference techniques 
  • Demonstrated experience applying econometric methods to real-world business problems in tech, e-commerce, or marketplace environments 
  • Deep expertise in the causal inference toolkit: IV, DiD, RDD, synthetic controls, panel data methods, experimental design, metalearners, doubleML, causal forests
  • Proficiency in Python or R with strong SQL skills to work with large-scale, noisy, real-world data, including the ability to query and process data
  • Track record of influencing product strategy or business decisions through rigorous quantitative analysis—ideally with examples of work that shipped to production 
  • Exceptional communication skills: ability to explain econometric methodology, identifying assumptions, and business implications to non-technical executives 
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced business environment

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Publications or working papers in applied economics, econometrics, or quantitative methods (academic or industry venues) 
  • Experience with marketplace or platform economics: two-sided markets, network effects, dynamic pricing, or general equilibrium modeling 
  • Experience integrating causal models into ML pipelines or production systems 
  • Familiarity with modern AI/ML workflows and LLM-assisted analysis tools 
  • Background in travel, e-commerce, or large-scale consumer marketplaces 

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $173,000.00 to $242,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $277,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Expedia Group offers benefits and perks designed to support employees and their families, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness and travel reimbursement, travel discounts, and International Airlines Travel Agent Network (IATAN) membership. Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Contract Duration

 Why you will love working here

At IATA, we represent over 350 airlines worldwide, striving to make aviation safer, smarter, more sustainable, and inclusive.

About The Team You Are Joining

The IATA Legal Team is part of the Legal Services and Corporate Secretary (LSCS) group and is made up of legal professionals qualified in various jurisdictions, providing legal support across IATA's operations, business activities and advocacy strategies. The team is divided into two workstreams reflecting IATA's activities, the Standards and Programs legal workstream and the Regulatory and Governance legal workstream.

The Legal Counsel is an early-career legal professional with relevant post-qualification experience and knowledge in standard setting, commercial law, regulatory, compliance, governance, antitrust and competition law, dispute resolution and / or financial services. They are responsible for providing legal advice, support, and research on diverse subject areas to support IATA’s standard setting, programs and industry activities. The Legal Counsel reports to the Assistant Director, Associate General Counsel Standards and Programs Governance (AD SPG).

This Role

What your day would be like

  • Provides legal advice and support on a broad range of commercial, operational, regulatory and governance matters affecting IATA’s standard setting, programs and industry activities;
  • Drafts appropriate responses to correspondence and communication raising legal issues or having legal implications;
  • Drafts and advises on agreements, contracts, instruments, governance documents, and policies in the context of IATA's standard setting, programs and industry activities;
  • Provides support and assistance to senior lawyers in relation to disputes, claims, enforcement actions and other legal proceedings, including reviewing submissions and liaising with external legal counsel when required;
  • Assesses and responds to requests for information from governmental authorities, regulators, law enforcement agencies and other third parties;
  • Supports the legal aspects of new initiatives, programs and strategic projects by identifying legal risks and providing practical solutions, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, governance and policies;
  • Reviews and advises on the agendas, minutes and governance documentation of industry groups, committees, boards and working groups to ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, competition law and governance requirements;
  • Provides support and assistance to the AD SPG and senior lawyers including legal research, drafting opinions, and liaising with internal clients and external counsel;
  • Develops and delivers legal training, policies and guidance material for IATA staff;
  • Collaborates with business, operational, finance and compliance teams;
  • Maintains strong relationships with relevant external legal communities.

We would love to hear from you if

You are an effective, confident communicator and a team player and have:

  • Advanced University degree in law (LLB, JD, LLM) from an internationally recognized university.
  • Admission to practice law in a relevant jurisdiction, preferably the UK, EU member state, Canada, US, Australia or New Zealand.
  • Minimum five years post qualification experience in an organization, government department or law firm.
  • Professional client relationship skills.
  • Excellent command of English, including superior written and oral communication skills.
  • Strong legal research and technical skills.

Travel Required: 5

job.job_description:
Organization- Regional Office - EAME

Who We Are

At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging and creating a culture of care, where our colleagues become family. Since 1957, our colleagues and our guests have been at the heart of our business and helped Hyatt become one of the best, and fastest growing hospitality brands in the world. Our transformative growth and the addition of new hotels, brands and business lines can open the door for exciting career and growth opportunities to our colleagues.

As we continue to grow, we never lose sight of what’s most important: People. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences and jobs into careers.


Your Role

As an Accounting System Installer, you will play an important role in supporting Hyatt's continued growth across Europe, Africa and the Middle East by implementing and enhancing the finance systems that keep our hotels operating efficiently.

In this role, you will lead the implementation, configuration and ongoing support of BirchStreet and related finance systems across new and existing Hyatt hotels. Working closely with hotel teams, vendors and regional stakeholders, you will help deliver successful hotel openings, acquisitions, transitions, conversions and system upgrades while ensuring colleagues have the tools, training and support they need to succeed. From system integrations and supplier enablement to marketplace administration and post-go-live support, you'll help create a seamless experience for hotels throughout the region.


Location: This position is based in either Germany or Spain. The successful candidate must have the legal right to work in the European Union.


Your Responsibilities

  • Implement, configure, administer and continuously enhance BirchStreet across Hyatt hotels throughout the EAME region.
  • Coordinate finance system implementations for hotel openings, acquisitions, transitions, conversions and upgrades, managing project timelines, training and go-live readiness.
  • Support integrations between BirchStreet and related finance systems, including ERP, PMS, POS and eInvoice solutions, ensuring accurate system performance and data flow.
  • Configure and validate system setup, including user access, approval workflows, supplier data, catalogues, order guides, inventory and finance mappings before hotel handover.
  • Administer Hyatt EAME Marketplace 321 while supporting supplier onboarding, catalogue maintenance and procurement process improvements.
  • Lead or support regional finance systems projects, including data migration, user training, system enhancements and post-go-live hypercare.
  • Troubleshoot complex finance system, integration and procurement issues, coordinating testing, issue resolution and user acceptance activities for system enhancements.
  • Provide ongoing support for eInvoice solutions, ensuring supplier readiness, interface validation, compliance and operational excellence across the region.


Qualifications

Your Qualifications & Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience supporting hotel finance systems, procurement systems, system implementations or operational systems.
  • Experience supporting hotel openings, acquisitions, transitions, conversions or post-go-live support is an advantage.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Hospitality Management, Business Administration or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong knowledge of hotel finance systems and integrations, including BirchStreet, ERP, PMS, POS and eInvoice solutions, with familiarity with systems such as iScala and Opera preferred.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, with experience using implementation documentation, project trackers and reporting tools; experience with Smartsheet or Microsoft Power Platform is a plus.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced regional environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner effectively across Finance, Procurement, IT, hotel operations, suppliers and external vendors.
  • Willingness to travel across the EAME region to support implementations, training and go-live activities.


How We Care For Our People

What sets us apart is our purpose—to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it informs how we have and will continue to support each other as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the key to our success. We’re proud to have earned a place on Fortune’s prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for the last ten years. This recognition is a testament to the tremendous way our Hyatt family continues to come together to care for one another, our commitment to a culture of inclusivity, empathy and respect, and making sure everyone feels like they belong.

We’re proud to offer the following benefits:

  • Annual allotment of complimentary stays at Hyatt hotels worldwide
  • Attractive colleague, friends & family hotel rates globally
  • Flexible work arrangements to support work–life balance
  • Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities through Hyatt’s myLearning platform
  • Tuition reimbursement to support your continued education and long-term career growth


We Welcome You

Research shows that individuals tend to apply to jobs only if they meet all the listed qualifications. Unsure if you check every box, but feeling inspired to enhance your career? Apply. We'd love to consider your unique experiences and how you could make Hyatt even better.
