job.job_description:
Job Description

 OVERVIEW OF ROLE

The Purchasing Executive is responsible for supporting the hotel's procurement operations by ensuring the timely and accurate sourcing, ordering and delivery of goods and services required for daily operations. This role assists in maintaining purchasing records, coordinating with suppliers and internal departments, and ensuring procurement activities are carried out efficiently, ethically and in accordance with company policies.

Working closely with the Purchasing Manager and operational departments, the Purchasing Executive plays a key role in supporting inventory control, vendor management and purchasing administration while contributing to the smooth operation of the hotel.

Responsibilities

 MAIN DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

The main responsibilities of the Purchasing Executive are summarised below; however, the list is not exhaustive.

PROCUREMENT & PURCHASING OPERATIONS

  • Process purchase requisitions and prepare purchase orders in accordance with approved purchasing procedures.
  • Source quotations from approved suppliers and assist in obtaining competitive pricing while maintaining quality standards.
  • Follow up on purchase orders to ensure timely delivery of goods and services.
  • Verify purchase documentation for accuracy before submission for approval.
  • Coordinate with requesting departments to ensure procurement requirements are fulfilled promptly.
  • Assist in sourcing new suppliers and products as directed by the Purchasing Manager.
  • Monitor outstanding purchase orders and resolve delivery discrepancies with suppliers.
  • Support day-to-day purchasing activities to ensure uninterrupted hotel operations.

VENDOR MANAGEMENT

  • Maintain positive working relationships with approved suppliers and service providers.
  • Assist in maintaining supplier records, contracts, quotations and pricing information.
  • Coordinate supplier communications regarding orders, deliveries, product availability and pricing updates.
  • Monitor supplier performance and escalate service or quality concerns to the Purchasing Manager.
  • Support supplier evaluations and market surveys when required.

INVENTORY & COST CONTROL

  • Assist in monitoring inventory levels and coordinating purchases to maintain appropriate stock availability.
  • Support regular market price comparisons to identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Work closely with the Cost Controller and operational departments to ensure efficient product utilisation.
  • Help minimise purchasing costs while maintaining required quality standards.
  • Assist during stock takes and inventory verification exercises.

ADMINISTRATION & REPORTING

  • Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier files, purchase orders, quotations and procurement documentation.
  • Ensure all purchasing documents are properly filed and readily available for audit purposes.
  • Prepare reports on outstanding purchase orders, supplier performance and purchasing activities as required.
  • Submit purchase orders, delivery notes and invoices promptly to Accounts Payable for processing.
  • Maintain accurate purchasing data within the hotel's procurement and inventory systems.

COLLABORATION & COMMUNICATION

  • Build positive working relationships with all hotel departments to understand operational purchasing needs.
  • Liaise with suppliers regarding deliveries, product availability and order status.
  • Support departmental projects, promotions and operational requirements by coordinating timely procurement.
  • Communicate effectively with Finance, Culinary, Housekeeping, Engineering and Food & Beverage teams.
  • Escalate purchasing issues or supply chain disruptions to the Purchasing Manager promptly.

COMPLIANCE & SAFETY

  • Ensure all purchasing activities comply with company procurement policies and approval processes.
  • Maintain confidentiality of supplier pricing, commercial agreements and procurement information.
  • Support compliance with audit requirements and internal controls.
  • Ensure proper documentation and record retention for all purchasing activities.
  • Follow workplace health, safety and ethical procurement practices at all times.

EXPECTATIONS

The Purchasing Executive Is Expected To

  • Demonstrate professionalism, integrity and attention to detail in all purchasing activities.
  • Deliver timely and accurate procurement support to operational departments.
  • Build positive working relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain excellent organisational and administrative skills.
  • Demonstrate initiative, accountability and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Work effectively in a fast-paced hospitality environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Uphold NoMad Singapore's values, brand standards and commitment to operational excellence.

Qualifications

 QUALIFICATIONS

  • Diploma or Degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, Hospitality Management or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum 1–3 years of purchasing, procurement or supply chain experience, preferably within the hospitality industry.
  • Knowledge of purchasing procedures, inventory management and procurement best practices.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
  • Experience using purchasing, inventory or ERP systems is advantageous.
  • Strong organisational, administrative and analytical skills.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively across departments.
  • Ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Previous experience in a luxury hotel or pre-opening environment is an advantage.

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.

Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

About The Team

How We’ll Help You Thrive

Benefits

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including*:

Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program

Own a piece of Hilton – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future

Personalized caregiving support – Access dedicated caregiving concierge services to help navigate caregiving for yourself and your loved ones

Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care

Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best-in-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered

  • Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

job.job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Data Scientist II - Product Analytics

Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.

Are you passionate about data, analytics, and collaborating with top talent to tackle complex problems? If you're motivated to make an immediate impact on reimagining travel through insightful recommendations that drive improvements, we want to speak with you! We are seeking an experienced analytics professional to join our Advance AI Agent Product Analytics Team, supporting a portfolio of some of the world’s leading online travel brands. This is a mid-level individual contributor role, partnering with product managers and focusing on user experience optimization via GenAI-driven personalization. As a Data Scientist, you’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to solve a wide range of problems. You will bring scientific rigor and statistical methods to the challenges of business growth and product development. This role supports key business decisions throughout the product development lifecycle to improve the user experience for millions of Expedia customers. You’ll be responsible for uncovering customer friction points, hypothesis generation and prioritization, experiment design, unbiased test analysis, actionable recommendations, and product optimization. If you are a self-starter who has demonstrated success using analytics to drive innovation and user engagement, this role is for you.

In This Role, You Will

  • Analyze and interpret complex data sets to uncover actionable insights that drive product and business decisions.
  • Design, develop, and implement analytical models, leveraging statistical and machine learning techniques appropriate to business needs.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to define and measure success metrics, and communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Build, validate, and optimize data pipelines and workflows to ensure high-quality, scalable analytics solutions.
  • Apply advanced data visualization methods to present results clearly and effectively for a wide audience.
  • Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, demonstrating familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
  • 2+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing large data sets and applying statistical methods to solve business problems.
  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language (such as Python or R) for data analysis.
  • Ability to communicate insights, methodologies, and recommendations effectively to diverse audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and implementing scalable analytics and data solutions in a cloud environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage advanced machine learning or AI/ML techniques to generate business impact.
  • Expertise in data visualization tools and best practices for effective storytelling with data.
  • Proven track record of collaborating with engineering, product, and business teams to translate data insights into action.
  • Experience safely integrating and operating AI/ML-enabled solutions that improve outcomes, including developing or deploying AI-driven analytics workflows.

The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $112,000.00 to $156,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $179,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.

job.job_description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: 2 days in-office

Principal Enterprise Architect, Infrastructure and Operations

Our Technology team is the backbone of our company: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you’re in the right place.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

As a Principal Enterprise Architect for Infrastructure and Operations, you’ll set the strategy and standards that power reliability, speed, and safety across Priceline’s platforms, networks, and run-time environments.

This role raises the architectural bar for Priceline’s Infrastructure and Operations—building reliable, scalable, secure, and cost-effective foundations so product teams can ship quickly without chaos. You’ll unify platform engineering, SRE, networking, and multi-region cloud infrastructure into paved roads and guardrails that accelerate delivery, improve reliability, strengthen observability, reduce change-failure rate and MTTR, enable safe, scalable AI adoption, and lower total cost of ownership (TCO).

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Define and evolve the target-state Infrastructure and Operations architecture aligned to Priceline’s long-term business and technology objectives, with a pragmatic phased roadmap and measurable interim milestones.
  • Design and govern global, cloud-native platforms (e.g., Kubernetes/GKE, service mesh, data and messaging backbones, edge/CDN, identity/IAM, network architecture) that are resilient, scalable, secure, and cost-optimized—grounded in explicit trade-offs.
  • Lead platform engineering strategy—establish paved roads/golden paths, an internal developer platform (IDP), reusable reference architectures, and self-service automation that shorten idea-to-production cycles.
  • Lead architecture governance, codifying standards and guardrails, managing technical debt, ensuring compliance, and minimizing architectural risk.
  • Partner with Product and Technology leaders to design end-to-end solutions across internal and third-party systems—defining integration patterns, API/data contracts, clear ownership boundaries, and SLAs.
  • Institutionalize SRE fundamentals and advance Infrastructure as Code and GitOps.
  • Embed security and privacy by design—partner with Security/Risk to implement Zero Trust, secrets and key management, vulnerability & patch orchestration, data protection, and regulatory controls (e.g., PCI, SOX, GDPR/CCPA) across platforms and pipelines.
  • Use business criticality classification to drive resiliency, capacity, and performance engineering requirements, with automated IaC policies for topology/redundancy, data protection, observability configuration, SLOs, change management requirements, and IAM policies.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, patterns, and vendors to shape strategic roadmaps—leading build/buy/partner analyses, proofs of concept, and TCO/ROI assessments to de-risk decisions.
  • Coach principal and staff engineers, uplevel engineering practices, and cultivate a culture of clarity, simplicity, and continuous improvement.

Who You Are

  • Strategic thinker and clear communicator who can influence executives, peers, and engineers.
  • Deep experience (8+ years) across cloud infrastructure and operations—Kubernetes/container platforms, platform engineering/IDP, networking and site traffic management/edge platforms, storage, observability, incident management, DR/BCP, and modern change management.
  • Hands-on engineering background with fluency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), automation (e.g., Python/Go), GitOps/CI/CD, service mesh, and production observability.
  • Cloud-native experience—ideally GCP (e.g. GKE, Cloud Service Mesh, VPC, CloudSQL/AlloyDB/Spanner, BigQuery, Bigtable, GCE, GCS, Vertex AI, Looker) and Kafka.
  • Security-first mindset with practical knowledge of Zero Trust, IAM, secrets management, vulnerability management, security and identity protocols (PKI, TLS/mTLS, OAuth 2.0/OIDC), and privacy/compliance frameworks (e.g., PCI, SOX, GDPR/CCPA).
  • FinOps-aware—able to model and optimize cost/reliability/latency trade-offs at scale.
  • Bias for clarity and simplicity—reducing complexity and enabling teams to move faster and smarter.
  • Analytical problem-framer who reduces ambiguity into clear, actionable components.
  • Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics are essential.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $175,000- $220,000 USD.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

Work/life support including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)

Financial security programs such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts

Signature travel perks including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits

Additional perks & discounts like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

job.job_description:
Catering & Event Manager

Department

Sales & Marketing

Reports To

Director of Sales & Marketing / Director of Catering & Events

Job Summary

The Catering & Event Manager is responsible for generating catering and event revenue by securing new business, managing client relationships, and overseeing the planning and execution of meetings, conferences, weddings, social functions, and corporate events. This role ensures seamless event delivery by coordinating with all hotel departments while maximizing guest satisfaction and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Sales & Business Development

  • Identify, solicit, and develop new catering and event business.
  • Manage existing corporate, social, government, and wedding accounts.
  • Conduct sales calls, networking events, and site inspections.
  • Prepare proposals, quotations, contracts, and banquet event orders (BEOs).
  • Negotiate pricing, packages, and contractual terms within hotel guidelines.
  • Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual catering revenue targets.
  • Upsell food & beverage, meeting space, guest rooms, and hotel services.

Event Planning & Coordination

  • Plan and coordinate meetings, conferences, weddings, exhibitions, and social events.
  • Organize all event logistics, including room setup, audiovisual equipment, menus, décor, entertainment, and transportation.
  • Conduct pre-event meetings with clients and internal departments.
  • Prepare and distribute accurate Banquet Event Orders (BEOs).
  • Serve as the primary contact throughout the event.
  • Ensure all client requirements are executed according to contract specifications.
  • Manage last-minute changes and resolve operational issues promptly.

Client Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with clients, event planners, and travel partners.
  • Provide exceptional customer service before, during, and after each event.
  • Conduct post-event follow-up to gather feedback and secure repeat business.
  • Resolve guest concerns professionally and efficiently.

Revenue & Financial Management

  • Maximize event profitability through strategic pricing and upselling.
  • Monitor event budgets, deposits, billing, and final invoicing.
  • Forecast catering revenue and prepare sales reports.
  • Monitor competitor activities and market trends.
  • Ensure all financial documentation complies with hotel policies.

Cross-Department Coordination

  • Work closely with Banquets, Food & Beverage, Kitchen, Front Office, Housekeeping, Engineering, and Finance.
  • Coordinate staffing requirements and event timelines.
  • Ensure smooth communication among all operational departments.
  • Maintain high service standards throughout the event lifecycle.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Event Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Catering Sales, Event Management, Banquet Sales, or Hotel Sales.
  • Experience with hotel systems such as Opera PMS, Delphi, or other sales and catering software is preferred.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

Core Competencies

  • Catering Sales
  • Event Planning & Coordination
  • Business Development
  • Key Account Management
  • Negotiation & Contract Management
  • Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
  • Revenue Generation
  • Budget Management
  • Banquet Operations
  • Food & Beverage Knowledge
  • Leadership & Teamwork
  • Time Management
  • Problem Solving
  • Communication & Presentation Skills

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

De Retail Employee is het visitekaartje van de organisatie. Als Retail Employee bij TUI maak je klanten blij met een onvergetelijke herinnering. Een vakantie moet een feestje zijn, waar de reis ook heen gaat. Aan jou de taak, als Maker of Happy, om de oriëntatie- en boekingsfase van de reis zo plezierig mogelijk te maken. Soms is de perfecte reis zo gevonden, soms kost het wat meer moeite. Jij begeleidt de klant, biedt diverse opties en maakt er vooral een positieve ervaring van. Jij zorgt dat de klant Happy naar buiten loopt!

Hoe maak jij een impact

Er Zijn Vele Mogelijkheden Om Het Verschil Te Maken

  • Je inspireert en adviseert klanten bij het kiezen en boeken van hun ideale reis en aanvullende reisproducten.
  • Je voert persoonlijke klantgesprekken, brengt wensen en behoeften in kaart en vertaalt deze naar een passend reisadvies.
  • Je realiseert verkoopkansen door reizen en aanvullende diensten aan te bieden die aansluiten bij de wensen van de klant en de commerciële doelstellingen van TUI.
  • Je ondersteunt klanten bij vragen, wijzigingen, klachten en verzoeken met betrekking tot zowel nieuwe als reeds geboekte reizen.
  • Je maakt actief gebruik van beschikbare klantinformatie en aankoopgeschiedenis om de klantbeleving verder te personaliseren.
  • Je zorgt voor een correcte en actuele registratie van klantgegevens en klantvoorkeuren in onze CRM-systemen.
  • Je signaleert commerciële kansen en verbetermogelijkheden en deelt deze proactief met de Retail Manager.
  • Je levert een bijdrage aan lokale verkoopactiviteiten, promoties en andere initiatieven die het succes van de winkel vergroten.
  • Je zorgt voor een uitstekende klantbeleving en bouwt aan duurzame klantrelaties.
  • Je handelt professioneel en daadkrachtig bij calamiteiten en onverwachte situaties en onderhoudt waar nodig contact met klanten, thuisblijvers en interne stakeholders.

Wat breng je mee

Er Zijn Meerdere Manieren Waarop Je Een Match Kan Zijn Voor Deze Functie – Hier Zijn Een Aantal Zaken Die Wij Zoeken

  • Je hebt minimaal MBO niveau 4 werk- en denkniveau, aangevuld met kennis van de reisbranche, ANVR voorwaarden en topografische kennis.
  • Je hebt bij voorkeur minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring.
  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engels taal. Papiaments is een pre.
  • Je hebt enige kennis van de (ontikkelingen in de) Wet & Regelgeving zoals de Europese privacywet (AvG) en de Wet op de Reis overeenkomst.

Jij en TUI

Werken bij TUI brengt vele voordelen, extra’s en fun met zich mee:

  • Een doorlopende reisverzekering na je proeftijd.
  • 23 vakantiedagen op basis van een 40-urige werkweek, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen of een aantal te verkopen.
  • Voordeliger vliegen indien plaats beschikbaar met onze IPB regeling.
  • Personeelskorting op TUI vakanties.
  • Mogelijkheid tot pensioen sparen.
  • Wij bieden een open werkomgeving in een dynamische bedrijf.
  • Mogelijkheid tot verschillende trainingen uit ons Learning menu.
  • Verschillende welzijn activiteiten die maandelijks georganiseerd worden binnen TUI.

Van een werkplek naar een plek om erbij te horen. Bij TUI omarmen we diversiteit, gelijkheid en inclusie, en moedigen we iedereen aan om te komen zoals je bent, want samen is ons potentieel grenzeloos.

Bij TUI Dutch Caribbean werken ongeveer 150 medewerkers, verspreid over Curaçao, Aruba en Bonaire. TUI Dutch Caribbean maakt onderdeel uit van TUI Nederland.

Ons kantoor op Curaçao huisvest diverse afdelingen, waaronder de TUI Shop, Reisleiding & Musement, Customer Services en Station Management. Daarnaast fungeert deze locatie als thuisbasis voor onze op Curaçao gestationeerde cabinecrew.

Op Aruba en Bonaire bevinden zich onze TUI Shops en teams van Reisleiding & Musement, die dagelijks verantwoordelijk zijn voor het creëren van een uitstekende vakantie- en klantbeleving op de bestemming.

Samen zetten onze collega’s zich in om klanten een onvergetelijke reiservaring te bieden, vanaf het moment van boeken tot en met hun terugkeer van de bestemming.

Location & Workplace Type

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

As Senior Analyst, Pay‑In (B2B), you will own and execute key Pay‑In and AR processes for Agoda’s B2B partner flows. You will be a subject‑matter expert on B2B cash and receivables, ensuring accurate and timely booking‑to‑cash accounting, reconciliation, and reporting, while supporting new product and partner launches.

In this role, you will:

  • Run day‑to‑day Pay‑In & AR operations for B2B flows
    • Perform daily and monthly tasks for B2B AR and Pay‑In accounts (e.g., bookings, invoicing, receipts, credit card settlements, write‑offs, reclasses).
    • Ensure that financial data for which you are responsible is accurate, complete, and delivered on time.
    • Monitor B2B receivables aging and cash‑in‑transit (CIT) balances, following up on unusual items and long‑outstanding items.
  • Manage B2B invoicing and cash application
    • Support and execute invoicing to B2B partners and/or intercompany entities, including aggregation logic and partner-specific configurations.
    • Reconcile cash receipts vs invoices and settlement reports for B2B partners, ensuring correct allocation at booking / CID / partner level.
    • Resolve payment‑related queries and discrepancies with internal stakeholders and partners with satisfactory outcomes.
  • Lead B2B reconciliation activities
    • Perform end‑to‑end reconciliation between:
      • Booking systems, B2B invoicing, and general ledger.
      • B2B settlement reports / gateway reports, bank statements, and AR Reconciliator outputs.
    • Investigate and resolve recon breaks and data issues in collaboration with Tech, Product, and other Finance teams.
    • Maintain and monitor CIT aging, ensuring timely clearing and appropriate accounting treatment.
  • Support new B2B products, partners, and projects
    • Provide operational finance support for new B2B initiatives (e.g., partner onboarding, new merchant flows, new business models).
    • Participate in UAT for system changes (e.g., ERP/Invoicing systems), ensuring correct Accounts Receivable behavior before go‑live.
    • Provide input on process and system design from an operational and control perspective.
  • Ensure strong internal controls and SOX compliance
    • Ensure that processes and documentation under your scope comply with internal policies and SOX control requirements.
    • Identify unusual items, exceptions, and control gaps, escalate appropriately, and drive timely resolution.
    • Support internal and external audits by preparing reconciliations, explanations, and evidence.
  • Drive continuous improvement
    • Identify opportunities to streamline and automate B2B Pay‑In and AR processes and reports, including elimination of unnecessary steps.
    • Provide inputs on required changes to related daily activities, reconciliations, and dashboards.
    • Contribute to the overall management and development of the Pay‑In & AR tower, including the successful achievement of its goals and objectives.
  • Coach and collaborate
    • Provide guidance and support to more junior team members in daily transaction processing and reconciliation work.
    • Proactively partner and fairly support stakeholders within Finance (Accounting, Tax, FP&A, Treasury, R&C) and outside Finance (Product, Tech, B2B / PPS teams).
    • Support the team to deliver ad hoc analyses, reports, and project work as needed.
What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3–4 years’ experience in Accounting / Finance Operations, preferably with exposure to:
    • Pay‑In, AR, or revenue reconciliation; and/or
    • B2B, affiliate, or payment operations (e.g., gateways, card settlements, invoicing).
  • Experience in a multinational company; travel / e‑commerce / online platform industry is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines.
  • Experience in transaction processing, reconciliations, and month‑end closing, including handling more complex transactions.
  • Proficient in MS Office (especially Excel); comfortable working with large data sets and multiple systems.
  • Dynamic and able to adapt to a fast‑paced, changing environment.
  • Strong teamwork skills – ability to collaborate, influence, and communicate effectively with other teams, both within and outside of Finance.
  • Energetic, proactive, and taking initiative, with effective verbal and written communication skills in English.

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience with ERP systems (Oracle preferred) and/or finance subledgers (e.g., AR reconciliation tools, revenue recognition systems).
  • Prior experience in online travel, payments, or B2B/Affiliate finance operations
  • Familiarity with SOX controls and audit requirements.
  • Experience with data / BI tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Looker, or similar) is a plus.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As an International Market Manager in the International Team, you will be in charge of:

  • Market Selection & Strategic GTM: Devising and implementing long-term go-to-market strategies for high-potential regions outside Europe, going beyond basic market analysis to define clear investment roadmaps.
  • Entrepreneurial Execution: Taking end-to-end ownership of market entry and localization efforts; actively identifying customer gaps, testing value propositions with other teams support.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Transforming complex quantitative data—including traffic patterns, market dynamics, and local competitor benchmarking—into actionable business cases to influence project prioritization across global functional teams.
  • AI & Scalability Mindset: Championing the integration of AI tools, automation, and machine-learning insights into daily workflows and regional strategy to maximize operational impact and scaling speed with minimal resources.
  • International P&L Efficiency: Overseeing and optimizing the full Profit and Loss (P&L) statement for the targeted markets and ensuring efficiencies in all the Revenue and Cost lines.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partnering closely with Product, Revenue, Marketing, Legal, and senior leadership to ensure local compliance, product market fit, and aligned strategic execution.

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:

  • Advanced Analytics & Data Literacy: Strong quantitative skills with a proven capability to manage key performance metrics, optimize full P&Ls, and make decisions rooted firmly in data.
  • AI Forward-Thinker: An individual who naturally looks for ways to leverage AI and automation to streamline processes, predict market trends, and scale operations intelligently.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Exemplary communication and leadership skills, capable of influencing diverse, cross-functional teams and aligning senior leaders around data-driven observations.
  • Language & Industry Knowledge: Fluency in English is required (Spanish is a plus). A solid understanding of the Online Travel Agency (OTA) competitive landscape or experience within the Latin American or Asian e-commerce market is a major advantage.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
  • Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
  • AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
  • Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.


What's in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture.

  • Your Well-being is our Priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcomes. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.

Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
  • Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.


Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

  • Set legal standards and provide oversight for our privacy operational processes, working closely with stakeholders across the business.

  • Genuine interest in AI regulation and the legal implications of AI-powered products and internal tooling
  • A builder mindset - curious about using AI tools to improve legal processes and willing to contribute to internal tooling, not just consume it

At Priceline, we pride ourselves on being the best travel deal makers in the world, all in support of our purpose to help consumers experience the moments that matter most. As a pioneer in online travel, we are on an exciting journey to reignite our brand superiority and weave Priceline into the cultural conversation.

This role, reporting to the Senior Director of Brand Marketing, will support the programming, optimization, and measurement of Priceline’s promotional activities to drive commercial growth and brand consideration.

Why This Job’s a Big Deal

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Promotions to help shape how Priceline’s deals and promotional moments show up across the site and app.

This role will bring rigor to how our promotions are merchandised, tested, and measured - ensuring our deals are not only compelling but consistently optimized to drive bookings and customer engagement.

In This Role You Will Get To

  • Promotions Merchandising: Support the Promotions Manager in bringing promotional campaigns to life onsite, owning homepage hero content and select placements while helping optimize how deals are surfaced and merchandised across the Priceline experience.
  • Structured Experimentation: Develop a learning agenda and roadmap to continuously test and refine promotional elements such as deal framing, urgency messaging, homepage placements, landing page structures, and discount strategies to improve conversion and booking performance.
  • Measurement & Reporting: Establish frameworks for tracking promotional performance across site and app placements, defining success benchmarks and enabling consistent analysis of engagement and booking impact.
  • Manage High-Stakes Seasonality: Work with promotions manager to plan and execute high-stakes seasonal events with flawless precision.
  • Product Partnership: Partner with Product and Engineering to bring promotional needs and insights into feature development, helping shape tools and capabilities that improve how promotions are surfaced and optimized across the site.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Lead cross-functional teams across Ad Sales, Messaging, Product, and Commercial partners, bringing clarity and alignment to complex initiatives with competing priorities and stakeholders.
  • QA Management: Lead and strengthen QA processes for promotions by establishing clear review workflows and launch readiness standards that ensure accurate and seamless execution.
  • Promotional Operations: Drive complex cross-functional promotional initiatives by establishing clear briefs, timelines, and operating processes that keep teams aligned and high-frequency launches on track.

Who You Are

  • Experienced Ecommerce Leader: 7–10+ years in ecommerce, site merchandising, retail promotions, or marketplace commerce within a large-scale consumer business.
  • Commercially Minded: You understand what makes a compelling deal and how promotional framing influences customer engagement and bookings.
  • Analytical & Data-Driven: You are comfortable analyzing performance data and translating insights into improvements for future promotions. Experience with tools such as Google Analytics, Tableau, or similar platforms is preferred.
  • Technical Collaborator: You are comfortable partnering with Product and Engineering teams and can help translate promotional needs into product requirements.
  • Operationally Strong: You enjoy bringing structure to complex initiatives and building the processes that allow teams to execute high-frequency promotions smoothly.
  • Team Leader and Mentor: You will provide guidance and mentorship, helping them grow their skills while maintaining high standards for execution and collaboration.
  • Tools & Platforms: Experience working with Contentful or similar CMS platforms, as well as merchandising tools, analytics tools, or similar systems used to launch and manage onsite promotions.
  • Demonstrated history of living the values important to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
  • The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. It’s therefore essential that you also meet our high standard of ethics, honesty, transparency and compliance

In addition to a competitive base salary, certain roles may be eligible for an annual bonus and/or equity grant.

The salary range for this position is $130,000- $160,000 USD.

Who We Are

WE ARE PRICELINE.

Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.

Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.

We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

Flexible work at Priceline

Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.

Perks & Benefits At Priceline

Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:

Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources

Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

A people-first culture with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together

Specific benefits and programs vary by location.

Inclusion is a Big Deal!

To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.

Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.

job.company_description:
Sojern is a Travel Marketing Platform that helps you find, attract, convert, and engage your customers throughout the travel buying journey.
We deliver your marketing messages directly to travelers and provide you with the insights, expertise, and technology needed to drive growth and maximize revenue for your travel business.
We deliver unrivaled traveler insight, intelligent audiences, multichannel activation and optimization, and a connected guest experience for hotels – all in one place.
job.job_description:
About Us:


Sojern is the leading AI-powered marketing platform built for hospitality, designed to boost growth and profitability for the travel industry. The Sojern marketing platform is a set of easy-to-use software and services that delivers unrivaled traveler insight, intelligent audiences, multichannel activation and optimization, and a connected guest experience—all in one place. More than 10,000 travel marketers rely on our platform annually to find, attract, convert and engage travelers. Sojern was founded in 2007 and acquired by RateGain in 2025, with teams in the Americas, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and Asia Pacific.


About the Role:


We are seeking a highly skilled Staff CPQ Administrator to join our team during an exciting period of technological transformation. We are currently evaluating our overall CPQ strategy and are exploring a potential migration from Salesforce CPQ to a next-generation platform like DealHub.

The ideal candidate will be a hybrid expert with deep, hands-on experience in Salesforce CPQ and, ideally, experience with DealHub (or similar modern CPQ solutions). You will play a pivotal role in maintaining and optimizing our current Salesforce CPQ instance using lean, "skeleton" framework models, while actively serving as a key architectural and administrative driver for our future CPQ state.


This position sits within the broader Salesforce team supporting Sojern’s business operations across Sales, Client Success, Operations, Product Management, Legal, and Finance. You will ensure our quoting systems meet urgent business requirements today while paving a seamless, flexible path for our upcoming CPQ evolution.


Responsibilities:


Strategic Architecture & Potential Migration

  • Act as the internal champion and technical lead for our CPQ transformation and a potential system migration (e.g., transitioning from Salesforce CPQ to DealHub).
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external consultants to evaluate and design future CPQ architecture, ensuring it supports our long-term sales strategies, pricing, and product structures.
  • Assist in formulating and executing data migration strategies between Salesforce instances, including accounts, opportunities, CPQ objects, and non-CPQ contracts.
  • Build and maintain "skeleton framework models" within the legacy Salesforce CPQ system to meet urgent, immediate business needs without over-engineering a platform that may eventually be retired.


System Administration & Support

  • Design, develop, and administer CPQ solutions (managing our current Salesforce CPQ footprint while preparing for a transformative shift) and ensure seamless integration with our Salesforce infrastructure.
  • Handle Tier 2 support tickets and perform project tasks including product setup, quoting processes, and the creation of price/product rules.
  • Manage approvals related to CPQ and make proactive changes based on business requirements.
  • Ensure data is accurately passed and maintained across Salesforce, Netsuite, and our internal Portal 3.0 system to maintain clear systems of record.
  • Assist with developing complex declarative automation on the Sales Cloud and Service Cloud implementations (e.g., building Flows, field updates).


Business Partnering & Enablement

  • Consult and manage the needs of cross-functional business partners including Pricing, Legal, Finance, Sales, and Leadership, translating functional requirements into technical builds.
  • Gather requirements to deliver and communicate enhancements to platform stakeholders.
  • Provide comprehensive end-user support and training tailored to both the current Salesforce CPQ processes and upcoming workflow changes.
  • Create and maintain robust technical and functional documentation on system configurations, migration mapping, and support resources.


Requirements:


  • CPQ Experience: 5+ years of hands-on administration experience with Salesforce CPQ or DealHub. Experience evaluating and implementing CPQ tooling is highly desired (preferrably DealHub experience)
  • Salesforce Experience: 5+ years of Salesforce administrative and functional design experience.
  • AI & Automation: Demonstrated interest or experience in evaluating and integrating AI tools to streamline CRM/CPQ processes and boost operational efficiency.
  • Transformation Expertise: Demonstrable experience migrating, modernizing, or transforming complex CPQ systems (specifically moving off Salesforce CPQ to another vendor is a major plus).
  • Certifications: Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist certification (CPQ 301) is strongly preferred.
  • Cloud Knowledge: Deep understanding of Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
  • Consulting Background: Previous CPQ consulting experience is a strong bonus (exposure to a wide range of CPQ implementations and architectures).

job.job_description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

As Senior Analyst, Pay‑In (B2B), you will own and execute key Pay‑In and AR processes for Agoda’s B2B partner flows. You will be a subject‑matter expert on B2B cash and receivables, ensuring accurate and timely booking‑to‑cash accounting, reconciliation, and reporting, while supporting new product and partner launches.

In this role, you will:

  • Run day‑to‑day Pay‑In & AR operations for B2B flows
    • Perform daily and monthly tasks for B2B AR and Pay‑In accounts (e.g., bookings, invoicing, receipts, credit card settlements, write‑offs, reclasses).
    • Ensure that financial data for which you are responsible is accurate, complete, and delivered on time.
    • Monitor B2B receivables aging and cash‑in‑transit (CIT) balances, following up on unusual items and long‑outstanding items.
  • Manage B2B invoicing and cash application
    • Support and execute invoicing to B2B partners and/or intercompany entities, including aggregation logic and partner-specific configurations.
    • Reconcile cash receipts vs invoices and settlement reports for B2B partners, ensuring correct allocation at booking / CID / partner level.
    • Resolve payment‑related queries and discrepancies with internal stakeholders and partners with satisfactory outcomes.
  • Lead B2B reconciliation activities
    • Perform end‑to‑end reconciliation between:
      • Booking systems, B2B invoicing, and general ledger.
      • B2B settlement reports / gateway reports, bank statements, and AR Reconciliator outputs.
    • Investigate and resolve recon breaks and data issues in collaboration with Tech, Product, and other Finance teams.
    • Maintain and monitor CIT aging, ensuring timely clearing and appropriate accounting treatment.
  • Support new B2B products, partners, and projects
    • Provide operational finance support for new B2B initiatives (e.g., partner onboarding, new merchant flows, new business models).
    • Participate in UAT for system changes (e.g., ERP/Invoicing systems), ensuring correct Accounts Receivable behavior before go‑live.
    • Provide input on process and system design from an operational and control perspective.
  • Ensure strong internal controls and SOX compliance
    • Ensure that processes and documentation under your scope comply with internal policies and SOX control requirements.
    • Identify unusual items, exceptions, and control gaps, escalate appropriately, and drive timely resolution.
    • Support internal and external audits by preparing reconciliations, explanations, and evidence.
  • Drive continuous improvement
    • Identify opportunities to streamline and automate B2B Pay‑In and AR processes and reports, including elimination of unnecessary steps.
    • Provide inputs on required changes to related daily activities, reconciliations, and dashboards.
    • Contribute to the overall management and development of the Pay‑In & AR tower, including the successful achievement of its goals and objectives.
  • Coach and collaborate
    • Provide guidance and support to more junior team members in daily transaction processing and reconciliation work.
    • Proactively partner and fairly support stakeholders within Finance (Accounting, Tax, FP&A, Treasury, R&C) and outside Finance (Product, Tech, B2B / PPS teams).
    • Support the team to deliver ad hoc analyses, reports, and project work as needed.
What you’ll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3–4 years’ experience in Accounting / Finance Operations, preferably with exposure to:
    • Pay‑In, AR, or revenue reconciliation; and/or
    • B2B, affiliate, or payment operations (e.g., gateways, card settlements, invoicing).
  • Experience in a multinational company; travel / e‑commerce / online platform industry is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines.
  • Experience in transaction processing, reconciliations, and month‑end closing, including handling more complex transactions.
  • Proficient in MS Office (especially Excel); comfortable working with large data sets and multiple systems.
  • Dynamic and able to adapt to a fast‑paced, changing environment.
  • Strong teamwork skills – ability to collaborate, influence, and communicate effectively with other teams, both within and outside of Finance.
  • Energetic, proactive, and taking initiative, with effective verbal and written communication skills in English.

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience with ERP systems (Oracle preferred) and/or finance subledgers (e.g., AR reconciliation tools, revenue recognition systems).
  • Prior experience in online travel, payments, or B2B/Affiliate finance operations
  • Familiarity with SOX controls and audit requirements.
  • Experience with data / BI tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Looker, or similar) is a plus.

job.job_description:
Change the way the world travels

Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours.

Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.

Team mission

Supply Marketing turns suppliers into long-term partners by owning the B2B marketing funnel from first touch to loyalty — exciting, engaging, and enabling them to grow with us. For example, we run joint campaigns with top suppliers and promote them across a mix of internal and external marketing channels. By providing exposure and helping suppliers with their business needs, these campaigns are a powerful way for GetYourGuide to strengthen strategic relationships and can be leveraged to negotiate better commercial terms.

We’re looking for a Partnerships Lead, NEA with a strong emphasis on Japan (and surrounding markets such as China, South Korea, and Taiwan depending on scope). This role sits at the intersection of B2B partner marketing, strategic supplier growth, and cross-functional execution, with a focus on building high-impact programs for priority suppliers and navigating the unique needs of the Japanese market.

A core part of the role is owning the destination / DMO partnership motion in Japan: securing external sponsorship funding and translating destination partnerships into measurable growth (GMV uplift and accelerated supply onboarding), leveraging tourism boards and public-sector stakeholders as strategic multipliers for GetYourGuide.

This is a senior individual contributor role with high ownership, visibility, and partner-facing responsibility.

Your mission

  • Own the NEA supply marketing strategy with a strong focus on Japan — adapting global supply marketing strategy to local market dynamics, partner needs, and growth priorities.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with top attractions, tour operators, and key ecosystem stakeholders — including government agencies / destination bodies / tourism boards where relevant.
  • Develop and manage a destination/DMO partnership pipeline to secure external sponsorship support that subsidizes customer acquisition and drives GMV volume for GetYourGuide.
  • Create, pitch, negotiate, and execute joint marketing initiatives (e.g., co-marketing campaigns, seasonal demand pushes, product launches, always-on visibility packages), ensuring win-win outcomes for GetYourGuide and partners.
  • Partner closely with Sales / Supply leadership to support supplier acquisition and development efforts — using marketing and destination partnerships as levers to unlock strategic relationships, improved commercial terms, and faster onboarding pathways.
  • Convert destination partner relationships into scalable supply acceleration (e.g., one-to-many onboarding initiatives, warm introductions, whitelists, and partner-enabled lead generation).
  • Lead end-to-end program execution by working cross-functionally with campaign managers and internal marketing teams to deliver initiatives on time and to a high quality bar.
  • Develop high-impact narratives and presentations — translating partner goals into compelling proposals supported by clear value propositions and measurable outcomes.
  • Track performance and iterate: define success metrics, report on results, and continuously improve programs based on insights and partner feedback.

Your toolkit

  • 7+ years of experience in B2B marketing, partnerships, business development, sales, supplier/account management, or strategic programs (agency experience considered if you’ve led complex partner programs).
  • Fluent in Japanese and English. You can confidently present, negotiate, and build trust in Japanese business settings.
  • Critical: hands-on experience working with Japanese businesses in Japan (not only with overseas branches). You understand local business norms, relationship-building, decision-making processes, and the nuances/unspoken rules—especially in public-sector contexts.
  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling partner marketing programs (co-marketing, joint business plans, go-to-market initiatives, partner enablement, etc.).
  • Highly preferred: experience working with government agencies, tourism boards, municipalities, public-sector bodies, or similar — ideally involving procurement processes, formal partnerships, tenders, or multi-stakeholder governance.
  • Commercially sharp and outcome-driven: comfortable building a pipeline, negotiating funding/value exchange with senior stakeholders, and translating partnerships into measurable growth outcomes.
  • Strong stakeholder management: you can align Sales, Marketing, Product, and Ops around shared outcomes.
  • Strategic (think 6+ months ahead) but hands-on and execution-oriented.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and storytelling skills; comfortable influencing without authority.
  • Analytical and impact-driven: you care about measurable outcomes and can translate insights into action.
  • Familiarity with the Japan travel / attractions / tours landscape is a strong advantage.

Extras that give you an edge

  • Experience in digital marketing (paid, CRM, onsite merchandising, performance measurement) and/or brand marketing.
  • Experience with enterprise-level attractions (museums, observation decks, theme parks), transportation-linked experiences, or large tour operators.
  • Experience operating across multiple NEA markets beyond Japan.

How We’ll Make Your Career Journey Extraordinary

  • Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
  • Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
  • A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.
  • Opportunities to collaborate and socialize with team members through quarterly team events and yearly company-wide events
  • Monthly transportation and fitness budget
  • Discounts for you, your friends, and family on GetYourGuide activities
  • Language reimbursement program
  • Health and wellness benefits

And more…

How To Apply

Submit your CV/resume in English using the form below. For tips and insights into our hiring process and culture, check out ‘how we hire’ and ‘life at GetYourGuide’. If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to get in touch at jobs@getyourguide.com.

We’re an equal opportunities employer

Our commitment is that every qualified person will be evaluated according to their skills regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. Please refrain from including your picture and age with your application.

世界の旅のあり方を変えよう

GetYourGuideの一員として、世界中の人々を忘れられない旅行体験へとつなぐ旅に参加しませんか。何百万人ものユーザーが、信頼できるユニークなアクティビティを求めて私たちを利用しています。それを支えているのは、すべての旅を特別なものにするという私たちのコミットメントです――それはあなた自身の旅も含まれます。

探究心あふれる仲間たちとともに、自分の可能性を広げる準備はできていますか？ベルリン本社、またはニューヨークからバンコクまで世界各地の拠点で、あなたにぴったりのポジションを見つけてください。最初の一歩は getyourguide.careers から。

チームのミッション

サプライマーケティングは、サプライヤーを長期的なパートナーへと変えることを目的とし、最初の接点からロイヤルティに至るまでのB2Bマーケティングファネル全体を担います。魅力的で、エンゲージメントを高め、サプライヤーが当社とともに成長できるよう支援します。

例えば、主要サプライヤーとの共同キャンペーンを実施し、社内外の多様なマーケティングチャネルを通じてプロモーションを行っています。サプライヤーに露出機会を提供し、ビジネスニーズを支援することで、これらのキャンペーンは戦略的関係を強化し、より良い商業条件の交渉にもつながる重要な手段となります。

現在、日本を含む北東アジア地域のパートナーシップリードを募集しています。特に日本市場（および必要に応じて中国、韓国、台湾など周辺市場）に重点を置いたポジションです。本ポジションは、B2Bパートナーマーケティング、戦略的サプライヤー獲得、部門横断的な実行の交差点に位置し、戦略的なパートナー向けのプログラム構築と、日本市場特有のニーズへの対応に注力します。

本ポジションの重要な役割の一つは、日本におけるDMO（観光局）パートナーシップの推進です。外部スポンサー資金の確保や、観光局・公共機関との連携を通じて、GMV（流通総額）の向上や掲載商品の拡充といった測定可能な成長へとつなげます。

本ポジションは、高いオーナーシップと重要度が高い、パートナー対応を担うシニアレベルポジションです。

ミッション（職務内容）

  • 日本を中心とした北東アジア地域のサプライマーケティング戦略を策定・推進し、グローバル戦略を現地市場に適応させる
  • 主要な観光施設、ツアーオペレーター、政府機関・観光局などのステークホルダーとの戦略的関係を構築・維持する
  • 外部スポンサー資金を獲得するためのDMOパートナーシップのパイプラインを構築・管理する
  • 共同マーケティング施策（キャンペーン、季節プロモーション、新商品ローンチなど）の企画・提案・交渉・実行を行う
  • 営業・サプライ部門と連携し、マーケティングを通じてサプライヤー獲得・育成を支援する
  • パートナー関係を活用し、掲載商品拡大を推進する（例：一括登録施策など）
  • 社内のマーケティングチームと連携し、プログラムの企画から実行までをリードする
  • 高い説得力を持つ提案資料・ストーリーを作成する
  • KPIを設定し、成果を測定・分析しながら継続的に改善する

応募要件（スキル・経験）

  • B2Bマーケティング、パートナーシップ、事業開発、営業、アカウント管理などで7年以上の経験
  • 日本語・英語ともにビジネスレベルで流暢
  • 日本国内企業との実務経験（海外拠点のみは不可）
  • 日本特有の商習慣や意思決定プロセスへの深い理解（特に公共分野）
  • パートナーマーケティングプログラムの構築・拡大経験
  • 官公庁や観光局などとの協業経験があれば尚可
  • 高いビジネス感覚と成果志向
  • 優れたステークホルダーマネジメント能力
  • 戦略的思考と実行力の両立
  • 優れたコミュニケーション・交渉・ストーリーテリング能力
  • データ分析に基づいた意思決定能力
  • 日本の旅行・観光業界への理解があれば尚可

歓迎スキル

  • デジタルマーケティングまたはブランドマーケティングの経験
  • 大規模観光施設やツアー会社との業務経験
  • 日本以外の北東アジア市場での業務経験

福利厚生

  • 年間の自己成長予算およびメンタープログラム
  • 年間30日間のリモートワーク（海外可）
  • 週3日のオフィス勤務＋2日の在宅勤務のハイブリッド体制
  • チームイベント・全社イベント
  • 交通費・フィットネス補助
  • GetYourGuideのアクティビティ割引
  • 語学学習補助
  • 健康・ウェルネス支援

ほか多数

応募方法

英語の履歴書を提出してください。採用プロセスや企業文化については「how we hire」「life at GetYourGuide」をご覧ください。ご質問は jobs@getyourguide.com までお気軽にお問い合わせください。

多様性と機会均等について

当社は機会均等を重視しています。年齢、性自認、人種、性的指向、障がい、宗教に関わらず、すべての応募者をスキルに基づいて公平に評価します。履歴書には写真や年齢の記載は不要です。

job.job_description:
Air Product Specialist

At Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), our journey began in 1973 with a single double-decker bus. Today, we’ve grown into a global travel powerhouse, headquartered in Brisbane, Australia, with a dynamic presence in 23 countries. As one of the world’s largest travel retailers and corporate travel managers, we’re not just experts – we are a passionate family of adventurers. We live and breathe travel, united by a mission to create unforgettable experiences and open up the world for those that want to see.

To learn more about Flight Centre please click HERE

About The Opportunity

Join a high-impact product team where your expertise in air travel sourcing, pricing, and supplier partnerships will directly influence our competitive edge. As an Air Product Specialist, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping compelling, market-leading flight offers across multiple channels. You’ll collaborate with global and regional teams to deliver innovative product solutions, optimize performance, and empower consultants with the tools and knowledge they need to succeed. If you thrive in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and love building strong supplier relationships, this role offers exciting opportunities to make your mark.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source and identify best-in-market air deals to ensure strong product availability across core, campaign, and tactical ranges
  • Partner with Supply/Procurement teams to secure competitive, exclusive offers aligned with strategy
  • Negotiate supplier deals that support campaign and promotional calendars
  • Build and maintain strong supplier and internal stakeholder relationships
  • Manage the full lifecycle of product offers from sourcing through execution and retirement
  • Curate and maintain a library of “hot offers” tailored to market needs
  • Ensure product content is accurate, compelling, and optimized across all platforms
  • Adapt global offers for regional relevance while maintaining brand consistency
  • Monitor product performance and provide optimization recommendations
  • Analyze sales data, conversion, margins, and campaign effectiveness
  • Conduct competitive analysis to maintain market relevance and advantage
  • Deliver reporting and insights to inform product strategy and decisions
  • Collaborate with Learning & Development teams to support training and enablement initiatives
  • Develop product guides, tools, and training to enhance consultant capability
  • Coordinate supplier training sessions and webinars
  • Partner with Revenue Management & Pricing teams for optimal pricing strategies
  • Work with offshore teams to ensure accurate and efficient deal loading
  • Support new product launches and supplier onboarding initiatives
  • Maintain accuracy and integrity of product data across systems
  • Act as liaison between category teams and country packaging specialists
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive.

Experience & Qualifications

  • 5+ years of travel industry experience with strong category product focus
  • 2+ years in a product role involving sourcing and deal creation
  • Strong experience negotiating with suppliers and managing partnerships
  • Proven ability to analyze data and translate insights into action
  • Experience working cross-functionally with global and remote teams
  • Strong understanding of flight products, pricing structures, and fare rules
  • Advanced GDS proficiency (Sabre/Amadeus)
  • Knowledge of airline ticketing rules and regulations
  • Experience developing or supporting training and enablement initiatives preferred
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong commercial and business acumen
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun: At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts: Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel: We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections: We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job: We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back: Committed to making a difference through our Corporate Social Responsibility program, which supports nominated charities via volunteering and fundraising, our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Generous paid time off policy
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Group benefits including extended health care, dental and vision, gender affirming care, fertility care
  • Insurance including life, AD&D, critical illness, long term disability
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • RRSP/RPP with matching
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

Location – Toronto, Canada

This posting reflects an active vacancy that we are currently seeking to fill.

For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary of $72,000. The salary is dependent on relevant factors, including experience, geographic location, and job requirements.

We welcome applications from candidates with diverse experiences.

We thank all candidates for their interest; however, only those selected to continue in the process will be contacted.

As part of our recruitment process, AI tools may assist in the screening and assessment of applications. Final hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team and hiring managers.

Our number one philosophy? Our people. Flight Centre Travel Group’s promise is to provide an environment with equality of respect, dignity and opportunity for all our employees. We value an inclusive and supportive workplace which truly reflects the diversity of our society.

We are committed to providing a barrier-free pathway throughout our recruitment process. We welcome accommodation requests to make our hiring and onboarding experience as accessible as possible. Please advise us about accommodation needs at any point by contacting our Recruitment Team at fccareers@flightcentre.ca
