job.job_description:
Pay Range: $70,300-$75,000 + bonus eligible

This is an exempt position and will be paid on a salaried basis in accordance with state and federal law.

Driving is required for this position; screening will be required.

Job Summary

Supports all property operations, ensuring that the highest levels of hospitality and service are provided. Manages the flow of questions and directs guests within the lobby. Supports the tracking and resolution of service issues.

Candidate Profile

Education And Experience

  • High school diploma or GED; 1 year experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.


Or

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.


Core Work Activities

Managing Guest Services and Front Desk Operations

  • Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
  • Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
  • Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
  • Supervises and manages employees. Understanding employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence.


Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals

  • Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
  • Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
  • Supports handling complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
  • Assists with energy conservation efforts by monitoring compliance during property tours.


Supporting Projects and Policies Related to Guest Experience and Safety

  • Supports implementation of the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.
  • Supports regular inspection tours of the entire facility for appearance, safety, staffing, security, and maintenance.
  • Sends copy of MOD report to all departments on a daily basis.
  • Ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.
  • Understands and can implement all emergency plans including accident, death, elevator, thefts, vicious crimes, bombs, fire, etc.
  • Understands and complies with loss prevention policies and procedures.


Ensuring and Providing Exceptional Customer Service

  • Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
  • Intervenes in any guest/employee situation as needed to insure the integrity of the property is maintained, guest satisfaction is achieved, and employee well being is preserved.
  • Serves as a leader in displaying outstanding hospitality skills.
  • Sets a positive example for guest relations.
  • Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.
  • Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.
  • Maintains high visibility in public areas during peak times.
  • Provides immediate assistance to guests as requested.
  • Interacts with customers on a regular basis throughout the property to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.
  • Records guest issues in the guest response tracking system.
  • Reviews comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.
  • Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.


Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

  • Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.
  • Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
  • Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.


Additional Responsibilities

  • Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
  • Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
  • Informs and/or updating the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.
  • Maintains a bold working relationship with all departments to support property operations and goals and to expedite the resolution of any problems that may arise through the general operation of the property.
  • Communicates any variations to the established norms to the appropriate department in a timely manner.
  • Participates as needed in the investigation of employee and guest accidents.
  • Performs Front Desk duties in high demand times.


Hyatt Vacation Ownership is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture.

This position is at a location where Hyatt is not the employer. The employer of individuals working at this hotel may be a third-party management company that is responsible for all employment benefits and obligations at this location.

About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.


Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.


We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.


We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


Key Roles and Responsibilities:

- Develop and implement go-to-market strategies for the Thailand market, identifying opportunities for growth and expansion.

- Monitor and report on the overall performance of the Thailand market to the senior management, identifying areas for improvement.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with partners and stakeholders, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and standards in Thailand operations.

- Monitor the performance of campaigns and projects using data analysis and BI skills, optimizing future campaigns and projects, improving customer experience, and analyzing conversion rates.

- Provide guidance and support to the team, ensuring each function performs at its best to collectively boost the growth of the Thailand market.

- Work closely with headquarters and other local departments and teams to ensure local operations align with overall business objectives.

- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and developments, ensuring the company remains at the forefront of offshore technology and innovation.

﻿

Qualifications and Experiences Desired:

- 7+ years of experience in the local travel, e-commerce, and online-platform industry.

- Experience in a fast-paced, startup or scale-up environment is preferred.

- Strong knowledge of Thailand regulations and standards in digital marketing.

- Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

- Fluent in English and native Thai. Mandarin speaking is a plus

- Strong analytical skills and mindset, preferably familiar with analytics tools.

- Proven ability to manage and lead a team, delivering projects on time and within budget.

- Willingness to travel moderately.

We offer a stage to unleash your full potential and drive global impact. As an international team, we embrace an open and inclusive culture that supports and respect team members in and out of the workplace. Everyone is on a trip, whether it's a career trip or a life trip. The Munich Marriott City West is setting new benchmarks for meetings and events. Inspired by the Bavarian way of life, the hotel features 398 spacious guest rooms and suites and nearly 5,000 square metres of versatile event space, including a state-of-the-art conference centre, making it the ideal venue for tailor-made, first-class events of every kind.The upscale dining concept includes the Italian Assoluto Restaurant & Vineria with its open show kitchen, the Assoluto Deli, and the westhub Lounge & Bar, offering exceptional culinary experiences paired with genuine hospitality in a stylish setting.Guests are equally impressed by the spectacular Cloud6 rooftop terrace and the exclusive M Club Lounge, both offering panoramic views across Munich and, on clear days, all the way to the Bavarian Alps.Located in Munich's vibrant Westend district, the hotel enjoys a central location just moments from the historic city centre and within walking distance of the world-famous Oktoberfest grounds.

JOIN OUR HOTELTEAM

  • as Assistant Director of Engineering (m/f/d) for Munich Marriott Hotel City West!

Your role...

As Assistant Director of Engineering, you are the first point of contact for the hotel team whenever technical challenges arise. You enjoy working in a state-of-the-art hotel equipped with the latest technology and take pride in ensuring that all building systems operate smoothly and efficiently. You organize the daily workflow of the Engineering team, monitor progress, and provide guidance and hands-on support whenever needed. You also serve as the primary contact for external contractors and have a thorough understanding of building safety and fire protection regulations. Working closely with the Director of Engineering, you support a wide range of projects and day-to-day operations. Throughout the hotel, you are known for your practical mindset, collaborative approach, and ability to find effective solutions to technical challenges.

What Your Responsibilities Are...

  • You share responsibility for the hotel’s entire technical infrastructure – from plant engineering and building structure to all FF&E.
  • You plan, coordinate, and monitor maintenance, inspection, and repair activities, ensuring with a forward-looking approach that all technical systems operate reliably at all times.
  • Together with the Director of Engineering, you develop technical strategies, plan investments, and support projects as well as the continuous improvement of our technical standards.
  • You keep an eye on energy and resource consumption, analyse optimisation potential, and contribute ideas to sustainably reduce operating costs and usage.
  • You share responsibility for building safety and ensure that guests, employees, and external partners can always move within a safe environment.
  • Preventive and organisational fire protection also falls within your area of responsibility – from regular inspections to compliance with all legal requirements.
  • You coordinate and supervise external service providers and contractors, ensuring high-quality execution of all work.
  • You take on technical leadership of the entire engineering team, organise daily workflows, and support your team with your operational expertise.
  • You fully represent the Director of Engineering in their absence.
  • You are responsible for shift planning as well as the creation of duty and on-call schedules, ensuring smooth staffing coverage.
  • You support new team members during onboarding and create a motivating working environment where collaboration and development are prioritised.
  • You work closely with all hotel departments as well as the leadership team and are a valued contact for technical matters across the entire property.

That's What We Want From You....

  • You have completed vocational training in a recognised technical or skilled trade profession (e.g. electrician for energy and building technology, HVAC systems technician, mechatronics technician, or similar).
  • Further training as a master craftsman or state-certified technician is an advantage.
  • Alternatively, you hold a degree in supply engineering, building services engineering, electrical engineering, energy engineering, facility management, or a comparable field.
  • You are highly organised and keep an overview at all times.
  • You are tech-savvy, enjoy working with computers, and are interested in new technologies.
  • You are a communicative networker who collaborates effectively with external contractors, suppliers, and colleagues across all trades.
  • You impress with your technical expertise and make well-founded organisational decisions.
  • With your positive presence, hands-on mentality, and can-do attitude, you like to get involved yourself and motivate your team.
  • Your engaging personality, can-do attitude, and hands-on approach are a natural part of who you are.
  • Your guest orientation and drive for performance inspire your team to achieve top results.
  • You speak German and English at least on a conversational level
  • You have a work permit for the EU/Germany

What Might Also Be Important To You…

  • You work in one of Munich’s most modern hotels with high-quality building technology and advanced technical systems.
  • You are part of a well-established engineering team and work closely with the Director of Engineering – challenges are solved together.
  • In addition to daily operations, you have the opportunity to actively shape processes, projects, and technical standards.
  • We value preventive maintenance rather than constant “firefighting” – so you can work in a structured and predictable way.
  • You will have a wide range of development and career opportunities within an international hotel group.

And This Is How We Inspire You....

Be part of the hotel team and contribute your ideas, concepts and imaginations!

  • An attractive, above-tariff remuneration for your flexible assignment in our hotel
  • Participation in our bonus program (based on annual income percentage)
  • Travel worldwide to our 10.000+ hotels at great employee conditions ("Explore Rate") and let yourself be pampered - by the way, this also applies to your family, partner & parents, for example.
  • Enjoy the culinary F&B offer in our 10.000+ hotels with 20% discount
  • Extensive corporate benefits with lots of discounts for leisure activities and travel
  • 20% extra pay for your work on public holidays
  • We will pay you an allowance for the job ticket/Germany ticket
  • As a birthday boy or girl, you get an extra day off to celebrate your birthday with your loved ones
  • Christmas and vacation pay according to the collective agreement, starting in the first year, without a waiting period (after the probationary period, pro rata for the year).
  • Your retirement provision is important to us and we will pay you not the usual 16% but 20% as an employer's contribution on top of the regular Hogarente if you convert your own remuneration.
  • Innovative training concepts that support you on your career path
  • Career opportunities and prospects in an international company
  • We offer you a wide range of free culinary delights in our staff restaurant.
  • We like to celebrate - and preferably with you! Whether team outings, employee celebrations, employee week, anniversaries, etc.... we can think of many reasons to celebrate you and your colleagues properly.
  • Your health is one of our priorities, which is why we provide you with comprehensive company medical care.
  • Tell us what we can do to make you happy! Each year, every employee gets to choose something from our elective benefits catalog. These could include
    • Membership subsidy for a sports & fitness provider
    • Shopping Card
    • Childcare subsidy
    • Extra allowance for retirement insurance
    • and much more

    (All benefit & bonus programs are subject to individual company regulations. Tax & Social Benefit laws apply and any tax deductions are being handled via payroll adjustments. There is no legal entitlement to the programs and the employer can adjust the offer at any time).

    Have we sparked your interest? Then apply here on MarriottCareers with your application documents as well as your salary expectations. If you have any questions, you can also contact us at RecruitingMunichCityWest@marriott.com. We look forward to hearing from you!

Introduction

Are you a high-energy, self-motivated individual excited about building a world-class travel brand in the Oceania market? Trip.com is seeking a dynamic Business Development Manager (BDM) for a 1 year contract to drive our property acquisition and growth efforts across Australia and New Zealand. This role is a "Hunter" position, primarily focused on onboarding standard hotels (3-star and above) and serviced apartments.  


In this Role, you’ll get to

  • Identify and target high-potential hotel partners, specifically focusing on independent properties and local chains (3-star and above).

  • Take responsibility for maintaining and growing Trip.com’s business presence in assigned Oceania markets.

  • A minimum of 2-4 years of working experience in sales and acquisition, preferably with a background from OTA companies or Hotel Revenue/E-commerce.  
  • Proven ability to generate and qualify leads, pitch value propositions, and close contracts with independent hotel partners (3-star and above).
  • Deep understanding of the Oceania hospitality landscape, including key competitors.
  • Strong logical thinking, data analysis capability, and a positive, enthusiastic team-player attitude.  
  • High level of adaptability in a rapidly changing business environment.

job.job_description:
About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.

Trip.com Group offers exceptional and comprehensive travel services, resources, and products across its platforms. We aspire to provide our 400 million+ customers worldwide with tools to plan and book their perfect trips.

We have more than 30,000 employees spread across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, and are actively expanding our global markets to grow and become the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands.


The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical Senior Product & Business Analyst to to help drive growth across our US & Canada markets. In this role, you’ll be the backbone of our strategy efforts—diving deep into financial performance, product funnels, marketing campaigns, and sales data to uncover insights that guide decision-making. As part of a small team and a growth market, you’ll flex across all aspects of the business, from P&L analysis to product optimization, ensuring we focus on the right opportunities and deliver impact. This role reports into the Director of Product & Marketing, US & Canada.


This is a hybrid role based out of Norwalk, CA.


In this Role, you’ll get to:

  • Analyze financial, product, and marketing data to identify trends, root causes, and growth opportunities.
  • Build dashboards and reports to track KPIs related to conversion, campaign performance, and profitability.
  • Translate complex data into actionable insights and clear recommendations for leadership and HQ product teams.
  • Collaborate with product, user research, and other cross-functional teams to support multi-channel, localization strategies.
  • Monitor competitive and market dynamics, providing data-driven input into strategic planning.
  • Drive business optimizations through structured analysis and timely performance diagnostics.


What you'll Need to Succeed:

  • 3-5 years of experience in product, business, or data analysis, preferable in travel or e-commerce. Experience in consulting or investment banking with strong analytical exposure also highly valued. 
  • Strong SQL, Excel, and data visualization skills (Tableau or similar).
  • Proven ability to extract data-driven and actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Results-oriented with strong ownership and curiosity to dig deep.
  • Proactive and growth-minded with a data-driven approach to continuously optimize strategies.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Business.
  • Mandarin is a plus.
  • Valid working permit/visa in the US (no sponsorship)

job.job_description:
当社は世界最大級の旅行予約サイト『Trip.com』を運営するグローバル企業の日本法人です。日本の観光施設を盛り上げるための企画から提案、契約まで携わります。


★アトラクション＆ツアー部署の具体的な仕事内容とは？

日本各地にあるテーマパークや観光施設、各種外国人向けの交通券などを仕入れ、『Trip.com』で販売をします。販売をスタートできたら、売上を伸ばすため、同時に各施設・サプライヤーの現在の問題点も解決できるように一緒に取り組んでいきます。集客を最大化することが重要なミッションですが、それと同時に地域の活性化などにも貢献できる、大変やりがいのあるお仕事です！


＜職務内容＞

  1. アトラクションおよび現地アクティビティ関連商品の開発と調達管理、サプライヤーとの関係維持、協力契約の締結および交渉を、会社の戦略および方針に基づき担当する。
  2. 観光局、関連団体、および社内部門と協力して、関連する市場計画を立案・実施する。
  3. 担当アクティビティのベストレート、在庫の獲得・維持。
  4. 定期的なマーケティングキャンペーンおよびプロモーションの連携を行い、売上の最大化を目指す。
  5. データ調査および分析（市場、製品、競合他社、価格、仕入れなど）
  6. 上司等からのその他の業務およびプロジェクトの実行


■アピールポイント

【Trip.comとは】

  • 会員数4億人以上を誇る世界最大のOTAです。アクティビティ、ホテル、航空券、鉄道など、旅行に必要なサービスが全てワンストップで揃うのが当社の強みです。
  • 世界規模でサービスを展開している当社ですが、特にアジア圏でのブランド力はピカイチ。グローバルな環境で、会社の影響力を肌で感じながら仕事をすることができます。




【具体的には】

  • 担当エリア内の遊び・体験商品の調査から提案、アフターフォローまで⼀連の業務を担います。

主な取り扱い商品：

・施設チケット（テーマパーク、遊園地、美術館など）

・交通系チケット（JRなど各鉄道会社のフリーパス、企画チケットなど）

・体験系商品（日帰りツアー、着物レンタル、マリンスポーツ、お料理教室など）

  • 営業業務だけでなく、マーケティングチームと密に連携しキャンペーンを実行するなど、幅広く活躍できます。
  • これまでの営業経験やスキルを思う存分発揮できる環境です。裁量権も大きく、主体性を持って働くことが可能。また、データ分析、マーケティング、ITなど新しいスキルを身に着けることもでき、キャリアアップも目指せます。
  • 社内では日本語、中国語、英語が飛び交っており、グローバルな環境で働くことができます。海外部署とのコミュニケーションも多数発生します。

例：チーム内のミーティングは日本語を使用。海外チームとのやりとりは英語、または中国語を使用します。

日本語6割、英語or中国語4割。


【仕事のポイント】

  • 施設との信頼関係を構築しながら、「どんなことをすればもっと集客できるのか？」「どんな商品ならインバウンドに向けて魅力的なアピールができるか？」と常に企画・提案をし、チーム一丸で目標に向かってコミットしていきます。
  • 多国籍なメンバーが在籍しているチームのため、グローバルな環境で成長することができます。

About Us

Founded in 1999 and listed on NASDAQ in 2003 and HKEX in 2021, Trip.com Group is a leading global travel service provider comprising of Trip.com, Ctrip, Skyscanner, and Qunar.

Across its platforms, Trip.com Group integrates travel resources from industry partners and helps travellers worldwide pursue the perfect trip with exceptional travel products and services.

We have four Customer Service Centres for Trip.com established in Japan, Korea, the UK, and the Philippines, providing 24/7 customer service in 19 different languages.

We have more than 30,000 employees scattered across 30 countries in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Oceania, striving to expand our global markets and aiming to be the world’s leading and most trusted family of online travel brands that aspire to deliver the perfect trip at the best price for every traveller.


In this role, you'll handle:

1. Expand and manage partnerships with international and local organizers, agencies, entertainment companies, and ticketing platforms, identifying scalable collaboration opportunities. 2. Lead co-marketing initiatives for large-scale events, including partnership negotiations, campaign planning, and execution to drive commercial results and brand impact.

3. Own end-to-end partnership projects, ensuring quality delivery, timeline alignment, and long-term partner satisfaction.

4. Act as the project PMO, coordinating closely with internal teams such as Marketing, Sales, and Product to ensure smooth execution.

5. Lead full-cycle commercial negotiations across various partnership models, managing risks and securing optimal business terms.


What you'll need to succeed:

1. At least 5+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, or marketing within the entertainment, sports, ticketing, or related industries.

2. Proven experience contributing to or leading large-scale international projects (3,000+ attendees) successfully delivered in Japan.

3. Strong industry networks within Japan’s event ecosystem, including agencies, promoters, organizers, ticketing platforms, or IP holders.

4. Excellent communication and coordination skills, with the ability to manage both external partnerships and internal cross-functional teams.

5. Strong market insight and business acumen, with the ability to create clear, impactful business decks and reporting materials.

6. Fluent Japanese is required for local market engagement and partner management, English and/or Mandarin proficiency is a strong plus for international coordination and cross-border projects.

Job Category Finance & Accounting

Location 8301 Hollister Ave, Santa Barbara, California, United States, 93117 VIEW ON MAP

Schedule Full Time

Located Remotely? N

Position Type Management

Pay Range: $112,000 - $145,000 annually

Bonus Eligible: Y

Job Summary

Function as one of the property’s financial business leaders supporting the property executive leadership team while executing much of the same daily work activities and responsibilities as directed by the Director of Finance and Accounting (DOFA), who is the strategic decision maker for the property and serves on the executive leadership team. The position is responsible for championing, developing and implementing the daily property-wide initiatives that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer and property associates. Financial expertise is critical to enable the successful implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives as directed by the DOFA, while maximizing the return on investment. In addition, this position contributes to the creation and execution of a business plan that is aligned with the property and brand’s business strategy and focuses on the execution of financial and accounting activities and the delivery of desirable financial results.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

  • 4-year bachelor's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; 2 years’ experience in the finance and accounting or related professional area.

OR

  • Master's degree in Finance and Accounting or related major; no work experience required.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Engaging in Strategic Planning and Decision Making

  • Develop strategy to improve profit, including estimating cost and benefit, exploring new business opportunities, etc.
  • Analyze information, forecast sales against expenses, and contribute to the creation of annual budget plans.
  • Compile information, analyze and monitor actual sales against projected sales.
  • Analyze difference between actual budget wages and forecasted wages for more efficient budget planning.
  • Identify the underlying principles, reasons, or facts of information by breaking down information or data into separate parts.
  • Think creatively and practically to develop, execute and implement new business plans.
  • Contribute to the creation of the annual operating budget for the property.
  • Provide analytical support during budget reviews to identify cost saving and productivity opportunities for property managers.
  • Implement a system of appropriate controls to manage business risks.
  • Verify a strong accounting and operational control environment to safeguard assets, improve operations, and profitability.
  • Analyze financial data and market trends.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of a comprehensive annual business plan which is aligned with the company’s and brand’s strategic direction.
  • Provide on-going analytical support by monitoring the operating department’s actual and projected sales.
  • Produce accurate forecasts that enable operations to react to changes in the business.

Leading Finance & Accounting Teams

  • Utilize interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocate sound financial/business decision making; demonstrate honesty/integrity; lead by example.
  • Communicate the strategic goals, the focus and the owner priorities to subordinates in a clear and precise manner.
  • Leverage strong functional leadership and communication skills to influence the executive team, the property's strategies and to lead own team.
  • Manage internal, external and regulatory audit processes.
  • Provide excellent leadership by assigning team members and other departments managers' clear accountability backed by appropriate authority.
  • Conduct annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Anticipating and Delivering on the Needs of Key Stakeholders

  • Attend meetings and communicates with the owners as necessary, understanding the priorities and strategic focus.
  • Understand and meet the needs of key stakeholders (owners, corporate, guests, etc.).
  • Advise the GM, Director of Finance and executive committee on existing and evolving operating/financial issues.
  • Communicate financial concepts in a clear and persuasive manner that is easy to understand and drives desired behaviors.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of cash flow and owner priorities.
  • Manage communication with owner in an effective manner when directed by the DOFA
  • Manage property working capital and cash flow in accordance with brand SOPs and owner requirements.
  • Facilitate critique meetings to review information with management team.

Developing and Maintaining Finance and Accounting Goals

  • Verify Profits and Losses are documented accurately.
  • Monitor all taxes that apply, validate that taxes are current, collected and/or accrued.
  • Submit reports in a timely manner, verifying delivery deadlines.
  • Develop and supports achievement of performance goals, budget goals, team goals, etc.
  • Improve profit growth in operating departments.
  • Review audit issues to validate accuracy.

Managing Projects and Policies

  • Generate and provides accurate and timely results in the form of reports, presentations, etc.
  • Reconcile balance sheet to verify account balances are supported by appropriate documentation in accordance with SOPs.
  • Validate the P&L is accurate (e.g., costs are properly matched to revenue, costs are recorded in the proper accounts).
  • Validate compliance with management contract and reporting requirements.
  • Verify compliance with standard and local operating procedures (SOPs and LSOPs).

Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities

  • Validate team members are cross trained to support successful daily operations.
  • Verify property policies are administered fairly and consistently.
  • Verify new hires participate in the department’s orientation program.
  • Confirm new hires receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.
  • Create appropriate plans which develop team members based on their individual strengths, development needs, career aspirations and abilities.
  • Conduct performance review process for employees.
  • Participate in hiring activities as appropriate.

Drive new business acquisition and consistently exceed revenue targets

Own the full sales cycle end-to-end — this is a 100% new business role

As Director of Sales & Marketing, I will fully comprehend the vision of Six Senses to help people reconnect with themselves, others and the world around them and our values of local sensitivity and global sensibility, crafted experiences, emotional hospitality, responsible and caring, fun and quirky and pioneering wellness.

Sustainability, Wellness and Out of the Ordinary experiences are at the core of everything we do at Six Senses. I will safeguard these pillars and its strategic planning and development and ensure all directives, practices and initiatives are implemented, embraced, adopted within the hotel.

Duties And Responsibilities

As Director of Sales & Marketing, I will assume full responsibility for the efficient operation of the Sales & Marketing department to provide exceptional products and services within brand operating standards. My key role is to drive the right business at the right price to ensure the resort achieves budgeted occupancy, rate and revenue.

The duties and responsibilities will include :

  • Write and implement the marketing plan, contracting, setting sales targets by segment and by client and prospect, undertaking advertising, sales, promotions and publicity initiatives, working with the revenue manager for setting rates, and directing the Sales & Marketing team.
  • Continually focus on revenue generation and profile building for our resort and spa and for Six Senses.
  • Constantly assess marketing strategies and tactics to remain relevant and effective.
  • Establish and deliver pre-established financial returns related to revenue generation, profitability and ROIC.
  • Operate the property consistent with all legal, statutory and financial requirements and documentation, reporting systems, contractual obligations, security and safety protocols, communications, product and service standards, host management practices and budgetary controls are implemented, reviewed and maintained to ensure the successful operation of the hotel.
  • Keep abreast of industry trends, market intelligence and competitor activity to continuously enhance the property's commercial performance.
  • Develop, implement and monitor the annual Sales & Marketing Business Plan aligned with the property's commercial objectives and long-term strategy.
  • Drive the right business at the right price to achieve budgeted occupancy, ADR, RevPAR and total revenue across Rooms, Food & Beverage, Spa, Meetings & Events and other revenue-generating outlets.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key luxury leisure, MICE, travel trade, corporate and strategic partners.
  • Attend industry trade shows, roadshows, client events and networking opportunities as a brand ambassador.
  • Monitor market benchmarks and competitor intelligence to proactively adjust pricing, segmentation and sales strategies.
  • Oversee all commercial reporting, including monthly performance analysis, forecasts, market share, production reports and strategic recommendations for ownership and executive leadership.
  • Prepare and present regular Month-End Reports summarizing commercial performance, key activities, achievements, challenges and action plans.
  • Create the Sales & Marking Budget
  • Ensure all departmental budgets, including payroll and operating expenses, are effectively managed while maintaining brand standards.

Qualifications

  • To execute the position of Director of Sales & Marketing, I must have the required qualifications, technical skills and experience in a similar role in luxury hotels with proven results and includes the following:
  • Possess a minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Marketing, or related field and five years total experience in hospitality or hotels sales and marketing setting, with direct supervisory experience over a sales team, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. More than five years’ experience in a senior sales and marketing role, preferred.
  • Fluent in English and French
  • Minimum five years' experience in a senior sales and marketing leadership position within luxury hotels or resorts.
  • Strong experience across Luxury Leisure, MICE, Corporate and Travel Trade market segments.
  • Established national and international luxury travel industry network.
  • Excellent commercial acumen with experience in budgeting, forecasting, pricing strategy and revenue optimization.
  • Proven leadership experience in managing high-performing commercial teams.
  • Strong analytical, negotiation and presentation skills.
  • Advanced knowledge of CRM, PMS, Revenue Management and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; French and additional languages are an advantage.
  • High degree of integrity, professionalism, discretion and strategic thinking.
  • I will maintain a thorough understanding of Six Senses in terms of guidelines, rules and regulations, brand and operating standards, facilities and services. European passport or valid Swiss work authorization

job.job_description:
Marketing & Culture Manager · £Competitive + Company Benefits · Full Time · Kings Cross


London sets the perfect stage for The Standard’s first European flagship and since opening in 2019, The Standard, London has firmly established itself as one of the capital’s most dynamic lifestyle hotels.


Set in King’s Cross within the hotel’s iconic brutalist building, The Standard brings its design-led, culture-driven, activation-heavy philosophy to the heart of the city. With 266 guestrooms ranging from snug Cosy Cores to terraced suites with outdoor bathtubs overlooking St Pancras Station. A constant programme of Happenings, from DJs and brunches to live music and cultural panels, the hotel has become both a neighbourhood fixture and an international destination.


Our Restaurants, Bars, and Rooftop terraces are legendary, and The Standard is known worldwide for nightlife and culturally relevant dining. Isla offers seasonal, produce-led menus on a serene garden terrace; Double Standard pairs American diner spirit with British pub classics; The Rooftop serves cocktails and hotdogs with panoramic London views; and Decimo brings bold Mexican Spanish cooking, mezcal, and skyline views via our iconic red-pill lift.


Together, these venues create a complex, high-volume, multi-outlet operation running from early morning through late night, welcoming hotel guests, London locals, and international visitors alike. In London, The Standard’s signature mix of playful, sophisticated, and unexpected hospitality continues to evolve, rooted firmly in the culture and energy of the city.


We are now looking for an experienced and Marketing & Culture Manager who will embody our Anything but Standard ethos and lead the continued growth of our incredible brand.


Your role:


As our Marketing and Culture Manager, you will support the Director of Marketing and Culture in the day to day running of the department, taking a leading role in the execution of all marketing, cultural and communications activity across both Rooms and Food and Beverage.


You will be responsible for translating strategy into action, ensuring that all campaigns, content, partnerships and activations are delivered to a high standard, on brand, and aligned with the commercial priorities of the hotel.


Working closely with the Director, Sales, Revenue and operational teams, you will take ownership of integrated marketing activity across the property, ensuring a cohesive approach across all touchpoints, from rooms to restaurants, bars and cultural programming. This is a hands on role requiring creativity, organisation and commercial awareness, with the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast paced environment.


What you'll be doing?

  • Leading the execution of integrated 360° marketing campaigns across Rooms, Restaurants, Bars and Happenings.
  • Bringing our programming calendar to life through compelling storytelling, creative briefs and seamless campaign delivery.
  • Managing our digital presence, content calendar, CRM communications, newsletters, paid media activity and agency relationships.
  • Building culturally relevant partnerships and collaborations while supporting influencer, VIP and media hosting.
  • Producing best-in-class content and marketing collateral through photoshoots, creative production and digital campaigns that stay true to The Standard brand.
  • Monitoring campaign performance, reporting on engagement and ROI, and identifying opportunities to continually improve our marketing activity.


This is not a ‘Standard’ Marketing & Culture Manager role so you will need to have serious stamina and passion; thrive in a high volume, high energy environment and able to work equally well both independently and as part of a team.


Do you have what it takes to be our Marketing & Culture Manager at The Standard, London?


While we take every detail of design and guest experience seriously, we do not take ourselves too seriously. ‘Standard People’ are at the heart of our brand; vivid, dynamic and engaging. We need a proactive self-starter and are ideally seeking an individual with a Marketing background in the Hospitality industry and other creative industries for at least 3-5 years at a managerial level.


All applicants must be eligible to live and work in the UK. Documented evidence of eligibility will be required from candidates prior to commencing employment.


If you think you have what it takes to be our Marketing & Culture Manager at The Standard, London we’d love to hear from you!


Benefits Include

  • Meals on duty
  • Pension Scheme
  • Life Assurance
  • Employee Rates across all participating Hyatt and Standard properties
  • In-house Experience Programme
  • F&B Discounts ranging from 25-50%
  • Recruitment Referral Bonus up to £600 gross
  • Tuition Aid Scheme
  • Season Ticket Loan
  • Medical Assistance (including online GP and Physio)
  • Employee Assistance Programme with Well-being service

Additional Information

Job Number26065203

Job CategoryFinance & Accounting

Location7750 Wisconsin Ave, Bethesda, Maryland, United States, 20814 VIEW ON MAP

ScheduleFull Time

Located Remotely?Y

Position Type Management

Pay Range: $182,100-$307,400 annually

Bonus Eligible: Y

Stock Package: Y

Expiration Date: 07/31/2026

Position Summary

The Vice President, Payroll will serve as the strategic business owner of Marriott’s payroll strategies, processes, and tools, and will leverage Marriott’s partnerships with AHS, UKG and other partner relationships as appropriate. This position will partner closely with Finance, HR and iT as well as other cross discipline leadership to review existing platforms, align on the strategy and execution of the Payroll platform, including technology, policies and business support as appropriate. As a member of Global Finance Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) Governance team, she/he will also have responsibility for managing the relationship with and ensuring the delivery of accurate and effective services by the Finance BPO Service Provider(s) to Payroll groups.

The Vice President, Payroll Services will function as the Payroll and Labor Scheduling systems and subject matter expert and serve as the primary point of contact for Payroll policies and related business processes, training and other deliverables. She/he will serve as a point of contact for Service Providers concerning the day-to-day delivery of services and monitor and review the Service Providers’ performance of the services in accordance with the existing and future corporate level agreements between Marriott International and BPO Service Providers.

The Vice President, Payroll Services collaborates with Finance, HR, iT and Legal, and the various Finance, HR and iT BPO Service Provider(s) to ensure that effective payroll, labor scheduling strategies are in place and executed in accordance with company requirements. The Vice President, Payroll Services must therefore be adept at managing and aligning competing priorities, tapping diverse sources of information, identifying appropriate solutions, anticipating challenges, and devising and executing approaches to deliver against current and future priorities.

EXPECTED CONTRIBUTIONS

  • Provides thought leadership in payroll to the organization. Unearths current and future needs and trends shaping business solutions to inform the evolution of innovative future payroll solutions for the enterprise.
  • Oversees the development and ongoing enhancement of payroll and processes that comply with legal requirements and support the business objectives.
  • Accountable for payroll and Atlas end to end processes; ensures that the Company has the right systems, processes and tools in the effective delivery of payroll and labor scheduling services; develops documentation to ensure process and role clarity; develops and maintains subject matter expert content and appropriate training for end users.
  • Partners with MVP, Global Accounting Services, key business and cross-discipline leaders, and key external partners (AHS, UKG, and others as appropriate) to develop payroll, labor optimization and disbursement strategies and create operational plans.
  • Chairs and establishes a Global Payroll Governance Council and other forums as appropriate with subject matter experts from Finance, AHS, HR, iT and Legal to develop a broader understanding of the end to end payroll processes and deepen relationships across disciplines; Council will tackle problems, develop business solutions and align on the enhancement and optimization of existing processes on a go forward basis.
  • Engages with the Executive US/Canada Payroll Council for policy change recommendations and investment approvals; partners with Co-Chairs to schedule meetings and set agenda.
  • Partnering with the MVP, Global Accounting Services validates that the Service Provider(s) and the Company follow contract terms and conditions, commitments, and notifications.
  • Provide advice and counsel to internal stakeholders regarding the scope and governance of services and the contract. Provide advice and counsel to the Service Provider(s) and support to internal stakeholders concerning questions and issues arising from the delivery of services.
  • Monitors and improves the quality of the relationship between Marriott and Service Provider(s). Develops processes and organization capability to execute relationship management processes. Operationalizes and manages relationship management processes. Collaborates with key stakeholder groups to validate the effectiveness of relationship management processes.
  • Establishes and maintains regular reporting and communication with key stakeholders regarding pertinent initiative activities and developments.
  • Leads and/or participates in RFP processes for third-party providers to support global payroll, labor scheduling and optimization as appropriate; participates in/contributes to contract negotiation efforts with third-party providers, where applicable.
  • Establishes and maintains strong, collaborative relationships with corporate and continent Finance, HR, iT and Legal teams to understand the business and ensure timely exchange of information. Provides ongoing advice and guidance to internal stakeholders concerning matters related to payroll and labor scheduling.
  • Leads and manages a team of experts and provides direction and guidance to meet established goals.
  • Manages budget for the department.
  • Participates in benchmarking and mark-to-market activities to stay abreast of trends and bring best-practices to Marriott’s model.
  • Contributes to achievement of team objectives and outcomes.
  • Champions excellence in business ethics and integrity, social responsibility, cross-cultural effectiveness, and associate engagement.
  • Performs other duties as assigned to meet business needs.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Key Talents And Experience

  • Minimum 10 years broad financial management experience in a global organization with increasing management responsibility.
  • Payroll knowledge is required, and labor scheduling and accounting experience preferred.
  • Strong business acumen and service orientation.
  • Knowledge of generally accepted finance and accounting policies, principles and controls.
  • Exhibits strong functional leadership and finance knowledge; able to leverage this strength to influence business team strategies and decisions.
  • Strategic thinker; processes information through a strategic lens and applies tenants of systems thinking/theory to issues/assignments.
  • Demonstrated ability to formulate creative solutions for complex business issues, mitigating risk and maximizing stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Strong qualitative and quantitative analytical skills; ability to take large volumes of complex information and present it in a clear and concise manner appropriate for senior management decision-making; uses data and a cogent problem solving methodology in decision making and impact assessment.
  • Able to orchestrate systemic change; initiates, supports and manages change within the organization, taking steps to remove barriers or to accelerate its pace.
  • Operates with a collaborative mindset to ensure that key stakeholders are considered, eliminating the need for duplicate systems; builds strong relationships to leverage information and insights to anticipate and respond to project risks; communicates well with project and other leaders; openly shares and does not withhold information.
  • Skillful negotiator in tough situations; able to sell ideas persuasively; settles differences and wins concessions without damaging relationships; can be both direct and forceful while remaining diplomatic.
  • Strong leader of people; able to create a compelling vision, demonstrate flexibility in approach, and motivate others to achieve desired results; able to work in a matrix organization and make things happen without having to own all the resources; leverages shared resources to achieve results.
  • Strong interpersonal skills; must be a successful “networker” and able to maintain effective relationships, both internally and externally with a broad group of stakeholders to foster trust and influence key decisions.
  • Communicates effectively, both orally and in writing; listens to others and effectively comprehends information; creates an environment allowing timely information flows throughout the organization.
  • Responsive; able to integrate and balance priorities, work activities and resources for the benefit of multiple key stakeholders.
  • Results oriented; delivers results under difficult conditions and demonstrates balanced judgment under pressure; able to assess, plan and get “the right priorities” done, on time and budget, at high quality levels; able to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Able to consistently make decisions in a timely manner sometimes with incomplete information and under tight deadlines and pressure; comfortable challenging organizational norms and accepted thinking to improve effectiveness.

Education and Professional Certification

  • Baccalaureate degree in Finance, Human Resources or related discipline required; MBA and/or CPA strongly preferred
  • 15 years of professional experience, including significant management responsibilities.

job.job_description:
Financial Controller |Hyatt Regency Newport Beach West

Job Description:

  • Plan, direct, and manage the provision of accurate, timely and objective financial data from which informed management decisions can be made. Recommend remedial action when and when necessary. Safeguard owner assets by creating and maintaining sound internal control systems. Participate in the total hotel management as a member of the hotel Executive Committee.
  • Support General Manager and Hotel Financial goals by direct preparation of monthly and annual reports; summarize and forecast hotel revenues, expenses and earnings based on the past, present and expected operations.
  • Must be able to apply mathematical operations to such tasks as frequency distribution, analysis of variance, correlation techniques, sampling theory, and factor analysis.
  • Negotiate and monitor contracts with hotel vendors!
  • Must be proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, ADP, MAS-500 and other applicable computer systems. Budgetary analysis capabilities required.
  • Ensure the collection and payment of applicable local, state, and federal taxes.
  • Advise management of desirable operational adjustments due to tax code revisions.
  • Arrange for audits of hotel’s accounts from local regulatory agencies and compliance audits from local union house. Must have a strong working knowledge of internal control procedures and implementation.
  • Prepare reports required by regulatory agency.
  • Work closely with General Manager, Asset Manager, and owner accounting representative at all levels of hotel operations concerning accounting functions and compliance with franchise and operating agreements.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Must possess a 4-year degree in Accounting/Finance and at least 2 years in accounting job with supervisory experience.
  • Preferably with hotel accounting background with knowledge of PMS and POS systems and reports.

Equal Opportunity Employer

job.job_description:
Vision et valeurs Six Senses:

En tant que Responsable Finance, vous comprenez pleinement la vision de Six Senses, qui consiste à aider les personnes à se reconnecter à elles-mêmes, aux autres et au monde qui les entoure. Vous incarnez les valeurs de la marque : sensibilité locale et ouverture au monde, expériences sur mesure, hospitalité émotionnelle, responsable et attentionnée, esprit « fun & quirky » et bien-être pionnier. En adoptant cette vision et ces valeurs, vous contribuez à offrir une expérience exceptionnelle aux voyageurs tout en accompagnant les Hosts afin qu'ils puissent exprimer tout leur potentiel.

Bien-être:

Vous adoptez, mettez en œuvre et protégez pleinement la philosophie du bien-être intégré de Six Senses ainsi que les programmes tels que Sleep With Six Senses, Eat With Six Senses et Grow With Six Senses. Vous veillez à ce que les initiatives liées au bien-être soient pleinement intégrées au sein du département Finance.

Développement durable:

Le développement durable est au cœur de l'identité de Six Senses. En tant que Responsable Finance, vous veillez au respect des directives relatives à la protection de l'environnement, à la réduction des déchets, au réemploi des ressources, aux achats responsables, aux emballages durables, à la suppression des plastiques à usage unique, à la responsabilité sociétale ainsi qu'à l'ensemble des pratiques définies dans les lignes directrices Développement Durable de Six Senses.

Responsabilités opérationnelles:

Vous êtes responsable de la gestion efficace de la fonction financière dans le respect des standards opérationnels de Six Senses. Vous assurez le pilotage des pratiques comptables de l'établissement et garantissez la production et la diffusion d'informations financières fiables auprès de la Direction, des différents départements, du siège (Home Office), des propriétaires et des partenaires.

Vos principales responsabilités sont les suivantes :

  • Assurer la gestion et le suivi de la politique de crédit de l'établissement.
  • Produire les rapports financiers destinés aux différents départements, au Directeur Général et au Directeur Régional Finance.
  • Participer à l'élaboration du budget annuel ainsi qu'au plan d'investissements (CAPEX).
  • Contrôler les résultats financiers et analyser les écarts par rapport au budget.
  • Superviser les opérations financières : demandes d'achats, bons de commande, comptabilité générale, paiements, caisse, paie, audits internes et externes et toutes autres opérations financières.
  • Identifier, analyser et résoudre les écarts comptables.
  • Collaborer avec le IHG Global Service Centre afin de garantir le respect des procédures financières et le traitement des opérations dans les délais impartis.
  • Travailler avec les propriétaires afin d'assurer la bonne priorisation, validation, comptabilisation et traçabilité des paiements.
  • Participer, avec le Global Service Centre et les propriétaires, à la répartition des résultats financiers entre les différentes entités juridiques.
  • Veiller à la mise en place de contrôles internes garantissant la conformité aux obligations comptables, fiscales et réglementaires.
  • Être l'interlocuteur privilégié des organismes externes : cabinet de paie, conseillers fiscaux, commissaires aux comptes, auditeurs et représentants des propriétaires.
  • Garantir le respect des standards de présentation, d'hygiène, de sécurité et des procédures d'urgence au sein du département.
  • Assurer une communication fluide entre les différents services afin de contribuer au bon fonctionnement de l'établissement.
  • Optimiser les coûts de personnel grâce à une planification efficace et une gestion optimale des ressources.
  • Préparer et transmettre l'ensemble des documents administratifs et réglementaires liés au département.
  • Produire l'ensemble des reportings financiers demandés par Six Senses, IHG France, le IHG Global Service Centre et les représentants des propriétaires.
  • Participer aux réunions de Direction et animer les réunions relevant de votre périmètre.
  • Réaliser toute autre mission confiée par votre hiérarchie

Vous adoptez en permanence une attitude professionnelle et exemplaire. Vous appliquez les principes, les valeurs, les procédures et les standards de Six Senses tout en favorisant un environnement de travail respectueux, collaboratif et multiculturel.

Entreprise Responsable:

Vous exercez vos fonctions dans le respect de l'éthique, de l'intégrité et de la réglementation locale. Vous veillez à la sécurité des voyageurs, des Hosts et des actifs de l'établissement conformément aux politiques de Six Senses et des propriétaires. Vous entretenez des relations constructives avec les partenaires externes et encouragez l'implication des équipes dans la vie locale et les initiatives communautaires

Responsabilités:

Vous êtes un manager impliqué, visible et proactif, doté d'excellentes capacités d'organisation et d'analyse. Vous êtes capable de prendre des décisions stratégiques et de contribuer durablement à la performance de l'établissement, notamment en matière de satisfaction client, d'excellence opérationnelle, d'engagement des équipes, de chiffre d'affaires et de rentabilité.

Profil:

Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme supérieur en finance, comptabilité ou d'une qualification équivalente, complété par une certification professionnelle en comptabilité.

Vous justifiez d'au moins quatre années d'expérience dans un poste similaire, idéalement au sein d'un établissement hôtelier haut de gamme ou de luxe.

Vous maîtrisez parfaitement la suite Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint et Outlook) ainsi que les principaux logiciels hôteliers (PMS, POS, CRM).

Vous possédez une excellente maîtrise de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. La connaissance de la langue locale constitue un atout.

Vous maintenez une parfaite connaissance des standards, procédures, politiques, installations, services et valeurs de Six Senses.

Informations complémentaires:

Les horaires et jours de travail sont définis en fonction des besoins de l'exploitation, de la saisonnalité et de la réglementation locale.

Le poste est évolutif et pourra être adapté afin de répondre aux besoins opérationnels de l'établissement. Des déplacements professionnels pourront être nécessaires pour participer à des réunions ou événements liés à l'activité.

Le poste peut être exercé partiellement à distance, mais une présence régulière sur site est requise, aussi bien pendant la saison que hors saison.

Reconnaissance:

Cette description de poste n'est pas exhaustive. Les missions peuvent évoluer en fonction des besoins de l'organisation. En acceptant cette fonction, vous reconnaissez comprendre les responsabilités qui y sont associées et vous engagez à accomplir l'ensemble des missions nécessaires au bon fonctionnement du département.

✦ Ce que nous offrons :

Un CDI avec:

  • Rémunération attractive avec valorisation annuelle de la performance
  • Hébergement possible si contrat hors télétravail
  • Place parking couverte au sein de la résidence
  • Environnement international et multiculturel
  • contrat en télétravail possible

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Premium Portfolio Brands will play a critical role in advancing cross-brand and portfolio-wide initiatives—helping to track, manage, and optimize a dynamic set of Premium & Endorsed brand management projects. This role sits at the intersection of brand strategy and execution, ensuring work across multiple brands is aligned, prioritized, and delivered with speed and impact. Scope encompasses fourteen brands – from our flagship brands (Marriott Hotels) to our emerging brands (Outdoor Collection).

This is an ideal role for a highly organized, strategic thinker who combines strong project management discipline with deep brand management expertise. The individual will flex across initiatives—stepping into priority projects, driving progress, and ensuring teams move seamlessly from strategy to execution.

Working closely with Global Discipline teams and Continent partners, this leader will act as a central connector—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to a complex portfolio of work.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Required

Education and Experience

  • Bachelors’ degree from an accredited college or university in Business Administration, Marketing, or related major
  • Five or more years’ relevant professional experience in brand strategy or management, operations, or project/program management ideally across multiple brands demonstrating progressive career growth and a pattern of exceptional performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver results under difficult conditions, particularly when faced with complexity and ambiguity.
  • Proven ability to lead complex projects and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong ability to manage complexity and drive clarity across a portfolio of work.
  • Highly organized with exceptional project management discipline—able to track, prioritize, and deliver against multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • Brings both strategic thinking and hands-on execution, with a bias for action.
  • Naturally collaborative and highly effective in matrixed, global environments.
  • Comfortable stepping into ambiguity and flexing across projects as business needs evolve.
  • Combines brand sensibility with operational rigor—understanding both the “what” and the “how” of great brand work.

Preferred

  • Experience in consulting, strategy, or transformation roles is a strong plus.
  • Prior Marriott experience
  • MBA degree

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

  • Drive Portfolio & Project Management Excellence
  • Manage and track a portfolio of brand management initiatives across multiple brands, ensuring clear priorities, timelines, and accountability.
  • Establish and maintain frameworks, tools, and processes to improve visibility, coordination, and delivery across projects.
  • Identify risks, gaps, and dependencies, proactively driving solutions to keep work on track.
  • Enable Cross-Brand & Cross-Project Integration
  • Support and connect work across brands to ensure alignment with broader portfolio strategies and shared objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to scale, streamline, or standardize approaches across brands.
  • Serve as a central point of coordination across initiatives, ensuring consistency and reducing duplication.
  • Step into and Advance Priority Projects
  • Flex into key strategic or operational projects as needed—providing both project leadership and brand expertise.
  • Drive progress on high-priority initiatives, bringing structure, clarity, and forward momentum.
  • Balance multiple workstreams, adapting quickly to shifting business needs.
  • Translate Strategy into Execution
  • Partner with brand leads to ensure strategies are clearly defined and effectively operationalized.
  • Turn complex ideas into actionable plans with defined milestones and deliverables.
  • Ensure brand work is delivered with rigor, speed, and quality.
  • Partner Across a Matrixed Organization
  • Collaborate closely with Global Discipline teams (Marketing, Design, Digital, Loyalty, CX) and Continent teams to advance key initiatives.
  • Act as a connector and influencer—facilitating alignment and driving decisions across stakeholders.

InterContinental Hotel Brisbane offers 319 spacious hotel rooms and suites, all day dining restaurant and lobby bar, outdoor pool, fitness centre and Club Lounge, all in a prime location above Queen Street Mall, perfect for exploring the city’s top attractions. With over 1800 square metres of meeting and events spaces, InterContinental Brisbane offers versatile function rooms and a Grand Ballroom catering for up to 1000 guests, making it a great choice for business and leisure events alike.

We are looking for a Casual Overnight Porter to join our Concierge team!

A little taste of your day-to-day

As an Overnight Porter, you’ll be a key figure in our overnight operations, offering seamless valet service, luggage assistance, and support to our Night Audit and Front Office teams. You are the first and last impression for late-night and early-morning guests - and your professionalism and attention to detail will help deliver the exceptional InterContinental experience.

  • Greet late-arriving guests with warmth, professionalism, and discretion
  • Provide valet parking service for arriving and departing guests (valid license required)
  • Assist guests with luggage, deliveries, or room transfers
  • Support the Night Audit and Front Desk teams with guest requests, room drops, and coordination
  • Monitor the front drive and lobby area for cleanliness, order, and guest needs
  • Conduct property walkthroughs and assist with security checks during overnight hours
  • Communicate effectively with other departments to ensure a smooth guest journey

What We Need From You

  • Prior experience in valet, bell service, or front office roles in a luxury hotel environment preferred
  • Valid open driver’s license (ability to drive automatic and manual vehicles)
  • Impeccable grooming and a polished, professional demeanor
  • Excellent communication and guest service skills
  • Physical fitness as you’ll be on your feet most of the day. Sometimes you’ll need to lift, push and pull objects, such as tables, up to 23 kg – we have the equipment to support you and keep you safe
  • A proactive attitude and ability to remain composed and courteous overnight
  • Availability to work overnight across a 7 day roster (available at least 4 nights per week)

What We Offer

You’ll be rewarded for your hard work with a range of benefits that supports you throughout your IHG career journey:

  • Free meals on shift
  • Laundered uniform supplied
  • Paid birthday leave - hip hip hooray!
  • Proactive paid wellness and mental health days
  • Some of the best colleague discounts across our IHG Hotels for accommodation

  • Most importantly, your career journey will be supported through our lifelong development programs, IHG career milestone celebrations, and transfer of leave entitlements as you move and grow with IHG.

What You Can Expect From Us

Not only will you benefit from a truly unique and career-defining opportunity as part of this exciting hotel opening, but you’ll receive a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work and a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life – including, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

Position Type Management

Bonus Eligible: Y

Job Summary

Manages the daily functions of the department to ensure protection of property assets, employees, guests and property. Maintains logs, certifications and documents required by law and Standard Operating Procedures. Trains staff in established emergency procedures and implements accident and fire prevention procedures. Position focuses on ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while achieving the operating budget.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education And Experience

  • High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the security/loss prevention or related professional area.

OR

  • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Criminal Justice or related major; 2 years experience in the security/loss prevention or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Security/Loss Prevention Operations

  • Assists the Director of Engineering in administering fire prevention programs and emergency preparedness.
  • Conducts hazard and risk assessments at the property to include quarterly OSHA/SAFETY audits, incident tracking, and the hazard abatement process.
  • Develops detailed "shut down" procedures for the property to ensure that all areas are secured at the appropriate times.
  • Comply with applicable laws and safety regulations.
  • Follow proper key control guidelines in loss prevention and in the property.
  • Develop a monthly checklist for all cctv equipment, alarmed doors, and duress alarms to ensure that they are fully functional.
  • Incorporate into patrols, which encompass all areas of the property's interior and exterior, an inspection tour of recording system.
  • Follow Duty of Care process for the protection of guests and employees.
  • Follows up on all unusual activities in and around the property that would impair the well being of guests and employees.
  • Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.
  • Implements action plans to monitor and control risk.
  • Monitors all unusual activities in and around the property that would impair the well being of guests and employees.
  • Oversees all loss prevention operations to include but not limited to patrol process, emergency response, investigations (initial & follow up) for all guest and employee related incidents, shipping and receiving process (makes recommendations for improvement), electronic key system and manager on duties responsibilities.
  • Oversees and guides the efforts of the Accident Prevention Committee.
  • Oversees first aid program for guests and employees.
  • Oversees the claims process and protects company assets by closely monitoring the General Liability and Worker's Compensation cases.
  • Communicates the importance of safety procedures, detailing procedure codes, ensuring employee understanding of safety codes, monitoring processes and procedures related to safety.
  • Emphasizes teamwork, close working relationships with other departments and assertive hospitality to serve as a deterrent to crime.
  • Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
  • Provides personal assistance, medical attention, emotional support, or other personal care to others such as coworkers, customers, or patients.
  • Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
  • Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

  • Meet quality standards and customer expectations on a daily basis.
  • Identifies the educational needs of others, developing formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaching or instructing others.
  • Inspects and critiques the performance of the loss prevention department to establish and maintain a high level of professionalism and customer service.
  • Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
  • Develops liaison with local law enforcement and emergency services.
  • Informs and/or updates the executives and peers on relevant information in a timely manner.
  • Provides information to supervisors and co-workers by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

job.job_description:
Role Purpose

A WFM professional that provides Operational WFM analytical support and consultative guidance around established WFM processes and procedures. Enabling and educating the Operational Teams on the proper use of established WFM policies and procedures to assist in leading the Operational Teams to optimize costs, revenue delivery, and guest experience. Providing Operational support in three key areas: 1. Real Time Management, 2. Customer Service, and 3. Business support to ensure the business achieves Key Performance Objectives and established targets. Empowered to make business decisions using the tools, insights, and resources available, enabling the Operational teams to deliver on Operational Key Performance Objectives. Ensuring all WFM processes and procedures are following the IHG business, local regulatory, and audit requirements while working within the established customer service and service level agreements.

Key Accountabilities

  • Real Time Call Performance Monitoring - Monitor agent and queue performance to ensure adherence to all applicable KPOs and targets. Managing agent schedule adherence and tracking same day exception codes. Communicating to operational teams any non-adherent schedule occurrences along consulting with Operations when KPOs or targets are not being achieved.
  • Customer Service - Maintain a consistent, high quality customer-focused orientation. Listen to and communicate with customers to obtain all required information necessary to determine and address their specific needs. Respond to individuals in the manner and time-frame promised or follow-up to explain status. Provide clear, accurate information. Explain procedures and materials, providing necessary training around Workforce Management processes and systems. Anticipate and resolve problems or questions; if service cannot be provided, explain and educate business need.
  • Business Continuity - Serve as the contact center hub for the Reservations Operations and Customer Care operations, providing triage, escalation, and communication support for emergencies and system outages
  • Business Support – Reporting and Analytics as necessary for WFM reporting or metrics including charts, presentation data, or logs, researching root cause analysis and reasons “why” KPOs or targets were not achieved. Collaboration with the Operational Teams, Global Workforce, Global Planning, and any other functional support group to align service level objectives, answer inquiries within service level agreements, and any ad-hoc data as requested. Communicate, answer, and process all WFM inquiries from internal and external contacts in a timely manner.
  • Staff Schedules – Completion of staff schedules in an efficient, accurate, and timely manner. Liaising directly with the Global Workforce Management on any outstanding staffing or scheduling issues. Posting Extra Hours or AWOP availability to ensure alignment between staffing and business requirements. Preparing and providing accurate schedule management and methodology ensuring everything is conducted and completed in accordance with WFM scheduling calendars. Distribute Schedules to employees upon final completion.
  • Payroll – Reporting accurately on all Schedule Exceptions and provide correct details (hours worked) to Payroll Department for further processing.
  • Ability to cover WFM or Center hours of operation, including holidays
  • Any additional duties or projects as assigned within the scope of the WFM Team
  • Basic troubleshooting to accommodate for work from home agents with technical issues.

Key Skills & Experiences

Education

High School diploma or Associate Degree in Business Administration or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.

Experience

1 to 3 years of business experience in Call Center and/or workforce management environment systems, terminology and processes. Genesys or WFM System experience preferred

Technical Skills and Knowledge

  • Excellent team working skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication and customer service skills with internal/external customers, supervisors, peers and management for the purpose of obtaining and conveying information, as well as producing reports and internal memorandums.
  • Demonstrated computer skills with an emphasis in spreadsheet and document creation.
  • Demonstrated knowledge or ability to learn workforce management system used to schedule and track call center agent activities.
  • Basic analysis skills and experience with problem solving – Ability to identify a problem, analyze the issues, trending, and be able to make a sound business decision.
  • Maintain a high level of knowledge pertaining to policy and procedure and communicate knowledge effectively to all personnel when applicable.
  • Basic trouble shooting knowledge to help WFH agents.
